And the longer it takes to make this decision, the more Bumrah will feel anxious. He's bowled a pretty decent ball - shortish and outside off, drawing Rashid into playing away from his body. The outside edge is pouched by Kohli. But all to no avail as it is called no-ball.
goes short and at the body, Rashid  works it away to fine leg
short and on middle, Rashid blocks
short and outside off, Rashid slaps it through point. He's timing em beautifully. And there's plenty of space out there. It's the slips that are packed with people.
goes for the bouncer to end the over. Rashid plays a hook which really was never going to come off
beats the outside edge with Broad stuck in the crease despite Pandya bowling pretty full and outside off
back of a length on off stump, Broad keeps a little leg side of it and pushes to mid-off
full and outside off, Broad drives to mid-off
bouncer, down leg though, Broad ducks underneath
goes short and angles it across the left-hander. Broad almost ducks into the line of the ball. For a second or so, he was in danger of getting a proper clang on his helmet
short on middle and leg, Broad taps it down to short leg
back of a length on off stump, blocks to cover
flirts with a shortish delivery outside off and is beaten
full on off stump, Rashid gets his bat down in time
throws his bat at this - loving the width on offer - and hammers the back of a length ball to the cover boundary
goes around the wicket and keeps bouncing him, but Rashid is more than happy to take it on. Hooks to deep square leg
lunges at a length ball outside off, looking to smash it through extra cover. No luck

whips it with absolute class to the square leg boundary! This man has first-class hundreds. Plenty of them and he's showing just why. What a flick of the wrists. There's some fight left in this yet...
full and outside off, Rashid goes after it, and is comfortably beaten
searches for a wide one outside off, playing cover drive after cover drive, but he's beaten again
he's playing around his front pad as he tries to glance a full and straight delivery down to fine leg. No contact with bat. Would have gone down leg after if it hadn't struck pad
full on off stump, Rashid keeps it out
beauty. Rashid slinks towards leg, defending from the crease and is no match for the back of a length delivery holding its line and almost sailing right over off stump
shortish and outside off, glides it to backward point
that bat whirls over the short ball outside off and sends it screaming to deep square leg
goes around the wicket for a fullish delivery on leg stump, Broad tries to clip it away, but it comes off the pad instead

dropped by Kohli, but this ball is travelling, which happens when Rashid is swinging without a care in the world. Sees a full ball outside off and throws his hands at it. The edge flies to the right of third slip and bursts through the hands
slaps a shortish delivery outside off through point
bangs it in short and wide, Broad thinks about cutting, but then lets it go
goes short, keeping it just outside off, Broad drops his wrists to make sure he survives
swings it away to the fine leg boundary as Ishant keeps going short
clears the front leg and pulls the banged-in delivery away to the midwicket boundary. He's expecting these. He's set up for there. And he's clattering these. At least when they come at ishant's pace
backs away, exposing his stumps, and they are only just left standing as Ishant pitches it on a good length and targets them
slides it down the leg side and Pant isn't quite able to gather it because of the wobble
clears that front dog and goes bang at a good length ball outside off. Only an inside edge onto pad results
ducks in sharply off the seam as Shami hits the deck outside off. Broad manages to tap it to cover
goes full and straight, Broad continues moving to leg and drives to mid-off

slower ball outside off, Broad carves it away to the point boundary and Shami flashes a totally bemused smile, as if he is wondering how this is all happening, wondering how this England batting tallies with the one that keeps losing four wickets in a clump
pushes forward to block outside the off stump, but this delivery, the undercutter, just goes straight on, past the edge
good length ball on off stump, Rashid pads up
breaks away from the right-hander. The one with the seam up, delivered with just one finger behind the ball. Rashid leaves it
lunges forward to the tossed up delivery on off stump and blocks
there's the outswinger again and it's epic! Angled into the right-hander, pitching on middle, as Anderson is known to do, then curls away so insanely that it misses the outside edge and the stumps
half an appeal for lbw as Broad shuffles across to flick the back of a length delivery through midwicket. Umpire Gaffaney thinks it would be going down leg
bouncer, angled into the left-hander. Broad ducks under it
shortish and outside off, Broad lets it go
good length on middle, Broad defends
full and outside off, doesn't bother with it
goes for the yorker, swinging into Broad from outside off, but the left-hander does well to keep his eyes on the ball, get in position deep in his crease and slice it behind point
good length offbreak outside off, Broad lets it go
spears in the arm-ball, swinging into the left-hander. Broad defends tentatively and gets an inside edge through midwicket. And that's the fifty partnership!
he's dealing almost exclusively in outswingers to the right-hander. Rashid drives to mid-off
tosses it up - think this one's the offbreak though - and Rashid gets forward to block
good length offbreak, which Rashid reads well, goes back and nudges it towards leg slip, who then moves to short leg
loops it up on middle, Rashid keeps it out
good length, on the pads, Broad tries to flick, doesn't make contact, but his pad does

taken at second slip, and this time, it is five for Bumrah! Pitches the new ball up, on middle, has the left-hander squared up because of the angle. Broad has to defend. The ball takes the outside edge. Rahul is waiting at second slip. How many catches does he have now? Seven, I hear. Meanwhile, Bumrah's leading India towards a dominant Test win, and along the way, he puts his finger on his lips looking at a part of the crowd that is screaming no-ball
shuffles across and follows a short ball angled across him. Lucky not to nick off

bouncer, and Anderson chooses to stay in line with it and block. That decision causes the No. 11 a bit of pain though because it strikes him on the left hand. Hard. Then clatters over to hit his grille
full and outside off, Anderson keeps to his crease and steers the ball to cover
back of a length and outside off, lets it go
fends it away over the keeper - Anderson doesn't really know too much about this short ball from around the wicket, coming right at his throat. Shami's mean. Very very mean
skids in off a good length from outside off. Anderson gets stuck on the pads - but it would be going down leg - and just to be sure, he kicks the ball away before it rolls onto his stumps
full and outside off, Anderson drives to cover and finds a single
good length, outside off, no shot
full and straight, Rashid does really well to get his bat down in time
nearly as Shami keeps searching for the off stump. This one even gets a tinge of away swing to confuse Rashid. He's playing inside the line - playing the angle - and gets an outside edge to point
good length on middle, Anderson shuffles a long way across and tucks it to midwicket
full and outside off, Anderson smears it to cover
beats the edge and I suspect it's the inside one. Anderson is basically hoping his bat intervenes with this full delivery on and around off stump. The ball only just misses the sticks
back of a length and outside off, Anderson wafts and misses
turns a back of a length delivery on middle and off to backward square leg or maybe a deep leg gully
full and straight. Anderson keeps it out
stands tall and thumps a back of a length delivery outside off away to the point boundary. A fine shot to bring up England's 300.
zips past the outside edge as Shami hits the deck and gets the ball to hold its line. Rashid tries to defend. No such luck
full and tailing into the right-hander, Rashid manages to keep it out
waits on it neatly and clips it away to the midwicket boundary. Fine little flick of the wrists and warm applause greets it as it scuttles away
short and outside off, Rashid lets it go
full and swinging away very late too. Rashid keeps his shape and ensures the game goes on
drifter, pitches on middle and leg, Anderson defends off the front foot and gets an inside edge to long leg
loopy delivery, a shade outside off. And it dips sharply on the right-hander. Rashid covers it well though
this seems like the outswinger, full and straight and moving away. Rashid blocks
bouncer, right at Anderson's chest. And the tailender just about evades it
shortish on middle, Anderson defends
turns a full delivery on middle away behind square leg to get off strike
looks for the yorker, just misses his mark, which is why Rashid is able to get forward and block
strides nicely forward to block this full length ball on off stump and that's the day
length ball close to off stump, gets a stride forward and defends to backward point
bouncer, bounces loopily, tennis-ball style, over the ducking batsman and down into the keeper's gloves

another bouncer, at a pretty gentle pace. Starts outside leg stump - Anderson moves his back out of the way - and then swings late just as it approaches Pant, leaving him on the ground as he just about manages to grab onto it
length ball wide of off stump and Anderson has a flash and a miss
back of a length close to off stump, goes back and across, deep in his crease, to defend, and misses. The angle beats his edge and the ball hits his back thigh
fullish, slanting away from off stump. Anderson goes back and across again to defend, and misses by a long way

length ball, straightens late towards the top of off stump. This is a good ball, and Rashid plays a lovely shot, gets on the front foot, head over the ball, to clip it away to the right of mid-on. Ashwin gives stately chase - I don't think he's fully fit, and probably shouldn't be on the field
back of a length close to off stump, defended into the point region
back of a length, close to off stump, gets nicely back and across to defend towards short extra-cover
digs it in short, angles it down the leg side. Pant dives left to collect after Rashid misses the hook
nice length, gets a bit of shape away in the fourth-stump channel. Defended into the covers
another bouncer, loses a lot of pace off the pitch as it rises up along the fourth-stump corridor. Waits an age and then bunts it down to backward point

tossed up fairly wide of off stump, stretches out and squeezes it away behind point. Ishant gives leisurely chase, willing the ball to roll past the boundary and keep Anderson on strike. It comes to a stop a meter from the rope
flat length ball outside off, defended off the front foot
floats this one out of the front of the hand, ends up down the leg side, past Rashid's attempted sweep
this one's flighted just outside off and Rashid sweeps again, with the turn, to long leg

is that it? It is. Ashwin takes the last wicket with a legbreak. Shortish outside off, turns sharply into Anderson and gets big on him as he makes room to cut. Ends up gloving it up over the slips, and Rahane backtracks from first slip to take the simplest of catches
aggression first up! Floated on off stump, shimmies down the wicket, and slogged over mid on's head
full on off stump, driven down the ground to cover

The bails are dislodged, but what's happened here? No one really knows. Sarfraz and Nawaz are celebrating though. Good-length ball on off stump and zipping straight through. Akmal's beaten for pace, and yes, the ball brushes past the outside of off stump. Goes for a golden duck
full on leg stump, and Smith misses his front-foot defense. Hits his front pad, but would've gone down leg
full on off stump, makes room opening his stance, and tapped to mid off
fuller ball to end the over. Pitches on off stump, and straightens. Forces the batsman to go deep, and defend
full on off stump, bunted back down the ground with minimal footwork
slashes hard at it, but over cover point! Risky, but lands just beyond the fielder. Full outside off, and gave it a wild heave. Not the best of connections from DR
full on off stump, driven hard down the ground, but only to mid off

cuts him in half! Good length on off stump, and tails inwards. Goes between his bat and pad, and through to the keeper. Dips as it goes to Sarfraz. Could've easily taken the top of off stump. Beautiful delivery
back of a length just outside off, stands tall and blocks off the back foot
good length outside off, tries to pull, but the ball does rise high enough. Bottom-edges his leg-side shot towards square leg
full on off stump, prods forward and defends back to Nawaz
full on middle stump, angles inwards, but Smith's up to the challenge. Defended
full on off stump, big wind up from Smith and slogged towards the leg side. Smacked over midwicket, but doesn't have the legs to go all the way
full on middle stump, big stride forward and defended towards the off side

full on off stump, another wild heave from Smith this time. Just about enough behind that slog to take it over mid off. Couple of bounces and into the boundary. On another day, he would've holed out to the fielder
big appeal for lbw, but the umpire's not interested. Full on middle and Smith misses the sweep. Hits his front leg, but would've gone down the leg side
full just outside off, takes a few steps down the ground tapped to mid off
back of a length outside off, stands tall and punches off the back foot to point. They scamper across
back of a length outside off, flat-batted back past the bowler to mid on. The fielder races to his left and intercepts
slower ball on middle stump, deceives the batsman, who misses the leg-side flick. Hits his pad and through to point
good length on middle stump, slower ball again and Smith plays at it with hard hands. Can only mistime it back towards the non-striker
full on off stump, pushed towards the leg side, but no chance of a run
good length on middle stump, stays on the back foot and flicked towards square leg
good length on middle and leg, can only punch it back to Nawaz. Cramped for space
good length on off stump, backs away towards the leg side and that's enough room for him to free his arms. Pulled over cow corner! Punished for bowling just a bit short
two in a row! Fuller ball on middle stump, but Smith predicted that length. Huge stride forward and muscled over the bowler's head. Falls 10 metres over the boundary
full on middle and leg, slightly flatter this time. Defended towards cover
good length on middle stump, uses his wrists to flick off his hips to the man deep on the leg side
good length on off stump, opens his bat's face and pokes it towards point. Slight misfield by the man there
good length outside off, plays the late cut this time. Runs it down to third man for a walking single
full just outside off, but it's the offcutter this time. Angles away from Smith after pitching. He tried to muscle this over the bowler's head, but can't connect at all
yorker on middle stump. Does well to get his front foot out of the way and squeeze it towards cover point. Quick!

play-and-a-miss to end the Powerplay. Good length on off stump and Hafeez came charging down the ground. Tries to drag it towards the leg side, but the ball goes under his bat. Just about misses the top of middle stump

tossed up outside off, Smith tries to slog it over Hassan, and just about manages to get enough behind it. Toe ends it, but powerfully played. Those big arms allow it to fall beyond the long-off boundary
slapped! Tossed up slightly wider outside off, but Smith's up to the challenge. Down on one knee and slog-sweeped over cow corner. He's on a roll!
drops his length now. Good length wide outside off, Smith goes deep and punches to mid on
good length on middle stump, makes some room towards the leg side and punched towards cover
full on off stump, angling inwards and driven past the bowler's left
back of a length outside off, mistimes his back-foot punch to long on. He'll keep strike
full outside off, driven with the bat's open face past cover. Starts off with a slower ball
good length on leg stumps, can't flick it towards the leg side. Hits him high on the front leg
good length on middle stump, inside-edges his back-foot punch towards square leg
full on leg stump, comfortably clipped off his toes to fine leg
short outside leg stump, and soars over his head. No call from either umpire and Hafeez has some words to say
good length on middle stump, angling across his body as he tries to slash hard at it. Goes just past the outside of his bat and through to Sarfraz. That's also the fifty partnership
good length on middle stump, and pulled furiously over cow corner! Nawaz the man in the deep, but he has no chance. Flew off the bat! Phew
full outside off, driven uppishly, but comes off the bat's top half. Soft catch at cover. Misses out on the half century
good length just outside off stump, prods forward and taps it towards cover
full on middle stump, angling into him, flicked off his pads to midwicket
back of a length outside off, and it's a slower ball. Goes over Wessels' shoulders and through to Sarfraz
full on off stump, angles into the batsman. Turned off his pads towards square leg on this occasion
full on off stump, and angling across. Driven inside out over mid off, and lands just inside the long-off boundary. Full swing of the bat, and nothing else really. Excellent from the prof
good length on middle stump, tiptoes and turns it off his hips to deep midwicket
full outside off stump, walks across towards the off side and driven to cover point
outswinging yorker on middle and off. Dug back to mid off, but the non-striker wants the run. Mix-up, but he's quick to turn back. Could've been close
good length on middle stump, nudged off his pads to square leg. Wessels wants the second, but Hafeez says no
short on middle stump, goes onto the back foot, and swivels to deep midwicket. Only a single for that beautiful looking shot
drifting in short on middle, he makes room and punches this to sweeper cover
turns this from middle and leg towards square leg
steps out and launches this hit over long-on. Didn't get to the pitch of the delivery but went through with the stroke. Mishit to be honest, but somehow he's lucky to see this sail over.

crunching cut shot. Too short, he rocks back, makes room to open up the off side and gives this a trash. The length was a result of the batsman stepping out off the previous delivery. Poor effort from Rahat at deep point
turns this into the leg side as they scamper a legbye
hint of width outside off, steers this down to square third man
looks to hoick this but can only hit it as far as Shane Watson at midwicket. Watto nearly dropped that. Somehow recovered to take it on the second attempt.
swivels back and pulls this short ball into the gap at deep backward square leg, the non-striker was halfway down the pitch for the second when he was sent back
short ball that gets stuck into the pitch, was through with the pull early. This hits him on the body.
floats this full on middle and leg, turned to midwicket
length on middle and leg, tucked towards deep backward square leg
cleverly done. Walks across to pull but ends up dabbing this down to third man as he sees Watson bang this short ball way outside off
too full on the pads, he walks across the stumps and whips this to deep square leg
sashays down the pitch and then carves this full delivery to Rahat at deep point. This just flew off the blade

flies off the edge to backward point. Done in by the extra pace and bounce. This just took off to hit the top part of the bat as Khushdil tried to defend. Initially looked to pull but got done in by the surface.
gets into position quickly and pulls this short ball to deep midwicket
gets the direction completely wrong. Ends up spraying this way down leg, good take by the keeper.
slower and fuller outside off, he looked to heave this from way outside off and ends up dragging it towards square leg
is he giving catching practice or what? Pulled from outside off to midwicket. The short ball didn't really arrive, he didn't time it well either. Peshawar sliding
sparkling drive but straight to mid-off

this is a sensational inswinging yorker that was honed in towards Sammy's left toe. He just manages to squeeze it out but in doing so, the ball could've so easily bounced onto the stumps. Sammy has the presence of mind to kick it away too.
short and wide outside off, Sammy lets this go assuming it'd be called wide. Umpire reckons it's fine.
drilled to the deep extra cover fence. Too full, he had room as he got to the pitch and gave this a whack
shapes to cut but is beaten by sharp turn. Wasn't all that short either

shapes to play a reverse sweep but the ball drifts in, straightens and hits him on the thigh. Height not in question really. The only thing that would've saved him was a thin inside edge. There's a very, very small spike but the only thing it can come in contact is the bat. So he will get away with it. Decision overturned
backs away and slaps this short ball to cover
belts this waist-high full toss over mid-off. Swatted that away disdainfully
straight, full and into his swinging arc. This has been deposited into the second tier, way over long-on. Didn't try to hit it hard, the timing - simply incredible
eases this short delivery to deep cover
slower length ball on off stump, eased wide of cover
walloped across the line and gets this over deep midwicket. He dragged this from outside off but still managed to get enough wood on it.
drills this full delivery down to long-on
makes room to go over the top, Laughlin follows him and bowls a toe-crusher, dabbed into the leg side for a single
pulled behind square, beats the man at deep backward square leg. Too short, too slow and this was sitting up nicely
swing and a miss. Looked to pull but was through the stroke way too early
right into the blockhole, leaves Sammy having no option but to simply block and run. This was right towards his toe
scooped over short fine leg. Too predictable the length this time. Walked across and simply ramped this away
tries to reverse paddle a low full toss, this tailed in to hit him on the pad but off the pad. There was an appeal for lbw but it wasn't given. Quetta reviewed but the decision can't be reversed.
super yorker, tailing in to leave him no option but to jam his bat down. Sammy gets a thick inside edge to the fine leg boundary
whips this to short fine where Watson pulls off a fine stop
down on one knee as he squeezes the drive straight to mid-off
good length outside off, spinning away from him. Cut to point
off to the deep point boundary! Cut away
good length on off stump, backs away and carves it to point. They race across for the run
good length on off stump once again, tapped to cover point this time
full on middle stump, driven straight back to the bowler
full on off stump, big stride forward and driven to mid off
back of a length outside off, angling into the batsman's body. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
back of a length outside off, goes deep onto the back foot and punched past cover. No stopping that!
carbon copy! Same ball, good length outside off, and comfortably punched off the back foot past point. Shifts all his body weight onto the back foot and carves it thereafter
good length on off stump, goes onto the back foot, and tapped to midwicket
good length on middle stump, shuffles across to the off side and flicks to deep backward square
back of a length outside off stump. Extra zip off the surface this time, and soars over the batsman's attempted pull. Through to the keeper
full on off stump, swinging away from the batsman. Mistimes his front-foot drive to mid off
good length wide outside off, tries to cut but the ball goes over his bat. Nice carry through to the keeper. Misses out on this ball that had some extra width
good length on off stump, backs away and flat bats it towards the non-striker. Off the bat's top half
good length on off stump, angles into Watson with the batsman backing away. Carved away to cover
full on off stump, tries to line the leg-side flick, but misses the shot completely. Off his bat and onto his pads
good length on off stump, punched off the back foot to cover point
good length on middle stump, Watson shuffles across to the leg side, and taps to midwicket
full on middle stump, goes onto the back foot and drags a leg-side heave towards deep midwicket
good length on middle and off, bunted back to the bowler off the back foot
good length wide outside off, goes onto the back foot and cuts hard. Powerfully played, and uses his wrists well to play it between cover point and point
good length, but wide outside off. Turns into him. Cut to cover point. No run this time
full on off stump, down on one knee and smacked over cow corner! What a hit. Soars over the man positioned there
the extra pace earns him the wicket! Quick and short outside off, tails into Shafiq, and his leading edge goes straight to cover. Soft dismissal
good length on off stump, goes onto the back foot and defends back to Hasan
full on off stump, walks down the wicket and drives down the ground. Hit well, and chase for mid off. Retrieves it though
good length outside off, mistimes his drive to cover, but that lack of speed allows them to scamper across for the quick run
full on off stump, it's the slower ball, and his leg-side heave is played too early. Manages to hit it, nonetheless, and drags his shot to deep backward square
good length on off stump, shuffles across to the off side and nudges it to Wessels at deep backward square
full on off stump, defended off the front foot. Pinged to cover
full on off stump, angles across him. Tries to drive inside out but can't connect. Through to the keeper
yorker on middle stump, dug back to Wahab Riaz. Well managed
falls just beyond short fine leg! Short on middle stump, and pulled over the infield. Top edged, really, but enough behind that to trickle down to the boundary
full on off stump, tries to drive away from his body, and inside edged towards the leg side. Played that shot down the wrong line
full on off stump, driven to mid on. No run. Minimal footwork from the batsman
back of a length on off stump, goes deep onto the back foot and carved to cover point
full on off stump, tries to tee off down the ground, but mis-hits it. Off the bottom of his bat, and through to the man at long on
thumped over cover! Full and wide outside off, manages to get under this delivery and smacked over the infield. No one bothered moving there
back of a length outside off stump, rocks back and pulls over midwicket. Falls between wide long on and deep midwicket. Excellent placement
full outside of, and spins inwards. Tries a slog-sweep towards the leg side, but mistimed to deep midwicket
short on middle stump, muscled off the back foot to deep midwicket. He'll keep strike
good length on off stump, tries to muscle this over to the leg side, but mistimed. Once again to the man in the deep

there's the big wicket! Short on middle, and Watson walks across to the off side to try and paddle this fine. Can't hit it well enough, and it's a feather touch that goes to the keeper's left. Soft dismissal
tests him with the short ball first up. Lands on middle stump and soars over his head. Tried to pull, but nowhere near that shot
good length on off stump, walks across to the off side and covers his stumps. Defended off the back foot
low full toss on off stump, tapped back by Rameez. Off the bat's toe end
back of a length outside off, tailing into him. Punched off the back foot to cover point
good length on off stump, defended off the back foot to cover
full on off stump, slaps this past the vacant cover area to the man in the deep. Only a single
good length on middle stump, flicked off his pads to deep midwicket
just over long on! That was full on off stump, and he walks down the wicket and smacks it over the bowler's head. Excellent sound off the bat
another one! DJ Khaled would be proud of that. Full on off stump, and this time the six is muscled over long off! Simply the full followthrough of the bat
good length outside off, backs away and cut to point
KP's walking! The bowler has the last laugh. Good length outside off, and this one zips straight through. Pietersen tries to cut, but he's edged it
full on off stump, smacked down the ground to long off
good length on off stump, spins into the left-hander. Tapped to midwicket
full outside off, spinning inwards and it's reverse swept! Beats short third man, and no stopping that!
good length on off stump, cramps him for room. Punched towards the non-striker
short and wide outside off, walks down the ground and smacks it to deep midwicket
ends the tenth with a maximum! Full outside off, and he meets the ball on the full. And lifts it - inside out - over cover. Terrific shot to end the over
there's an appeal for lbw but this one rolls off the back thigh to third man. Looked to play the short arm jab but was beaten for pace
length on off, slices this down to third man
chance at the non-striker's end, but Wahab misses. Once again beaten for pace as he looks to work this to the leg side. Legbye taken
delicately done. So typical of Sarfraz. Smart batting. Hint of width to this delivery angling away, he uses the pace to simply dab this past the keeper and beats short third man.
crisp drive to deep cover point
drifting into middle and leg, tucked to midwicket
down on one knee as he sweeps this fiercely on the bounce to deep midwicket
tossed up on middle, he lunges forward and defends this into the off side

shapes to sweep and gets into an ugly tangle as the ball strikes him full but the impact was outside off, or so it seems. Liam Dawson has asked for a review. First thoughts: Missing off. There's a hint of glove as well. Can't be given even if it would've gone on to hit. Decision upheld
stunning stroke. Backs away, gets under the length and lofts this inside-out over extra cover. Superb
steps out and lofts this down towards long-on
sharp turn and bounce. Sarfraz looks to run this down but this wasn't all that short. Beaten
swept from outside off, picks the gap between deep square and deep midwicket. Outstanding batsmanship
too short, he rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket
yorker-length delivery that tails late to hit him on the pad.
angling into middle and leg, worked off his hip to deep square
floats this full outside leg stump as he sees the batsman backing away, squeezed to sweeper cover
mistimes this hook shot down to fine leg, the ball got big on him
slower length ball on leg stump, he backs away to slash. This gets stuck onto the pitch and lobs off the top part of the bat to the off side
yorker that tails away late, squeezed into the off side for a quick single
this is a crunching drive, the cover fielder thought this wasn't too far from him and hared back, only to see the ball gather pace. Superb
pulled to deep square, fetched it from outside off
beaten by the slowness of the surface as he backs away to cut, ends up defending back to the bowler
bottom-edges a cut that races to the third man boundary. Fortune favours the brave, this wasn't far from the keeper.
right into the blockhole, squeezed out
reverse swing, another superb yorker that's been turned to deep midwicket
spears in a superb yorker from around the stumps, squeezed towards point. A direct hit at the bowler's end and Rossouw would've been gone
driven back past the bowler to mid-off

the umpire was in danger of being smashed on the head by that flat-batted slap. Too short, he backed away and literally gave this a thump. Shah had to duck for cover quickly, this one whizzed past his ears.
pulled into the deep midwicket region for an easy single
full and tailing away from middle, turned to the leg side
looked for a yorker, but turned out to be a full toss that beat the batsman's swing. Too quick even for Kamran because the ball hit a spot and just took off. That's really tough on the keeper.
length outside off, beaten as he looks to cut this
thick outside edge to this yorker, down to third man

given out lbw as he misses a full toss that tails in to hit his left pad. First impression was it may have been missing. Proved right on replay. All three stumps were visible at the point of impact. Decision overturned as Rossouw reviews
yorker on middle and leg, gets a thick inside edge to fine leg
backs away and pulls this into the gap at deep midwicket
full on middle, he makes room and squeezes the drive to the edge of the ring at mid-off
short on middle, pulled to deep square leg
full outside off, he makes room and thumps this to the deep extra cover boundary to level the scores. Unbelievable timing

pulled on the bounce to deep midwicket. Hugs in the dugout as Sir Viv runs up to Moin Khan. Game set and match. What a partnership this between Rossouw and Sarfraz. What this result also means is the curtains come down on Lahore's campaign. They can't progress into the final four anymore.
good length outside off, nips away after pitching. Tries to cut but misses
good length on middle stump, mistimed pull to mid on
full and wide, and crunched past cover! Played off the front foot and beats the infield
full on middle stump, tapped to midwicket with soft hands
good length on middle and off, defended off the front foot
full outside off, drives away from his body with the bat's open face. Runs it down to third man
overpitched wide outside off, sticks his bat out and plays towards point
good length wise outside off, cuts through the ball's line and beats point! Races away thereafter
back of a length outside off, and it's punched off the back foot. Goes between the two infielders on the off side, forcing the fielders to give it a chase
good length on middle stump, chopped down to third man off the back foot
short on middle, swivels and pulls fine! No chance for fine leg to intercept
full ball on off stump, driven down the ground to the bowler
wider outside off, opens the bat face and chops it down to third man
a tad short outside off, Shehzad gets underneath it and slashes over backward point
full, swinging back in, guided to third man with the open face. Nicely played
full and wide, moving away, struggling for timing, hit away towards mid-off
that will be the length on this stadium, shortish around middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single
slashed, full and wide with plenty of width. Fakhar opens the bat face and carves it away with the open face past point. Lovely timing on that from Zaman, can't bowl there to him
good length delivery outside off, 137 kph, moves away. Zaman's feet don't move, the ball moves away and beats the bat
full around middle and leg, Fakhar comes down and inside-edges it down to short fine leg.
nicely bowled, 140 kph, full around off, swinging back in, defended towards mid-off. He wants one, but Wheeler is quick on it
141 kph, nice and full, swinging back in, driven with the angle of swing, to mid-on
full and straight, more swing, 139 kph, hit to midwicket. Tidy comeback from Wheeler after that first ball, even got some swing
smashed. Full around off, can't bowl that length at Eden Park. It's full and straight, Fakhar clears his front leg and bludgeons it straight, past mid-off
bad timing, but over mid-on. Rance makes the error of bowling that full length, around middle and leg, Shehzad clears his front leg and mis-times a lofted drive over the fielder
nicely played, but it is still full. Driven to mid-on
a low full toss around off, 138 kph, pushed to mid-off. Good single, keeps the pressure off
that's his wheelhouse. Short and wide, Zaman gets underneath the length and carves a cut with so much ease over backward point
back of a length on middle stump, muscles his pull down the ground but comes off the bat's top half. Straight to mid on
back of a length on leg stump, swivels and pulls along the carpet past square leg. Chase for the man from deep midwicket, but he can't cut it off
full on off stump, smacked down the ground with some power! Got his front foot out of the way, and bunted this past Fakhar. Mid off's diving effort can't stop it either
back of a length on leg stump, clipped off his pads to square leg for a quick single
good length on middle stump, angling into the left hander, and Fakhar simply pulls this behind square by dragging this behind. Too short, and sent for a boundary with fine leg inside the circle
full outside off, swinging away from the batsman. Slapped off the front foot, but straight to cover. Misses out on a wide ball
full on off stump, straighter one. Defended off the front foot, back to Sodhi
full just outside off, tries to drive towards cover but the spin induces the inside edge. Played through to mid on instead
flatter ball on a good length. Pitches on middle stump. Turned off his hips to midwicket with soft hands. Nice call early for the single
good length just outside off, and spins away from the batsman after pitching. Tries to cut, but way too close to his body for that shot. Misses, and the ball flies just over his bat
full on off stump, prods forward and taps it down the ground to long off for a walking single
tossed up full outside off, swept hard after getting down on one knee. Man in the deep there
full on leg stump, tries to sweep but misses the shot. Raps his pads instead as the ball trickles down to short fine leg
good length outside off, rocks back and punches off the back foot to long off. Good effort from Santner diving to his left, but can't stop it from going past him
all the way! Flat-batted maximum! Full on off stump, and Fakhar comes down the ground and bunts it over the bowler's head. Lands straight into the sightscreen
another maximum! Over cow corner this time. Uses his feet once again to get to the length of this full ball on leg stump, slogged over to the leg side, and it lands in the stands

lucky this time! Full and wide outside off with the batsman charging down the ground. The wide line forces the batsman to reach at it. Wild slog takes the top edge over the keeper's head. Work for third man running back

this time it's over deep midwicket! Full on middle stump, and he comes down the wicket once more. Slogged square to the leg side, and it's off the middle of the bat. Into the stands once more. Did really well to get to the length of the ball
good length on off stump, backs away towards the leg side and carved off the back foot to deep point
full on middle stump, no spin on this occasion. The batsman prods forward in an attempt to defend, but played down the wrong line. Hits his pads
good length outside off, spins further away. Cut off the back foot, but brilliantly stopped by Williamson, who sticks one hand out at point and stops the ball
full on off stump, tapped towards point with soft hands, and they take off for a quick single. Great work from Williamson, who throws it in a flash. It's a direct hit, but Fakhar was home
overpitched full on middle stump, squeezed back to the bowler
good length on off stump, extra bounce this time that surprises the batsman. Stays deep in his crease as he pokes at the ball. Takes a thick edge and lands near mid off. Excellent over from Sodhi
good length on off stump, quick ball that forces the batsman to go onto his back foot. Firmly punched back to Rance

full and wide outside off, driven square to cover point and Fakhar wants a single. Shehzad doesn't want the single, and Guptill's throw was on target, but bounces just over the stumps at the non-striker's end. Fakhar survives
back of a length on middle and off, pulled over the infield, but goes to deep midwicket on the bounce
short on middle stump, stays tall and pulls along the carpet to deep midwicket. There's his maiden fifty!

beautiful! Another flat six. Full on off stump, and he smacks it through the ball's line. Lifted over the non-striker's head, but hit so hard that long on has no chance. He sees it soar over the ropes. What great timing

holes out this time! Slightly slower ball on off stump, and Shehzad tries to repeat the same shot. Deceived by the pace, and through his shot too early. Doesn't have the distance, and taken by de Grandhomme at long on
full outside leg stump, tries to clip this fine down the leg side but can't get bat to ball. Hits his pads but impact's outside leg. They scamper across for the single
back of a length outside off, stays in his crease and punched back past the non-striker to long on

another slower ball fetches a wicket! Short on leg stump, and Fakhar attempts to pull this behind square. But there's no pace behind that delivery for the pull shot. Plus, he's through his shot too early. Top edged to fine leg, who composes himself and completes the catch
full on off stump, driven off the front foot, and played down the ground to long on
good length on off stump but angling into the right hander, flicked off his pads to deep midwicket. Calls early for the second run
full just outside off, tapped past the non-striker to long on once again
good length wide outside off, waits for it before cutting square off the back foot. Straight to Munro at deep cover
good length on middle stump, swivels and pulls along the ground to deep midwicket. Hit too well, actually. Fetches him only a single
quicker ball, darted full on middle stump but going down the leg side. Sharp take from the keeper
floated on a good length but pitches wide outside off, turns past the wide line. Got to bowl that again
short on off stump, muscles his pull down the ground to long on. Comes off the bat's top half. Quicker ball this time
good length on off stump, angles into the batsman as he pulls to long on once more. Straight to the fielders
full ball on middle stump, squeezed past the bowler's left to long off. Keeping it tight
full ball on off stump, smartly defended with soft hands towards cover. Early call for a single, and they race through with ease
full on middle and leg, down on one knee and swept very fine! Paddled actually, and no chance for fine leg to intercept. Not timed as well as he would've wanted, but he'll take it
short on off stump, and soars over Sarfraz's head as he pulls out off the pull shot. The umpires call it a wide, albeit tentatively. CDG isn't pleased
good length on off stump, turned off his pads to midwicket. Babar wants the second, but slips while turning

glorious straight drive! Full on off stump, and that's driven off the front foot past the bowler. Mid off races to his right, but his slide ain't good enough either. Races away to the long-off boundary
full on middle and leg, worked off his pads behind square on the leg side. Man in the deep, though
back of a length on middle stump, nudged off his pads to the man at deep midwicket once again
fuller ball on middle and off, driven towards the leg side off the front foot. Played towards cow corner
full on leg stump and it's gently tapped off the front foot towards Bruce in the deep on the leg side. Rotates the strike

good length on middle stump, too close to his body for the cut so Sarfraz opens the bat's face late and runs it down to third man. Diving effort from the keeper to stop that ball, but can't get his hands to it
back of a length on middle stump, uses his wrists to whip this off the back foot to midwicket. Calls for the single, and they take Santner's arm on
overpitched outside off stump, and angling further away. Goes over the wide guidelines
back of a length on leg stump, swivels and pulls to deep fine leg off the back foot. Sodhi the man there
short on leg stump, challenges Babar with that delivery. Forces the batsman to duck, and get under the line of the ball. First bouncer of the over

back of a length on leg stump, and it's flicked beautifully off his pads! Flies over square leg and threads the gap between fine leg and deep midwicket. Superb placement, and ends the over with a boundary
full outside off and turning away after pitching, sticks his bat out and chops it down to short third man
good length on middle and leg, turns across the batsman's body. Tapped towards midwicket with soft hands. No fielder there, forcing the bowler to race behind it
good length on middle stump, pulled off the back foot to the man at deep midwicket. Not hit well enough
tossed up full outside off, it's a low full toss and it's driven past cover off the front foot. Beats the infielder, but Santner races across from long off to intercept that shot. Stops the boundary
good length on middle stump, tentatively turned off the back foot to square leg for a single
full and wide outside off, spins away once again. Cut late off the back foot to short third man. Can't stop them from stealing a single, though
full on off stump, and it's smacked over Boult first ball! Hit through the ball's line after clearing the front foot. Lands full on the sightscreen. What a shot
fuller ball but wide outside off, gives it a big heave towards the off side but can't make contact. He had backed away too much to the leg side, and couldn't reach at the ball
good length on leg stump, pulled well but straight to midwicket. One foot on either side of the fielder and that would've been four
too short! Pitches on leg stump and soars over Sarfraz's head. Tried to pull, but the ball went over his shoulders
good length on leg stump, glanced off his hips to fine leg. Paddled away, just helping the ball on its way

full on off stump, and it's hit straight down the ground! Boult dives to his left but can't stop it. And neither can the diving mid-off fielder. Quick outfield and that crashes into the long-off boundary. There's the fifty partnership!
full on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket off his pads for the single and there's the team 150!
tossed up, and punished! Full on off stump, and Babar comes down the ground and bunts it over Sodhi. Hit dead straight. No chance for either long on or long off
full on off stump, tries to smack it straight once more but dropped by Sodhi. Stuck his left hand out, but the ball hits his hand and lands nearby. Saves three for certain
lifted inside out! Full on off stump, Sarfraz backs away making some extra room, and driven over the infield. No chance for either deep point nor wide long off. Floats away into the boundary

lands in the second tier! Short on middle stump and Sarfraz generates some extra pace off the shot with a whip towards the leg side. Pulled with a lot of bat speed behind it, and it lands in the stands beyond deep midwicket
full outside off, and spins further away. Too wide, and Sarfraz chooses not to offer a shot
good length outside off, cut late off the back foot to short third man
full outside off, tapped off the front foot with the bat's open face. Played to deep point
full and wide outside off, goes beyond the wide line on the off side. Seventh wide of the innings
overpitched outside off, eventually it's a low full toss. Tries to drive but takes a thick outside edge. Runs down to third man
full and wide outside off once again. Eventually comes to Sarfraz as another low full toss. Carved behind square to deep point by sticking his bat out
full and wide outside off, but once again beyond the tramlines

b>full toss, and dispatched! On off stump as Rance misses his line and Babar muscles this over the bowler's head. Perfect timing off the bat's middle, and it lands just beyond the long-off boundary. The fielder was interested in the deep, but eventually gave up as the ball came towards him
full and wide outside off, it goes through from inside the tramlines but the umpire calls it wide anyway. Third wide of the over. Oooo, close call
slower ball, full on off stump. Driven straight but takes the outside edge through to third man

slower ball full on middle stump, slogged towards the leg side and lobbed to Santner at midwicket. But he's lost it! Fluffs the catch. He may have lost it in the crowd. Lucky for Sarfraz. Goes down as a dropped chance
full on off stump, driven down the ground but straight to the bowler
back of a length on off stump, extra bounce takes it through to the keeper and Sarfraz misses the late glance
What. A. Shot! Full on middle stump, Sarfraz gets his front foot out of the way and lifts this towards the leg side. Manages to get under the ball, and sent into the stands
slower ball does the trick! Good length on off stump, and the batsman tries to repeat that shot, but he's through his pull too early. Holes out to Munro at midwicket, who completes a sharp catch
short on middle stump, pulled into the deck and goes through to wide mid on
this time Santner holds on! Short on middle and pulled too early! Top edged and easily taken by the man at midwicket. Almost a front-foot no ball from Wheeler, but good to earn the wicket

terrific attempt from Rance, but dropped! Short on off and pulled off the back foot. Top edged again, and Rance races in from fine leg and dives forward with his left hand stretched out, but the ball pops out. Great effort nonetheless
full on middle stump, muscles the slog to midwicket. They scamper across for the single, giving Babar the strike
good length but wide outside off, angling across the batsman's body. Driven over cover but takes the top edge instead. Through to third man. Brings Hasan Ali back on strike
full and fast outside off, wild heave towards the off side from the batsman, and it's an outside edge that's very fine! Flies over the keeper, and through for four
short on middle stump, tries to pull this away but the ball stays low. Hits his shoulder. Ouch
low full toss on middle stump, slogged towards the leg side but straight to midwicket. They're running anyway, and completed

There's Babar's fifty and the team 200! Short on leg stump and pulled away towards cow corner. Two men in the deep but neither can stop it. Strong end from Pakistan to their innings. They finish on 201 for 4
good length on leg stump, Guptill turns it off his gloves fine down the leg side. Perfect start for New Zealand but the umpire thinks it's come off his thighs. Goes down as leg byes
good length on off stump, tapped off the back foot to cover
good length on middle stump, angling across Guptill. Drops his hands and glances it to backward point
full on middle and off, and angling across once again. Big stride forward covering the line of the ball, and then left alone
back of a length on middle and off, tries to leave the ball but it's too close to his body. Defends it towards the off side tentatively
good length on middle and leg, chopped down to third man off the back foot. He'll keep strike
back of a length on leg stump, flicked off his toes to midwicket. Played off the back foot
back of a length on middle and leg, pulled along the carpet towards cow corner. Work for the man in the deep, who runs to his left and parries it back
good length on leg stump, tapped off the back foot to midwicket. No run this time
too short on leg stump, soars over Guptill's head with the batsman offering no shot. Easy decision for the umpire
back of a length on leg stump, Guptill charges down the wicket but is cramped for room. Flicked off his hips to short fine leg
full and wide outside off, slogged towards the leg side but not off the middle of the bat. Oh, no. He's overstepped. Free hit
full outside leg, and he's punished! Uses his wrists to whip this off his toes. Squeezed between square leg and short third man, and that races away
full on leg stump, clipped off his toes to deep midwicket
back of a length outside off, goes away towards the leg side and slaps this over point. Beats the infield and lands just beyond Shadab, but not enough muscle behind that shot to get four
back of a length on middle and leg, cramps Guptill. Can't free his arms. Tapped towards the leg side
short on middle stump, and angling away. Too much width on offer, and Guptill slaps this over point for a maximum. Frees his arms, and goes through with his shot. Earns him half-a-dozen
full on middle stump, driven straight but comes off the bat's toe end. Straight to mid off
yorker just outside off stump, squeezed away with the bat's open face to third man
traps him! Full on off stump, and Munro misses the leg-side flick after walking across to the off side. Hits him full in front of off stump, and the umpire raises his finger for the lbw
back of a length on leg stump, flicked off his pads fine down the leg side. Work for deep backward square, but his diving effort stops the boundary
good length on middle and leg, punched off the back foot to mid on. They scramble across for the single
good length on middle and leg, flicked off his hips to midwicket and it's been lobbed to the fielder! Diving catch, jumping across to his right, and it's a superb take from Haris. KW falls cheaply
full on middle stump, worked towards the leg side after prodding forward. Played to deep backward square
good length on leg stump, flicked off his pads to square leg. Keeping it tight
slower ball full outside leg, flicked fine down the leg side but sharply collected by the keeper diving to his left
good length on middle stump, goes down the leg side as the batsman misses his flick
back of a length outside off, lifts one leg and flicks this over square leg to the man in the deep
short on middle stump and he goes with the pull shot. Extra bounce takes the outside edge over the keeper's head!
back of a length outside off, slashes hard at it and it's going straight to third man! But dropped! And it goes over for a six! The captain cannot believe it. Rumman the guilty man there.
full on middle and leg, Bruce was backing away towards the leg side anyway. Driven to cover
short, wide, misses the cut
bouncer outside off, jumps over the pull and beats the leaping keeper
Guptill shimmies out, Hasan bangs it short on middle. Jabbed to the covers
short and skids in to take the inside edge and roll down to third man

Haris Sohail throws the stumps down at the non-striker's end. He had one stump to aim and he nails it down to catch Bruce short. Banged in short on off stump, he does not middle a pull. Instead, he drags it to midwicket. Sets off for a single but Haris is too quick and accurate
back of a length on off, punched on the up to long-off
pitched up on off, presses forward, drives to mid-on and sets off. Rumman throws from mid-on but can't hit the stumps
back of a length outside off, cuts behind square but straight to point
good length outside off once more, stays deep in his crease and punches to cover
back of a length outside off, pokes at it towards short third man as they take another dangerous single. Quick throw in, but the batsmen were through
short and wide outside off, spins further away but it's cut next to point
taken at short third man! Short outside off, and Guptill cuts at it but is through his shot too early. Takes the top edge, and straight to the infielder. Easy take, and that's four down
full outside off, and it's crunched over cover! The fielder put in a flying, diving effort but it was so well struck. No stopping that
good length on off stump, tentatively tapped back to the bowler
back of a length on off stump and angling into Philips, defended off the back foot to the bowler

back of a length outside off, carved off the front foot to third man. They need to hurry for the second run, and he's in, but it's a direct hit from the deep. Did he ground his bat or feet? Yes he did. Got his left foot down but not his bat
back of a length on off stump, gets inside the line of the ball and punched towards mid off

good length on middle, extra bounce off the surface, and Philips drives this ball. Hasn't adjusted for the extra zip off the surface, and his on-side drive lobs into the air. Sohail's not going to miss that at midwicket. Takes his third catch of the evening
back of a length on middle stump, stays deep in his crease and opens his bat's face. Hit to point
full outside off, spins away from Grandhomme but he's lifted it over cover! Great timing, and smacked into the stands. Played with the spin and earns him the reward

Shadab has the last laugh! Slower in the air this time, and on a good length. The batsman came down the wicket too early, and the ball spun away from his bat. Quick take from the keeper, and he dislodges the bails before CDG can turn and ground his bat
back of a length on middle stump, flicked off his pads to deep midwicket
back of a length on leg stump, turns across the left hander. Misses the defense and hits his pads. Loud appeal, but turned down. Too high
good length on middle stump, punched off the back foot to cover
good length on middle stump, flicked towards short midwicket and the bowler goes racing behind it. Stopped with the dive
back of a length on off stump, slides across the batsman and through to the keeper. Tries to drive but can't connect

back of a length on middle stump, punched off the back foot and beats the diving cover fielder. Raees, from mid off, races across to his right and stops the ball from going past the second line of defense
back of a length on off stump, tapped to cover for a quick single. They're taking the fielder on, but the throw is wayward. Forces Santner to dive nonetheless
full outside off, and entices the batsman to drive. Just the perfect length, but there's no second slip! Edged and flies past first slip for a boundary
full outside off, crunched drive off the front foot to cover. But straight to the fielder placed there
back of a length outside off, tapped off the back foot towards cover
back of a length on middle stump, flicked towards the leg side but straight to the infielder
full outside off, and that's driven inside out over extra cover. Well hit, but wide long off races across to his right and intercepts
full outside off, prods forward and carves it behind to point. No chance of a run
on a good length outside off, cut away from his body but can't beat the infield. Goes to cover point once again
back of a length outside off, cut off the back foot and beats the infield on this occasion. Goes to the man in the deep
full on middle stump, tapped down the ground to long off. Only a single
back of a length on leg stump, tries to pull but not enough muscle behind that shot. Can't clear the infield
extra short on middle stump, tries the tennis-shot pull over midwicket and it's shovelled well enough! No one at cow corner, and fetches Santner some runs

full on middle stump, and it's smacked over the bowler's head!! Looks like it's going for six over long on, but Nawaz jumps high near the ropes and parries the ball back in. Excellent effort, with a lot of hang time
back of a length on middle stump, played off the back foot towards the leg side. Gives Santner the strike
good length on middle stump, but angling into the left hander. Santner goes deep into the crease and pulls towards midwicket
good length wide outside off, spins further away. Left alone by the batsman and an easy decision for the umpire
back of a length outside off, straighter one this time. Goes through to the keeper with no shot offered
full on middle stump, bunted down the ground to long on
full and wide outside off, tries to heave it over the infield, but the slog gets the outside edge. Flies past the keeper and the sliding short third-man fielder can't stop it either
back of a length on middle and leg, turned away towards short fine leg. Played with the legspin
back of a length outside off, rocks back into the crease and pulls this over the non-striker! Enough wood behind that shot, as the ball lands beyond the long-on boundary
back of a length outside off, slaps it square to the man in the deep off the back foot. Not timed well enough
quicker one that cramps the batsman. Good length  on middle stump and zips straight through. Cut from near his body to point

full on leg stump, knowing fully well that Santner would make some room. Cramped for space, and flicked off his hips behind square to deep backward square. He wants the single, but slips at the non-striker's end

delightful straight drive! Full on off stump and in the slot to be punished. Stays still and hits through the line of the ball. Shows the full face of the bat and lands in the crowd. Taken by a spectator!
good length on middle stump but angling across, opens his bat's face and runs it down to third man
full and wide outside off, driven square off the front foot but straight to cover point. Was in the slot to be hit. The bowler will feel lucky
slower ball this time. On a good length outside off but always angling away from the right hander. Tries to get bat to ball but can't
yorker outside off stump but he drives at it anyway. Takes the bottom edge and bounces over the keeper's left
back of a length outside off, tries to ramp this over the keeper, but misses. One bounce for the over, says the umpire, but the crowd boos. They reckon it should've been called a wide
full outside off, heaves it over extra cover off the back foot. Rock solid in his stance, and smacked over the infield. No stopping that

cleans him up! Real quick ball on a good length outside off. Angling into Wheeler as the batsman misses the pull shot. Takes a bottom edge and crashes into middle and leg. Huge celebration from Hasan Ali

full on middle stump, the batsman's walking across to the off side and attempts a flick. Misses the connection of the bat, and goes down the leg side after hitting his pads. No one that fine on the leg side
full on middle stump, nudged off his toes to deep midwicket
good length just outside off, angling into Santner and it's punched off the back foot to mid on
starts off with the slower ball. Pitches on a good length outside off, and Santner swats it away! Stays on the back foot and lifted over mid off. No stopping that once it clears the infield
full on middle stump, bunted down the ground to mid off. They scamper across
full on off stump, but stays very low! Goes through bat and pad and just about misses the outside of off stump. Collected by the keeper
slower ball on leg stump. The batsman has to check his slog, after seeing the change in pace. Drags it behind square to the man in the deep
good length on middle stump, Santner slogs towards the leg side but takes the bottom edge. Beats Sarfraz, who dives to his right, and it's more freaky runs
back of a length outside off, backs away and slaps this to cover. Stopped by the fielder there, but can't stop the batsmen from taking the run
full on off stump, backs away and smacks it past the non-striker to long on
full toss on off stump, sticks his bat out and runs it down to third man
slower ball but short on middle stump. Dragged off the back foot to square leg inside the circle. Well deceived by Hasan
low full toss outside off, and it's been sent packing! Slogged over long-on's head, and it's hit well enough
full on leg stump, Sodhi backs away towards the leg side but misses the shot. The ball goes between his body and leg stump. How did that not break the stumps?
back of a length on middle stump, Sodhi backs away towards the leg side before muscling a shot past cover and into the deep
good length on middle stump and it's pulled over midwicket. Wide long off races to his right but the ball lands just short of the cow-corner boundary
full outside off, bunted down the ground to long off

back of a length on middle stump, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket. They want the second, but the throw from the deep is flat and accurate. The wicket's quickly dislodged by Sarfraz, but Santner's dive saves him
excellent bouncer that follows Santner. Short on middle stump but always angling into the batsman's body, despite him backing away towards the leg side
back of a length on off stump, tries to pull but beaten by the pace. Misses the shot, and a feather edge off the bat takes it through to Sarfraz. Santner goes after a fighting knock
full outside off, angling across the right hander. Tries to drive at it, but takes a thick outside edge. Goes down to deep point

full on leg stump, Rance backs away and muscles this over the infield, but no distance behind that shot. Comfortably taken by Fakhar at long on. Swing of the bat, and enough wood behind it, but safely caught by the Navy man
short on off stump, the batsman backs away thereby missing the shot completely. Flies over his bat
short on middle stump, slower ball and the pull induces another top edge. Flies over the keeper, but short fine leg races behind to complete the catch. Pakistan win by 48 runs!
full, sliding in on the pads, Roy clips it away through square for a single for the first ball
back of a length outside off, 85mph but no swing, Buttler forces to mid-off from the crease
pitched up, 86mph and Buttler steps out, SPLUT! goes the bat as he hits through the line and picks a gap wide of mid-off to send it skittering for four
full on middle, Buttler doesn't move this time, creams it up and over mid-on! Good pace, up at 89mph but dismissively lofted, bounces just in front of the rope
touch back of a length and clipped to point as Buttler stands tall
superb line to start with, nibbling away a fraction as Roy gropes forward on off and is beaten
not quite as full, Roy moves across and lets it go
pitched up, swings a fraction but right into the line of Buttler's bat as he clubs four more straight back over the bowler
four more! Slapped on the pull to deep backward square leg, a real crunchy connection and there's no protection out there
shimmy from Buttler, the back foot going as the bowler approaches the crease, pitched up and driven to cover
back of a length, this rises up and cramps Buttler, who taps it back to the bowler
drops short, maybe a slower ball but this time Buttler goes deep and clubs it away between mid-on and midwicket for four
swing! Beautiful bowling from Chahar, 86mph and shaping away from just back of a length as Buttler pushes down the line and is beaten
pitched up and swinging a touch, Roy watches it works to the leg side, they hurry through as mid-on comes in to fire a throw
good length, 87mph and holding its line on off, this time it's watchfully blocked coming across
uh-oh, spaghetti-ohs! Driven by Roy to mid-off, but Hardik Pandya's long barrier is short on effectiveness and it hits his ankle before deflecting to the rope
shortish, Roy pulls... and gets a thick inside edge on to his thigh. Owee!
full, 87mph and slamming into the pads, Kaul belts out an impassioned appeal... Tim Robinson merely signals a leg bye. Impact outside leg, never mind where it was heading
pace on, 87mph in the slot... and mullered over the sightscreen at long-off! Clean as a whistle, that shot
full, 85mph but Roy can't get under this one, crunched along the carpet to mid-off
fired in, up towards the blockhole and Roy chops down, squeezes out one to square leg
short ball, cutely played by Roy, just flicks it up over his shoulder to fine leg for four
shortish outside off and stabbed towards point, just a single
flighted, maybe the googly as Buttler comes out and is hit on the front pad

dropped! Buttler scoops a top-edged slog-sweep into the sky, it looks like it's landing in a vacant area of the pitch... only for Sid Kaul to get there, get his hands under the ball, but fail to cling on! Magnificent effort, but that'll go down as another miss

goes to his fifty with a brutal slap over long-on! Too full, Roy is on to the front foot, mows it down the ground for six! A half-century from 23 balls - just like our analyst Ravi Bopara, back in the day
pitched up and driven down the ground for one
pitched up, that's right where Roy likes it, never mind that it was a slower ball... dispatched with aplomb (and a cheery) over long-off!
adroit batting from Roy, goes back and dabs this towards short third man
short ball, 86mph and Buttler swings - gets a thick top edge over Dhoni for four more! Nothing going for the bowling side so far

bowled 'im! Kaul rattles the woodwork... Big swing and a miss from Buttler, who was aiming for cow corner, it was on a hittable length but the thing about hittable balls is: you have to hit 'em. The partnership is broken, Kaul's red bandanna to the rescue
good length on off, Hales defends carefully with an almost exaggerated straight bat. Suspect he won't be playing like that for long
tosses the legbreak on middle and off, defended back to the bowler
pushed through and Roy goes back to cut in front of point for a single
sends down the googly, Hales again defends on off
pushed through quicker, Hales can't get it away on the leg side
FETCH THAT! A clean golf swing off a length, Roy has pongoed this over deep midwicket! Majestic hit. Welcome back, Deepak

edged behind, gets him with the slower ball! Superb comeback from Chahar, gets him his maiden wicket for India...Short of a length, cutting his fingers over it, Roy went back and tried to cut it late to third man, just flicked off the toe of the bat through to Dhoni. Still, a mighty fine knock from Roy
banged in, 86mph and Hales pulls out of his shot... not too high, though
short and again taking the pace off, Hales swirls his arms up and around but fails to connect... but that is deemed a second short ball in the over for Chahar, and therefore a no-ball!
full toss, Hales collars it, clubbed over long-on! Keep your peepers open in the crowd! More pain for Chahar, that was a bit wayward and dealt with accordingly
flighted, Morgan flicks back to the on side and the bowler can't quite  collect to prevent one
tossed up, bit of dip and drift on leg stump and Hales prods to midwicket
pushes this through, possibly the Bosie and Hales has to block it on the back foot
rolled out, a touch leg side as Hales backed away, slugged up and over the ring, between long-on and deep midwicket, it bounces away for a boundary to end the over
back of a length on the hip, tucked to the man at midwicket
touch short, nipping in as Hales comes across and plays it down
pushed through flat outside off, Hales drops back to cut
flat legbreak outside off, Hales slaps it to cover
floated up on leg stump as Hales wanders down and clubs to cow corner, between two men but it won't go for four... and now England have run a two for the first time today
Hales backs away, Chahel lobs it up full and wide - but Hales manages to broomhandle it past cover, not a good bit of fielding and the man in the deep can't prevent four
dug in short, Hales jabs at it uncertainly
banged in short, Hales nails his pull into the crowd at deep square! Really sweet connection on that one
angled across, 86mph outside off, Stokes just glides a single to third man
short, on the hip and it tucks him up as he flicks across the line
length on off stump, tapped down towards cover
slower ball, Bairstow drops back and pulls for one - that's the England 150 up
length outside off, Bairstow backs off looking to carve over the covers, gets a thick inside edge past his stumps
full and wide, 82mph and Stokes has to stretch for it, squirted off the toe and it sneaks past short third man for four!
pitched up and clubbed down the ground, Pandya doesn't quite take it cleanly on the bounce at long-on - but it's just one
heads! He's lost his bat! Swung through the covers (the ball), and away to short fine leg (the bat)
full toss, just dips below the waits as YJB swats it into the leg side for one - decent over from Kaul
oh my! He's smashed this over extra cover! An extraordinary shot from YJB, going in to out, almost a perfect wide yorker from Umesh but somehow the batsman lofts it into the crowd!

Stokes skitters about in his crease, full and straight, at the stumps... but ramped at the last moment for four! Looked for all the world like it was about to lose his stumps, but managed to flick it past Dhoni!
fired in, this deflects off the pad, leg side though
did that nutmeg him? Full and leg side, Bairstow swings and misses
short ball, Stokes pulls but gets it high off the bat past the bowler for one
length outside off, taking the pace off, YJB rocks back and pulls flat to deep midwicket
cutter this time, in the channel outside off, Stokes has a big ole swing and misses
back of a length, Stokes swats at it... and lobs a catch to mid-off! Kohli takes the catch, that's another for Panyda, mixing it up well and bagging his third wicket. The dangerous Stokes departs
full, slower delivery... but this time Bairstow is ready for it, back in the crease and flayed over cover for four!

pitched up, Bairstow throws the bat - and nicks to the keeper! He's missed out on a half-volley there, really, not quite in the right position and reaching for it, pace was up and Dhoni swallowed the edge
full and wide, Willey jams down on it and gets one to third man
pitched up in the channel, Jordan bunts a single to mid-off
lights up the stumps, Willey plays on! Full, 90mph just outside off, Willey digs it out - but it deflects into the timber
full and wide of the stumps, Plunkett stabs it for one
pitched up, 89mph outside off and Jordan just pings another single through the covers
full, in the channel outside off, Jordan swats a single to the sweeper
Plunkett moves across, pitched up and hit without timing into the on side, they come scampering back for a second
wide full toss, Rashid swings and only needs to get a thick edge to squirt four to third man
big appeal first up! This shapes back very nicely at Sharma, on a good length, takes the front pad. Perhaps pitched outside leg. Replays showed it pitched on leg stump but as going over
that's more like it! Takes a step down the pitch and effortlessly flicks this over midwicket and it's comfortably into the stands
full outside off, pushed wider left alone
more swing, this is full at the stumps, tucked into midwicket
lovely graceful shot to get off the mark, it's full outside off, he takes a stride forward and places it through the covers. All timing.
starts with a short ball, angled in at leg stump, and he just swivels on a pull behind square. Poor start from ball
gets onto off stump, back of a length, takes the splice of the bat as he defends and runs into backward point
short of a length outside off, he takes his bottom hand off the bat as he plays back down the pitch
back of a length at off stump, no width offered, dropped into backward point with an angled bat
moves well outside leg stump, Ball follows him and it's clipped off the pads backward of square

super catch! Big bonus for England. This is full, angled into the pads, Dhawan goes to flick it away but sends it just within reach of Ball at short fine leg and the tall fast bowler pulls out a dive to his left. Hasn't been a great series for Dhawan
that's the shot of a man in form, eases onto the front foot and drives a delivery from outside off straight down the ground
good length, a fraction wider outside off, big stride forward and pushes to cover
shorter in length, at off stump, he angles it towards backward point and can't steal the single
full at the stumps, 83mph, driven to mid-off who is deep enough for the single
full and straight, clipped out to deep midwicket
full, wide outside off, carved through the covers with a dismissive drive
gets away with this one, was even wider outside off, he threw his hands into a drive but found Willey at cover
pumped down the ground! Jordan goes full and it's launched into the crowd. Sharma got underneath the ball, from deep in his crease, and deposited it over long-on
another one into the crowd! Jordan opts to go short, Sharma pulls it high over fine leg. Miles back
back on a good length at off stump, pushed to mid-off...India ahead of the required rate
back of a length outside off, opens the face and runs it backward of point to third man
this didn't come quite out of the middle, but it didn't matter, Sharma drives on the up over the covers to a cross-seam delivery that was short of a length
back of a length outside off, goes for the square drive and bottom edges into the pitch then it bobbles to point
fantastic stroke! A good-length ball, he goes for the lofted drive and opens the face a touch to guide it into the crowd wide of third man
a full delivery worked from outside off to mid-on
what a stroke! That's magnificent. Ball drops this short of a length and it's a wonderful pick-up pull short which goes over deep square leg

Don't believe that, it is a spectacular catch! Jordan has pulled off one of the great catches. Rahul got underneath this, a fuller delivery, and aimed to send it over wide long-on. It looked to be travelling all the way, but didn't quite have the legs. Still, Jordan had to make huge ground from long-on and then flung himself full length to add another brilliant catch to his collection
tucks a length delivery out to deep square leg
back of a length outside off, opens the face off the back foot down to third man where Hales misfields and Kohli is alert to the chance of the second run
that's a lovely piece of timing and placement, Hales' misfield proves costly, Kohli walks across the crease and clips this from outside off through midwicket
back outside off, steered down to third man
full, wide outside off, and that's a brilliant stop by Roy at backward to intercept the square drive that was timed so sweetly that it would have run to the boundary
onto the front foot and drives to deep cover
there's a noise as this goes past the bat, but it was bat hitting the ground...reaching out for a full, wide delivery. Must have been close to a wide
short of a length outside off, finds backward point
a clear tactic from Stokes here, this is very full and wide, jabbed into the pitch off the bottom edge
good length ball angled in at the stumps, tucked to midwicket. Good comeback over from Stokes
short of a length outside off, square driven towards deep cover where Bairstow makes excellent ground to cut off the boundary
fuller, outside off, eases forward and drives to deep cover
short of a length, straight, good uses of the crease as he plays back then drives with an open face to beat cover
excellent placement, touch too much with Rashid, Sharma places his late cut wide of short third man
better length, brings the batsman forward and it's driven to deep cover
very full, outside off, steered to third man
opts for the short ball, the first one he's bowler, Sharma goes for the pull and it's a top edge but runs to fine leg to take him to fifty off 28 balls
back to full and wider, it's a slower ball, skews off a thick outside edge and it goes one bounce to third man
back of a length, angled into the pads, swung down to fine leg...Kohli probably feels he missed out
back of a length outside off, driven behind square on the off side and Roy parries it with a full-length dive. He's taken a blow on the wrist
gets well across his crease and flicks this from around off stump to deep midwicket
that's a fierce square cut, a fraction short from Rashid, he waits for it to turn and places it perfectly
full at the stumps, he stays leg side of the delivery, opens up the off side and drives wide of long-off
stays back in the crease time, it's a flatter, shorter delivery, pulled to deep midwicket
full outside off, guided to backward point
goes for the slog sweep, think he picked the googly, but doesn't make contact and it's a neat take from Buttler
full and straight, he's down the pitch and it takes a thick inside edge behind square
just short of Bairstow at deep square as the short ball nearly works, takes the top edge as he pulls but Bairstow can't reach it and the ball rebounds off him for a second run
another short one, pace off this time at 69mph, pulled to deep square
