more boos as he pushes a length delivery to cover
shorter, outside off, guided to backward point
down the leg side, a diving take from Buttler...sadly that means another delivery
taps a good length delivery to the off side
full outside off, driven back down the pitch
well, there we are...and he's found deep midwicket! Charged down the pitch, went for a big blow over the leg side, and it's held just inside the rope by Stokes
short on off stump, angled down to third man
driven into the off side
that's stone dead...full and straight, playing across the line although Kaul has called for the review. No inside edge, hitting the back pad and hitting
gets forward and defends to the covers
angled into the pads, slips down the leg side and beats everything and everyone...given wide, although there was a sound as it went past the pads
speared in towards leg stump, takes the pad but comfortably missing the stumps
defends a good length ball to cover
full and straight, clipped off the pads down to long leg
very full at off stump, dug out to point
back of a length at leg stump, defended
some aggression and it's a very nice shot, in fact, as he drives a full delivery straight down the ground. Mid-off is up and long-on can't get across
two chances for a run out here as this is defended into backward point and there's almighty confusion
a short ball from round the wicket, he ducks underneath
full outside off, defended to the covers
back of a length outside off, slides past the outside edge
full, he gets across and clips to mid-on
full outside off, pushed into the covers
back of a length at off stump, defended
driven through the off side, Bairstow does the mopping up around the boundary
full at the stumps, driven to cover
gets forward and drives to mid-off
a shorter ball, he goes for the pull and it comes from high on the bat over midwicket
slips down the leg side
goes for a booming drive at a length ball angled across him, flies of Buttler through the vacant slip cordon (England could have had three in there!)
good length on middle and leg, 141 kph, defended
strays down leg for a wide. A hint of swing, but ill-directed.
nicely bowled. Good length, slightly wider angle, defended into the cover region.
full delivery, angling away, the first delivery that is not on the stumps or straighter. Left alone by Guptill

what a start to the day. After all those drop catches in the crowd over the last few days, a spectator turns up, sticks his hands out and takes a one-hander in the crowd with that brown T-shirt. A share of, or the whole, 50,000 dollars for that man. On the pads from Amir, and Guptill just flicks him over square leg. Just an extension. Applause from Guptill too
good length on middle and leg, defended back.
good length around off, 132 kph, defended into the cover region
six more. What a start this. Short and wide, tripe to be fair from Ashraf. Munro flays and the ball flies over the slip cordon for six. Flies over thirds man
in the gap. Good length outside off, punched through cover for a couple. Just a push. Malik fumbles, but no extras

uh oh. Exuberance. This has been some start to the day. A full delivery outside off, Munro walks across, looking to swivel into a flick over square leg, but there is some extra bounce. Takes the leading edge and lobs to Sarfraz. A bit of a slog sweep there.
good length around off, 136 kph, defended
nice comeback from Ashraf. Fullish length around off, blocked back
good length delivery around off, beautiful line, another defensive block
oh beauty. Angled away from Williamson. Good length around off, there is some away shape and it keeps moving to beat the edge.
on a length outside off, Williamson is solidly behind the line to defend
139 kph, full delivery outside off, gets Williamson forward, played to point. Lovely line
lovely lines these. Just around off on a length, Williamson plays this towards point, a dive saves one
good length delivery outside off, he stays tall and punches the ball back towards mid-off
a tad short and Guptill lays into the stroke. Back of a length around off, comes back in slightly. Guptill stays tall and pulls over square leg. Cannot bowl short so early
full delivery outside off, Guptill just leans forward and caresses his drive through cover for two. Sublime timing
too short again from Ashraf. Back of a length again, Guptill rocks back and caresses a back-foot punch through cover for a couple
still too short but gets away wit this because the line is closer to off. Guptill stands tall and blocks. He has to be fuller with the new ball.
141 kph, good length on leg, Williamson hurried through a flick, beaten for pace, struck on the pad. Amir's optimistic appeal is quickly struck down. Far too high and pitched outside leg.
full delivery outside off, 141 kph, defended into the off side. Williamson 0 off 8
140 kph, letting the ball come to him, so much like Kane Williamson. Playing the ball late. Good length delivery outside off, dabs the ball into the gully region
goes back a tad shorter, around off, Williamson tries to flick but the ball moves away, pushed back up the pitch
into the gap for a couple. Was overpitched by Amir, goes wide and gives Williamson a half-volley. Pushed nicely into the gap at cover
edged but falls well short of Babar at second slip. That's on account due of Williamson's soft hands, the ball dies down. Good end from Amir.
poor delivery. Ashraf is too short, and wide. Guptill chops a cut towards cover
much better length. Goes fuller outside off, Guptill strides forward and crisply caresses a drive to mid-off
good stop from the cover fielder. Full and wide outside off, caressed towards cover. The fielder dives to his left to stop the ball from going through
just poor bowling. Goes full and very wide, allows Guptill to throw his hands at that, scythed through point. Ashraf has struggled today, should be his last over of the spell
much better, good length outside off, comes back in. Guptill gets forward and lets it go
136 kph, on a length on a fifth-stump channel, maybe sixth stump. Hit into the cover region
138 kph, skewed into the gap at square leg for one. Full delivery around off, looking to go straight but the ball hits the inside half
142 kph, a back of a length delivery around off is punched back towards Amir. Hardly any swing today
excellent run. 140 kph, good length on off, inside-edged towards square leg for one
full delivery outside off, 138 kph. Williamson strides forward and defends to point
139 kph, full delivery outside off, Williamson gets forward and defends to backward point. Trying to dab the ball through third man
they certainly will try with balls like those. Short and wide outside off, chopped back towards point.
much better bowling. Good length on a fifth-stump channel, pushed to cover from the crease
a forward charge from Guptill, looking to come down and muscle a ball through cover, but the ball may have moved back enough to take the inside half. Hit back to the bowler.
132 kph, nice looking stroke. Good length, a tad wide, punched towards point. His line and length is subtly much better
134 kph, another big appeal, but hit Guptill too high. Good length on middle and leg, Guptill is hurried trough a flick and is struck on the pad in front of leg. Going over
a maiden from Ashraf. Back of a length around off, pushed away towards mid-off
late on a pull, and struck on the box. Good length on middle and leg, Williamson may have felt that was a touch short. He can't connect with a pull, wears the blow
good lines, full on a fourth-stump channel, angling away, defended into the off side
shuffles right across, exposes his stumps, full around off, another block back. Terrific bowling
129 kph, looks for a pull over the infield, but the length isn't short enough so he improvises a dab back. An excellent first five balls from Raees. Can he finish well?
130 kph, onto the pull quickly this time. Good length on middle and leg, pulled away through square leg. Fine leg gets around
135 kph, superb start from Pakistan. Very impressive discipline apart from the occasional bad ball. Full around off, moving back in, driven to mid-off
136 kph, good length outside off, punched away towards mid-off

no one there so the ball is pulled back just inside the boundary. A tad short and Hasan reads the length quickly, goes back and pulls over square leg. Slow outfield. Malik pulls it in, running across from mid-on
a bit of extra bounce. Back of a length outside off, some zip too. Defended into the off side
a tad full, and straight. Beautifully-timed on-drive finds mid-on. Guptill has a chat with Williamson
good single. 136 kph, good length outside off, a punchy drive towards mid-off. Called for one immediately and made it easily
superb hit from Williamson. He comes down and drills a perfect drive, right over the bowler's head. Not perfect timing but the placement is good
a slower delivery outside off, Williamson is a tad late on that, goes past his cut
beauty. Seams and angles away. 130 kph, good length outside off, keeps moving away and leaves Williamson's bat hanging.
good stop from Shadab. Good length outside off, carved away towards backward point, where Shadab dives to his left.
shuffles right across and flicks a delivery through square leg. A manufactured run, like Amla
full delivery around off, hit to cover. Good comeback from Raees
good length around off, 138 kph, punched away to mid-on from the crease
139 kph, seams back in, full delivery around off, the ball comes back in, whipped to midwicket
full delivery outside off, Williamson shuffles across, looking to hit the ball to mid-on but it trickles to mid-off
a slower delivery outside off, Williamson comes down slightly and drives to cover
goes short, 136 kph, Williamson watches the ball onto his pull, one to square leg
a short delivery, down leg this time. Guptill avoids the delivery but not called a wide
back of a length outside off, Williamson pushes to cover from the crease
struggles to time the pull again, back of a length around middle and leg, pulled to deep square leg
133 kph, good length on the pads, flicked away to deep midwicket for a run
good length delivery outside off, keeps a tad low, scoots underneath the bat.
a tad short from Raees, under-edged through square leg for two. Right in the gap there
a good single. A loud yelp of frustration from Sarfraz. Full around middle, pushed to mid-on for one
laced into the gap behind square. He was waiting for that, short, a bouncer around off. Guptill gets on top of the bounce and places his pull into the gap
good length on middle and off, worked to midwicket.'Andar aa raha hai ball,' says Sarfraz (the ball is coming in)
a stop from Shadab saved three. Would have gone for four if it beat point. Full and wide, carved away towards point
the only dot of the over. Good from NZ. Back of a length outside off, pushed to cover from the crease
the legspinner, looking for the cut is Guptill. Some bounce takes it over the bat
too full, overpitched outside off, driven back to the bowler
edged for four. Short and wide, a thick outside edge as Guptill tries to cut
shortish and wide, 86 kph, slashed to point. Very far outside off
90 kph, pushed through, full around off and quick, defended towards cover
good length outside off, 131 kph, probing channel. Pushed back to the bowler
beaten on the outside edge. Good length delivery outside off, the ball flies past Guptill's edge, looking to go at the ball too hard
excellent lines, 135 kph, around off on a length, pushed towards cover
the outside edge down to third man. Slightly wider of the crease, on a length, thick outside edge is found
smashed! Williamson charges, Ashraf sees it and shortens the length but Williamson still knows what's coming, a short delivery around off, pummeled back over the bowler. Excellent batting
135 kph, full and a tad wide, chopped back to the bowler
84 kph, a full delivery outside off, thick inside edge towards fine leg for one
overpitched outside off, 84 kph, driven to deep cover
88 kph, quick outside off, pushed to cover
googly on middle and leg, 92 kph, nudged to midwicket. A tad cautious against legspin is Guptill
short and wide outside off, punched to long-off for one.
short of a length outside off, slaps it away to sweeper cover
in the air and just in front of point. Guptill haves against the line at this back of a length delivery and pops a leading edge that drops short of the fielder
length ball, keeps a little low outside off and Williamson gets an inside edge that rolls behind the stumps as he sticks the bat out
short of a length and angling in, Williamson backs away slightly and stabs it into the covers
short and wide, slapped over the in-field with poor timing to sweeper cover on the bounce
short of a length, angling in around off, Guptill flicks to deep midwicket and Williamson belts out a late 'no' as they look for the second run
length ball, loped up on middle and spinning away, presses forward and drills into the off side
full, gets down for a slog sweep and fails to find the middle as the ball rolls away to deep midwicket
good length, stays in the crease and tucks into the leg side
short of a length on off, shifts back into the crease and whips it away in front of long-on
back of a length, pitching outside leg, flicked to midwicket
short of a length, pitching outside leg, stands tall and taps to midwicket
full around the leg-stump, pushed out to midwicket gently
short of a length on middle, stands tall and punches to long-on
short of a length, angled in, turned away behind square on the leg side

a horrific mix-up. Oh, dear! They did all the hardwork by consolidating and now have fallen to bad communication. A full legbreak that was driven out to deep point. Williamson wants the second but Guptill isn't sure. Williamson continues on his way and Guptill responds. But it's so late that they're almost at the same end. The throw comes on to Sarfraz's end who then underarms it to the bowler who gathers it and takes out the stumps even as Guptill puts in a full-length dive
full on the stumps, pushed back
floated up outside off, driven to long-off
short of a length outside off, gets on top of it and drops it towards mid-on
short of a length outside off, punched firmly to the covers
short of good length, gets slightly big and he whips it slightly uppishly down to wide long-on
short, wide, opens up for a late cut and point moves to his left and dives to make a clean stop
now one that keeps low, on a length outside off, kept out
short, makes some room and cuts to point
fullish length, outside off, steps forward and defends tightly
floated up again but this time he's given lot more room and he crunches a drive through the covers. To the left of the fielder there
full, wide, driven through the same region but straighter to the sweeper at the boundary
short of a length, non-turner, Taylor makes sure to give himself some room and opens the face from front of off for a late cut through short third man
short of a length, angling into him, whipped to midwicket who dives forward and stops
full and swinging in, driven slightly uppishly to the covers
short of a length outside off, drills it back down the pitch and the bowler gets down to his right to stop it
short of a length, holding its line outside off, punched to sweeper cover
back of a length, works with the angle past the diving midwicket fielder for two
full, curving in on off, clipped away to wide mid-on fora sharp single. Manages to beat the throw at the bowler's end
full and slid across, clipped through the square leg region
length ball, slanted across on middle and off, punched to mid-on
full and tight on middle, shuffles across to cover the drift and defends back
slightly short of a length outside off, stays put in the crease and punches towards mid-off

that's a much-needed boundary for Williamson. The strike-rate had slipped under 50 and then he sees this gift of shortness and width outside the off stump and accepts it by gleefully cutting through the covers
short, wide, slashes a cut to deep backward point and third man runs across
short of a length outside off and that's a superb shot. Stands in the crease and crunches a backfoot punch well to the left of mid-off. Top placement and sweet timing
short ball, gets over Williamson's arched back
short and wide, gets on top of it and cuts to sweeper cover
shortish, fetches a pull from outside off and drags it down to deep backward square leg
full and slanted across, nudged to midwicket

Williamson has reviewed an lbw decision. This may have pitched outside leg. Malik slides one across at an in-between length and Williamson is caught on neither foot. Shifts back late and looks to flick but it comes on a tad too straight and nails him on the pad. Williamson goes up straightaway and it has indeed pitched outside leg
slides in a fuller delivery on middle and leg, gently caresses it down to long-on
full, pushed wide of long-on for a single
short, keeps a little low and he pulls it with the turn from the confines of his crease to deep midwicket
full, pitches outside leg, nudged it to square leg

oh, what a shot! This has been timed to perfection. A short of a length delivery that's pretty accurate on middle. Williamson wristily whips it to deep midwicket. Azhar Ali runs to his left from deep square leg and dives right in fornt of the boundary. And he has done superbly to pull it back while not making contact with the ropes
short of a length outside off, gets on top and bunts it into the surface on the off side
short of a length outside off, punched to mid-off
full, a wide half-volley that gives Williamson his fifty WIlliamson gets forward and drives through the covers
short and wide, cut late through backward of point
full and slanted across on middle and leg, pushed straight down and right through Malik who lets it go through the legs
full and slanted across on off, drilled down to long-on
full and slid across, knocks it to midwicket
wide length ball, spinning further away, Taylor walks towards it outside off and cuts but can't beat point
short of a length and some width again, cuts to sweeper cover
short, wide, cut to sweeper cover
short of a length and some spin away, stays legside of it and cuts to sweeper cover
flicked into the leg side
full and driven to long-on
similar length, pushed further across, driven to long-off this time
extra flight and loop on this one, driven down the ground for one
full outside off, driven to the off side
slower short ball, picked early by Williamson who waits before nailing a pull to the left of deep backward square leg
length ball outside off, drops it into the turf towards mid-off
length, outside off, opens the face for a late dab to third man
slower full ball outside off, squeezes it out into the off side
length, spins away on off, dabs it to point for a quick single
sliding on middle and leg and straightening, punched to long-on
pitched up around off, drilled down to wide long-on
a forehand swat, short around off, pulled to midwicket. Toe-ended it. Would have been wide had he left it.

and Williamson chips his wicket away. A bad period of cricket from Williamson. A slower delivery outside off, he comes out, looking to go over cover,  but hits it rather badly. Carries over the head of Hafeez at mid-off, but the ball pops out. He keeps his eyes and his head, and takes the parry.
good length around off, the ball seaming in, 129 kph, dabbed towards point
a tad wider outside off, dabbed to third man for a single
beaten on the outside edge. Good finish. Good length outside off, gets the ball to angle away and beat Taylor's hanging bat.
overpitched from Malik, outside off, drilled down to long-off for a single
a tad flat around off, driven to long-on. Taylor's intent has been really good today
on the pads, nudged down to short fine leg. Taylor calls for one, very clear communication from Rosco.
flayed away into the gap behind point for four. Full and wide outside off, he lets the ball come to him before slicing a drive into the gap behind point. Great placement
on the pads, quicker, fired in. Latham misses a flick, struck on the pad. Missed an opportunity
good length on off, 132 kph, a thick outside edge down to third man for a single. Raees creating that away angle
beauty. Full delivery, shaping away, beats Latham on the outside edge. Using subtle changes in point of release
good length on off, pushed to mid-on, 129 kph
good length around off, hit back to the bowler from the crease. Playing with a nice, full face of the bat
a slower delivery on the pads, 106 kph, flicked into the gap behind square for a couple. Well-placed shot
a tad full outside off, caressed to mid-off, 126 kph. Just three off that over
full delivery around off, the ball seaming back in, nudged to midwicket
full delivery outside off, the ball seaming back in, Taylor's attempted drive skews away to mid-on
the wrong end. Good length outside off, chopped towards backward point. Taylor's hesitant, but goes through with the run. The fielder throws and misses at the batsman's end, Latham is comfortable
good length around off, defended back.
walks right across and flicks the ball nicely into the gap at midwicket for a couple. Well placed, made that shot by shuffling
full delivery outside off, driven towards cover, who dives to his right but parries the ball away to the sweeper cover
back of a length delivery outside off, defended back
good length outside off, 137 kph, carved to point. Playing it with the full face of the bat
lovely shot. Good length around off, Latham drills his drive, past Taylor. A punchy push. Great timing. Four to mid-on
slower delivery outside off, thick outside edge falls just short of Sarfraz. One to third man
140 kph, full around off, driven to mid-on. Walking into the shot
edged down to third man. Shortish delivery outside off, Taylor lets the ball come onto him before dabbing one off the outside edge. Wanted one but got more
good length outside off, 135 kph, seaming in, pushed back towards the bowler
short delivery down leg, 129 kph, Taylor gets underneath. Clever change in length, earned himself a dot ball
full delivery outside off, 140 kph, pushed to mid-off with the full face of the bat
too high and called. A short delivery around middle and leg, Taylor bails out of a pull
good length outside off, edged down to third man
into the gap behind point. Full and wide outside off, Latham leans into a cut and carves the ball through  backward point. Four more
ooh, gets away with it. Short and wide outside off, slashed to point
good length delivery around middle and off, defended back
a slower delivery outside off, Taylor opens the face and carves a ball to point.
four dot balls, excellent bowling. Quick offcutters, around 125 kph, defended back up the pitch
a slower delivery outside off, defended towards point, 122 kph
flat around off, 84 kph, defended towards point for a run. Just a tap
the googly on middle and leg, nudged away into the gap at square leg
drifts down leg, 87 kph. Not a wide says the umpire. Hmm, down the leg side it was
nails the sweep, flat around off, the hard sweep  but along the ground to deep backward square leg. Sarfraz warns Malik of the spin
full on middle and leg, drilled into Latham's feet, the ball ricochets to long-on
goes short, on middle and leg, Taylor nails a pull to deep square leg
another short delivery, 127 kph, pulled down to fine leg. Got on top of the bounce, very well played
a shortish delivery around off, 141 kph, pulled to deep square leg for the single that takes Taylor to fifty. Anchored the innings nicely
a nice, short, slower delivery. Taylor misses it. But Amir has overstepped, by a few inches. Sloppy
looking for the wide yorker, 141 kph, may have been just inside the tramline. The umpire doesn't think so. Tough one to call
goes on the pads, full, quick and hurries Taylor, 143 kph. Taylor can't connect with a flick
a short delivery down leg, 123 kph, pulled down to fine leg. Decent over for Pakistan
87 kph, full on middle and leg, worked away to deep midwicket for a single
flat outside off, 87 kph. The reverse sweep from Latham goes to third man

flat and straight and given! Short on middle, Taylor opts not to review. That's halfway up, in front of middle. Only question for the umpire was if it pitched in line. Taylor stayed low but missed a pull off a straight delivery. This being the 43rd over, he could have taken a risk. But walks right off. A fine fifty from Taylor.

what a stunner from Shadab. A googly outside off, Nicholls looks to turn the ball towards long-on, but the ball moves away, which forces a leading edge. Shadab throws himself to his right and plucks out the second one-handed stunner of the day. Very similar to Lyon's catch in the Ashes, but the other direction and devoid of the hangtime
too full down leg, worked to deep midwicket, 86 kph
flat outside off, worked into the gap at midwicket for another couple. Very nicely placed from Latham
full and wide outside off, drilled to long-off, 92 kph
flicked away to long-on
flat around off, 93 kph, driven away to long-off
comes down, plenty of flight on that, driven away to long-off for a single
short and wide outside off, 86 kph, cut out to deep point. Quick on it to prevent the possibility of two.
short and quick on middle and off, 89 kph, pushed back to the bowler
the googly on middle, 88 kph, overpitched, drilled to long-off. Just setting up for the last five overs
looking for the slog sweep, but Shadab bowls it full and wide, awkwardly jabbed to deep midwicket for one
short down leg, flicked away to deep midwicket, 87 kph.
a googly, outside off, carved to deep point. Amir fumbles and allows the second. Shadab ends at 2 for 51
a slow, shortish delivery down leg, helped along towards fine leg
dropped! Full delivery on middle and leg, hit away towards long-on. Oh, it's an easy catch made look incredibly hard. Flat to his right, he comes in does Hafeez and drops a clanger.
giving himself room, follows him full down leg, driven to long-on

and gone! Hasan strikes. He was struggling Santner. A short slow delivery down leg, Santner is through his flick too early, the ball goes through his flick, hits him on the thigh pad and ricochets onto the stumps. This is turning out to be a fine comeback from Pakistan

straight to Malik at deep square leg. Wow, what a turnaround this is. A short, slower delivery around off. Latham sees an opportunity to get six and he hits it nicely, but there was late dip on the ball. And the ball carries straight to Malik at deep square leg, who takes a good catch. Trouble for New Zealand now

out with a direct hit! 132 kph, good length on off, tapped towards point for a quick single. Shadab runs in and misses at the batsman's end, and then his body collides into Southee, who falls over after contact.
short delivery around off, played back towards the bowler, 131 kph
a short wayward delivery drifts down leg for a wide.
good length delivery outside off, 129 kph, Southee opens the bat face and guides one down to third man for one
poor line. On the pads from Raees, Astle flicks him away down to fine leg for four. These are all crucial runs
134 kph, good length delivery outside off, carved down to third man
134 kph, full and straight, driven to mid-off. Some hesitation but the run is easily completed
that's four. A slower delivery on middle and leg, 116 kph, pulled away behind square for four. Clever shot. Vital runs

goes right through, 134 kph, full on middle and leg, the yorker. Southee backs away and misses a big slog, the ball hits middle and leg stump, and from nowhere, New Zealand are nine down. Beaten completely for pace
full and straight, 136 kph, Boult shuffles across, exposing his pads but pushes one to long-on. Wild cheers

133 kph, full, straight and Ferguson misses a flick. Sarfraz reviews! It was tailing back in ever so late, but struck Ferguson in front of leg. Looks like it is clipping the side of leg stump, at best. HawkEye says it's missing the stumps completely.
a slower ball outside off, Boult thinks of cutting, driving, pulling, slogging, but ends up leaving it
a low full toss, 130 kph, driven to mid-off for a single.
a short slow delivery outside off, 123 kph, wanted to smash that through long-on but sliced
a low full toss down leg, worked away into the gap behind square for a couple. Hafeez collects and throws right in the middle of the pitch. Awful throw
110 kph, out with a direct hit. He had sooooo much time, a slower delivery on off, tapped to Sahdab at backward point, who takes aim and misses at the batsman's end with Boult not in the frame.
133 kph, short down leg, Ferguson is hurried for pace on his pull, one to fine leg
full down leg, 136 kph, Boult clears his front leg and looks to give the ball a massive thwack, but fails to make contact
SMASHED! The crowd goes wild. Full delivery outside off, Boult clears his front leg and slaps the ball over mid-off
a short, slow ball outside off, patted towards cover. The throw to the bowler is fumbled and Boult comes back for two. Sarfraz isn't pleased
gasps of exasperation from the crowd. Full on off, Boult clears his front leg and shovels a flick with plenty of bottom hand, right in the gap at midwicket
looking for the yorker, full down leg, the perfect yorker. Boult clears his front leg, and jams the ball onto his foot. The ball then ricochets back onto the stumps. Three for Hasan.
short of a length, coming in towards off, punched to mid-on
length ball on off, presses forward and blocks into the covers
short of a length, curving in towards off, stands tall and punches into the covers
length ball, angling in from well outside off, not bothered with
full and straight, holding its line around a set of stumps outside off, left alone
full and wide again, left alone in the channel outside off
full and sliding on the pads, beats the attempted glance to hit him on the pad
a loose cut shot attempted away from the body, cuts in a little to get an inside edge that misses the stumps narrowly

dropped. Santner has had his share of misfields and dropped catches this series. Oh, dear, this is catching practice. Driven uppishly straight into his hands. This really should have been taken with his eyes closed
length ball outside off, chops a defence into the turf

Santner will breathe a sigh of relief. A ripping awayswinger from Boult. This is unplayable. Forcing Azhar to play at it by landing it around middle and off before it swings away from the back of a length to graze the outside edge on its way to first slip
full on middle, clipped off the pads straight to midwicket
slower length ball at 117.8kph outside off, presses forward and blocks
good length, angling in late towards middle, defended back solidly
rolls his fingers over the seam, another slower ball at 109.6kph that's full, driven to mid-on
fullish, angling in on off, defended towards midwicket
pristine cover driven with a long stride forward but picks out the fielder in the region

and Boult strikes again. This one's not to a good delivery or anything though. Zaman indiscreetly slashes at a wide short delivery but it cuts in ever so slightly to find the inside edge and crash into the stumps
short of good length on off, stays back and defends into the off side

this is good stuff. Boult dishing out some unplayable deliveries here and Pakistan are crumbling. Hafeez is drawn forward early by a good length delivery and is once again forced to play at it. The ball jags away very late and very subtly to take an edge to first slip who takes the catch to his left
short of good length, hits him high on the pad as he pushes at it from the backfoot. But the ball pitched outside leg
fullish length, holding its line, left in the channel outside off
short of good length, a bit of movement outside off, Babar defends back off the inside of the bat
full, around the fifth-stump channel, gets a good stride forward to block into the covers
short of a length outside off, jumps up and keeps it out
poor delivery to end the over and that gives Pakistan their first boundary of the innings. Back of a length, drifting down the leg side, tucked away through square leg
good length on off, bunted down the pitch
short ball, gets pushed back as he jumps up and bunts it into the covers
full and angled across, chases it a mile away from the body and gets comprehensively beaten
length ball, left alone as it holds its line in the channel outside off
full, pushed across, squeezed out to third man for one. A wicketless over for Boult. What a rarity!
short of a length, around the fifth-stump channel, chops a gentle cut into the ground towards point
full, angling in on middle and leg, pushed elegantly down the pitch with a straight bat to mid-on
short of a length around the fourth or fifth stump channel, Malik stabs it into the off side after getting on top of it
great accurate bowling. Not giving anything. Length ball on middle and off, blocked down the pitch
full outside off, presses forward and blocks into the covers
short of a length around off, defended back solidly
back of a length, angled across, left alone close to off
good length on middle, taps it against the angle towards midwicket
short ball, angled across, arches out of the line
ill-advised pull shot attempt. Definitely not short enough for the shot. The ball sneaks from under the bat and more importantly misses the stumps pretty narrowly
good length around off, defended into the off side
short of a length, angled across, steers it late through backward point
length ball, angles in around off, defended
good length, angling in towards off, gets a good stride and blocks into the covers
fullish length, keeps a little low around off, blocked
back of a length on the stumps, tucked to midwicket
back of a length, a little low outside off, punches off the inside part of the bat to mid-on
good length, cuts in around middle, defended
fullish length, angled across a set of stumps outside off, left alone
good length around off, defended
short ball, well-directed, hurriedly gets out of the way
good length on off, blocked into the off side
back of a length outside off, drops it in front of point for a quick single
short and wide, no pace, cuts to point
good length outside off, pushed back
short of a length around off, punched to midwicket
length ball outside off, gently taps between cover and point for one
fuller, shapes in from outsideoff, Babar shows the full face of his bat and the ball takes the inside of it to long-on
waits for this one to come on before opening the face and picks out short third man
fullish outside off, defended
back of a length outside off, punches to cover
this one angles in from similar length around leg stump and he tucks it away to square leg
back of a length on off, defended

now all of a sudden Pakistan decide to come alive and that has resulted in a run out. A short of a length delivery that is punched to sweeper cover. They magically realise the need to get a move on and take on the fielder in the deep for a second run. And it's suicidal. Santner has run to his left, gathered it and fired a flat powerful throw at the keeper's end. Babar grounds his bat, it gets stuck in the turf and he is empty-handed by the time the bails are whipped off
short of a length around off, defended to mid-off
length ball, cuts in towards off, defended from the crease
full on middle, driven to mid-on
short of a length, drilled straight back to the bowler
back of a length around off, punched to long-on
short of a length on leg, tucked around the corner to deep backward square leg
short of a length outside off, dropped into the point region
and they keep piling on. Back of a length around off, defended

the tight lines are being defended. That means the only time they can open up is when there's width. Malik does that, is patience is tested which has clouded his judgement and he fends away awkwardly from the body. Nowhere near the line. Thick, healthy outside edge taken on the second attempt by Taylor at first slip. Pakistan are writing the book on how not to bat in one-day cricket
short ball, sways out of the line
sticks the bat out loosely to a delivery outside off that curves in sharply and narrowly beats the outside egde
full outside off, defended
length ball on middle, defended
good length outside off, defended
short ball, sways out of the line
short of a length, down the leg side, tries to tuck and misses. Some noise but that was ball hitting the pad. So wrong call from the umpire
short of a length, stays in the crease and gets an inside edge into the leg side as he defends
short of a length around off, punched into the covers
the greatest against-the-run-of-play six ever! Off a top-edge as he pulls this short ball, well over deep backward square leg. Way, way over the stands. A monstrous hit
shortish, stops on him a bit, mistimes a pull but gets it between midwicket and mid-on
very full outside off, squeezed out to point
length ball around off, defended
short of a length, blocked to mid-off
full outside off, driven back
full on the stumps, hammered down the ground to long-on
back of a length, punched down to long-on
144 kph, good length outside off, Sarfraz opens the bat face and carves this down to third man
goes full, around off, 146 kph, pushed to mid-off. Beaten for pace, but he got his bat down in time
full on middle and leg, flicked away through square leg for two. Again, hurried into the shot.

139 kph, the short ball and Ashraf is caught at fine leg. It's a short delivery outside off, Ashraf clears his front leg, looking to pull through square leg, but the ball is too quick and angled away. Takes the leading edge and settles in fine leg's hands. An abject capitulation
short again, on middle and leg, 140 kph, Hasan ducks underneath
another short delivery, 136 kph, too short and called a wide
146 kph, full delivery outside off, a thick outside edge races down to third man for a single.

Williamson takes a blinder and Pakistan are 32 for 8! What a catch. We've seen many one-handed stunners today, but you can't beat this. It's short on middle and leg, Hasan pulls towards midwicket. Williamson is beaten by the pace of the shot, or so it seems, until he sticks out his right hand and catches it even as it seems like the ball has passed him. How did he catch up with that? Amazing reflexes, he takes some absolute stunners in practice, this ain't practice.
good length around off, defended
good length outside off, carved to point
good length delivery outside off, punched to cover
a slower delivery outside off, blocked away.
maiden. Full delivery outside off, driven towards cover
a short delivery on middle and leg, Sarfraz tickles this fine to fine leg, happy to take the single.
full and straight, skewed to cover. His feet moving nowhere. Seems like a matter of time
good length around off, blocked. Can't blame Amit but all batsmen's intent is the same: block, block and try to score
dug in, too short outside off, a wide called
inside-edged through fine leg for four. Good length delivery outside off, plays outside the line, a thick edge. No lowest total for Pakistan
142 kph, full on the pads, chipped away towards midwicket
good length down leg, 142 kph, nudged to square leg. Pakistan get to 20 overs. We have a match
good length on middle and leg, 119 kph, shovelled to midwicket
full around off, shovelled with the bottom hand to midwicket
full and straight, 118 kph, driven to long-on
full delivery outside off, 118 kph, outside-edged down to third man.
short, dug in with the keeper up, Sarfraz ducks underneath. Stopped by the keeper
a slower delivery outside off, shovelled away to midwicket
144 kph, full and straight, driven towards Williamson at mid-off, he sprints to his left
142 kph, good length outside off, carved off the open face to third man
142 kph, short delivery outside off, pushed away towards point
good length on the pads, 138 kph, nudged to square leg
136 kph, dug in, short outside off, Amir avoids it rather awkwardly
absolutely smashed for four, Pakistan avoid their lowest ODI total. Full outside off, Amir leans into a drive and caresses it, through the gap at cover
good length outside off, punched away towards cover
121 kph, good length on off, a solid block
122 kph, good length outside off, carved to point. Nothing happening in Dunedin.
good length on middle, nudged to midwicket
133 kph, full and wide from Boult to begin, slashed to point
good length outside off, dabbed down to third man
back of a length outside off, 137 kph, patted to point
looking for the yorker, full, sliding down, jammed to square leg
137 kph, Amir clears his front leg and nails a lofted drive right over the bowler's head. Not great timing but enough

140 kph, four and out! Full delivery down leg, Amir was probably anticipating the bouncer, clears his front leg, but the ball takes the outside edge and smashes the middle stump. 4 for 9 now for Boult
125 kph, good length delivery outside off, pulled to midwicket
good length delivery on middle, nudged to midwicket
short and a tad wide, 129 kph, slashed down to third man
smashed on the helmet. Goes back, looking to pull, but is soooo late on the shot that the ball has an unhindered path en route to thwacking the badge.
short and wide outside off, 130 kph, Raees backs away, looking to swat the ball over the off side, a thick outside edge races away over the keeper's head. Off the toe end actually
good length outside off, 129 kph, dabbed down to third man and they take the single
a full delivery, wide outside off, driven to mid-off
full outside off, fourth-stump channel. Raees clears his front leg and swings, but the ball goes over the hoick
fullish delivery outside off, bunted away to cover for a run
139 kph, looking for the yorker, but misses, blocked out.
dug in too short on off, over the head, wide
130 kph, back of a length on middle and leg, dabbed to point
ooh, take that. Dug in short and Raees was waiting for that, he goes back and hammers a pull through midwicket. A tennis forehand
a full toss down leg, a thick inside edge down to fine leg
dug in short, down leg, goes over Sarfraz
a full and wide delivery outside off, glided off the open face to third man
lovely looking shot again. A low full toss on off, delectably punched back past Southee. Long-on runs around to his left to mop up
full and straight, Raees backs away and clatters a lofted drive over mid-on. Nice hit
136 kph, five-for for Boult. Full and straight, Rumman backs away, misses the straight ball and the stumps are disturbed. New Zealand take the series with it.
swing straight away. Leaves the right-hander from a fullish length and Masakadza presses forward and pushes it into the covers
full, angling in on middle and straightening from that channel, pushes it down to the ground with the full face of the bat. Neat shot to get off the mark
shortens his length right away. This one's at a back of a length and he tucks it with the angle to midwicket
full and angling on the pads, too easy for Masakadza who flicks uppishly past the fielder at short midwicket. Second four of the opening over
lovely, there's the riposte from the bowler. Full and drawing him forward. Masakadza responds and the ball  leaves him so late and so sharply to beat the outside edge
short of a length, left alone outside off
turn straightaway, takes the inside of the bat as Mire presses forward and defends
pitched up outside off, flights it up with lots of room and Mire gets down and crunches a sweep from outside off through square leg
fullish length on middle, flicked to short leg
slightly back of a length, shifts back and pats it to the left of the short leg fielder for one
short of a length, holding its line outside off, left alone
short and wide, plays the upper cut. Not very convincing as he couldn't get on top of it entirely but enough to clear the in-field
short of a length, holding its line outside off, left alone
back of a length, angling in on middle and leg, flicked through midwicket
full, angling in on off, driven to mid-off
loops it up on middle and leg, clipped through midwicket
flat and full outside off, just comes on with the arm and beats the edge as Mire sticks the bat out playing for the turn
huge appeal for leg before. Not given and it seems like the impact may have been outside off. Gets down to sweep to the wrong length. Not full enough. Mathews does not take the review
closes the face looking to flick with the turn but the ball's well outside off and he gets a leading edge into the off side
pitched up outside off, crunches a drive to mid-off
short of a length around off, stands tall and punches into the covers
short of a length on off, gets behind the line and punches down the ground solidly
the off-cutter outside off but too full and Mire picks it early. Waits for it before thumping it straight down the ground for four
short of a length, flicks uppishly with the angle through the vacant midwicket area
good length, cuts in off the seam to find the inside of the bat as he stands in the crease and punches
too full and well outside off, gets down and crunches a reverse sweep through backward of point
full around off, jabs it towards mid-on for one
full and tight around off, defended off the front foot
short ball, bounces considerably and has him scampering under it. One for the over
short of good length on off, punched crisply off the backfoot back to the bowler
back of a length, a lot more width this time and Masakadza presses forward and punches into the covers
full around off, carved away to mid-on. No run there
short ball, this time it's not disconcerting for Masakadza who gets on top and controls a pull through backward of square leg
length ball on off, drops into the covers with a solid block off the front foot
flighted on middle and leg, these are easy offerings on the pads, and Mire gets down to sweep of them through backward square leg
full on middle and leg, blocked to the right of the bowler
short of a length, presses forward and the ball jags away to find the outside edge before running down to third man
full and holding its line outside off, left alone
short of a length, nips into him and strikes the pad as it beats the attempted tuck. Angle an issue there. Would have missed leg
swing and a miss outside off
full on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket
full and angling into the stumps, drilled to midwicket
short of a length, angling in, worked off the hips to deep fine leg
full on middle, turns it away with the angle to midwicket
short ball, gets well over the batsman and called a wide
full on the pads, clipped uppishly through midwicket
short ball, gets over off and Masakadza is looking for a wide call but the umpire deems it fine
short, angling down  the leg side, goes for the pull and misses
good length, angling in on the stumps, worked to long-on
stays in the crease to defend and chops it into the surface
reaches out for a fuller delivery and drives it square, to the left of point who gets down and sticks the hand out. Good timing
too short and goes well over the batsman. This is some tripe from Perera. He's bowling all over the place
short of a length on off, defended
full and accurate around off, punched back
short of a length on off, turns it away into the leg side
short ball, rushes onto him at serious pace and beats the attempted pull

edged but safe. Extra bounce from around the good length region and completely catches him off guard. Mire can't get on top of it and gets an outside edge and goes on the bounce towards third man. Stayed up for a good length of time
short ball, this time he gets on top and crunches a pull to deep midwicket
good length, accurate on off, punched back

stops on him a little. Could have been the slower ball as well. Looks to flick into the leg side and gets a leading edge as he closes the face early. Luckily for him, the ball lands on the vacant spaces at the cover region
fullish length at 124.2 ks, pats it into the leg side

oh, dear! This was a needless shot. He's been trying to force something for a while but it was really not required because Zimbabwe were moving along at a fair clip. Mire tries to force a pull but it really didn't come on to him. And it's the wrong line as well. Tucked up completely and he skews it off the top-edge to short midwicket who moves to his right and gets under it. Much-needed breakthrough for Sri Lanka and it's been gifted to them
brilliant fielding. Full and angling in on the pads, flicked off them and short fine leg dives to his left to stop a certain boundary
short ball, gets over middle and leg, ducked under
full on off, driven towards mid-off. A bit of hesitation on the single and Ervine eventually responds and beats the throw at the keeper's end

edged and put down at second slip. Would have been a stunning catch had he held on. Kusal Mendis the fielder. Flung himself to his left and gets his hands on it but the ball bursts out. Poor shot from Ervine. Chasing a delivery he really should have left alone
full on off, defended
back of a length, angled across, holds its line and it's left alone
short of a length on middle, quietly turns it away into the leg side
full and angled across on off, defended
short ball, angled across his off-stump and he sways out of the line to let it go
full and drifting into him, tries to flick but the ball grazes the pad instead as it goes to short fine leg
good length on off, defended off the front foot
short ball, shapes up for a pull but decides against it and keeps his bat down as the ball goes over
short of a length outside off, stands tall and punches to the right of deep point
short ball, uses the angle and just pulls it over the short fine leg fielder. Deep backward square leg runs across and dives to his right but the ball beats him
climbs from a good length region. Hits the high part of Masakadza's front pad
full delivery outside off, tidy line, defended into the cover region
good length on middle and leg, the ball coming back in slightly. Defended into the leg side
full delivery outside off, 136 kph, some seam movement back in. Edged into the pad
good end. Full delivery outside off, Taylor lifts his bat vertically and lets the ball go.
flat and quick, pushed through the air, defended back
very full outside off, sliced through to the sweeper cover for a run, hit with the spin
a tad short and wide, easy ball for Taylor to go  back and cut to deep cover to open his account
quick around off, flatter trajectory. Blocked back
looks for the reverse sweep, he likes that shot, but he toe-ends this away to point
good length delivery outside off, 136 kph, dabbed down to third man for a single.
good length delivery on middle, 129 kph, nudged down to fine leg
good batting from Masakadza. Taps a length delivery down to third man to get to fifty. Needs to double it or get close for Zimbabwe
127 kph, short delivery on off, well-directed, but there isn't a lot of pace on this surface. An awkward jabbed stab down to fine leg. Lobs away
on a length, 129 kph, worked away to midwicket
131 kph, back of a length delivery around off, Masakadza tries to drag his flick to midwicket but can only find the fielder
that's a filthy full toss. Happens with wristspin. Taylor heaves the ball away to the midwicket boundary. Nicely hit
83 kph, full delivery outside off, driven to cover
overpitched outside off, 84 kph, drilled to long-off for a single.
a yorker on middle and leg, 82 kph, driven to long-on. Too full
too full again, around off, jammed towards mid-on for one. Another good single
more flight outside off, nicely driven to long-off to get to the team 100
full delivery outside off, coming back in, driven to the sweeper cover
132 kph, full and straight, shovelled to square leg for nothing
another shortish delivery outside off, Taylor arches his back and carves the ball towards third man, on the bounce
back of a length, around off, defended back. A bit of extra bounce
full delivery, coming back in with the angle, pushed to mid-off
more extra bounce, 127 kph, around middle and leg, Masakadza keeps it out awkwardly. Seems to be generating some steep bounce from that good length area
gets right across and sweeps to short fine leg. Flat and straight delivery
looking for the paddle sweep this time, but it's too full, toe-ends it away

looking for the reverse sweep this time. He has been given, but Taylor reviews right away. Was there some bat or glove? He just missed a straight one, it seemed. But he did not, he got an under-edge onto the pad. Never easy for the umpire to see those ones, but good review from BT
flat and quick on middle and leg, 78 kph, nudged to midwicket
full delivery outside off, worked to deep square leg, got to the pitch
short and wide outside off, slapped away past mid-off for four. Too wide from Chameera, and there are massive vacant areas there. Nicely punched
back of a length around off, 133 kph, blocked back. Gets on top of the bounce
full delivery around off, a thick outside edge to third man. Nice lines
oops, dug in but too short and too wide. Masakadza swayed away, and earned an extra
back of a length outside off, punched away to cover from the crease. Stood tall and hit it away
short around off, worked away to midwicket
a tad too full outside off, driven to mid-off. Good comeback from Chameera in that over
knew his area, stayed low and slog-swept gleefully to the deep midwicket boundary. Better choice of sweep with that field. A tad too full from Dananjaya
beautiful batting, full delivery outside off, coming back in, worked away into the gap at square leg for two.
the googly, out the back of the hand, full delivery outside off, defended
full delivery outside off, 86 kph, nudged to midwicket
the legbreak this time, lots of flight down leg, spinning towards the stumps, defended
shuffles right across, gets outside the line, and looks to sweep, but misses. Struck outside the line. Good batting, gives yourself a failsafe if you miss
good length outside off, pushed to cover
not in control, but he gets four. Dug in, short around off, Masakadza drags the pull from well outside off but bisects square leg and fine leg.
drifts down leg, wide.
beautifully played. Full and straight, Masakadza drills the drive right back, hits the stumps at the bowler's end
good length down leg, nudged to fine leg for one
85 kph, the legbreak, on middle and off, driven to long-on
lovely batting. Lots of flight, Masakadza clears his front leg and nails the lofted drive right back from where it came. Great place to hit the ball, right over the umpire's head
flat around middle and leg, defended away
slightly short and wide, smashed through extra cover for two. Great batting. Taking full advantage of poor bowling
too short again, and wide, slapped to long-on
flight, and a tad wide, driven into the cover region
too short, lots of time for Taylor to pick the delivery off the pitch. He stays back and punches to the sweeper cover, to his right
on middle and leg, nudged to midwicket
overpitched outside off, nudged to long-on for a run
lots of flight again outside off, driven to long-on

taken at mid-off. False shot, Masakadza is distraught. Lots of flight, overpitched outside off. Masakadza sees an opportunity, winds up and swings. But the ball is too full, disallowing him from getting underneath the length. And so his powerful drive goes straight to mid-off, who takes a juggled catch
loads of flight again, like an offbreak, driven to cover
flight outside off, 87 kph, sliced to the deep point fielder
down leg, nudged to fine leg
short and wide, a poor delivery to start. Taylor unleashes a cut but makes no contact
full and wide, 128 kph, left alone this time
full delivery outside off, fifth-stump channel, worked to midwicket
full and straight, shovelled to square leg. Playing with the full face
shortish delivery outside off, a dab to point
dug in, but drifts down leg for what I felt should have been a wide. Not called
eeks, that was tripe. A slow legcutter that was so short and soooo slow. Taylor was looking for the fine sweep but then improvised a paddle sweep to the fine leg boundary.
a full toss outside off, Raza picks out midwicket as he looks to sweep
slower through the air, wider outside off, defended in front of point for a run
a low full toss on middle, pushed away to long-on
another neat drive to long-on for one
on middle and leg, nudged to midwicket with the angle
some seam movement back in, good length outside off, inside-edged into the body. Probing line
full and wide outside off, Raza looks to scythe a cut but misses
full delivery outside off, a thick outside edge past point. Third man runs around but two
good length down leg, worked towards square leg in the air. Lands just in front of the fielder
full delivery outside off, punched into the gap at cover for two. Very neat batting from these two
good length outside off, punched to cover from the crease
likes that shot too, short delivery around off, Taylor looks to ramp the ball towards third man but the ball lobs away off, and just past point
126 kph, short delivery outside off, left alone. Good line on the bouncer
good length outside off, 138 kph, punched to deep point
good length on middle and leg, nudged to midwicket
dug in, short down leg, the ball flies down leg for an extra
length ball, keeps a little low outside off, manages to keep it out
fullish length, angling into the pads at 129.6ks, flicked to midwicket
shot! Beautiful timing. Full outside off, it's a cross-seamer, he just strides forward, meets the pitch, and presents the full face to chip it over long-off
back of a length, tucked off the hips to deep fine leg

variable bounce. Taylor is cleaned up by one that keeps slightly low. But only slightly. It's a very good delivery. Cuts in off the seam and takes the inside edge as Taylor brings the bat out and clatters into the stumps. Crucial strike for Sri Lanka in their bid to peg Zimbabwe back
reverse sweep, put away through point. Susses out the length early and takes the front leg outside off before crunching it to the right of the fielder at point
full on the pads, turned away into the leg side
full on middle and off, spins in and takes the inside of the bat as he knocks it down to long-on
<the legbreak. Pitches on middle and comes on dead straight to hit the high part of his pad
full on the pads, swept away to backward square leg
length ball outside off, opens the face and misses
short of a length, there's the variable bounce again, keeps a little low but he deals with it and defends
good length, nips in slightly and he turns it away with the angle into the leg side
short ball, Waller arches his back as the ball goes over middle and leg
full and angling on the pads, flicks it uppishly but manages to get it over the fielders at midwicket and mid-on. Dangerous shot
good length, just outside off, keeps it out with a solid front-foot defence
full and slid across on middle, pushed back
shuffles across to a length ball and flicks it to deep midwicket
fullish length, spinning in on middle, defended down the pitch
floated up around middle and leg, backs away and keeps it out awkwardly away from the body
beautiful shot. Advances down the track to meet the pitch before crunching an inside-out drive through extra cover
short of a length on off, punched away through the right of point
short of a length outside off, shuffles across and defends back
short ball, completely loses shape as he pulls. The back hand comes off, his head tilts back and he almost tumbles over. Manages to keep it along the ground, though, so well done in the end
short ball, backs away and looks to ramp it over the keeper. Bounce is considerable and has him beaten

just wide of the fielder at deep square leg. Doesn't control this pull shot. This is a slower short ball, he had rolled his fingers over the seam, and Waller doesn't control the shot. Deep backward square leg runs to his left and dives but the ball lands just in front and sneaks past him
short of a length, backs away and looks to flick but inside-edges to the pad
loopy dipping fuller ball on off, sweeps with the turn to the fine leg region
short and spinning in, backs away and cuts through point. Brings up the 200 for Zimbabwe
drifting in on the pads, turns it away to short fine leg
extremely full on the stumps, dug out back to the bowler
shortish outside off, can't get on top of it as he drags a pull to mid-on
short again, sitting up more nicely for him this time and he swivels around with a pull to deep square leg
in the air and over mid-on. Waller is lucky. A scrambled-seam short ball outside off. He slaps it with a flat bat and it takes the top-edge and just lands in front of mid-on running back
short, sees the bounce on it and lets it go outside off
short and too much bounce outside off
short of a length, cuts into him, backs away and opens the face to backward point
full and angling on leg, pushed down to long-on
short of a length, no pace at all, gently pulls it away to deep fine leg
full on middle and leg, 86.2 ks, pushed down to long-on
this one comes in to him slightly. Waller plays the line and the ball goes down to long-on off the inside of the bat
full, eased down to long-on off the front foot
slightly short, swivels through with a pull to deep backward square leg
slower short ball at 108ks, cut to sweeper cover
short ball, gets under it as the ball climbs over middle and leg
short of a length on off, stays legside of it and opens the face to point

in the air and in no man's land. Backs away to a shortish ball. All that does is tuck him up. And along with the lack of room, it results in a mistimed pull that goes in the air off the top-edge before landing in square leg. Midwicket gets around it
full outside off, driven to covers

appeal for lbw, not given. The angle seems very sharp but Sri Lanka are reviewing this. Cross-seamer, cuts in from a short of a length and beats his attempted whip to hit him in front of leg. But given the way it has drifted in, this seems unlikely to hit the stumps. Indeed, missing leg. SL lose their review
full and tight on off, defended back to the bowler
short of a length, cuts in, waits before turning it away to short fine leg
short of a length. Sri Lanka's bowlers are offering no pace here. Jumps and slaps it past the left of the cover fielder to the sweeper
short of a length, jumps up and tucks it to deep backward square leg for one
short of a length, walks across off and looks to heave it over the keeper. Misses
short again, but the lack of pace is messing up their timing. Pulled in the air and one-bounce to deep square leg
slower short ball, gets up well over off

oh, brilliant catch. That's as good a take as you'll ever see. Waller responds to a dipping full toss from outside off by getting down on one knee and heaving a sweep. Deep backward square leg runs to his left and slides across just in time to get behind the line and snaffle a lovely catch. And it's Tharanga with the terrific catch
full outside off, driven down to long-off
sprayed down the leg side
ooh, what happened there? A length ball that cuts in like an off-break to hit him high on the front leg before lobbing away behind square on the off side
full and angling in on middle and leg, clipped wide of mid-on
full, around the fifth-stump channel, and it's a lovely stroke. Drives very late behind square on the off side by opening the face of his bat
fullish outside off, driven to point
length around off, defended back
length ball outside off, defended
short of a length in the corridor of uncertainty, holds its line and Moor sticks the bat out to get beaten
full outside off, leans forward and pushes it out to mid-off
good length, spinning in, swivels around and pulls it away through square leg. Fifty for Raza. He is key to their surge now
looped up on leg, hits the pad as it goes to short fine leg and they take on the fielder there for a leg bye
shortish, leg side line again, pulled out to deep square leg
legbreak, spins the other way from middle, pushed into the covers

run out chance missed. He's confused by the spin on this one and gets hit on the pad as the ball lobs towards point. They steal a legbye and Dananjaya fails to collect the throw from Chandimal, who moved to his right, with the batsman a good distace away from the crease
poor delivery, drifts a back of a length delivery down the legside and it's tucked off the pads to deep fine leg
short ball, catches him off guard, gets up and arches his back but it climbs significantly to hit him on the arm
these are easy runs that are being gifted here. Again on the pads, back of a length, and it's been whipped off the pads through backward square leg
now he delivers one on off but the length is predictable. He isn't changing it up and Raza advances down, makes some room and slaps it through extra cover
in the air and safe! Moor looks to pull and gets a top-edge as he's tucked up. It lands in square leg with a man from the deep running in and midwicket running across. Lands in between both
that's a ridiculous shot. A slower back of a length ball, it's a legcutter, he picks it early and just slaps it straight over with a flat bat. Over long-on
Sri Lanka are not pleased with this call. It's the slower bouncer and it goes over the helmet and bat as Moor is crouching. Seems a fair call in the end
very full outside off, fetches it from outside off and whips it through deep midwicket
full and wide, driven to cover who misfields. lets the ball go through and they take a brace
full on middle and leg, tries to heave it away and gets an inside edge to backward square leg
in the blockhole, angling in on leg, dug out into the off side
full toss, backs away and makes room and crunches a drive to the right of sweeper cover
another full toss, slips out of the hand and Raza slashes it out to third man. Very poor bowling
full outside off, stays put in the crease and swings away from his body and misses
short of a length, slower, pulled to deep midwicket
down the leg side, gets down for a heave and gets hit on the pad as the ball goes to short fine leg

goes for the big hit again and this one's skewed off the splice. He's expecting it to come into him but it comes straight on and lobs in the air at cover where Dananjaya gets around it and takes it on the second attempt.

full and angling in on leg, he backs away but the ball follows him and he heaves it over mid-on. Gets lot of elevation but not the distance as the ball lands between the two fielders getting around it
extremely full outside off, crunches a drive to cover
wow, that kept very low. Flat and wide, and short. Keeps very low but Kusal slaps a drive past cover, wide long-off for four.
flat and wide outside off, too much width, Kusal goes back and carves a cut through backward point
some spin, but too wide again. Short and wide yet again, a thick outside edge over the slip fielder for a couple of runs. Got to bring that line sraighter
there it is, full on middle and leg, skewed to midwicket
waft from Kusal. Short delivery, angling away, Kusal goes at the ball but it leaves the bat hanging
a tad wider and Kusal slashes a punch through point. Back of a length delivery, just a scythe in the gap at point
that's what Jayasuriya used to do so effectively: pounce on even a little bit of width. Short and wide, he goes bottom to top and hits the ball over point for four.
poor line from Jarvis. Short down leg, nudged down to the fine leg boundary. Just a tickle and four. Zimbabwe have to adjust quickly
much better, good length, or just fuller than that. Angles away and beats the bat. Tharanga's bat left hanging. Good end
nicely bowled, quick outside off, defended
flight outside off, driven to cover
pushed through, overpitched and quick, driven past cover for a couple to wide long-off
76 kph, lots of flight on leg, driven to long-off
and again, quick outside off, scythed away towards point
flat outside off, 84 kph, outside-halved to third man
edged but well short of wide slip. Full delivery, moving away, edged but dies in front
a tad short, a tad wide, Tharanga thinks there is a cut to play but the ball seams back in and goes past his shot
short down leg, nudged to short fine leg, an offcutter. But good comeback over from Jarvis
lovely from Kusal. A shimmy to the pitch, gets there and just chips the ball over long-on. Full face of the bat. Extended his shot
full on middle and leg, charges down and drives to long-off

ooh, what happened there? A stumping missed? Or did the ball hit the stump, it did, it hit the leg stump with lots of force but it's a stubborn piece of equipment. Masakadza takes off the bail, weighs it and puts it back. Wow. Tharanga came down to the pitch and inside-halved the ball into his body, it ricocheted back but somehow Tharanga survives
what a shot, flight on off, Tharanga clears his front leg and lofts the ball easily over cover
poor delivery. Short and wide, slashed through extra cover for four. Was aware that Kusal may come down, but he didn't. The batsmen won that battle
more shots. Dug in, short and angling away, slapped through wide mid-on. Dragged it away. Big vacant areas
128 kph, full delivery on off, pushed to mid-off
127 kph, on a length around off, dabbed into the point region

and gone. Too many shots from Sri Lanka and they lose one. It's full outside off, he looks to flay a drive through the off side. Hard hands through the line, the ball lobs off the inside half to mid-on. A poor shot, it worked for a while but there were just too many, especially considering the start they had got
full around off, driven to mid-on
full delivery, coming back in, sliced to point
full and wide outside off, pushed towards cover
short and wide, 120 kph, poor delivery, chopped to point

Kusal picks out the fielder this time and Sri Lanka have lost another. His terrible form continues. Short delivery outside off, Kusal goes back, looking to pull but the ball is too close to him. All he manages is a stabbed pull to mid-on. Sri Lanka under pressure
good length delivery around off, 122 kph, pushed to mid-on
short and wide outside off, 130 kph, Kusal looks to crash a cut through the off side but extra bounce takes it over the bat
full and straight around off, defended to mid-off
too straight and whipped away for four. Nicely played from Kusal. Waited for Jarvis to come to him and then hit the gap and the boundary

125 kph, a big appeal, no says the umpire. But Zimbabwe review. They want Mathews. It seemed a tad high, full around off, the ball seams back in, hits Mathews high on the front pad in front of off. No bat on that. Missing the stumps says HawkEye, rising over. The review is lost
good length on middle and leg, 127 kph, picks out short fine leg with a nudge
a tad short and straight, swatted away through midwicket for a run to deep square leg
good length delivery outside off, pushed back to the bowler from the crease
shortish and still a tad wide outside off, 117 kph, pushed to mid-off
beauty! Goes fuller outside off, and then the ball moves away ever so late to beat the bat. Mathews actually quite lucky that moved considerably
full around off, worked into the midwicket region
129 kph, full around off, defended back
slower ball on middle and off, defended nicely
wow, how is that six? A low-flying six. Short and not that wide, he makes room and gets so much bottom hand power on his cut that it flies and flies and keeps flying over point. The shot of the day
shortish delivery on middle and leg, jammed away into the leg side.
129 kph, full on middle and leg, clipped down to short fine leg for a run. Opens his account
a slower delivery on middle, defended
short around off, swatted away to midwicket. 49 off 30 for Kusal Perera, not too many wild shots.
123 kph, on the pads, nudged to short fine leg
good length on middle and leg, some seam movement back in, worked away into the leg side
on the pads, flicked into the gap behind square for a couple. Kusal gets to fifty , a fine effort.
short delivery around off, shovelled to deep square leg
full delivery outside off, Mathews strides forward and defends to cover
full delivery outside off, 119 kph, hit back to the bowler. Mathews cautious early, as he should be
full delivery outside off, overpitched, drilled to mid-off
135 kph, full delivery outside off, right in the slot. Kusal swings and misses. He needn't be so aggressive
that's better, good cricket. Short and wide, dabbed down to third man. Ervine dives to his right and saves three. Fine stop
130 kph, seam movement, inward shape. On a length outside off, the ball comes back in, takes the inside edge onto the pad
short, the bouncer outside off, Mathews looks to drag the pull, makes no contact. Well bowled again
full delivery outside off, blocked to cover. A lot of shots for one run
124 kph, good length delivery around off, defended back
strays on the pads, nudged nicely to short fine leg
well played. On a length around off, 128 kph, nudged to midwicket for one
full and wide, Mathews' feet is rooted in the crease, driven to cover. He is careful of that seaming delivery back in
good length outside off, pushed towards wide mid-on. They aren't sure whether they want one, so Mathews decides against it
short and wide from Muzarabani, slashed to deep point for one.
good length around off, worked away to midwicket
big inside edge into the body. Ouch! Good length delivery outside off, Mathews plays outside the line and wears the blow.
a nice short delivery, around middle and leg, Mathews fails to connect. He is now 3 off 21 balls.
strays down leg this time, wide.
good length around off, 121 kph, clipped to midwicket. Mathews has taken his time so far
full outside off, 128 kph, punched to cover from the crease
on the pads this time, 125 kph, Perera misses a flick, struck on the pad but the ball is sliding down leg
good length on middle and leg, nudged away to midwicket, a good tight run
short and wide outside off, 125 kph, carved straight to point
dropped! That flew again to deep backward point, who was placed right for that shot. Short and wide, slashed away in the air. The fielder comes in, but it's flat and quick to Mire. The ball pops out
shortish around middle and leg, worked down to fine leg. Mathews careful of not stepping on his stumps
full and wide outside off, Kusal doesn't move his feet, but goes through with a drive, beaten
better from Kusal. Responsible. Good length outside off, dabbed to deep point
a nice slower delivery outside off, driven neatly to deep cover for a single
another good single. Short around off, defended towards cover for a run. Well placed
a slower delivery outside off, pushed to mid-off. Early call of yes from Kusal, quality single
slower delivery down leg, wide
shortish delivery outside off, pulled through mid-on with decent timing. But he wanted it more towards midwicket
a slower delivery down leg, 121 kph, nudged to short fine leg
a good short ball around off, 124 kph, Mathews gets underneath the ball
another short delivery around off, 120 kph, pulled to deep square leg for a single. Got on top of the bounce
a slower ball on middle and leg, worked to midwicket
short ball outside off, rolls his wrists and controls a pull along the ground to deep square leg
fullish outside off, presses forward and drives it square of the wicket to deep point. The bowler has overstepped marginally
that's an unbelievable strike. Mathews maximises the free-hit. A full delivery, way outside off, fetches it from all the way there and slogs it clean and big over deep midwicket
was that deliberate? A length ball outside off. Yes, Mathews makes use of the vacant cordon and sticks the bat and slightly opens the face. A thick edge but intentional
short ball, outside off, jumps to get on top of the bounce and pats it through backward point for one
fullish, angles in from outside off, pushes to mid-on off the inside of the bat
full on off, driven off the front foot to long-on
full, slides on middle, defended off the inside of the bat
slightly back of a length, spins in, backs away and chops a cut into the surface as the ball keeps low
short of a length, no room, again chops a cut into the surface
similar length and now he finds the room he's looking for, cut through backward point
spinning in from a length and kicking up, gets a glove to it as he tries to leave it
backs away but it spins in too sharply and he cannot free his arms on the cut to point
slides on with the arm, backs away and tries to cut but misses
length ball, spins into him and goes down the leg side
backs away and cuts this short of a length delivery through the covers. Superb timing and placement
length ball, leg side line, misses Mathews' flick and trickles to short fine leg off the pad
makes some room and forces a cut square of the wicket
length ball, spinning in outside off and keeping low, nudged away to deep backward square leg
short of a length, straightening around off, backs away and slaps to point
similar line and length, again cuts, this time to the left of deep point
back of a length, spinning in, punched to covers

misses everything. Perera blindly charges down the track and swings but the ball's too full and he can't get on top of it. It spins in sharply and gets well past the keeper. Not even half a chance at pulling off a stumping
fuller ball, inside-edges a flick
floated up outside off, drilled to midwicket
tries to make some room for a cut but just isn't finding it with the ball turning into him, pats it away to deep backward point
gives it too much air and sends down a low full toss that's shovelled to midwicket from one knee down
full on the stumps, clipped to midwicket
shot. Shovelled through midwicket. Back of a length, doesn't turn much, just slides into him and straightens around off. perera swings around and hammers a pull through deep midwicket
slides it across Mathews' off-stump, he waits before opening the face to short third man
full outside off, driven down to long-on
full and accurate on middle, defended off the front foot
loopy and pushed across around middle, driven down to wide long-off
slid across around middle and off and spinning in, misses a flick and wears it on the pad
full and accurate on the stumps, defended down the pitch
lands it at a slightly back of a length on middle and leg, punched down to long-on
length, slid across on middle and off, keeps a little low but he manages to stay in the crease and whip it to deep midwicket
full toss on middle and off, flicked down to long-on
fullish on middle and off, presses forward and nudges it into the leg side

nice, smart catch. Perera's been trying one shot too many and he finally loses his wicket. Tries to force a sweep and is really strangled for room as this one's slid into him and curves in sharply. And it's not full enough either which results in a top-edge that lobs towards short fine leg. Muzarabani moves across to his left and tumbles forward to take a nicely-judged catch
good length, spinning away outside off, presses forward and drops it into the off side

looped up on leg, drilled down to long-on where the fielder makes a save on the second attempt. Moves to his left and sticks the left hand out to flick it back even as the momentum carries him over the ropes
full on off, driven into the covers
looped up outside off and gets it to turn away, reaches out and drives it down to long-off
comes forward looking for a flick. This is the googly, spins into him and hits the pad. Would have gone down leg with the drift and turn
fuller outside off, pushed out into the off side on the front foot
short of a length outside off, drops into the covers and looks for a quick one but has to decide against it
full and angling into the pads, flicked off them to deep midwicket
short, outside off, slapped through the covers for one
