143kph, outside edge lands short of AB as he dives to his right at gully. Back of a length outside off, slices it
full outside off, defended on the front foot. Very close to the pad as it jags inwards, but he had got it outside the line
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
144kph, length outside off, big stride to defend on the front foot
good length, wide outside off, left alone
good length wide outside off, left alone
back of a length on middle stump, leaps and nudges to long leg
good length, wide outside off. Left alone
lbw appeal as Kohli shuffles and misses a flick. That was going above. Pitched on a length and climbed up at middle and off
142kph, full outside off. Gets the flick off the inside edge as he loses balance
overpitched outside off, driven to mid-off
short and wide outside off, cut to deep point
back of a length in the corridor, big inside edge as he looks to defend on the back foot. Rolls wide of the keeper on the leg side
143kph, length and in at off stump. Defended late from the crease
chases wide outside off, but he's on top of it with the front foot stride. Drives it past cover
back of a length in the corridor, left alone
good length outside off, defended on the front foot
bouncer very short outside off, left alone
good length in the corridor, defended solidly on the front foot
back of a length in the corridor, defended on the back foot
good length and shaping away from the corridor, left alone
back of a length in the corridor, left alone
good length, shaping in to the corridor. Left alone
full and wobbling in the corridor, pushed to mid-on
back of a length in the corridor, punched to deep point
inside edge as he looks to defend on the back foot in the corridor. Gets two to long leg's right
good length, wide outside off, left alone
short and wide outside off, left alone
good length on off stump, defended on the back foot
good length in the corridor, defended
wanted to pull out of this square drive. Went through with it. Full ball outside off, chased and checked. Ran it aerially to deep point
good length and wide outside off, left alone
full and swinging away from off stump, looks for the cover drive. Inside edge into the midwicket region
good length in the corridor, defended on the front foot
short of a length in the corridor, climbs at him and he adjusts very late to get on top of this and cut through gully
good length outside off, driven on the up to cover

traps him in front of off stump and the appeal is turned down. Shuffles and gets caught in two minds about where to hit this. It skids on from a length. Landed on the seam though, and it was going over
full outside off, shuffles and flicks to midwicket
starts with a full toss again. Driven to deep mid-off
full and drifted into middle stump. Pushed to midwicket
full on leg stump, flicked to mid-on's right
tossed up on off stump, driven to mid-off
floated up on off stump, driven back to the bowler
full on off, driven to mid-off, with a slight deflection from short extra cover's dive to the right
good length in the corridor, defended on the back foot
good length in the corridor, squeezed off the inside edge to midwicket as this dips in late
full on off stump, squeezed into the midwicket region off the inside edge
good length and in at off stump, defended very late, very close to the body
good length and moving away late. Anxious form Vijay as he leaves. They've curbed his shuffle and push forward by getting QDK up
back of a length in the corridor, punched to short midwicket off the back foot
full and drifted into the legs. Driven to mid-on
overpitched on off, driven firmly with the turn but can't beat short extra's dive to the left
short and wide outside off, waits for it and hammers to the point boundary. Fifty for the third wicket
full on middle stump, defended on the front foot
good length, dipping outside off, spinning away a touch. Makes him reach out for the defence
full on off stump, defended on the front foot
good length and slanting in towards off. Defended very late from the crease
good length and wobbling at an off stump, deep in the crease to defend
good length on middle stump, defended to midwicket
back of a length outside off, left alone
good length and nipping away off the surface in the corridor, left alone
back of a length in the corridor, left alone
full and drifted in at leg stump, jabbed wide of mid-on
tossed up at off stump, driven to sweeper cover
back of a length on middle stump, whipped to short fine
full on middle stump, flicked to midwicket
full at middle stump, pushed back to the bowler
back of a length at off stump, punched to cover off the back foot
what a shot. Full outswinger outside off stump but Vijay uses his wrists to drill this through midwicket
back of a length outside off, punched to deep point
good length outside off, reaches out and stabs it in front of deep point
full on middle stump, late shape away. Pushed to mid-on
overpitched outside off, opens the face to push it to deep point
overpitched outside off, holds his balance and punches this past the non-striker
full on leg stump, leans in and clips it between midwicket and mid-on
back of a length, turning and bouncing away. Pushes away from the body to point
short and wide outside off, late cut, straight to point
good length on off, defended on the front foot
full and drifted in at middle stump, driven to mid-on
overpithched just outside off, driven back to the bowler
full outside off, leans into the cover drive and manages to beat extra cover. Sweeper cleans up
back of a length, wide outside off. Left alone
good length outside off, walks down the track and defends on the front foot
length outside off, defended into the leg side
short and wide outside off, mistimes a cut to deep point
full outside off, driven to deep mid-off
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
climbs past the outside edge as he gets leg side to try and cut. That spun and bounced above his shot. Very close
tossed up on off stump, driven to short extra
good length, wide outside off, left alone
overpitched outside off, driven to sweeper cover
bouncer fired down leg side, left alone
bouncer dug in too short, ducks under it
bouncer at the ribs, dabs it square off the glove
short ball at middle stump, climbs on top and spanks it. Straight to deep square
gets under the bouncer to leave
back of a length on middle, clipped to square leg
back of a length in the corridor, makes room and chops from close to the body. Can't beat point
good shot. Full at leg stump stump, plants the front leg forward and brings the bat down sweetly on this sweep to find the square leg boundary
tossed up on off stump, driven to short extra cover
floated up on leg stump, flicked to midwicket
arm ball nearly sneaks through. Vijay goes on the back foot and just keeps it out as it heads for off stump
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
short ball sits up for him and he pulls in front of square to bring up his fifty
ducks under this short one
ducks under another one, this one down leg side
and again. Avoids going after this leg stump bouncer
bouncer across off stump, ducked
short ball on leg stump, dabbed to leg gully as he leaps
tossed up on off stump, driven to short extra-cover
back of a length now, on off stump, goes back and defends back down the pitch
lovely ball, dips onto a good length and goes on with the angle. Times his front-foot stride well, ensures his pad isn't in the way, and defends into the off side
not short enough or wide enough to cut, goes back and chops into the backward point region

gone! This was coming - he's been trying to cut him repeatedly for the last three-four overs, even when the ball wasn't short enough. Tries it again - this one's got some width on it but it isn't a short ball - and it hurries through and gets a top edge through to de Kock
flat and fired in full on middle and leg, gets his front pad out of the way to defend towards silly point

ooh, and he bowls a beaut first up. Back of a length, away seam in the corridor, extra bounce. Kohli jabs away from his body - much like the first innings in Cape Town - but this time he doesn't edge it
a bit fuller and a bit wider. Kohli takes a big stride forward and leaves it
shortish rising ball in the corridor, left alone
fuller now, in that sixth-stump corridor. Kohli leaves again. How long will he keep doing this?
ooh, excellent follow-up ball. Full, angling into the stumps, looking for lbw. Kohli plays around his front pad but does so safely on this occasion to pick up a flicked single to deep square leg
back of a length, fairly wide of off, left alone
tossed up full on off stump, big stride forward to drive inside-out to the man at deep point
full flighted ball on off stump, blocked to short extra-cover
nice flight again, some drift in towards middle stump, blocked back to the bowler, keeping the front pad out of the way
nice length, not as full as the previous two balls, angling into off stump. Defended into the covers
short, wide, and Rohit puts that away easy, a nice late-cut to get off the mark, to the left of backward point. This is the sort of ball Vijay should have waited for
lots of turn, but it turns from a good length well wide of off stump, and Rohit makes no attempt to play
length ball wide of off stump - seventh or eighth stump, and if you actually measured it might be the 14th stump - and Kohli leaves it alone
short outside off, gets up above shoulder height, and Kohli plays a tennis-style swat-pull to the right of the diving Morkel at mid-on
stylish leave from Rohit. Fullish, on a tempting fifth-stump line, and he watches it until the last moment before lifting his bat away with a swishing motion
goes wider this time, gets some away movement. Rohit leaves again
good ball, on a length and shaping away from a sixth-stump line. Looks like reverse outswing. Rohit watches it well and leaves it
full, much closer to off stump, defended to short extra-cover
nice footwork there, skips out to the flighted off-stump ball and drives inside-out to the right of short extra-cover. Long-off moves left to stop it
beautiful. Some drift in towards middle and leg and dips slightly on Rohit, who defends inside-out to short extra, with his bat reaching just a touch away from his body
a bit quicker along the same line, defended to short extra-cover
flat and full now, on middle and off, defended back down the pitch
a teaser bowled wide of off stump, not short enough to cut. Rohit leaves it
tossed up nicely on middle stump, stretches out and defends it back to the bowler
full outside off, driven to short extra-cover
length ball wide of off, moved his line back to that 7th or 8th stump. Kohli shuffles across and plays an open-faced dab towards gully
bouncer, well bowled. Comes into the batsman, who is taking a step out of his crease and across his stumps (as usual), and he has to hurriedly duck it

big appeal for lbw, catches Kohli on the shuffle with one that nips in from just back of a length. Not-out is the call, not reviewed either. Jagged in and he tried to bring his bat down hurriedly to push into the on side. Both feet were off the ground when the ball hit his front pad, and he may have shuffled outside the line of off stump too. Umpire's call on impact, missing the top of the stumps, according to ball-tracking
length ball outside off, carries through at head height to de Kock after Kohli leaves
flighted and full close to off stump, stretches out to defend into the covers
again, flighted ball on off stump, driven to the deeper, squarer cover
flatter now, on off stump, opens his bat face to dab towards backward point. Wants the quick single, Rohit sends him back
back of a length outside off, goes nice and deep in his crease, waits, and simply taps the ball on top of its head to guide it wide of slip and down into the third man region
fullish, drifting in towards off stump, defends inside-out into the point region
fullish on middle stump, defended to short extra-cover
full outside off, driven wristily to mid-off

length ball, sixth-stump line, strides out and drives to the right of deep point. Maharaj throws to the bowler's end, and nearly catches Rohit short - he was a little slow running the second. Direct hit, he was gone by yards!
back of a length close to off stump, defended into the point region
back of a length on off stump, shuffles across and tucks it to deep square leg
back of a length close to off stump, defended into the covers
back of a length, a bit of away swing in the corridor, Rohit ignores it
full and drifted into the pads. Inside edge as he looks to flick
tossed up on off stump, driven to long-off's left
full on off stump, defended into the covers
skidder in the corridor. Goes deep in the crease and cuts hurriedly to point
good length and in on middle stump, defended on the front foot
classy from Rohit. Steps out as this comes in full on leg stump. Reaches the pitch and whips it over mid-on, one bounce and four
good length outside off, defended into the covers
good length and wide outside off. Chases and drives aerially to deep point
good length in the corridor, left alone
bouncer at middle stump. Comes on too quickly as he looks to hook. Dribbles past midwicket and deep square cleans up to his left

struck on the back leg right in front of off stump. This nipped back in and beat the inside edge. They've reviewed after the umpire gives this...it's hit him on the back thigh. Feet are quite deep in the crease. There's no bat on it...tracker shows it's umpire's call as it clips the top of middle. He's gone. Slanted in at a length by Rabada, Rohit looking to drive on the up and is caught playing the wrong line. 7th lbw dismissal in his 42 Test innings, to go with nine times being bowled
back of a length and wide outside off, left alone
floated full on middle stump, pushed to midwicket
tossed up on middle stump, driven to long-on
drifted full outside off, driven nervously on the up, without getting to the pitch
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
good length on off stump, taps it cover's left and steals the single
bouncer at off stump, ducks under it
good length and wide outside off, jabs to deep point
back of a length outside off, left alone
back of a length and straightens away from off stump, defended to point off the outside edge
good length and moving away outside off, left alone
yorker headed for middle stump is dug out very very late
full on middle stump, stretched forward and pushes to long-on
full outside off, mistimed drive to short extra cover
back of a length, spinning in sharply from the rough. It's headed for middle and off. He just manages to get bat as he attempts to cut while falling into the leg side
length on off stump, steps out and drives to long-on
short and wide, cut to sweeper
good length outside off, defended on the front foot

struck on the pad as Kohli shuffles across to the off side and looks to flick. It's a full ball and he's struck in front of off. Did he manage to get outside the line? Was there bat? We'll see as SA have reviewed...oh it's plumb but UltraEdge says there's bat! So so close. Full and dipping in. They picked up two as it rolled through square leg, and then an extra run as an overthrow to sweeper
good length and down leg side. Looks to flick, beaten
148kph, back of a length on leg stump, flicked to fine leg's right
back of a length on leg stump, nudged to fine leg
beats the outside edge! Ngidi is getting as close as he can to getting Kohli as his first wicket. Length ball bouncing high outside off. Kohli chases far away from his body
inside edge as he jabs in the corridor. Back of a length ball nips back in at him. Single behind square on the leg side
full on middle stump, leans in and drives to long-on
length and in the rough outside off. Whips on the rise to deep midwicket
good length outside off, bounces up from the rough as he pushes forward to defend
tossed up on off stump, driven back towards the bowler
good length at off stump, flicked to short midwicket
back of a length in the corridor, defended off the back foot
good length in the corridor, pushed to deep point
good length on leg stump, tapped to square leg on the up
short and very wide outside off, chases it and misses
bouncer flies past his shoulder. He's lucky that fizzes so quickly. It's saved him from getting an edge. Not in position to hook at all
back of a length in the corridor, defended off the back foot
good length at off stump, nipping away off the surface and past the outside edge as he hangs the bat out
length and into the rough. Pings off the pad as he looks to flick
back of a length and spinning in sharply at off stump. Chops it into the off side
thick outside edge as he stretches too far forward to try and drive this away-drifted outside off. Plays behind his body. Ngidi's chase from short third man is lazy at best
full outside off, pushed back to the bowler
good length at off stump, pushes forward and flicks to midwicket
nicely played. Doesn't get to the pitch but uses the full swing to get behind this outside off and lift it over midwicket with the turn
full on off stump, flicked to deep square
classy. Leans into the overpitched ball outside off and creams it through the covers
good length and shaping away outside off, left alone

his maiden wicket is a beauty! Angles in to off stump, nips away off the surface and draws the edge as Parthiv looks to defend his stumps. Offered the full face and that's about all he could have done. Big outside edge and Ngidi is overjoyed
short and wide outside off, left alone
outside edge as this ball dies on him. Nips away sharply too. Lands well short of slip and squeezes behind him
good length and wide outside off, left alone
good length outside off, dies on the keeper as Pandya leaves this
141kph, good length and wide outside off, left alone

wow! Short ball outside off, he walks into the off side ad fetches it with a boisterous pull shot to the midwicket boundary. South Africa had a 2 minute discussion about that short ball. Pandya was more simple...
back of a length wide outside off, walks at it and leaves
full outside off, defended into the covers
good length in the corridor, defended into the covers
good length, wide outside off. Walks at him too. Left alone
good length outside off, walks into it and defends
full and wide outside off, left alone
yep, yorker in at off stump. Pandya up to it. Stays put this time and drives firmly past Kohli, but Markram stretches a long way to save that at mid-on
back of a length in the corridor, defended off the back foot
back of a length and wide outside off, left alone
good length and wide outside off, left alone
good length and wide outside off, late movement away. Left alone
full outside off, left alone
good length outside off, left alone
good length and in at off stump. Shuffles and punches on the up to mid-on
walks into the off side again. Leaves the short ball alone
overpitched outside off, walks at it, leaves
under-edge as the short ball keeps low. Once again, walking into the off side and looking to drag it with a pull. Lands short of De Kock
good length and in at middle stump, stands tall and drives past the non-striker
bouncer very short outside off, and very wide too. Walks at it and leaves. It's called wide
good length wide outside off, left alone
good length outside off, left alone
back of a length in the corridor, stabbed through midwicket off the back foot
bouncer flies past his shoulder as he leaves
bouncer on middle stump, ducks under it
nearly chips one to square leg. Morkel goes cross seam and full at leg stump. Pandya's head falls over intot he off side as he flicks and he gets this to square leg on the bounce
short on off stump, defended off the back foot
good length and shaping away outside off, pushed to sweeper on the front foot
good length outside off, left alone
good length and in at middle stump, pokes it through midwicket off the front foot
good length on off stump, defended off the back foot
outside edge goes wide of first slip. Kohli hurriedly jabs outside off on the front foot. There was reverse, coming into him. He played inside the line
good length outside off, left alone
good length and in at off stump, defended on the front foot
good length outside off, walks into it and taps it into the covers. Kohli refuses the single
back of a length outside off, left alone
bouncer at leg stump, gets on top of the bounce and dabs it behind square on the leg side off the glove
big offcutter, coming into the corridor from back of a length. Left alone
short and wide outside off, left alone
good morning. Full and wide down the leg side, too much for De Kock, and that's an expensive loosener
good length outside off, pokes at it and is beaten
full and swinging sharply into the pads. Flicked to fine leg
back of a length outside off, nips back in off the pitch. Left alone
good length outside off, big stride to defend on the front foot
good length in the corridor, rises up on him as he pushes on the front foot. Gets it into the pitch off the inside half of the bat
good length and swinging away outside off. Walks across, leaves
back of a length outside off, slight movement away off the pitch. Shuffles to get behind this and defend into the off side
good length outside off, late movement away. Shuffles and defends to mid-off
full and wide outside off, left alone
yorker in the corridor, hurriedly jammed to mid-on
good length wide outside off, driven to sweeper cover with an open face
big inswinger at off stump, manages to get the bat in front of the pad and push this to mid-on
another inswinger, on a length at off stump. Defended to mid-on
good length and in at off stump, defended on the front foot
back of a length outside off, tapped to deep backward point
good length and tailing in at off stump, defended solidly on the front foot

glorious. Classy front foot drive through the covers, executed to perfection. Big stride, soft hands, slightly away from the body but right off the middle of the bat as this swings away late. Creams it between short cover and extra cover
outside edge falls safely in front of Amla at first slip. Back of a length and straightening in the corridor. Stabs away from the body again
good length on off stump, defended from the crease
full outside off, driven to extra cover

135kph, full on middle stump, drilled past the non-striker. Elgar gives chase from mid-off and pulls it back. Takes the boundary padding with him as he slides. The ball rolls past the line where the padding was. Interesting to see if they'll check that...they won't.
back of a length in the corridor, defended down the pitch
length on middle stump, taps it wide of mid-on
142kph, back of a length outside off, lifts and moves away in the corridor. Left alone
good length and wide outside off, left alone
142kph, back of a length in the corridor, walks towards it and drops it into the open point region
good length and fizzing in at off stump. Gets it onto pad off the inside edge as he looks to keep this out. Steals the single pitchside
length on leg stump, looks to flick, deflected off the pad. QDK leaps big to his left and holds on
full and wide outside off, left alone
back of a length outside off, left alone
good length outside off, left alone
good length in the corridor, holds its line as he jabs away from the body. Thick outside edge through gully. Deep point cleans up to his left

good length and late swing away in the corridor. Defended to mid-on who Pandya wants to take on. Kohli says no. Pandya has to run back and looks like he's in as Philander hits direct...but his leg's in the air! Oh they're amused to have stolen a run as the ball deflects into the leg side, but he doesn't look so smart now. Terrible from Pandya. He's made his ground - well he would have, but he wasn't on the ground. The bat and foot are in the air as ball hits stumps.
nasty bouncer greets Ashwin. Fizzes past his grille and he barely has time to react
143kph, and for the second time in the series, South Africa have found Ashwin's thumb with a short one. This climbs at his chest and once again he's caught fending.
outside edge flies over gully. Very nervous waft outside off as another short one angles in at him. But this one moves away as well as it climbs.
good length at middle stump, pushed to Philander's right at mid-on and they get the singe
short ball outside off, gets his bat well inside the line and leaves
short ball in the corridor, angled in this time. Bat inside the line again as he leaves
short ball wide outside off, wafts at it away from the body, beaten
short and wide outside off, chases and slices. In control this time. Boundary through backward point
good length in the corridor, defended to backward point
big inswinger at middle stump, flicked to mid-on's right
good length in the corridor, nipping away from him. Squared up as he pushes into the covers
good length and slight shape away outside off. Plants the front leg forward and carves it through cover on the up
pummels it wide of mid-off. In the air for a bit but wide of extra cover. Length ball outside off and he punches on the up, away from his body. Assertive
superb assault from Ashwin. Good length and wide outside off, drives through the line and on the up, sends it to the cover boundary again
short ball just outside off, withdraws the bat this time
good length and swinging away outside off, left alone
back of a length outside off, Kohli sashays out of his crease and defends into the covers
lovely ball, in the corridor, jags away off the seam. Kohli does well to leave it
length ball on middle and off. Kohli shuffles across to tuck it into the square leg region
full outside off, defended to short extra-cover
back of a length, fifth-stump line, defended to short extra cover. This one seemed to keep slightly low and not really come on to the bat
back of a length outside off, opens his bat face and steers it to that newly stationed third man
lovely. Extra bounce from a good length in the corridor, and Ashwin's outside edge is beaten as he presses forward to defend
back of a length, a little wider. Shapes to play, and then pulls his bat away from the line as it veers away late
length ball angling into middle and off, stays in the crease and defends to short extra
back of a length close to off stump, defended to short extra-cover

back of a length close to off stump, a bit of extra bounce, and South Africa appeal for a catch at gully. Ashwin gets out in that area a lot, and this was a hard-hands jab, the ball just flew off the outside half of the bat. Soft signal is not-out... AB dived to his left from gully and took it low - did it bounce before it reached him? Looks like it's bounced for sure, a couple of inches from his hands, but the third umpire's still having a few more looks at it, magnified.
short, rising ball in the fifth-stump channel. Ashwin feels for it and, fortunately for him, can't get any bat on it. Another superb, endlessly testing over from Rabada
fullish, sixth-stump line, left alone
length ball, still rather wide of off stump, Kohli leaves again
back of a length, slightly closer to off stump, shuffles across and defends with soft hands, towards gully
bouncer, too wide of off stump to make Kohli play at it

short again, rising up to chest height on middle stump. Rides the bounce nicely and drops it smartly into the on side with soft hands and calls Ashwin through for one. No-ball signalled - he's clipped the stumps with his leg while delivering the ball
back of a length wide of off stump. Some away movement but it's too far from Ashwin to make him play
back of a length close to off stump, defended into the covers
length ball angling into middle stump, clipped away through square leg
bouncer close to off stump, drops his wrists and sways his upper body smartly out of the way
another bouncer in the corridor, Ashwin evades it again
short ball angling in and rising to chest height right above off stump. Rises to his full height, drops his bottom hand, and keeps it down into the cover region
short ball outside off. Jabs at it, away from his body, but manages to place it to the right of the diving AB at gully
full, angling down leg. Fails to connect with the flick and the ball hits his pad
good length and wide outside off, big turn away. Left alone
good length on off stump, defended into the covers
drops it short outside off, chopped past backward point and the sweeper can't get to it
drops it short again and this time Kohli waits late and chops it to backward point's left
oh that spits at Kohli from the rough. Length ball very wide outside leg, Kohli looks to defend on the front foot. Cops it on the back thigh
back of a length on leg, pushed into the covers off the back foot
attempted yorker is met on the full and he clips it easily through the vacant midwicket region
short and wide outside off, steers it between third man and deep point. AB runs to his right and parries to the deep point fielder
good length on off stump, defended off the back foot
bouncer at middle stump, ducks under it
good length in the corridor, pushed to third man off the outside edge
inswinger on off stump, looks to drive with hard hands. Ends up deflecting it to fine leg
full outside leg, kicks it away
good length outside leg, pushed off the front foot. Literally. No bat if you bowl there says Ashwin
full outside leg, struck on the pad
length ball in the rough outside leg, he looks to sweep and misses. De Kock can't gather on top of leg stump
tossed up on leg stump, driven with the turn to mid-off
back of a length at leg stump, flicks straight to short leg
short and wide outside off, square drive on the up and there's no third man
good length outside off, neatly punched to deep point and that's the fifty stand in just 62 balls
bouncer at his helmet, gets under it and plays the hook very late. Top edge well wide of fine leg
bouncer on a middle stump line, ducks under it
bouncer at off stump, jumps up and defends down the pitch. He was in the air as he played that
short ball outside off, climbs the bounce and opens the face to guide it to deep point's left
full on off stump, defended into the covers
back of a length and turning away in the corridor. Cuts from under it and is beaten
outside edge lobs over the slip fielder. This climbs up at him as he defends on the front foot. Looks to be off the shoulder of the bat
good length on off stump, defended onto the front foot
tossed up on off stump, driven to long-off
good length ball on middle stump, goes deep in the crease and defends very late
good length and in at the corridor. Shuffles and defends close to the body
short ball in the corridor, drops it into the point region with soft hands
short ball in the corridor, surprises him. He manages to drop his wrists to let it go
short and wide outside off, cut to deep point
short ball wide outside off, sits up and then almost dies on Kohli. It's a slo-mo pull. In front of square, wide of mid-on who gives chase and pulls it back
good length in the corridor, keeps very low. Manages to squeeze it out
tossed up on off stump, reaches the pitch and lifts it gracefully over mid-off

good length at off stump, defended into the leg side off the back foot
good length at off stump, defended into the leg side
full on leg stump, flicked to square leg
good length outside off, defended on the front foot
back of a length, angling into off stump, defended to midwicket
length ball close to off stump, opens his bat face and pushes it to the right of backward point
full outside off, driven to the left of mid-off, where Ishant slides to restrict Faf to one run
back of a length, angling into off stump, defended to mid-off
ooh, some extra bounce from a length. Angling into off stump again, and Philander jabs at it, leaning forward rather than taking a proper front-foot step. Thick inside edge rolls into the leg side
back of a length, close to off stump, defended into the point region
back of a length, slanting across to off stump, defended back to the bowler
full now, clipped with the turn to long-on
Nice flight just outside off, stretches out to push into the covers
nice length outside off, some sharp turn too as he comes forward to defend. Off the inside half of the bat to straight midwicket
too full now, outside off, stretches out and opens his bat face for a gentle push into the covers
back of a length, sixth-stump line, reaches out for a defensive push to backward point. India won't mind that
bouncer, Philander ducks under it and it loops tennis-ball-style to Parthiv
back of a length, angling into middle stump, defended back to the bowler
back of a length, angling into middle stump again, defended to short midwicket
in the blockhole, and an lbw appeal from Bumrah. Perhaps some bat on it. The appeal dies quickly, and there's no interest in a review. No bat, but that's missing leg stump by a long way
tossed up wide of off, overpitches, and Philander drives it to the cover boundary
full, on the stumps, blocked back to the bowler
floated up high and wide, drives again, bottom hand takes over, and he drills it back to the bowler, along the ground
quicker and flatter now, on off stump. Stays on the back foot and defends into the on side
length ball on off stump, stays back to clip to the left of square leg
tossed up on middle stump, clipped to midwicket
fullish, angling into middle and leg. Stays back to clip to square leg
fullish outside off, defended into the covers
exactly Pandya's effort here. Goes wide of the crease and spears it full at the stumps. Aborted lbw appeal because that was sliding down leg after Philander missed his flick
full, angling into off stump, driven to the left of mid-off, and Ishant makes another good diving stop
fullish, angling into off and middle, gets nicely behind it and defends to midwicket
full outside off, defended to mid-off
tossed up outside off, gets on the front foot to clip to the left of square leg
carrom ball on middle and leg, goes back to clip towards square leg
full now, on off and middle, blocked back to the bowler
tossed up on middle stump, clipped to long-on
down the track now, not quite to the pitch, flicks to the right of midwicket, where Kohli makes a diving stop
no turn, slides on towards off stump after pitching just short enough for Faf to go back and punch to deep point

another yorker, on off stump, and an lbw appeal that doesn't move the umpire. India have reviewed. Looked like either bat-boot or boot-bat. Which one is it? There is no boot at all. Just bat, the toe-end of it. Oh, well
back of a length, angling into off stump, defended towards mid-on
ooh, lovely. Fullish on off stump, straightens off the pitch. Looked to clip that with the angle, through midwicket, and ended up hitting it to cover off the leading edge
length ball on middle stump, lets it come on and clips to deep square leg
back of a length on off stump, defended into the covers
full, angling down leg, and Philander looks to flick and gets just enough bat on it to send it flying to the fine-leg boundary
good length and in at middle stump. Defended solidly on the front foot
good length and down leg side. Can't get bat on the flick. Pandya destroys the silent tension in the ground with a raucous appeal which is half a celebration. No one knows why
short and just outside off. Taps it to cover's left
good length and in at off stump. Defended into the covers
good length and in at off stump. Inside edge onto boot as he pushes forward
back of a length and slanted in from outside off. Left alone
good length and straightening from an off stump line. Blocks from the crease
full and just outside off, driven to extra cover. That looked like an offcutter
good length and a touch outside off. Tapped to extra cover from the crease
good length at off stump, squeezed off the outside half of the bat. That kept low
back of a length outside off, nudged through point off the outside half
good length and just outside off, steered to backward point off the outside half
in at leg stump, deflected behind square on the leg side
good length and in at leg stump, defended to short leg off the back foot

lbw decision reviewed. Faf trapped on the back foot against this indipper. He's struck in front of leg stump. That's close actually. Not climbing too high, although Faf is in the air....yes, it's umpire's call. Would have stayed out if it was given, but it wasn't. India retain the review
full and wide outside off, drilled to extra cover. Lots of dust as that ball pitched
good length at off stump, shapes away slightly. Tapped to extra cover off the toe end
good length just outside off, taps it on the up to mid-off and steals the single. Philander labours to it at the other end. That's 200
good length and in at off stump, defended to extra cover
beats the outside edge it appears. Yes. There was a big sound of a nick though. Length ball cuts away rapidly outside off and he chases it
good length and in at off stump, defended on the front foot
good length and in at leg stump. Flicks the pad and goes through to Parthiv
back of a length on off stump, defended off the back foot
good length ball fired in at leg stump. Watchfully poked to midwicket
full at middle stump, some late swing in. Flicked straight to midwicket
inside edge as he chases an offcutter wide outside off. Rolls through to the keeper. He was looking to drive
good length outside off, left alone
inside edge lobs wide of backward short leg. Looks to pull this short one outside off, drags it onto his pad
good length on off, pushed back to the bowler
clips it off his ankle after leaping up against this short ball pitching outside leg. Not. Rising. At. All. Pandya bowling a similar pace to Philander
short ball, fired down leg. Lets that pass
full and just outside off, left alone
good length ball skids between bat and pad, and past off stump. At shin height.
short ball outside off, gets on top of the bounce, swivels and hooks to deep square
good length and in at the pads, nudged to fine leg from the crease
full and in at off stump, defended solidly on the front foot
overpitched outside off, driven firmly to extra cover. Classy shot
back of a length outside off, dabbed to gully
slower ball at a length just outside off. Defended off the back foot
chips wide of backward short leg. Another offcutter. Loops in full on the pads. He's early on the flick and nowhere near the ball as it pitches
offcutter, good length and just outside off. Driven back to the bowler.
slower ball just outside off, driven to mid-off
good length and in at off stump, defended off the back foot
yorker on off stump, jammed back to the bowler
short ball in the channel outside off, defended off the back foot
deflected through square leg off the pads as he misses this full one angled into leg stump
good length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
length at off stump, defended from the crease
good length and skidding in at middle stump. Knocks it to mid-on
good length and in at leg stump, pushed to midwicket on the up
backward short leg moves to his left, Vern gets on the back foot and clips this aerially to his right. Single to fine leg
good length and shaping away late from off stump. Squeezed to backward point off the outside half
good length at off stump, defended on the front foot
length on leg stump, pushed to short square leg
good length on middle stump, pushed to mid-on
good length and outside off, left alone
short ball outside off, cut to extra cover off the back foot
falls short of midwicket as Faf pushes out in front of his body. Length ball on middle stump. Bat turns in his hands
back of a length outside off, left alone
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
good length at a fifth stump line. Defended on the front foot
short ball just outside off, pulled to midwicket from the crease
good length and angled outside off, dropped pitch side off the back foot
good length on leg stump, defended into the leg side
good length on off stump, pushed to mid-on
full on the pads, flicked to deep midwicket
full inswinger on middle stump, defended solidly to mid-on
good length in the corridor, chopped late towards the solitary slip
good length and in at leg stump, pushed to midwicket. Ishant tumbles in his follow through

pulls to square leg. The perils of being a bowling allrounder in a blockathon. You will lose your concentration at some point. Short ball in the corridor. Sits in the surface and he's early on the pull. Standing on one leg and losing balance as he looks to pull. It's a feeble chip to the fielder
full and in at middle stump, awkward front foot push. Big inside edge to fine leg's left
good length and wide down leg side
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot

big deviation as Faf looks for the cut and misses. Parthiv dives to his right and takes it in front of where first slip should have been. The umpire says no. India don't review. Replays show there was no nick. It was the seam being upright that took the ball away after it passed the bat
length on middle, pushed off the back foot
length on middle, defended off the back foot
good length, down leg side
misses another cut as this one keeps low. Short and wide, skids through from under the bat
good length on off stump, defended off the back foot
good length and wide outside off, left alone
slower ball, taken on the full in front of leg stump. Reaches out, ramps it off the toe end, wide of long leg's right
bouncer on off stump, ducks under it
length ball pushed down leg side, can't connect as he looks to flick
lifts up in the corridor and takes the outside edge. Back of a length and climbing steeply at Maharaj who can't get on top of the bounce as he looks to defend. Edge off the high part of the bat
back of a length outside off, tapped back down the pitch
slider outside off on a good length. Walks into it and squeezes it past slip off the outside edge
glove as he shuffles and looks to defend. Pushing out at it. It falls short of leg gully
full on leg stump, defended into the leg side
struck on the pad but he's outside off on the back foot. Still plenty of bounce here for Ashwin
good length outside off, pushed through the open cover region on the front foot
full on off stump, inside edge onto front boot as he looks to defend
full outside off, driven on the bounce to extra cover
good length outside off, tapped to cover's left on the up
short and wide outside off, left alone
good length and slanted across off stump, beaten
bouncer and down leg side, left alone
good length just outside off, solidly defended on the front foot
good length and in on leg stump, bunted through midwicket on the up
good length and in at leg stump defended on the front foot
full on leg stump, looks to drive but it stops on him. Dribbles to mid-on
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
one for our Faf highlights. Back of a length outside off, leans in a touch and taps it on the up through the covers
arm ball, in at middle stump. Defended on the back foot
beaten as he chases this slow loopy one outside off. Spins past the bat and the keeper and slip can't hold on to his right
arm ball, full outside off. Left alone
length ball drifted in outside off, spinning and bouncing away sharply
overpitched on leg stump, flicked to backward square leg
good length on off stump, spits up as he looks to defend on the front foot. He manages
good length and skidding low on leg stump. Gets forward and jabs to mid-on off the toe end
good length on leg stump, pushed to short leg on the front foot
back of a length just outside off, tapped through cover point
good length on leg stump, clipped uppishly towards midwicket

falls in front of short midwicket. Pandya seems impossible to score of, because he's getting neither any pace nor any lift off this surface. Everything skidding low. Rabada looking to flick again at this length ball, can't roll his wrist in time
good length on leg stump, defended on the front foot
good length and just outside off. Skids on at knee height and dies on the keeper
offcutter, full outside off. Drags this to mid-on with a mistimed drive off the inside half
good length outside off, keeps low as he looks to punch. Tapped off the toe-end of the bat
full inswinger at middle stump, driven back to the bowler
good length at middle stump, tapped to midwicket on the up
shot. Well adjusted from Faf. This short ball comes on really slowly at the chest. Swivels and gets his wrists above it. Bisects fine leg and deep square
flat and at a length, pushed down leg side
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
length outside off, defended on the front foot
short of a length just outside off, left alone
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
tossed up on leg stump, defended into the leg side off the inside half
full and in at leg stump, pushed to midwicket on the front foot
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
short ball rising fast in the corridor. Does well to arch back and stabs this with his top hand, to deep point
good length and in at leg stump, flicks to deep square leg and Faf refuses the run
full and in at off stump, big stride to punch this to mid-off
shot. This one comes on nicely and he drills it past the bowler. Overpitched just outside off, no movement.
short ball comes on slowly. Looks to punch through cover, has to laboriously drag it wide of mid-off instead as he plays well in front of the body
short ball just outside off, gets under it and swats it over midwicket
good length and just outside off, opens the face and guides it to deep point
good length and in at leg stump, clips him on the thigh as he looks to flick
good length just outside off, beaten as this keeps low and straightens past the outside edge
overpitched on leg stump, driven nicely but straight to mid-on
good length at off stump, defended on the front foot
back of a length at off stump, punched to extra cover off the back foot
good length on off stump, defended to mid-on
good length on off stump, defended to point from the crease
short of a length just outside off, punched on the bounce to cover point
yorker tailing in at leg stump, dragged wide of mid-on off the toe end

dropped. Faf looks to drive this overpitched ball just outside off. Ends up jamming it out off the toe end and it goes straight into Bumrah's body in his follow through. Tough to react and he's half trying to avoid it. Puts it down
short ball in at middle stump, pulled stylishly to deep square's left
bouncer fired down leg side, left alone
well-directed bouncer. Climbs up at his throat and he has to back away quickly to leave this
short ball slanted across off stump, left alone
ducks under the short ball on middle stump
full and tailing in at off stump, driven to mid-off where Ishant can't deny them the single

edged to second slip and it's an easy take. Length ball coming in at off stump, drives on the up with no feet and ends up playing inside the line. Ball dips on Kohli but it's at a comfortable catching height
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
bouncer follows him as he stands tall on his leg stump guard. He ducks under it
good length and slanted across off stump, left alone
full and in at middle stump, pushed on the up to mid-on
back of a length outside off stump, punched to sweeper cover
back of a length outside off, crunched on the up to sweeper cover. Denies the run again
slower ball, good length and wide outside off. Checks his shot after shaping to drive that

sticks out the right hand takes this in his follow through! Deceives him with the slower ball. An offcutter. Full and in at off stump. Faf shapes to drive inside out through extra cover. It pings off the inside half and hangs up for Bumrah who is fully in control this time.
yorker at middle stump, manages to dig it out
full at middle stump, high elbow as he defends on the front foot
length and in at leg stump, clipped to midwicket off the back foot
back of a length and sliding into the thigh. Gets back in the crease and nudges it past short fine
back of a length outside off, defended off the back foot
length on off stump, defended off the back foot
back of a length and lifting into the mid-riff. That's Morkel's mid riff, so it's climbing some way. He looks to punch off the back foot and it pings the shoulder of the bat
shot. Gloriously put away from Morkel. Short of a length and sliding into leg stump again. Gets on top of the bounce this time and whips it to midwicket's left
bouncer and angled down leg side. Looks to hook, beaten
another bouncer. Another attempted hook. Flies over the edge
deflected over the slip cordon off the helmet. Bouncer, too quick for his third attempted hook.
bouncer at leg stump. Looks to hook, beaten
yorker on middle stump, brings the bat down hurriedly, squeezes it out to deep square off the inside edge
good length at middle stump, defended on the front foot
tossed up outside off, inside edge on the forward defence

gets great connection on the slog but he's found long-on. Tossed up at middle stump, he ends the solid batsman charade and swings with his front foot out of the way. Long-on was a few yards in and had to leap to take this with a reverse cup. Well connected, but flat enough to keep that fielder in the game
back of a length and nipping away outside off. Follows with his hands and jabs it through point
beats the outside edge as he hangs this up outside off. Swinging away. Rahul rooted to the crease and chasing a very wide one
good length and shaping away from off stump. Drops it into the off side and wants a single. Vijay says no
good length and in the corridor with some shape away. Big stride forward to defend
back of a length and swinging away outside off, left alone
back of a length and just outside off. Looks to close the face but it dribbles down the pitch
good length and swinging away wide outside off, left alone
good length outside off, nips in off the surface. Left alone on the front foot
good length shaping away outside off. Drops it in front of point and takes the run. Maharaj's throw slips out of his hands and it's an overthrow through mid-on
good length and wide outside off, left alone
short of a length in the corridor, defended off the back foot
dies on the keeper as he lets this go. A length ball slammed into the turf outside off
full and swinging away outside off, left alone
good length and swinging away. Pushes on the front foot and pokes it into the covers
good length and swinging away outside off, left alone

mid-on slips on his heels and is on the floor with a split. Vijay escapes as he looks to take a dangerous run. Length ball on middle, nervous calling after tapping it straight to the fielder. Rabada over there
full and wide outside off, swinging away nicely. Left alone
back of a length and bending away outside off, left alone
short and in at the chest, defended into the pitch
good length and just outside off, defended on the front foot
shot. Back of a length just outside off. Transfers the weight to get behind this and punches it handsomely through point
back of a length wide outside off, left alone
short and wide outside off, sliced to deep point
good length and in the corridor. Drops it into the covers with soft hands and calls confidently
good length and keeping low just outside off stump, goes on the back foot and taps it to mid-on
good length and shaping away from off stump. Goes on the back foot and defends right under his eyes
good length, outswinger, wide outside off. Left alone
good length, outswinger outside off. Solidly blocked on the front foot
well played. This is a full outswinger, starting on middle and leg. He follows it closely and defends on the front foot
anxious prod as he decides to leave late. This jumps and runs into the off side off the face of the bat
good length and just outside off. Defended on the front foot
short ball just outside off stump, drops his wrists and lets this go
good length and in at leg stump. Tapped to midwicket on the up
good length and in at middle stump. Defended on the back foot
good length and teasing outside off. Leaves this alone
short ball outside off, forces a leap from QDK. Vijay happy to leave
back of a length on middle stump, shovelled on the up to midwicket. That ball took out a piece of the pitch
full and swung away outside off. Tempts the drive. Rahul leaves
good length and in at middle stump. Nicely behind the line to defend off the back foot
full and shaping away from off stump. Defended on the front foot
full and swinging away outside off, left alone
how has that missed?!> Ankle height from a good length. This is what Pandya was doing late in SA's innings. Just outside off, skids very low - from under the bat - and somehow misses off stump
good length outside off, sweetly timed jab on the up. Straight to extra cover
lazy poke away from the body. Length ball outside off, no feet at all as he chases this. Big gap between bat and pad. It rolls into the leg side
short ball in the corridor, defended on the back foot
good length and slanting in from outside off. Left alone

chops it on! It's that low bounce again. So similar to what Bumrah did. It's sufficiently short of a length for a batsman not to be forward, but it doesn't take off at all. Vijay looks to punch from the crease, gets it off the inside edge of the toe and the ball tonks leg stump
good length and wide outside off, left alone
good length at off stump, defended on the front foot
length on the pads, flicked to fine leg
full and just outside off, left alone
back of a length on middle stump, tapped to midwicket's right off the back foot
well played in the end. This doesn't climb, but it's going away from him from a good length. Follows it and expertly nudges it wide of gully
good length on leg stump, pushed to mid-on from the crease
back of a length just outside off, guides it to gully's right and steals the single. Direct hit nonetheless. De Villiers
back of a length on off stump, defended on the back foot
bouncer climbs steeply at him. He bends down hurriedly to avoid it. QDK can't stop it cleanly, high to his left
shot. Straight to extra cover. Leans in nicely to this full one outside off but can't find the gap
good length, shaping away and climbing up outside off. Left alone
full and in at middle stump, solidly blocked from the crease
full and just outside off, dead-batted on the front foot
good length and skidding in low at off stump. Defended with a half stride
good length and swinging away outside off, left alone
good length and just outside off, defended on the back foot
beats the outside edge after getting this indipper to nip away off the pitch. Pujara looking to defend on the front foot

oh dear that is a terrible shot. Short of a length outside off. Half punch, half cut. A nothing jab in the end - ends up like a slice. It's a hard one to describe. The only thing that's clear is that he was very, very nervous playing that shot. Backward point didn't have to move
good length outside off, looks to defend close to the body on the front foot
good length and wide outside off, left alone
short and jumping up at him outside off. Defended on the back foot
good length and wide outside off, left alone
good length at off stump, patted back down the pitch
good length and wide outside off, left alone
short ball in the corridor, defended off the back foot
short and wide outside off, left alone
good length and wide outside off, left alone
good length and fired in at leg stump, pushed to mid-on from the crease
short and wide outside off, left alone
back of a length, angling into off stump, blocked to mid-off
full outside off, gets forward and across and defends to mid-off - argument could be made that he didn't need to play at that, but this is how he plays
shortish outside off, stops on him a bit. Was shaping for a proper punch, but adjusted and just played a defensive push into the covers instead
what a delivery. On the fuller side of a good length, angling into off stump and leaving him late. Looked to push towards mid-on, maybe, and got a thick edge that rolled away wide of gully
back of a length on off stump, shuffles across and tucks it to the right of square leg
back of a length, shapes away from a fifth-stump line, left alone
shortish, angling into off stump. Hops to ride the bounce and defends it back to Morkel
oh man, how well did Kohli play that. A shooter from a shortish length - goes through at knee height towards off stump. Somehow jams his bat down and it hits very, very low on the blade
fullish now, wide of off stump, left alone
length ball, sixth-stump line, left alone

similar ball to the previous one, on the fuller side of a good length and fairly wide of off stump. Kohli leaves again. The funny thing is how high Morkel is getting these fuller balls to carry - de Kock took this one at head height
full, too straight, clips it off his pads crisply and beats Morkel throwing himself to his right after sprinting from long leg
once again on the pads, this time he flicks it straight towards Morkel and can only get one for the shot
length ball angling into the fourth-stump channel. Good stride forward to defend into the covers
shortish, fourth-stump line. Rides the bounce nicely and defends into the covers
back of a length outside off, a little wider than the previous ball, defended towards cover

gone, lbw, that was unplayable. Went wide of the crease, hit that Bumrah spot, got that Bumrah angle into the stumps, and that Bumrah low bounce too. Was jumping across, playing for the bounce all the muscle memory built up over all these years must have made him expect, and the ball hits him low, just around the knee-roll. The umpire's finger goes up immediately, and he reviews - hoping against hope. It's crashing into middle stump, however, and Kohli must walk back. South Africa have the big wicket, and 287 is a long, long way away
ooh, that nipped back from outside off. Pujara is stuck on the crease, the length did it, and the ball sneaks past the inside edge of his defensive shot and hits his thigh pad
length ball, fifth-stump line, left alone
fullish, fifth-stump line, Pujara leaves again
length ball, even wider outside off, Pujara leaves again
fullish, angling too far down leg for Pujara to be able to flick
shortish, wiiiide outside off, Pujara leaves again
length ball, sixth-stump line, left alone
back of a length outside off, Parthiv leaves again

shortish, a bit of extra bounce and that's come back into Parthiv too. Was on the jump, looking to fend it away into the leg side, and the ball sneaked past his inside edge and hit him on the chest. He's gone down, and looks in quite a bit of pain

one hits him on the chest, the next one, from a not dissimilar length, creeps through at shin height, towards off stump. Somehow Parthiv keeps it out. He was jumping, initially, and then he jammed his bat down in a hurry and made just enough contact
full, angling into off stump, jabbed to midwicket, went off the inside half of the bat. Was looking to hit through mid-on, I think
back of a length close to off stump, keeps slightly low again but he plays it well, defends into the covers
length ball angling into off stump, defended to midwicket
too full, on leg stump, clipped to long leg

ooh, this one seams away after pitching on a good length in the fourth-stump channel. Beats Pujara's outside edge, but he did well not to push at it away from his body. Whoa, Ultra-edge shows a small spike as the ball passes Pujara's edge. No one appealed - de Kock started to but aborted his appeal quickly
back of a length on off stump, defended to midwicket
fullish, angling down leg, Pujara leaves it
good length and in at off stump, leaps to defend into the leg side

energetic appeal from South Africa as Patel looks to whip a length ball on leg stump. QDK takes it down leg side and the umpire turns it down for caught behind. They won't review. That was off the pad, replays show
back of a length just outside off, climbs at him as he defends on the back foot
beats the outside edge. Looks to defend in the corridor as this climbs up again. Slight noise. No appeal
back of a length on middle stump, defended on the back foot
slices aerially through the covers. Full and coming in outside off. Not to the pitch of this
full on middle stump, flicks it in front of deep square leg and calls for two immediately
good length on off stump, defended on the back foot
short ball just outside off, defended to point off the back foot
good length and wide outside off, left alone
short ball climbing up at off stump, defended nicely. Gets on top of the bounce and takes the bottom hand off
good length at middle stump, defended to midwicket
full and just outside off, hangs the bat out and squeezes it past gully off the outside edge
whew. Climbs viciously into him from outside off. He thinks of defending on the back foot but that's come in so sharply, he can't do anything but leave
good length and in at off stump. Poked down the pitch with an angled bat and hard hands
back fo a length and fired down leg side, he jumps away from it happily
full on middle stump, driven to mid-on
overpitched just outside off, driven firmly back at the bowler who picks up and throws it back. Parthiv had wandered marginally outside the crease. Had to evade that throw
back of a length and pushed through flat outside off. Rooted to the crease as he stabs late and away from the body to get this into the covers
good length and in the rough. Kicks up as he pushes forward to defend. He's taking them on the body, whoever the bowler
overpitched just outside off, driven on the bounce to short extra cover
floated up full in the rough outside off. Defended on the front foot
good length outside off, dead-batted into the pitch
good length outside off, leans in, defends neatly into the leg side
challenges the inside edge straight away. Length ball coming in at off stump, defended to midwicket off the inside half
just misses off stump as Pujara leaves. Back of a length and banged in wide outside off, but this comes in sharply and doesn't climb as much as he expects. Climbs marginally over
length outside off, pushed into the point region with soft hands
good length on off stump, leaps up to defend into the off side
short ball just outside off. Short enough for him to duck
back of a length just outside off, dabs it off the outside half.  Beats Morkel's slo-mo dive at backward point
poor start from him. Short and wide outside off. Doesn't climb too much but Pujara has judged it well and opens the face to find the third man boundary
good length and swinging a long way out from a corridor line, left alone
full outswinger just outside off, taps it wide of mid-off with a turning bat
short of a length and wide outside off, keeps low and he mistimes the back foot punch
good length on off stump, slight shape in. Punched back to the bowler on the up
ankle height but swinging down leg side. Short of a length on leg stump. Not finding his line. QDK lunges and gets a hand on it
back of a length and skidding low in the corridor, defended watchfully off the back foot
back of a length and in at middle stump, defended solidly on the back foot
back of a length at off stump, nicely behind the line to defend towards mid-on
short of a length outside off, jumps to smother the bounce, defends to point

good length and just outside off. Looks to drive on the up and gets it to mid-on as the bat turns. Philander throws at the striker's stumps and it deflects down leg side. Amla is backing up, he dives to his right to save a possible boundary. But he can't stop them from saving a single
back of a length outside off, pushed wide of third slip with an open face
good length and in at leg stump, can't get bat on the flick. Deflected wide of square leg off the pad
back of a length and zipping into the corridor from wide outside off. Beats the inside edge at knee height. Can't find the off stump
good length and coming in at off stump, pushes on the front foot this time and defends off the inside half
length outside off, pushed to point on the front foot
good length on off stump, spits up at him as he looks to defend. Poked into the leg side
back of a length and wide outside off, wafts and misses
bouncer at an off stump line, ducks under it
short of a length just outside off, pushed into the covers
shot. Length ball slides through outside off, he leans in and drills this wide of mid-off on the up
back of a length in the corridor, flicked to square leg off the back foot
good length and wide outside off, beaten on the outside edge as he defends
good length and shaping away outside off, left alone
good length and just outside off, defended solidly on the front foot
good length and swinging away outside off. Hangs the bat out, gets it to run past slip off the outside half
good length and keeping low at middle stump. Defended on the front foot to mid-off
good length and swinging away outside off, left alone
back of a length on middle stump, clipped to deep square off the hips
short one climbing in at off stump, gets on top of the bounce and pushes it wide of square leg
back of a length just outside off, pushed to extra cover on the up
shot. Lovely shot. Full ball angled in towards off stump. Stands tall and creams this on-drive past the non-striker
good length and just outside off, defended into the point region

oh Morne you beauty! He has pulled off a screamer at fine leg! Wow. Sprints to his right, lunges out with his big levers and manages to keep his elbow from slamming into the ground. That's all about balance from Morne - holds his hands up in the air as he slides on his hips. Short ball outside off, Parthiv gets behind the line and launches the hook shot. No chance of keeping that down because he's not on top of it, so he looks to go big. He hasn't connected well enough. Morkel's team mates are static when it's in the air...they're olympic sprinters when he's held on
full on middle stump, driven on the up to mid-on
stunning shot. Full ball in at middle stump, reaches the pitch and clips this cleanly over midwicket, with the trailing leg raised to add to the flair. Glorious
good length and sliding low at middle stump, defended on the front foot
good length and in at middle stump, defended off the back foot
short and wide outside off, slices to third man's right
good length on middle stump, driven on the up to mid-on
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot to extra cover
good length ball bowled wide outside off. Chases with no feet. Beaten
short of a length wide outside off, tapped to point with no feet again
full and in at off stump, driven to mid-on. Wasn't to the pitch of that
good length and wide outside off, leans in and guides this through backward point and AB can't pull it back in
back of a length just outside off, chopped into the turf towards point
good length and wide outside off, walks into it and runs it out to third man
floated full and into the rough outside leg, kicked away
full outside leg, padded
full and just outside leg, leans in and defends
full outside leg, pushed back to the bowler
length and into the rough, deflected to short fine off the thigh guard
good length on off stump, shuffles and defends into the off side
big outside edge as he looks to defend on the front foot. That lifted up at him and flew past second slip. Maharaj gets there from his fly slip position and pulls it back in with his right hand
back of a length at off stump, defended from the crease
walks across and flicks aerially past midwicket. Back of a length and coming into him. Gets two to deep square's left
back of a length and into middle stump, shovelled to fine leg
good length and just outside off. Straightens past the outside edge as he pushes on the front foot
full and in the rough. Reaches out and sweeps along the floor to long leg's right
good length outside leg, looks to defend, it pings into the point area off the pad
tossed up on leg stump, defended on the front foot
length outside off deflected wide of silly point off the front pad
shot. It's dropped short at an off stump line. Dabs it to deep backward point with an open face
good length on middle stump, steps out and defends down the pitch
back of a length outside off, left alone
back of a length at off stump, defended on the back foot

QDK leaps to his right and takes it one-handed. Ngidi wins the Pandya battle. They'd taken fly slip out. He bowled it short and very wide. Pandya has to reach out a long way to try and get it over the cordon with a ramp. Can't manage it. It's a thick outside edge
short ball down leg side, can't get bat on it
short and wide outside off, looks to slice this square. Beaten

review for caught behind. Ashwin struggles to drop his wrists and get away from this bouncer climbing up at him. It looks to have hit something on the way through to the keeper. South Africa have several men indicating it was bicep...but they review anyway. It's nowhere near bat or glove. Decision will stand.
full outside leg stump, defended with the turn into the off side
turns a long way outside off after pitching outside leg. Rohit is backing away and reaching out with a cut. Under-edge can't beat AB at slip
full outside leg stump, swept to long leg
drops it short and spins it wide. Goes on the back foot and hammers it in front of square. Sweeper cleans up to his right
floated up at off stump, driven to long-off
good length on leg stump, pushed back to the bowler on the front foot

outside edge through to the keeper. Well, that's how you get Ashwin most times. Length ball, slight shape away outside off. He looks to drive through the line on the up, hardly a front foot stride in. It's elementary. Ngidi sprints away in delight, he's one away from a five-for on debut
back of a length on off stump, defended on the back foot
short ball outside off. Batsman rises, ball doesn't. Squeezed to cover off the under-edge
short ball outside off, hangs the bat out and is beaten
hooks over short leg and no one there for that shot. Late on the short ball that's climbing up at his grille
stabs it wide of point after reaching out. Short ball wide outside off, thick outside edge lobs between gully and point
full outside leg stump, flicked to midwicket
nicely placed. One fielder behind square on the leg side and he slaps this well to his left. Full ball outside off, sweep is aerial, but it's safe
good length on middle stump, defended on the front foot
superb again. He's enjoying this spin bowling. Tossed up at leg stump, steps out, gets under it and launches it over mid-on with the full face
good length at middle stump, defended to extra cover on the front foot
good length and on off stump, pushed it to point's right on the front foot
short ball at the ribs, gets behind it and drops it into the leg side
short ball just outside off, defended into the covers
good length and in at off stump. Solidly defended into the covers. There's no on there. Everyone but the two slips are back on the boundary
short ball wide outside off, steers it to third man with an upper cut
short ball outside off, pokes it wide of point off the back foot and they steal a tough single . Rohit was diving in. Would have made it
short ball wide outside off, takes it on with the hook. Nowhere near connecting
good length on off stump, driven straight to extra cover
drills it wide of Morkel at long-on who has probably used up all his glamour credits in the field. Tossed up on middle, swings hard, it's flat and dipping wide of Morkel whose dive is beaten
short ball wide outside off, dabbed expertly past slip and they manage to steal the third as backward point gives chase
good length on leg stump, defended with the turn
QDK can't take this down leg side as Rohit leaves. 'Let it go for four' someone says on the stump mic. The fielder pulls it back and Rohit is still at the same end
full on off stump, driven to mid-off
good length and in at off stump, defended off the back foot
back of a length and climbing outside off, beaten on the outside edge
full and swung in at off stump, defended to extra cover on the front foot
swipes from under the bouncer, beaten as it zips past his shoulder
meets the attempted yorker on the full and flicks it to fine leg's left from middle stump
short ball just outside off, tapped to deep point
gets an inside edge that saves him from being trapped right in front. This keeps low off a length and is headed for middle stump. Does well to get the bat down
good length and just outside off, left alone
short of a length and wide outside off, left alone
short ball just outside off, gorgeously carved to deep backward point
good length, in at off stump, climbing away off the surface. Shami's attempted defence is no match
full outside off, doesn't believe in the stride as he looks to drive this wide of mid-off. Pushed to mid-on off the inside half
good length and in at off stump, defends solidly into the open off side
back of a length just outside off, defended off the back foot
back of a length outside off, steered to deep backward point
whew. He's carted this over backward point. Short of a length and wide outside off, chucks his hands at it and it flies to the boundary
full at leg stump, flicked to mid-on's right
good length and in at off stump, driven on the up to long-off
full and wide outside off, left alone
full and wide outside off, driven on the up to deep extra cover
short ball outside off, climbs the bounce and hooks to fine leg's left
bouncer lifts above his head, he doesn't even have to duck
short ball on off stump, defended into the off side
short and slanted across off stump, sliced to third man
nicely controlled. Bouncer slanted down leg side, swivels, gets on top of it, and hooks it very fine
not in control at all this time. Jumps into the off side to try and hook this, there's no room. Deflects it off the glove, over de Kock's left shoulder
short ball on a middle stump line, ducks under it
walks down leg side to create room. Bouncer follows him and he can't get the hook away

dropped at square leg. Hashim Amla jumps up and slightly to his right to try and catch a well-timed pull shot but he can't hold on. Short ball follows him down leg side again and he hits this well. Amla can parry it at best
short and on a middle stump line, ducks under it
short ball at middle stump, makes room and taps it through extra cover with soft hands. Calls for two immediately. Nicely judged
short one on leg stump, gets on his toes and pulls to fine leg
good length on leg stump, backs away and taps it to wide mid-off
has he got a glove on that? No, it appears. Late on this bouncer as it climbs across him. Can't get bat on the hook. There was half an appeal
followed with a short ball down leg again. Places the hook straight to fine leg
good length on middle stump, nicely timed tap on the up past the non-striker. Won't get a run for it
inside edge onto pad as he backs away to try and hook

looks like AB has taken it! Yes, it's clean! Superb. Loses control of a hook - it's a difficult pitch to get that shot right every time. Backing into the off side, manages to get under it and there's no room. Top edge hangs some 20 yards in front of AB at fine leg. He sprints quickly, goes low with a slide to pouch this and then gets up gracefully to toss the ball up and volley it in celebration
bouncer from around the wicket, ducks under it
yorker at off stump, jams it into the extra cover area
short ball on a middle stump line, watches it closely and leaps into the off side to let it go
short ball on middle stump, defended off the back foot
fly slip doesn't have the wings to reach this. Length ball coming in at off stump. He backs away and pulls out the old swipe across the line. Leading edge sails to that fielder's left

five wickets for Ngidi. What a show on debut fo this guy. He's hit India hard. Back of a length ball fired in at a middle stump line. Shami backing away again to try and make room for a slog. Ends up slicing it straight to Morkel who takes it with a reverse cup at mid-on. Standing ovation from the dressing room for Ngidi
length on middle stump, defended from the crease
bouncer on leg stump, ducks under it
outside edge past second slip. Do they have a few of AB out there? He's after this and he slides to pull it back in. With grace, as always. This was angled across off stump on a length
bouncer up at the left shoulder, plonks the front leg across and looks to hook. Beaten
good length at middle stump, defended off the back foot
bouncer on a middle stump line, hurriedly sways away from it
short ball climbing in at middle stump, jumps into the leg side and squeezes this to gully
yorker nicely dug out. Speared in at leg stump. He gets the front leg out of the way and jams the bat into it
short ball on middle stump, arches backwards and lets it go
full ball in at off stump, arches back a touch, no forward stride. Opens the face and slices it wide of point
short ball wide outside off, swings hard across the line, beaten

Philander lunges forward and gets his hands under it at mid-off. South Africa have won the series. Full on off stump, Bumrah's weight going backwards as he pokes with hard hands. It's a feeble chip, dying on Philander. He takes it. Six for Ngidi
back of a length and swings back in from over the wicket, cramps the batsman for room, flapped to square leg
full inswinger, but finishes too straight, tickled off the pads to the fine-leg boundary
full outswinger, starts outside off, and bends away outside off, no shot
good length on off stump, not much lateral movement, tip and run into the covers for one
full and outside off, sticks in the pitch, and foils the cover drive. Scooped away
back of a length and outside off, dragged off the inside half but only as far as mid-on
back of a length and skidding into the pads, deflected off the pad to short fine leg
hip-high short ball on off stump, swivels on the back foot and wristily pulls to the right of square leg
Archer keeps digging it short and outside off, the batsman controls a pull to deep square leg
short and attacking the body, fended off to midwicket off the back foot
Archer overcorrects and floats a half-volley outside off, Manzoor eases forward and laces a drive through the covers. So easy on the eye
full on off, offcutter? Not quite sure. Tapped into the covers for a hasty single
back of a length and attacking off, jabbed into the covers for one more
nice and full on off, blocked to the off side off the front foot
full and swings in a touch, worked to short midwicket, where the fielder fumbles to his right
full and shaping in on middle, nudged in front of mid-on for one more
good length and angling in at off stump, Manzoor presses the ball in front of cover and sets off.  Rossouw runs in and aims to attack the ball but can't gather it cleanly
flat incoming dart on middle, bunted up to mid-on for one
arm ball, snakes in on middle, whipped past midwicket, deep square leg runs to his left to hunt the ball down in the deep
length ball, angling in on middle stump, defended square on the off side from the crease
wide yorker from wide of the crease, forces the batsman to reach out. He swishes... and misses

follows the yorker with a short, wide ball outside off. Manzoor rises on top of the bounce and scythes it on the up. Hit flat and hard over point. <s>Goes all the way for a six</s>. Did the ball drop just in front of the rope? It seems so and given as four

Has Watson deflected the ball back onto the stumps at the non-striker's end? Watson thinks he has Denly. Yes, Watson has finger-tipped the ball back onto the stumps to catch the England batsman short. This was very full on middle, presses forward and pats it back to the right of the bowler.
