full and nipping into the pads, inside-edged away to square leg as Maxwell does not get enough bat onto the leg-side flick
inswinging yorker, nearly storms through the defences of Short and takes the leg stump. Lucky to get away is Short
Short rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and steers a single down to deep third man
flatter wrong'un, spins away past the waft outside off
back of a length and outside off, another googly, Short has a crack at it and slashes an outside edge fine of short third man
Short dabs this from outside off to short third man. There's a mix-up between the wickets. Maxi asks his partner to undo his steps. Short slips but dishes out a full-length dive to make his crease
full and outside off, driven on the up to cover, where the fielder lets it through his legs. Short celebrates his return with a fifty and gets a hug from Maxi

Maxwell swings one straight into the lap of Ali at long-on. Pushed through on middle stump, Maxwell winds up and golf-swings it straight to the man in the deep. Two wickets in three overs for Pakistan
Hasan hits a hard length on middle and forces the batsman to jab it back to him

Dropped by Shadab at backward point. He throws himself to his right but the ball bursts out. Back of a length and outside leg following the moving batsman who chips a leading edge and continues to lead a charmed life
back of a length on middle stump, defended to the leg side off the back foot
pitched up and outside off, forward and drilled through the line to mid-off
lifter, slower ball, outside off, periscoped away to third man
short inducker, nips back in and cramps the batsman for room. Stoinis inside-edges the ball beside his feet
Short skips out, Shadab darts a googly outside off, stabbed into the covers
another googly, turns and bounces outside off past the cut. Sarfraz lets the ball bounce out of his gloves now
full googly outside off, slapped to mid-off
back of a length and breaks away outside off, lashed off the back foot to sweeper cover's right
Short camps back to this short googly and flashes another four fine of short third man for four
Short leans back to this skidder outside off and chops a risky single to short third man
really full on middle stump, clipped away to deep midwicket
middle-stump yorker, squeezed away to the left of deep square leg for two
slower offcutter outside off, toe-ended away to wide long-on
slower length ball outside off, punched away down to long-on
Short connects with this and middles a six over wide long-on. This was in his swinging arc - on a length and outside off - Short smites it away. Sarfraz shakes his head in disapproval
Short now jumps away outside leg, dragged shorter and outside off, Short stays leg-side of the ball and launches another six, this soars over Hasan's head
back of a length on middle stump, Stoinis lines it up and muscles it over midwicket for a huuuuuuuge six. Three successive sixes for Australia
slower cutter, floated wide outside off past the tramline. Sarfraz suggested a slower one but Amir's line is wrong
low full-toss on off, Stoinis clears his front leg and smears it away down the ground. The man at long-on dives across to his left to intercept this muscular drive
lifter, angling away outside off, Stoinis does not get any bat on the ramp

full-toss, angling away outside off, Stoinis is forced to reach out for the ball. He carves this low full-toss to sweeper cover, where Malik, after dropping Finch on 0 earlier in the morning, takes it with both hands
Head gets behind the line of this short ball on off and fends it back to Amir
full-toss, swinging in at off, clipped to long leg
full-toss wide outside off, sliced away to sweeper cover
on a length and outside off, Short flays it straight to cover. He stays leg-side of this ball and holes out to Farhan. No celebration from Afridi. Short lost his shape while meeting the ball
full and straight, Carey whips to deep square leg
really full and outside off, opens the face and squeezes it away between backward point and third man for four
overpitched and outside off, leans into a drive and places it to the right of mid-off for back-to-back fours
short and thuds in towards off stump, Head looks to pull but falls on the floor
Carey jumps across off for a lap-sweep but this ball it too short for the shot. Edges it away behind square
really full on middle, right in the slot, Head clears his front leg and walllllllllops it into the stands beyond midwicket. Brute power from Head
very full on middle, Head backs away and smears a single down the ground

Pakistan's fielding veers from ordinary to extraordinary. This rocket drive from Carey seemed destined to fly to the boundary. Instead, Shadab throws himself to his right from mid-off and plucks it out with one hand, inches from the ground. Simply sensational. This was very full and outside off, belted away in the air. Then came Shadab's athletic intervention. What a youtubeable catch. Awesome stuff, Shadab
back of a length and angling across off, jabbed to short cover
wide yorker, jammed to sweeper cover. And here comes the fumble. Perfectly sumps up Pakistan
mighty full on leg stump, backs away and squeezes a single square through the off side
middle-stump yorker, dug out to long-on
leg-stump yorker, jammed to deep third man now
Hasan hunts for the yorker again, but overpitches it on middle stump, Agar gets underneath the length and swings  a four over mid-off
full and swinging away outside off, beats Agar's own swing
bowled'em. That's a bail trimmer. Good length on off stump, Agar swings for the hills... and does not get bat on ball. Hasan clips the off bail to cap his spell with a wicket
Australia continue to lose their way in the end over. Head holes out to long-on. On a length and outside off, Head swings and gets more height as opposed to distance
low full-toss slanting away outside off, scooped to mid-off for one
back of a length and zipping away outside off, Tye can't touch it
Killer yorker from Amir. It floors the middle stump. Ripper from over the wicket, storms under Tye's swinging bat. Can Australia reach 180?
full and angling across off, backs away and caresses it to sweeper cover

Yes, Australia go past 180. Fuller than a good length and slanting away wide outside off, Richardson, having skipped away outside leg, reached out for  the ball and carves a four fine of deep third man
flighted on off from round the wicket, driven down to long-off off the front foot

Duck for Farhan on T20I debut. What an unfortunate way to go, that too in your first international. Maxwell slides a full ball down the leg side, draws the batsman out of the crease, Farhan falls over, and the keeper whips the bails off. Stumped off a leg-side wide
lobbed up outside off, encourages the batsman to drive and goes past the outside edge
pushed through on off stump, forward and tipped to the covers

Maxwell strikes twice in the first over with the new ball. Talat also gone for a duck. Maxwell tosses up this outside off and gets it to break away. Talat drives a long way away from the body and slices a catch to backward point. Dream start to the defence for Maxwell and Australia
full on pads from round the stumps, glanced to fine leg
dropped short and outside off, Zaman reaches out for the ball and flashes to point
back of a length and snaking in on off, Sarfraz hops, skips, and fends it away to the leg side
wide of the crease, holds its line outside off, Sarfraz angles it down to deep third man
lifter on leg stump, gets big on Zaman, and beats the hook
back of a length on leg stump, Zaman gets behind the line and pushes a single to the covers
back of a length and bounces over middle stump as Sarfraz hoicks to the leg side and misses
darted outside off, drilled down the ground past the left of Maxwell for a powerful four
back of a length and breaks away outside off, Zaman skips away outside leg, creates additional room and carts it up and over extra cover
Zaman runs down the track and hacks a short ball from middle down to long-on
Sarfraz jumps away outside leg, this is tossed on his legs. Sarfraz goes low and slugs a slog-sweep over midwicket
Sarfraz jumps outside leg again, meets a short ball outside off and flays it square through the off side for another boundary
Zaman steps away outside leg, this is on a length and outside off, the batsman stays leg-side of the ball and pumps it over the covers. Pakistan's chase is on
Sarfraz aims for a cut,  but Stanlake hits the splice with a short ball. It rolls away to point
back of a length and on a fifth-stump line, Sarfraz backs away and looks to go over the covers. No dice. Beaten on the outside edge
Sarfraz hangs deep in the crease, picks a short ball from outside off and pulls it away to the long-on fence
pitched up and outside off, punched up to Tye at mid-on for one
back of a length on a fourth-stump line, opens the face and punches to cover
back of a length, angling in, straightening away as Sarfraz wafts and misses in the channel
Sarfraz makes room outside leg but is beaten by this zippy short ball chasing him
back of a length and seaming away, another swish and a miss. Four dots on the bounce
back of a length on a fourth-stump line, spanked away. Stays leg-side of the ball and sends it up and over extra cover with a flourish
picked off the hips wide of short fine leg for one
slower ball, short and outside off, Sarfraz reads the change-up and drags it away to the wide long-on boundary. Shot, Safi

on a length and outside off, Sarfraz knows fine leg is up, he scoops it away over short fine leg. Nice shot but harebrained running between the wickets. Richardson swoops down on the ball, slides, hauls it in, and the throw comes to the bowler, Sarfraz is caught napping on the third. He was so very late to take off. Lazy running
short on leg stump, flapped away to short fine leg
back of a length and outside off, punched back to the bowler
slower ball on off, chipped past the left of the bowler
short knuckle ball, Malik is early into his shot and wears it on the body
dipping full-toss on leg stump, dug out
banged short and outside off, chops a cut to the covers
Zaman leans back and chops a short ball from outside off to backward point
back of a length and angling into a dab to point
back of a length and angling in on off, opens the face and plays it behind to the keeper
back of a length on off, tapped to point
back of a length on the hips, Zaman flicks his wrists and sends the ball to the square-leg boundary
slower ball, beaten outside off
slower, short ball on middle, swivel-pulled to short fine leg. Another offcutter from Stoinis
Malik gets off the mark after seven balls with a pull shot to long-on
full on middle from round the wicket, bunted away to long-on
short, angling away, leans back and punches in the gap at point
Malik comes down the track, Maxwell fires it short and wide outside off, chopped away to point
off-stump yorker, jammed down to long-on
tossed on middle, eased away between wide long-on and deep midwicket
back of a length on middle, this hip-high ball is merrily swatted away over backward square leg for a one-bounce four. Bam!
Malik moves outside leg, back of a length and wide outside off, past the reach of Malik
full on middle stump, push-driven down to long-on
Zaman backs away outside leg, the bowler follows him with a bouncer, the opener carefully ducks under it
back of a length and outside off, smoothly punched to sweeper cover
full on middle, backs away and smears it to extra cover, where Wildermuth fumbles
full and angling in on middle, tipped away to square leg
slower short ball outside off, Zaman cuts and misses in the corridor, throwing his hands at the ball
short and wide outside off, looks like another slower ball, but it's well past the tramline
short, wide, reaches out for the ball with his hands and carves it away behind point. The ball thuds into the boundary. Zaman loves it there
darted short and too wide outside off, another off-side wide from Wildermuth
very full and very wide outside off, Zaman flits around in the crease, throwing the bowler off
back of a length and angling away outside past the tramline. Yet another off-side wide
back of a length and angling away close to off, punched up to backward point. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end and concedes an overthrow
full just outside off. Spinning into Fakhar, and he swipes at it across the line. Thumped to long on
full on leg stump, and Malik opens his stance to drive to cover
straight as an arrow! Full outside off, and he comes dancing down the wicket before drilling it over Agar's head! Enough width for him to smack this flat-batted for a maximum. Fifty too
full outside off, and once again Fakhar comes down the wicket. Mistimes a thump over the non-striker's head, but still has enough legs to crash into the boundary. Ten off two balls
drilled! Full on leg stump, but Fakhar expected that. Backs away to the leg side, and then slaps this past Malik for a boundary. Almost took the non-striker out
full and fast outside off stump. Fakhar lets it go, and the ball hits the keeper's pads. The ball trickles away to point for extras
full outside off, but it's the slower ball from Tye. Waits for the ball to get to him, before slapping a late cut past the keeper's left
cheeky! Slower ball outside off again, and Fakhar shuffles across to the leg side, and scoops a pull over square leg for more runs
yorker outside off, and Fakhar digs this down the ground to long off for a quick single
up and over! Short on off, and Malik tries to pull. Through his shot too early, and it's been top-edged over Carey. Leaking runs now
slower ball, but on a length outside off. Malik opens his bat's face and pushes to point with soft hands
low full toss on off, and that's been driven to long off for one. Malik wanted two, but Fakhar says no
Fakhar moves away outside leg, Stanlake chases him with a full ball that grazes the pad and squirts away to fine leg
short and just a shade outside off, Malik gets up on his tippy toes and rides it down to deep third man's right
short and wide outside off, Zaman jumps outside leg and flays it up and over backward point. Thumped into the deserted stands
Jumps away outside leg and stabs it to the leg side
short and skips back in, fended to the covers off the back foot
Malik backs away, leg-stump yorker, dug back
Zaman gets on top of a short ball outside off and firmly cuts it away to sweeper cover
offcutter outside off, whipped away to deep midwicket
full-toss outside off, driven sweetly to sweeper cover
slower bouncer on middle, swatted away to long leg
short and wide outside off, Zaman stays leg-side of the ball again, and pummels it away to the cover fence. Flat-bats this offcutter into oblivion
slower, short ball outside off, crunched away. Agar overruns the ball and gives up four. Nothing going Australia's way
full on the stumps, laced down to long-on
back of a length on off, Malik sits back in the crease and chops the ball away to point
leans back and chops this short ball much finer to third man
slower cutter on middle, run away to point
back of a length on middle, flipped away to deep square leg for one

Zaman holes out to deep backward point. No hundred for him. Zaman shows his cards early and steps away outside leg. The bowler goes shorter and wider outside off. Zaman still reaches out for the ball and slices underneath the ball in the air but straight down the throat of Maddinson, the sub
back of a length and nips away outside off past the outside edge
fullish on off, dropped to the covers
back of a length and outside off, Ali slogs and misses
full on middle and leg, tapped down to long-off for one now
turned to the leg side for one
length ball on off stump, Malik lines it up and smokes it over the midwicket boundary. Such a smooth swing
near yorker on middle, squeezed away to long-on
slower ball outside off, driven hard to long-off
banged in short on middle, shovel-pulls to deep square leg
slower ball outside off, pulled away straight of long-on. Finch slides to his left and parries the ball to long-off
nice and full on off - right in the slot - Asif Ali gets underneath the length and slams it straight over the bowler's head like a boss. The slower ball has been dispatched into the stands
full on middle stump, Malik backs away outside leg and smears it over point for four
shuffles outside leg and nurdles a single past short fine leg
Ali bunts a full ball on middle to long-on
Malik backs away outside leg and digs out a yorker to the keeper
slog-swept away to deep fine leg
middle-stump yorker, jammed down to long-on for a couple of runs. Pakistan another couple away from victory
back of a length and outside off, muscled away to long-on
Pakistan clinch the tri-series in Zimbabwe! Back of a length and outside off, slower offcutter from Stoinis, Asif Ali reads it and slugs it away wide of deep midwicket for four
and a tight end to the over as Tahir hones in on Root's off stump and a fourth googly in a row is tucked into the leg side
there's no loosener from Ngidi as he finds immediate bite and lift outside off. But Roy does well to ride it, fending to point
fuller, and straighter, Root aiming his drive right at mid off
full, straight and Root is forward to push a single wide of mid on
flicked straight of midwicket for one more
too short from Tahir, but he's not punished for it as Roy's cut finds point
swept this time, but now the shot finds short fine leg and it's another dot
tennis-ball bounce outside off as Roy thrusts out at it, the ball flying through the vacant gully region and down to third man
beaten outside off by one that holds its line outside off. He's been seaming them in, but this one just kept going outside off to beat Root's edge
this one does seam in a shade, and Root is back and across to defend to cover
boom! Too short from Ngidi, and Root reads the length nice and early to get himself into position to pull to midwicket. It's the long boundary, but there's a big gap to aim for too
just short! Ngidi aims fuller and wider, and Root has to stretch into a drive and can't keep it down. Fortunately for him, the ball lands just short of Duminy, who has been moved into gully
Ngidi keeps things tight on off stump to finish, and Root is content just to keep it out
too short and Roy hops back to hammer a cut well in front of square
and so Root goes for the reverse sweep, picking the gap nicely. But Rassie's after it, and hauls the ball in inside the rope
swept hard! An orthodox stroke from Root this time, and he's helped by some creaky fielding from Amla at short fine, who falls over the ball as it passes him but can't stop it

chipped in the air! But safe. It was a full toss too, and Root might have put this anywhere. Perhaps he was taken a little by surprise, and does at least manage to pop it just over a leaping Rabada at midwicket
speared in flat and fast to finish, and Root defends
rising off a length, on or around off stump, and Roy pushes him to midwicket
Ngidi's lost his radar with this one, offering a gentle leg-stump length delivery that Roy helps on its way down to fine leg
the riposte from South Africa's big quick is to dig one in halfway down, but the bouncer balloons up way too high and is called wide
sliced in the air through gully! Where is the fielder? Ngidi aims fuller, and wider, and Roy holds nothing back in the drive - but there's no-one there to catch it
Ngidi finds that splice-jarring length and Root can't quite get on the front foot as he defends this one
Root is one the drive once again, but Markram hares after it to keep them to two

and he's punched down the ground! Gosh, this is a lightning quick outfield. Rabada aimed full to start, but this was nothing more than a push from Roy. Once it beat the bowler, and mid off, it was four
Rabada pulls his length back to stop another drive, and Roy defends
shorter still from Rabada, but this one is aimed wide of off and Roy shoulders arms
another steepler on a fifth stump line, and Roy is at pains to pull his hands out of harm's way as he leaves well alone
Roy sets himself to drive again, but he's not quite to it and pokes his shot uppishly towards Phehlukwayo at mid off
indipper from Rabada, at a decent clip too - 90mph. But Roy is forward with bat and pad together to defend to point
Root is drawn into an injudicious prod outside off by a cross-seamed delivery from Ngidi that holds its line outside off, beating the bat
neat follow-up from Ngidi, a slower ball. It cuts in off the track. Root defending to leg with a hint of inside edge
crisp! Ngidi has found tennis-ball bounce, but Roy just stands up on this one - another cutter - and checks his drive, on the up, to collect four more
Roy is up on his toes again to spank this short one towards point, where Duminy parries and takes the sting out of the shot, so it's just the one
Ngidi offers a little width outside off, but again Root picks out the cover fielder with his forcing stroke
shaping in towards off stump, and Roy is half forward to press to cover
and Roy brings up England's fifty with a neat little clip into the leg side, finding just enough room for a quick single
Rabada pulls his length back at 87mph, Root jumping to defend into the leg side
short, and pulled! Root has looked in absolutely top form on the pull today, and even though he was a little rushed by Rabada's pace he controlled the stroke and placed it just so to collect four
Rabada adjusts his line, outside off, and Root presses firmly to cover
good awareness from the batsmen in the middle as Root pushes a fuller one towards Tahir at mid on and they sense the opportunity for a quick single
that's a better line from Pretorius, in the channel outside off and Root punches defensively to cover
surprise bouncer from Pretorius, and Roy can't take full advantage as he pulls to fine leg for one
again it's short, and now it's Root who pulls out to deep midwicket for one
decent line angled into off stump, and pushed to cover
flicked off the pads, Root keeps things ticking along
inswinging full toss! That was a dicey delivery ... an inside-edge squirts through third man, that would have been pretty tight if he'd missed!
leaning forward, crunched through the line, short cover intercepts another well-timed stroke
rolls the fingers on a full length outside off, and pressed up to mid-off
too short, too wide, Roy doesn't miss out on those! Slammed with disdain in front of square, a huge wholehearted pivot of the body, stiff forearms. Wallop
better length, tighter line, solid block
back of a length, pulled in front of square
flashed hard over backward point! Lunging onto the front foot, and chopping a cut out of harm's way, through the gap and down to the sweeper at third man
back of a length, that's supreme placement! A short-arm jab, just guided through the gap at midwicket, but with timing that purrs off the bat. England are beginning to warm to their task now
flicked with a lot of bottom hand into the leg side
outside off, dabbled to third man with a late flick of the wrists
too short, flogged off a tight line through square leg. Gathered in the deep
banged in short again, swished across the line, but under-edges the pull to short midwicket
very full, doodlebugging into the blockhole, and stabbed down into the deck and back over the umpire's head for the single
rolls the fingers on a full-length delivery, looking to clip through the gap at midwicket but can't create the angle
firm block back down the track, so firm in fact that the umpire is sent sprawling as Phehlukwayo gets a hand on the ball and deflects it towards his feet
full again, angled into the stumps, and worked through the leg side
clonked into the leg side, pulled down from eyebrow-height
punched with a full face to cover
solid block on the back foot, tight line and length
tip and run to mid-on, and there's a direct hit at the non-striker's end... but he's home by a country mile. Next!

tucked to the leg side, up comes Roy's fifty... his fourth in a row in ODIs, and he's in some sumptuous form at the moment... EDIT: Actually, it's a leg bye. Stand down! Either way, that will be drinks
working around the front pad to the leg side
flicked with intent into the leg side. And Roy celebrates his fifty... again ... Well, one way or another, he's got there!
head over the ball to defend
looking to flick on the up through the leg side,  but can't time the stroke
whittled to the leg side
battered down the ground! Roy is camped on the front foot, waiting for the over-pitch, and a wrist-snap of an on-drive to the rope!

banged in short, a wild front-foot slap, top-edge to the deep-set mid-off, and there's the breakthrough! Roy will be furious with himself, the third time in four innings he's given it away when set for something special. That said, what a hand he's played after those anxious early exchanges...
outside off, Morgan allows himself a sighter
full and angled across the left-hander, head over the ball to block
wider line, full length, Stokes leaves alone
tucked to the leg side, a bit of extra nip off the deck
beaten outside off! Lovely line and length, shaping away from the left-hander, who hangs his bat out to cover the line and doesn't get close
looped onto a full length, nurdled to the leg side
back and across, watchful against the legbreak and blocked back down the pitch
slightly short, Morgan tries to manipulate the angle, but flicks it back to the bowler
stretching forward, blocked on the front foot
sliding past the leg stump
back of a length, outside off, guided with an open face through backward point
driven off the back foot into the leg side again
lots of air, dipping outside off, played with a full face into the covers
floaty full length outside off, eased down to long-off
back of a length outside leg stump, a solid clip to deep midwicket and finds the right pace to scurry back for two before the sweeper can intercept
sharper spin this time, defended with a vertical bat back down the pitch
a bottom-handed swish through the leg side. England settling into another regrouping phase. It's nip-and-tuck out there...
worked to the leg side, right behind the line
looking for another drive, but not quite to the pitch this time, as Morgan pulls his stroke into the leg side
forward once more, swishing into the drive, but mid-off gathers
cunning slower ball, pops a touch as Morgan flicks into a defensive push, but falls well short of being a return catch
round the wicket, looped onto a good length, defended
outside leg stump, flicked urgently off the toes, not quite enough bat on it to beat fine leg
beaten on the angle! Morgan is lured into the fence outside off and doesn't connect
no faffing around from Morgan! Gallivanting out of his crease, a lofted slap over wide long-off!
drags down the bouncer, Morgan climbs into the pull! That's a sweet, sweet connection, getting right underneath the stroke and lifting it high over fine leg
offcutter from Ngidi, a good response, full length, wobbling to the pitch as Morgan can't time his on-drive
opens the face, glides the drive out to deep extra cover
slower ball, outside off, through to the keeper. That was a lively over
tossed up, a lofted drive zips safely out of the clutches of short cover
too straight to the left-hander from round the wicket, Morgan latches onto the angle and sweeps with power through fine leg
and now the reverse-sweep, he's always played that stroke well. A half-stop at backward point but good intent
cut hard to backward point
a bit more action on that delivery, twirling into the toes and punched to short cover
on the pads, nurdled to the leg side but straight to the man on the 45
Stokes momentarily in two minds, thinking of the flick to leg but settling for a block to off
fractionally short, and Stokes slams his first boundary through the covers!
nudged to the leg side for another single
leaning onto the front foot, defended
on the back foot, thrashed with intent but straight to short cover
outside off and cut to backward point
a touch of width and cut to backward point
round the wicket, angled into the left-hander, a solid block on off stump
on the pads, cramped on the angle, short midwicket gathers
fired down the leg side
slower ball, defended from the crease back to the bowler
tight over, angled into the body once more, and defended to the leg side
round the wicket, lobbed up on middle and leg, poked away
smeared, in the air but dipping and swerving beyond the dive of long-off! Rabada made most of the ground, threw himself bodily, but couldn't cut it off
tossed up and driven through extra cover for one
WALLOP! Slog-sweep from Morgan, hey ho me dearie-oh into the crowd! Right out of the screws as the England captain decides he's seen enough of Markram's dollies
pushed through flatter, cut off the back foot but picks out point
round the wicket, full length and clipped through mid-on coming forwards
length ball, 130kph/80mph and drifting leg side, tucked off the hip square
short ball, whipped away on the pull, into a gap behind square... Fifty for Morgan, quick raise of the bat and then he's back on it, eyes glinting between helmet and grille
pitched up and pushed back down the track
pitched up a touch, 126kph/78mph and driven down the ground to long-on
shortish outside off, dabbed to backward point
fuller, 123kph/76mph outside off, driven into the ground towards mid-off and they scamper the one
full and wide and clipped to the cover sweeper coming forwards
pitched up, another single as Stokes opens the face and drills one to deep point
short ball, pulled off the hip, nicely placed for a couple
short of a length, Morgan whips away a pull from back in the crease
pitched up, a decent yorker that sidles under the bat and just misses off stump!
back of a length and sliced for one through point
cheekily done, and that's his half-century! Took a while to get going but he's bringing out the full repertoire now, this one reverse-dabbed past de Kock for four to third man!
village all round! Full toss from Tahir, but Stokes nearly blunderbusses his own foot off with a mistimed heave!

Tahir does it again, thanks to a brilliant take running in! Chipped towards long-on and Markram flies forward to scoop up the catch and end Morgan's stay! Didn't quite get under it enough, though it then looked like the ball might plop short, 'down, down!' mouthed Morgan - but there's no extra life for the England captain
dropped short into the off side, Stokes is scrambling... but Markram's underarm misses the stumps! Now that would have pegged England back
pitched up and driven through the covers coming across
shortish outside off, Stokes draws himself up and spanks to the sweeper
short ball, looping up and through to the keeper, Stokes hanging back and hoping for a wide to be called - but nothing doing
flighted, this spins back as Buttler presses out and blocks
tossed up and worked into the leg side
back of a length, clipped of the hip down towards fine leg for a couple
short of a length, Stokes pulls and gets one off the bottom edge
dug in, 130kph/80mph and Buttler cracks a pull past the diving Hashim Amla at midwicket, they come back for two
pushed through outside off, dabbed towards backward point
pushed through on off and tapped down into the covers

oops... Buttler drags on to leg stump! An intake of breath around the ground as the crowd realises Buttler's a goner; huuuuuuge wicket for South Africa, just as England were looking to hit the afterburners! Another cutter from Ngidi and it was a ngoodie for SA
round the wicket, length ball on off that's tapped away
slower ball comes out wrong, squirting away practically off the cut strip
short of a length, pace off again and this is guided behind point - that's the 250 up for England, but they want more, moooorrre, I tells you!
floated up on the stumps and worked short of mid-off
goes back and cuts for one
flighted, spinning on middle and leg, Stokes flicks into the leg side and they come back for two
full and wide, slower delivery, just 105kph/65mph and Moeen nearly flings himself off his feet trying to hit down the ground!
full, wide and with pace off, another big yahoo that fails to connect! Ngidi winning this battle so far...
short, another cutter, Moeen hoicks it away through midwicket
too clever this time, Stokes attempting to reverse-pull... and it hits the toe of the bat, loops into the covers for one
over the wicket, angling the ball back in, Woakes defends on off stump
pitched up, 126kph/78mph outside off and sliced behind point, they settle for one to get Stokes on strike
full and drifting leg side, Stokes gets a tickle on it and de Kock dives to prevent it running away fine... Woakes wonders about a second, but that's too risky
pitched up, Stokes plants the front foot and plays a cheeky French cricket dab square, they hurtle back for two
driven on the up through cover, just a single
slower ball, comes out as a full toss and Stokes clumps it back at him, Rabada whacked on the boot in his follow through and it deflects for another single
short and wide, 137kph/85mph and Woakes gives it some tap, sliced up and over backward point to an untended part of the boundary!
pitched up and driven down the ground to long-on
length ball, 86mph and pulled without timing through midwicket
whoopsie, that's gone wrong! Out the back of the hand, I think, and well off the cut strip for a wide
full outside off, driven firmly but well stopped by backward point
round the wicket and slung down the leg side for another freebie
cutter from Phehlukwayo, pulled but off the bottom edge for one to deep backward square
back of a length in the channel, Woakes stabs it in front of the cover sweeper for a couple
fullish, not quite a yorker but Woakes can only bunt to long-on
cutter, following Stokes as he backs away and swings a pull to deep midwicket

full-bunger, smacked on the boot... Half-hearted appeal from Rabada but SA review, though it looked plenty leg side to me. No bat on it as Stokes whooshed across the line, but it clearly pitched outside leg, so on we go
dug in short, Woakes is hanging back and attempts to ramp it but doesn't connect
short and wide, another cutter and Stokes it struggling to reach it with a broom handle... but somehow manages to get enough power on it to pick up four to deep extra cover! He's into the 80s
another slower ball, pulled into the leg side
first ball is squirted away fine! Misdirected, on the pads, Stokes swivels and flicks past the man on the edge of the ring
full and wide, a slower ball in the tramlines but Plunkett had moved across and although he can't connect with a heave the umpire is happy enough
pitched up and clubbed down the ground, single to long-off, brings up the England 300

goes for the reverse-pull - slapped straight to backward point! Stokes was ticking, but he's tocked his last for today! Throws back the head in frustration, though he walks off to a round of applause. A fine knock, but we may only know how good it was come the end of the day...
fullish outside off, Archer unleashes his levers and blaps four through cover! Good way to get off the mark in international cricket
fullish, 86mph and flicked into a gap, nicely done and they'll scuttle back for two
pitched up and whipped through the leg side
fired in towards the blockhole, Rabada sticking to his yorkers, Plunkett squirts it behind square and they get back for two
full again, can only dig it out into the off side
back of a length, on the pads, clipped hard to midwicket where Stokes intercepts well
that's a sharp length outside off, just back of comfortable, angled away from the left-hander. De Kock chops down into his crease
attacking the top of off from just back of a length. Defended with soft hands into the cordon
on the toes this time, flicked comfortably to backward square to open South Africa's account
beaten outside off. Well bowled, tight to the edge, de Kock tried something funky to run the single through third man, but couldn't connect. A good tone-setting first over
line and length first-up, decent pace outside off. Blocked
short and wide, slashed hard through point but Roy intercepts superbly with a dive to his right. That saved four
full length on leg, no width to free the arms. Tucked to midwicket with a closed face
flicked off the hip once more, this time finds enough of a gap to scamper the single but that's another tight over
on the back foot, flicked to midwicket with a late turn of the wrists
off-stump line, back of a length, pressed to mid-off
fuller length on the toes, clipped with intent but short midwicket's hands are true. England looking sharp in the field
too short this time, the slip has just been removed, and de Kock gets away with a calculated slash through third man. Buttler dived but never got close.
clipped behind square, injecting pace on the ball with good wristwork, and Bairstow scoots round at fine leg to cut it off
rides the bounce outside off with silky-soft hands. Two slips in place but he undercuts them both
slower ball from Archer, rolling the fingers at point of delivery and taking oodles of pace off a full-length floater
bouncer into the grille! That was self-evidently not a slower ball! Amla climbed into the pull but that bit him like a cobra! Proper pace from nowhere! And out comes the physio to check him over
outside off, full and fast, left alone with a shoulder of the arms
outside off, full length, met with a full face into the covers
tight to the hips, back of a length, offering no width whatsoever as de Kock is squared up and struck amidships
this time he gets his width! A shimmy to leg, to encourage Woakes to stray to the off, and he gets his cuttable slot-ball. Duly slotted to the fence
up on the toes, fizzed through to the rope off the back foot. That's supreme batting, hanging on the leg stump, a touch outside his crease, and making Woakes think again about his restrictive line
full and into the toes, crunched to mid-on. A good tussle
back of a length outside off, punched to cover
full length cutter, eased through the covers for Plunkett to hunt it down in the deep
sizzling through to the keeper! A 91mph bouncer, , de Kock sways, hoping for the wide, but it's not forthcoming
pulls the length back to the right-hander, who defends squarely in front of his stumps. It's a tussle out there!
tight to the legs once more, back of a length, clipped to square leg
full length, cracked off the front foot to point. Nothing much in this pitch at present, but the shots aren't quite there for the taking
back of a length, wicket-to-wicket line. Patted back to the bowler. More cut-and-thrust in that over
very full, outside off, that's a lovely sighter for Faf, who places bat on ball and strokes a sumptuous four through the covers
full face of the bat, vertical stance, eased to the on-side
on the pads, attempted flick, and a very loud guttural Afrikaaans 'Arrrgghhhhkkk!' rings across The Oval as he fails to make proper contact
on the pads, flicked behind square
beaten outside off with a flat-footed whoosh! Whatever slot Faf thought that was in, he was wrong! Anyway, we move on ...
back of a length, nurdled to the leg side
banging out a solid line, just back of a length, fenced to cover

banged in short, top-edged, Moeen steadies himself, gone! That is a huge scalp, and Archer is showing his value to this team from the outset. Lured the skipper into a pull, but the ball just kept getting big on him, spiralled off his eyebrows, and Moeen at fine leg had an age to contemplate his existence before pulling it off very coolly in the end...
tight line on a full length, stabbed down to the cordon off the line of off stump
nurdled to the leg side
outside off, tight line and length, swatted to cover
on the toes, flicked to fine leg
leg stump line, met with a solid stab to mid-on
outside off, a slowly turning legbreak, straightening into a gentle back-cut to point

got him, or has he?! What on earth has gone on here? England think they've bowled him! It's flicked the bat on the reverse sweep from outside leg, thumped the outside of the stump and triggered the zing bails but the bails haven't come off, and the ball has gone for four!
back of a length, pulled through the leg side
a wristy flick into the covers
well, hello, scratch that! If it strays into the slot, it will be slotted! A booming full-faced monstering high over long-on!
dabbed into the leg side
tossed towards the blockhole, nudged to midwicket
big legbreak! Held back the pace that time, let it bite the pitch outside off as de Kock leant back for the cut and had to hastily adjust
outside off, another wild chop with the spin, but can't connect as Buttler gathers
a tentative crease-bound prod, bobbling to the leg side
pulls back the length as de Kock advances, pressed to mid-off
edged, dropped! Turn from Moeen outside off, vdD played inside the line, a thin tickle, into the gloves and out again!
nutmegged! A tough over for Buttler is made even worse as this one scuttles a touch outside off, eludes the edge and fizzes through his legs!
slog-sweep, good connection, gathered in the deep
back and across, into the crease, tucked to the leg side
back-of-a-length legbreak, tentatively forward to block
tied down outside off by another lifter off the deck. Defended back to the bowler
fine bowling, tight, controlled, defended back to the bowler on a solid line and length. The rate is creeping a touch ...
reverse-sweep, and he's nailed that one! That's the way to relieve the pressure, backward point dives but that was through him like a dose of something nasty
worked to the leg side
driven on the up, bobbles through to wide mid-off. If he'd timed that better, he'd have been in trouble...
swept again, but can't beat backward point. England's spinners are going a decent job at the moment
swept down to fine leg, good connection and placement
rushed into the cut, beaten outside off. 'Ayeee-aah!' is the cry from QDK, which sums it up
flicked off the pads to the leg side, and that will be drinks
pushed through, close to off stump and straightening as de Kock clamps down in defence
superbly fielded in the covers by Roy! Firmly driven but he pounces on it, gathers in and fires off a throw with de Kock having to scramble back to his ground
short, aiming to tuck the batsman up, de Kock helps it away fine for a couple
back of a length, 136kph/84mph and flicked away to deep backward square
short of a length and jumping to hit the shoulder of the bat as RvdD stays back
back of a length outside off, van der Dussen slashes a thickish outside edge over backward point
floated up, dipping as RvdD goes for the reverse-sweep, nearly over-balances but gets it away square
flatter, close to the stumps and he attempts to force a cut, picks out backward point this time
darted on off, van der Dussen plants the front foot and clips uppishly back to the bowler
short, dug in at the ribs but de Kock is equal to it, rolls the wrists on a smooth pull for four!
tapped down into the leg side
short outside off, 132kph/82mph and van der Dussen slaps a cut to the cover sweeper
tossed up on off stump, de Kock shows it a straight bat and ushers to long-off
flat trajectory on off, met on the front foot
short on the hip and jabbed away square
length ball, driven firmly on the up in front of the cover sweeper for a couple
short, 135kph/84mph and tucked down to the on side
touch short on off, defended towards point

golden arm strikes! Short and flogged down the throat of deep backward square leg! Plunkett does the job, England's middle-overs money-maker... Just seemed to be a half-tracker on leg stump and de Kock swung it away, but straight to the man on the rope, who took it safely plunging forwards!
tossed up and driven through mid-off for his first run
flattish outside off, RvdD is across and pokes one through point
tossed up around off stump, opens the face and runs one more behind point
short outside off, draws an ungainly fresh-air shot from Duminy
comes across and blocks on off stump
short ball, rocks back and twocks a single out to deep backward square
length outside off, 134kph/83mph and slapped through cover
full, maybe a cutter from Plunkett, right up on the toes as Duminy clips it to midwicket
length ball, 83mph around off stump, defended into the turf
tossed up wide of the stumps, van der Dussen reverse-sweeps to backward point
pushed through and blocked

oh my... Lofted straight to long-off! Dumb from Duminy, and he's heading for the changing room, gifting a catch to Stokes, who ambled in a few yards and took it safely! Seems like the bat turned in his hands, maybe he was aiming squarer towards extra cover... But he's taken on Moeen and taken himself down!
shortish and Pretorius is off the mark with a pull

this could be tight at the non-striker's end! Yes, Pretorius is inches short...! Pitched up, 132kph/82mph and slapped towards deep extra cover, looks like Pretorius called him back for the second - but a good throw from Stokes left them struggling, Morgan gathered well and Robert's your mother's brother!
short of a length, RvdD hangs back and opens the face to third man
back of a length outside off, 138kph/86mph and slashed down to third man
touch short, van der Dussen rides it and drops behind square on the off side
pushed through wide of the stumps and cut behind square for a couple
flights the legbreak, straightening on leg stump and tucked square
another drop? Or did it miss everything...? Very full and he threw the bat, hit the ground and maybe grazed the edge, too, but the ball thudded off Buttler's fingertips and went straight to ground
tossed up and he comes down, heaves this over the leg side for one more
tossed up on off, Phehlukwayo gets out and drills through the covers
touch short, creamed in front of deep point this time! Van der Dussen showcasing some strong wrist work now
flatter on off, defended
flighted outside off, stabbed square and he wants one, but is sent back
fullish, driven coming forwards, Rashid gets down to stop it
tosses up the leggie, slooooooow and low on middle and leg, RvdD defends
pushed through flatter, van der Dussen drops into his crease and cuts for one, brings up a fighting half-century
floated up, goes for the reverse-sweep, hit hard but can't get it past Archer at backward point
good length outside off, van der Dussen attempts to open the face, only succeeds in deflecting it through to Buttler on the bounce
slower ball on middle and off, tapped back
good pace, 88mph and driven into the covers
shortish and tucked to the leg side
dug in, 141kph/88mph outside off stump, Amla drops the hands and watches it coolly by
pushed through on middle and off, Amla defends
flattish on leg stump, flicked away through square on the back foot
pitched up this time and defended on the front foot
back of a length, 140kph/87mph and Amla rises to guide a cut <deL>past</del> into Roy's orbit at backward point and he latches on brilliantly to keep them to one
round the wicket, climbing to judder the splice as Phehlukwayo defends
licks from Archer, flicks from Lucky... 90mph delivery on the hip disappears to fine leg, neatly done
bangs in a 145kph/90mph bouncer this time, called on height
short of a length around off stump, defended stoutly
outside off, flat-batted into the covers
decent line, back of a length, fenced to the leg side
outside off, on the back foot, Roy slips round effortlessly at point to gather. He's been immense as well today, to be fair
banged in short, outside off, a slapped pull to the leg side
outside off, chopped down into the crease, and gathered by the keeper
banged in short, swinging away as the batsman ducks inside the line
short, leg-sided, pulled but without much intent, gathered at backward square
inside-edged, a flat-footed drive into the covers

banged in short, pulled through the leg side and Morgan can't cling on! He stretched high to his left, but did he fully commit? I suspect he may have had his hurty finger in mind there ... discretion is better part of valour at this stage of the match and tournament
middle-and-leg line, tapped back to the bowler in his followthrough
rolls the fingers on a full-length delivery, slides down the leg side
banged in short, a waft off the eyebrows, it's the slower-ball bouncer, and Amla walks! Plunkett bags his second, and South Africa's wafer-thin hopes are now officially ended
width outside off, a back-footed slap at thin air
canny deflection, opening the face outside off, and a thick edge down through third man
short, slapped, inches short of midwicket!

short again, pulled again, held at deep midwicket again! It's Plunkett this time, stooping forward to cling on in both mitts. That was a solid connection, but the man was well placed and England's fielding has been the most composed aspect of their play today.
full, and angling away outside off, Danushka watches it through to the keeper
good length and slanting away on a fourth-stump line, Danushka gets right behind the line and solidly defends it back to the bowler with soft hands
pretty full and outside off, Danushka presses forward, gets closer to the pitch, and drives through the line to mid-off, where the fielder (de Bryun) throws himself to his left but fumbles
Steyn shortens his length but still explores the corridor, Dimuth, however, doesn't. Left alone watchfully
Steyn hits a hard length on middle, Dimuth gets right behind it and plays it back to the bowler
opens his spell with a short ball outside off, Danushka leans back and flays it straight to backward point
back of a length and skids down the leg side, the batsman falls over the leg-side flick and does not make contact
pitched further up and angling away outside off, no shot
nice and full outside off, punchily driven off the front foot straight of mid-off
short of a length and angling away outside off, punched up to extra cover
full and angling across off, nearly 140ks, the batsman closes the face and drives weakly to mid-on
fiery lifter on leg stump, bursts off the deck to the leaping keeper as the batsman ducks under it

pitched up and angling away outside off, right up Danushka's alley, he presses forward to this full ball. He does not meet the pitch and drives uppishly but wide of the covers. Some glove love between Dimuth and Danushka
good length on off, Danushka responds with a rock-of-Gibraltar defence back to him
very full on the pads, Danushka inches forward and whisks it away to mid-on
rising short ball on middle, Danushka rides the bounce and pats it down to the leg side
full and angling away outside off, squeezed behind point off the outside edge
back of a length on a fourth-stump line, front-foot defensive
dug in short and outside off, sits up to be hit, Dimuth swivels on the back foot and laces a pull to the left of the square-leg umpire and right of long leg. Shot, Dimuth
back of a length and wide outside off, no shot
banged in short and angling in from around the stumps, 142.8ks rocket, rushes Dimuth into the hook. He bottom-edges it onto his ribs. Ouch!
keeps it short and gets it to kick up outside off, hits the splice and lobs over where short leg may have been. The fielder had been pulled out earlier in the over
back of a length and on a fifth-stump line, opens the face and punches to backward point
good length on middle, chips a drive does Dimuth but it does not carry to Maharaj at square leg
fuller than a good length and swerving away outside off, Dimuth has a crooked poke and nicks it... it does not carry to second slip. Replays suggest it was the fast offcutter from Steyn
Danushka gets behind the line of this shortish ball on off and blocks to cover
full and on the pads, presses forward and clips it away straight to short midwicket
mighty full and outside off, jabs out a drive to mid-off
short and angling in at off from round the stumps, played back to the bowler
nice and full outside off, forward and driven up to mid-on, where Ngidi dives forward to gather the ball
there comes the bouncer, angling in at the head of Dimuth. The batsman has his eyes locked on the ball before ducking underneath it despite hanging his bat up
short and skids on off stump, 144ks, diffused to mid-on
full and outside off, closes the face and drives it beautifully through midwicket for a four. The ball trickles away to the fence, teasing the chasing fielder
full on middle, presses forward and defends to mid-off
full on middle, drives uppishly as he's early into the shot, scooped to the left of mid-on
draws the edge, but it does not carry. Good length delivery outside the off stump. He looks to defend it and gets an outside edge
defends from the middle of the bat this time. He comes forward and defends a good length ball outside the off stump

Ngidi belts out an appeal for lbw, not given by umpire Llong. Pretty full and slanting in with the angle from around the stumps, Dimuth plays around his front pad and falls over the flick but this seems to be heading down leg. Oh, the tracker returns umpire's call on leg stump
lovely finish to the over from Ngidi. Good length, angling in, coaxing the batsman to play the angle. But the ball straightens away late to beat the outside edge
back of a length and angling into a front-foot defence to cover
tight line on off, Danushka opens the face and fillets the gap between covers and point
full and outside off, firmly driven down the ground, Rabada tumbles to his left to intercept the ball
back of a length and angling in at off, closes the face and forces the ball away to the left of mid-on
yowza! Lifter outside off, Danushka drops his gloves, weaves inside the line, but falls over in the end
follows the bouncer with a full ball outside off, Danushka is concentrating. He gets forward and push-drives to mid-off
back of a length and outside off, keeps a touch low, jabbed away to backward point

This murmur extends into a spike as the ball sneaks through from under the bat...and that is enough for TV umpire Paul Reifel to uphold the decision.

Happy birthday, Dilruwan! Another non-turner from Dilruwan, slides in from around the stumps, Elgar dares to sweep from the stumps and misses it altogether. Timbaaaah. Oh wait, the umpires are checking for a possible no-ball. Tight, tight call. Looks like the foot is on the line. Nothing behind the line, according to me. But I guess the benefit of the doubt will go to the bowler. Nope, it's been called a front-foot no-ball. A not-so-happy birthday for Dilruwan
good length and on off stump, defended off the back foot
Dropped by Mathews at first slip. Wide of the crease, angling in and breaking away outside off. Draws the batsman forward and finds the outside edge but it has been dropped
arm ball on middle, defended
full and wider outside off, left alone
Mathews catches the ball now but there's no bat. Good length, drifts in and breaks away to beat the batsman as well as the keeper
pushed through on off stump, no turn, Markram stretches out and clunks a sweep to the midwicket boundary. The stand is worth 16 - SA's highest for the first wicket this series
skids in on middle, draws an inside edge but does not carry to short leg
back of a length and spins away, prodded past slip
back of a length and spits up at Markram, he stays back and pats it down
nimble footwork from Markram. He races down the track, takes it on a half-volley and smears it straight of mid-off for four
short and spins in on middle, back-foot force to midwicket
another front-foot no-ball from Dilruwan. Slashes a short ball to point
fuller on off, defended

Markram has been given out lbw by umpire Llong. He decides against a review, and rightly so, as it looks pretty adjacent.Straighter one on off stump, Markram shuffles across for a sweep but does not lay bat onto it. Instead, he is struck on the back pad. This is crashing into middle. Has the procession started?
this spins away outside off, he plays inside the line and lets it go
tossed wide outside off, de Bruyn employs the sweep and hammers it away to the midwicket fence
skidder on off, jabbed back off the back foot
shorter and spins away outside off, Elgar leans back and forces to point
tossed on off, played back down the pitch
Elgar shuffles across and prods to short leg
full and spins past the outside edge as Elgar plays inside the line of it
back of a length and rips away past the outside edge again as Elgar dangles his bat out
dangled up outside off, Elgar reverse-sweeps... and misses. Raises a big puff of dust from the surface
fired on middle, Elgar dares to take it from the stumps and reverse-swat it over point. Bam!
tossed on off, forward and defended to short leg
full on middle, stretches forward in defence
pushed through on middle, here comes the flat, hard sweep from de Bruyn. Nailed to the midwicket boundary
on a length and outside off, no turn, stabbed to the covers
tossed on middle, forward and defended
short and darted onto the hips, clipped through midwicket off the back foot

Dilruwan belts out an appeal for lbw, not given. SL choose to review the on-field not-out decision. Fired from around the wicket, straightens to beat the outside edge and hit the back pad in line with off stump. Pitching in line, impact in line, but umpire's call on off stump. Clipping only the outside of off stump. The ball rolls away fine. Four leg byes

another straighter one that pins the pad. Sangappeal from Dickwella. SL choose to review back-to-back not-out decisions. Good length and straightens on off to beat the outside edge and ping the back thigh. No bat involved again. This also returns umpire's call on off stump
looped up on leg stump, think its off the pad as the ball lobs to short leg
length on off, blocked on the front foot
length on middle, pushed into the leg side
short of a length outside off, defended off the back foot
full outside off, blocked into the off side
flicks aerially past short leg. Length ball dipping at off stump, doesn't get to the pitch as he closes the face
length on middle stump, defended towards short leg off the inside half
length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
thick edge past second slip. Once more, doesn't get to the pitch. This time he's looking to drive through cover
short of a length outside off, defended off the back foot
tossed up outside off, driven to point's left off the front foot
nicely done. Dilruwan stays around the wicket and tosses one up at off stump. De Bruyn puts a big stride forward and reverse sweeps, on the full, past slip
length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
tossed up outside off, looks to reverse, cops it on the pad. He's at a sixth stump line. It's full enough that it won't spin into off stump
length outside off, blocked on the front foot
another reverse. This is tossed up at leg stump and once more he has three stumps exposed as he goes after it. Connects nicely to get it through point this time
short of a length outside off, stabbed to deep point off the back foot
tossed up outside off, gets an inside edge that pops into the pad off the ground
tossed up at off stump, blocked on the front foot
length on leg stump, pushed into the leg side off the front foot
nice. Length ball curves in at off stump and climbs past the outside edge
full on middle stump, blocked with the turn
full on leg stump, dead-batted into the pitch. He picked that arm ball

got him! A poor shot from Elgar. It's a slider outside off. Both his feet are on a leg stump line while his bat is swaying well outside off. It spins just a touch and takes a thin edge that Dickwella takes easily....oh dear. Rod Tucker is signalling to the dressing room to call Elgar back. He has missed yet another no-ball call. The third umpire has pointed it out. The decision will be overturned. He's two inches in front with his heel. Before the rules were changed earlier this year, a batsman couldn't be called back after walking off the ground. Elgar might be the first one to benefit from that rule.
rips past the outside edge. Length on off stump, spins away sharply
short of a length outside off, punched to point off the back foot
short of a length outside off, jabbed into the covers
length on middle stump, pings to short fine off the inside edge
nice. Another swept boundary. Length on off, gets down quickly, big stride, uses the angle to caress it to the deep square boundary
length on leg stump, dabbed to midwicket off the back foot
length outside off, spinning back into the front pad. But he's struck outside off. Lbw appeal turned down
inside edge onto pad, looks to drive again, away from the body at this wide length ball
length outside off, defended from the crease
short of a length and spinning in at middle stump. Backs away and gets cramped as he looks to punch. It rolls down the pitch
length on middle stump, inside edge into the turf as he looks to defend on the front foot. Leg slip dives to his left to stop
length ball spins into his pad as he gets on the front foot. Struck in front of leg stump
length on off stump, gets back in the crease to defend with the turn
lands wide of short leg who is running back and to his left. De Bruyn steps out and looks to flick but has got an inside edge onto pad that lobs up
length ball pitches on middle and slides down to rap the front pad in front of leg stump. Appeal turned down
spits up from off and Dickwella catches at hip height as Elgar looks to defend on the front foot
into the pads and tickled into the leg side
length on middle, tapped to midwicket off the back foot
short of a length and lifting up at leg stump. Kills the bounce, defends into the turf in front of short leg
well done at deep square. Roshen puts in a dive to his right to stop a furious sweep from De Bruyn. Picked up from wide outside off
tossed up outside off, driven to cover with the turn
full outside off, neatly flicked to deep square with a big stride
length ball turns away, Beats the outside edge of the bat and the off stump
nicely timed. Length ball on off stump, big stride for the sweep and a clean swing to get it in front of square. No one in the deep
length on leg stump, tickled through square leg off the back foot
full on off stump, blocked on the front foot
length on middle stump, dead-batted into the pitch
length on middle stump, pushed through midwicket off the back foot
tossed up outside off, gets to the pitch and pushes against the turn to mid-off's left
length on middle stump, defended off the back foot
full on middle, blocked off the front foot
length on leg stump, tapped into the leg side off the back foot
short of a length at leg stump, steps out and tickles to short fine leg
full on middle stump, flicked to mid-on's left
full and slanted across off stump. Past the outside edge of his forward defence
is that dropped? Appears to have been pushed into the square leg region by a leaping leg gully. Before that, De Bruyn appears to have got an inside edge onto pad on the sweep
length outside off, looks to sweep, caught on the back leg which outside the line of off stump
length on off stump, blocked on the front foot

length outside off, stabbed to cover's right for a quick single. The throw comes in and ricochets off De Bruyn's sliding bat. Dilruwan, running to his right to back up at square leg is forced to change direction, but he won't be able to stop that
length ball on leg stump, defended into the leg side off the back foot
length outside off, big stride to defend on the front foot
length on off stump, solidly defended on the front foot
falls short of leg slip. Another sweep that he's gone through too quickly with. Pings of the back of the bat forearm, with maybe some help from the pad first. Dies in front of the fielder
length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
jumps past the outside edge as he's stuck halfway between forward and back when looking to defend

trapped deep in the crease and struck on the back leg as he goes back to this arm ball. Looks on first glance like that might have been sliding down leg. But Elgar shakes the head and won't even consider it. Does he feel a sense of justice in not reviewing? It's a very close call - but Elgar's right. On replay, we see that's hitting leg stump. Dilruwan has his foot behind this time and that man Elgar in his wickets tally. At last.
length on off stump, shuffles on the back foot to defend
length ball down leg side, left alone
short of a length on off stump, dead-batted into the pitch off the back foot
lovely shot. Steps out against this loopy length ball outside off and picks up with the turn, launching it high and wide over mid-on
length outside off, struck on the front pad, well outside off stump
legbreak from Akila. He picks it. Length ball turning away from off and he defends with the turn
length ball outside off, smothers it into the pad outside off
googly that Amla hasn't picked. But it's full enough to not misbehave as he gets forward and defends off the inside half
length on leg stump, turned into the leg side off the back foot
short of a length on leg stump, whipped into short leg's shin off the back foot
full outside off, inside edge onto pad as he looks to drive
length on leg stump, nudges it to leg slip with the turn
shot. Gets to the pitch to drive against the turn and squeezes it through cover
inside half as he looks to force another one against the turn. Not even close to the pitch of the ball outside off this time
length ball wide outside off, shuffles to sweep, cops it on the front pad. He's outside the line
beautiful. Authoritative from Amla. Jumps up at the right time, meets this offbreak at the pitch wide outside off and jams it wide of mid-off

lbw appeal turned down as Amla looks to sweep. Sri Lanka will review it. Amla is caught on the pad looking to sweep. He's shuffled a long way first. Has he done enough to get outside the line of off? This decision hinges on that...yes he has. Just outside. The decision stands and the review will be retained.
full on off stump, goes deep in the crease to defend
offbreak pitches on leg and spins down. He can't get bat on the flick and the keeper can't stop cleanly
short of a length on off, defended off the back foot
length on middle stump, loud appeal as leg slip catches this deflection off the front pad. It's not out on both lbw and caught - spinning down leg
short of a length on off, tapped into the extra cover region off the back foot
length ball on leg stump, catches him on the thigh as he looks to flick
nicely done. Down the pitch to meet this at the pitch and flick to deep midwicket
length on leg stump, dead-batted on the front foot
arm ball on off stump, defended off the back foot
length outside off, blocked on the front foot
hard-spun offbreak, on a length, starts outside off and breaks down the leg side
Amla ventures down the track and drives a full ball from off back to Akila's left
tossed up and breaking down the leg side, and beating the keeper, as Amla lets it go. Byes
loopier on off, forward and smothered
very full on middle, the batsmen goes deep in the crease and drives a single to deepish mid-on
tossed up and breaks in at off, defended
looped up and holds its line on off, the batsman bends forward and dead-bats it
full on middle, de Bruyn answers with the dead bat again
pushed through outside off and Dilruwan finds a hint of turn to hit the front pad outside off
tossed up on off stump, de Bruyn shuffles across off and jams it out

cracker of a ball from Herath. He knocks out Amla's off stump. Fuller than a good length, drifts into middle stump, Amla goes on the back foot and prods at it, the ball breaks away just enough to beat the outside edge and hit the off stump. Whoa, what a sumptuous delivery from Herath. Just too good for Amla, who was hanging on the back foot
full and outside off, laced to the covers
pushed through outside off, Faf drops to one knee and smokes a sweep to midwicket
full and drifts in on middle, defended
full on middle, dead-batted again
uses his feet and pushes a full ball to the covers
short of a length at leg stump, pushed to midwicket off the back foot
full on leg stump, pushed to midwicket off the front foot
good length outside off, stretches out to sweep to backward square
length on middle stump, dead-bats off the back foot
legbreak slides straight on off the pitch. He watches closely to block on the front foot
length ball on off stump, dead-batted on the front foot
length ball into the pads, inside edge onto pad and into the leg side
full on middle stump, blocked on the front foot
short an wide outside off. Looks to cut but it spins a long long way away. Past the keeper too and between him and slip
nicely played, albeit a little too early. Sweeps from outside off, and gets a bit of a leading edge on this. Between deep square and deep midwicket
length on off stump, blocked into the covers on the front foot
tossed up wide outside off, driven to point
rips back in sharply at middle stump as he looks to make room again. Just gets bat to keep it out
length outside off, sweeps to deep square
length outside off, pushed down the pitch off the front foot
full on middle stump, driven back to the bowler
length on leg stump, blocked on the front foot
full, curving in towards off, Faf plays for the angle but the ball spins sharply past the outside edge
turn and bounce outside off, Faf is beaten in the corridor again
shorter and wider outside off, forced away to the right of short cover
the batsman shapes for a sweep, adjusts to a straighter one on off, and pokes it out to the covers
fast skidder outside off, leans back and chops hard to backward point

back-to-back wrong'uns, Maharaj has been pinned in front this time. Given out by Tucker this time. Maharaj chooses to challenge the decision now. Full and the googly breaks in to catch the front pad as Maharaj has a short stride and plays outside the line of it. Impact in line with off stump. Did Maharaj snick it? Nope, and the tracker returns three reds. Why did Maharaj review if he hadn't edged it?
topspinner on off, stretches out and solidly drives it back to the bowler
offbreak from Akila, spins down leg, Bavuma overbalances as he misses the reverse sweep
flat and balloons into the lap of short leg off the thigh pad
full and dips at off, forward and dead-batted
shorter on middle and leg, de Bruyn picks the length early. Goes back and punches the ball through the midwicket region
tossed up and drifts in on middle, Bavuma plays back and pokes it out to point
pushed through flat on middle, rolls his wrists and sweeps it away behind square for four
low full-toss outside off, forward and laced to mid-off
tossed up on leg stump, Bavuma can't deal with extra bounce and top-edges a sweep over backward square leg
fuller and outside off, de Bruyn stretches out and sweeps it with the break to the square leg boundary. Hit flat and hard to the fence
short and spins back into a back-foot punch to sweeper
floaty full ball on off, dead-batted away
back of a length on middle, defended to short leg
drags down a legbreak outside off, de Bruyn steps back and crunches it away through the covers. He feels his arm right after hitting that. Sore?
full on middle, defended to the off side
swept from outside off to deep midwicket
drifts in and bursts away outside off as de Bruyn tucks his bat inside the line
full on middle, presses forward and dead-bats it
full on off, played back to the bowler
sharp turn from outside off, hits the inside edge but Dickwella can't catch it diving forward. Just evades him
swept from outside off to square leg
full on middle, shuffles across and blocks stoutly to the leg side
dangled up on off, dead-batted
shorter and outside off, a back-foot force to the covers ensues
full and straightening down the line on off, blocked out
tossed up on the leg stump, rolls out another sweep and finds the gap between long leg and deep midwicket
full and outside off, jabbed to the covers
pushed through on off, Bavuma stretches out and sweeps flat and hard through square leg
short and wide outside off, chopped to the left of Dilruwan at backward point. Top diving save from the birthday boy
pushed through on off, de Bruyn dead-bats it
short of a length on off stump, defended off the back foot
tossed up outside off, gets down for the first sweep of the day. Squeezes it out to deep square
length on off stump, defended off the back foot
short ball turning down leg side, left alone

length ball on leg stump, plonks the front leg across and paddles it fine

full on off stump, driven with the turn to extra cover

nicely done. Gets down the pitch and is beaten in flight. But manages to keep his shape and flick this on the up through midwicket
raps the pad outside the line of leg stump. This spins back in and takes the inside edge
length ball on middle stump, looks to sweep and cops it on the body

length and angled in at off. Gets deep in the crease and defends with a straight bat
beaten. Defends inside the line as this drifts in at off stump and fizzes away
yorker length outside off. Jammed back down the pitch
and once again. Turning too much to cause trouble. Bavuma happy to defend inside the line for the one that skids on
full and flat outside off. Stabbed into the off side with no feet
length outside leg stump, gets back and flicks to long leg
sweeps aerially past square leg. Not in control against this rising ball, but he manages to get it fine of the fielder
short of a length at leg stump, whipped to long leg off the back foot

short leg lunges forward to take one. Bavuma steps out and looks to flick. It looks like has lobbed off the pad with no other contact...but Sri Lanka have made a late review decision. He looks okay. There's nothing on Ultra Edge. Ball's climbing into his front pad too as he's down the pitch, surely it's turning down leg...it is decision upheld. Sri Lanka lose the review.
tossed up on off stump, gets down and gets a vicious sweep out to deep square
length ball dipping and ripping outside off. De Bruyn can't get his bat close as it spins away
once more, sharp turn, steep bounce as he gets forward to defend
short of a length and wide outside off, he lets it go. Herath smiles at the young'un
the arm ball. De Bruyn is alive to the wily old man's variation. Blocks into the leg side with a short stride
nearly steers to slip. Follows this short of a length ball outside off with his hands and jabs aimlessly with an open face. It falls short of Mathews
short of a length outside off, on the back foot to tap into the covers. Dilruwan retrieves the ball himself
length on off stump, dead-bats with the turn on the front foot
length ball climbs up at his thigh and he allows it after shaping to try and defend

length on leg stump, defended down the pitch

arm ball sliding in rapidly into his pad as he looks to get on the back foot. It's going down leg

inside half as he's lulled into this loopy ball on leg stump. Not to the pitch, just manages to close the face and get this out to deep backward square
length on leg stump, pushed into the leg side off the front foot
short of a length on leg stump, punched through midwicket off the back foot
loud appeal as short leg takes another loopy one. It's off the pad as he stretches far outside off to try and defend
short of a length on leg stump, whipped expertly behind square
short of a length on leg stump, punched to square leg's left off the back foot
tossed up outside off, driven to mid-off's left. Herath tumbles there and can't keep it to a single

defends inside the line as the ball spins steeply away outside off
thick outside edge rolls past the slip. Tossed up at off stump, blocked with soft hands as this spins away
length on off stump, blocked solidly on the front foot
past the outside edge. This straightens marginally and nearly takes off stump too. Nice floaty ball on off stump
length on off stump, pushed towards mid-on off the front foot. An electric Herath gets across and prevents the run
length on leg stump, blocked into the leg side
starts with an offbreak. It's short and very wide. Bavuma slaps it to the point boundary with some authority
short of a length and climbing up at off stump, defended off the back foot
googly is picked. Tossed up outside off and he gets a big stride to clip this to deep midwicket
nicely done. Superb. Short from Akila again, spinning in at off stump this time. Gets right back and punches it wide of mid-off while he's still on the move.
length outside off, blocked on the front foot, off the inside half
length ball spinning down leg, past the inside edge as he looks to defend off the back foot. Past the keeper too, and leg slip.
length ball spinning away from the corridor, squares him up as he defends on the back foot
length at the stumps, blocked on the front foot
short of a length and down leg side. Gets it caught between his knees as he looks to whip off the back foot
length on leg stump, defends down the pitch with soft hands
length outside off, looks to sweep and is caught on the pad. Long way outside off and they won't review
length outside off, blocked from the crease
length and spinning in at leg stump, pushed into the leg side
short of a length and coming in at middle. Looks to make room again but is cramped quickly. Dangerous shot. Rolls back down the pitch
length ball turning down leg side. Left alone
short and coming in at off stump. Backs away and cuts off the high part of the bat, into the covers
short of a length just outside off, doesn't quite come on. De Bruyn must be excited about pace. Looks to force this through cover but can't time it
length on off stump, blocked solidly off the back foot
length and in at middle stump, punched to mid-on's right. A throw from him at the non-striker's end. It deflects off the stumps for an extra run at extra cover

shot! Oh this is glorious. Length ball outside off, lifts up with the spongy nature of the pitch. But he plans half a stride into the off side and slams this pull over the square leg boundary. Top quality shot on a slow pitch. Too good.
length in the corridor, blocked off the front foot
length on off stump, gets deep in the crease and nudges into the leg side off the back foot
nice take at short leg, diving forward and one-handed. But this has pinged off the pad

inside edge as he looks to drive against the turn. Not close to the pitch of the ball and he's lucky this flies past short leg
tossed up outside off, meets it on the full and sweeps to deep midwicket
full on leg stump, blocked on the front foot
short ball outside off. Gets back to try and pull, but it slides from under his bat. Was looking to drag it from a long way out
short of a length at off stump, blocked off the back foot
length outside off, left alone
length outside off, opens the face and guides it to gully
short and into the hips. Clips it to deep square off the back foot

pings off the glove as this acts naughty outside off. He's on the back foot to try and defend, it floats wide of slip

full on leg stump, swept firmly. Square leg dives to his right and stops this but he can't prevent the single that gives Bavuma a fifty. Good, positive knock.

jumps high and wide outside off from short of a length, taking a lot of the soil with it. Leaves it alone
arm ball on middle stump, defended off the back foot
yorker outside off, slices to point
full on off stump, blocked into the covers
short of a length and lifting in at the hips. Watches closely and dabs, very late, between leg slip and short leg

expertly done. This is full outside off and he's put himself in a hole with the stride across. But in the end, he's got the bat around quickly to short-arm jab this towards the third man boundary. Deep point runs across and puts in the slide, can only manage to parry it into the boundary
