drifts one in at length on middle and leg, turned to square leg
makes room and cuts this to deep point. Brings up 500 runs this season
down the track, goes straight and hits it clean. Lovely swing to hit it up and over. Bounced just in front of the advertising triangle
he bowls this wide outside off, anticipating another chip down the track. Dhawan leaves, wide called and rightly so
rocks back and slaps the pull to long on
whips this shortish delivery on middle and leg to deep square
nice drift, touch fuller so Dhawan lunges forward and turns this gently into the leg side for a quick single
length on off, Dhawan shows the full face as he defends back
crunching cover drive, Harbhajan may have got a hand on it to give Willey at mid-off some hope of pulling it back in, but he had no chance. Dhawan in total control, superb balance
huge wide, loses direction in trying to swing the ball back in, slips it down leg in the process
looks to belt this full delivery on the leg side behind square but the ball misses the pad, swings further down
beaten by a lovely awayswinger. Shapes to drive, minimal feet movement as Williamson looked to lace that through extra cover
straightens a length ball on middle and leg, worked to midwicket
picked away! Too short, he's cracked the cut, Jadeja hares to his left to cut that off.
pulls and misses. Touch too full for him to play it
slips this down leg, wide and rightly so
short and angling down leg, Williamson helps this on its way to the fine leg fence. Too easy
slants a full delivery across, Dhawan watches this through to Dhoni

goes through, Harbhajan makes a mess of it at short fine leg. Short and angling down, Dhawan pulls this straight to short fine, Harbhajan loses control as he tries an unnecessary slide. Gives away four when there should have been none
full and angling away, left alone again
length on off, steered to deep point
too short, put away. Dhawan waits inside the crease and then gives it a proper whack through cover when it arrives.
pulls this short ball to wide long on
fired in outside off, Dhawan shapes to cut but is beaten
sliced over point. Length on off, he backed away and then used his wrists to hit this where he wanted, superb.
swung over the ropes at deep square leg. Too short, he picked the length and smeared this from outside off. Clobbered that, deep into the stands. Coach Tom Moody has a big grin
gets inside the line and helps this short ball up and over, down to third man
full toss, above the waist? Not quite, punched straight to point. Harsh call, Watson gets away with one. Above the waist
full but swinging back in down leg, Dhawan swings and misses.
reverse paddles this quicker one past short third man, deft touch from Dhawan
goes for a slog, has to fetch it from way outside off, gets a thick inside edge wide of Jadeja as they scamper a single
bowls length, gets punished. Dhawan flat-bats the pull over deep midwicket to bring up his half-century.
too much width outside off, smeared into the gap at sweeper cover, Willey does the mopping up
drifts into middle and leg, tucked towards midwicket
reverse paddle, but no control, bounces in front of Watson running in from short third man
flat hit, just clears Bravo at mid-off. Too full, he got underneath the length and belted that
goes short, this time Williamson goes back and helps it over point, good work by Jadeja
Luck favours him this time! Shaped to pull from outside off over deep midwicket, thick outside edge past the keeper to third man
hammered back over the bowler's head, one bounce to the ropes. Too full on off. Absolutely picked the bones out of that
the bat breaks as he defends. Calls for a few spare ones from the dugout
makes room and forces this length ball past extra cover, don't think Williamson realised how well he hit it till it raced away. Deep cover stood no chance
belts this full toss to long-off, another half-century for Williamson. His 10th overall in the IPL
right into the blockhole, squeezed wide of cover

oh, dear. He's scooped this straight to short fine. Dhawan tries to be too cute, gives away his intentions much before Bravo delivered, so he bowls a cutter at length on middle. No pace to work with and he hits it straight to Harbhajan even as thick rain clouds gather over the MCA Stadium from the east. They look ominous too.

sensational catch from Bravo. He has removed two set batsmen in two balls. Full and wide from Thakur, Williamson drives with an open face, over short third man, but from deep point Bravo runs to his left, goes about 20 metres, and takes this low to his left with both hands
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for one
driven to long-on for another single. CSK breathing easy momentarily
short of a length again, driven to deep cover for another single
mid-off is up, Hooda picks his spot, and manages to mis-hit this length ball over that man. The timing is not perfect but Hooda's idea is good: go over the man inside the circle
slower ball, offcutter, on a length, outside off, soft hands to push this towards long-on, which allows them to come back for the second
wide down the leg side, Bravo trying to go behind him but going too far with the angle

shuffles too far across, Bravo pings him right in front with a full ball. He has kept CSK into the game with two wickets and a catch now. Oh hang on. This is interesting. Seemed like a review in hope than in conviction but the ball is shown to be missing the leg stump by the ball projection. This ball didn't have much to travel but the tech ology shows Hooda is not out
bunted into the leg side, Jadeja rushes in from deep midwicket, but they steal the second
slower offcutter, full, turned to leg for a single
short of a length, outside off, crisply driven on the up, but doesn't beat the man at deep cover. Gets a couple
bouncer, seems like the off-pace bouncer, Pandey through it before it arrives. A rare dot ball
full and fast, beats his drive, but it is too wide and called
Hooda moves across to another full and wide ball, and strikes it clean over long-off. This one is not executed well either. The two previous ones were too wide, this one too close to Hooda
wide yorker gone wrong again. Too wide outside off. There is a bit of an appeal for a catch at the wicket but the umpire's call is emphatic and early
on a length, gets away with just a single as Shakib manages to hit this only as far as point
full, just outside off, Shakib drives it to long-off to hand it over to Hooda
not great bowling. On a length, on the pads, with square leg and fine leg inside the circle. Shakib plays the pick-up over square leg

yorker, under his bat, hits his pad. Might just have pitched outside leg. This is a bluff because he has three fielders in the circle behind square on the off side. Shakib is expecting something outside off but gets a straight yorker
and now the one outside off. Slower ball, offcutter, beats Shakib's attempt to cut it
full and straight, stock pace, mis-hit tolong-on, gives Hooda enough time to come back for the second
floats this full on off, Watson punches this into the cover region to get off the mark with a couple
reaches out to drive, mistimes this to extra cover
touch ahead of length on off, defended towards cover
shows the full face of the bat as he defends to mid on
back of length on off stump, Watson gets on top of the bounce and defends
pulled in front of square, sails over deep midwicket. Not all that bad a delivery, length and Watson got into position quickly
punches this length delivery to cover point
angles a full delivery on middle and leg, defended with soft hands
lunges forward and defends this full delivery with hard hnds
cramped for room, bunts this length delivery to cover
turns this length ball towards Shakib at short midwicket as they scamper a single
poor. Slower ball gone wrong, slides this down leg, Watson nonchalantly gets down on one knee and sweeps him over the fine leg boundary
short, and this is even bigger. Muscled over deep midwicket! This is Watson unleashed. Sandeep can't afford to bowl that length, he needs to be much, much fuller.
on the backfoot as he defends this length ball
goes inside-out and this sails over deep cover. Full and moving away, Rayudu just cleared his front leg and biffed that away
steps out and toe-ends a pull to wide mid-on
defends this incoming length ball from the crease
Rashid darts a full-toss on off, spliced to wide long-on
quick fizzer outside off, no turn, Rayudu punches off the back foot to backward point
slid through on off, hint of turn, Rayudu camps back and runs it to short third man
full on off stump, wrong'un?  Rayudu stretches out, rolls out a sweep and hits it to the right of a sliding Hooda at deep midwicket
another wrong'un, back of a length and skids in, cramps Rayudu for room, worked to leg
speared outside off, Watson presses forward and secures a single down to long-off
tripe from Shakib. Full and sliding down leg with fine leg inside the circle, nudged away fine of the diving fielder. Easy pickings
full and sliding into leg stump, this non-turner is swept between short fine leg and square leg
CSK pass fifty in the last over of the Powerplay. Tossed on middle, Rayudu forays down the track, gets close enough to the pitch, and hoists it over the bowler's head
flat dart on middle stump, here comes Rayudu. Down the track and clipped down the ground for one
back of a length on off, cramps Rayudu for room. He dares to pull and ends up splicing it over midwicket for four
short and outside off, Rayudu clears his front leg and skies a pull. Hales moves in as opposed to hanging at the edge of the boundary. Rayudu clears Hales and lifts the ball into Sunrisers' dug out
fuller and outside off, opens the face and dabs through point with soft hands
wide of the crease, chest-high short ball, slanting in, Rayudu stays back and fends it off
overpitched and outside off, Rayudu, having camped back all this while, presses forward and drills it straight of mid-off
lifter wide outside off, Rayudu lets it fizz through to Goswami
arm ball, ducks in on middle, stabbed to midwicket off the inside half
short and angled in on middle, Rayudu flat-bats it down the ground to long-on
Shakib hits a hard length on middle, slides in, messes with Watson's sweep and hits the pad
hip-high short ball outside off, right in Watson's swinging arc. Rocks back and muscles a pull against the intended break to the wide long-on fence
slower and outside off, leans back and glides to sweeper cover
back of a length and breaks away outside off, Rayudu flashes and sends an outside edge to short third man
straighter one on off, 97.4ks, tip and run to cover
googly spins from outside off, Watson does not read it, slog-sweeps and does not make contact
another googly, sliding into the hips, helped wide of short fine leg for one
quicker ball, thigh-high short ball outside off, this 104ks dart is swatted off the back foot to the midwicket fence
skidder just a shade outside off, chopped to backward point
wide of the crease. Pretty full and just outside off, Watson hoists it over extra cover. Hales skips to his left and cuts it down at long-off
hip-high short ball on middle, slower one, Watson picks it up and pulls to deep midwicket
another slower one outside off, 110.7ks, flat-batted away to long-off
low full-toss outside off, Watson stretches out and creams it to the right of sweeper cover. Excellent sliding save in the deep from Rashid
gee, how did that miss off stump. Knuckle ball, bounces  over off. Watson swipes early and misses
slower again, short, Watson waits for the ball to arrive and scythes a square cut. He raises a 31-ball fifty and is embraced by Rayudu
chest-hunting short ball on middle stump, Rayudu takes it on with a pull and splices it between deep square and deep midwicket
Kaul bangs another one into the pitch, attacks the body, Watson top-edges a hook to deep square
Rayudu brings up a fifty of his own and the side's 100 with a six over midwicket. Banged in outside off, Rayudu, having shuffled across, smokes it over midwicket. Bam!
middle-stump yorker, good comeback ball, jammed back to Kaul
overpitched on middle now, Rayudu stays leg-side of the ball and crunches a drive to the left of long-off. Skips away to the boundary
really full on leg stump, tucked away to deep midwicket
Rayudu slices a loft and clears Hales at long-off. Tossed outside off, breaks away, drops to one knee and lifts it over for six
fired outside off, 99ks, stretches out and drives to cover
googly, but the length is short, picked away off the hips into the vacant spaces at midwicket
looks like another wrong'un, finishes on a fourth-stump line, fended to the leg side for one more
very full and attacking the stumps, defended back to the bowler
back of a length on middle, hangs back and works to leg
back of a length and angling in on off, Rayudu has an almighty leg-side swipe, and skews it to the right of Rashid at deep midwicket
back of a length, skids in, hits Rayudu on the mid-riff as he is rushed into a pull
here comes Rayudu, charges down the track. Bhuvneshwar shortens his length on middle. Clubbed over the wide long-on fence for six
just short of a good length and outside off, Watson drags a pull between long leg and deep midwicket
looped up on leg stump, Rayudu dashes down the track and launches it into the wind. Into the midwicket boundary
Goswami gathers the throw from Kane Williamson and catches Watson short. Rayudu pushes it to cover, and they chance a quick single. But Watson isn't quick enough. Some respite for Sunrisers
floated full on off, bunted to long-on off the front foot
full on middle, eased down to long-on, again
slower length ball on off, punched to long on
full on middle, drills this down to long on as they jog a single
too short, way over Dhoni's head. Easy call for wide
looks to nudge this leg side, the ball angles in to deflect off his pad and they take a leg bye
short-arm jab to long on
drifting into middle and leg, eased to deep midwicket
charges down, Shakib cleverly fires this full and wide, Rayudu reaches out to squeeze this away to cover
friendly full toss, Rayudu gleefully accepts as he steps out and swings this straight back over Shakib's head. This shot is as easy as stepping out in Hyderabad and finding a biryani store
squeezes a drive to backward point
gets to the pitch as he drives to long off
can't get this past cover, Dhoni squeezed out the yorker length ball
full toss, biffs this down to deep midwicket
waist-high full toss, punched through to long off. Rayudu asked for the no-ball, Erasmus went 'no, mate. All good there.'
another full toss, another bunt down the ground to long off, they're walking home in singles here
another full toss, another slap but straight to deep cover
Sid Kaul keeps bowling full tosses, keeps getting whacked! Hasn't learnt, bowls a full toss on middle, Dhoni sends this deep into the deep square leg boundary. That was the fourth full toss in a row
banged in short, Rayudu leaves. Umpire signals one bouncer for the over. He shaped to pull but decided to let go late
lands short of third man! Rayudu went over mid-off, ended up slicing it towards third man.
slams this pull to deep square leg. Neither deep midwicket nor fine leg moved. Ferocious strike
turns this gently into the leg side, that's that. CSK cruise home in style with an over to spare. They're all but into the playoffs.
short of a length ball skidded into the man he calls bhaiyya in the Delhi Ranji team. Bhaiyya stands tall and slaps it to the cover boundary
another short of a length ball hooping in sharply at off stump. Dhawan chops straight to short third man
length ball on off stump, tapped to extra cover off the back foot
full ball down leg side, paddles it straight to short fine
short of a length just outside off, sudbued flat-batted drive straight to extra cover
length ball on middle stump, drops it into the covers with soft hands to pinch the single
poor start. Short and wide and slanted across Dhawan. We've seen him long enough to know what that means. Spanks it over backward point
short of a length at off stump, squares him up as he goes on the back foot. Thick outside edge down to third man
looks for the full inswinger. It starts at leg stump and goes down
bouncer at leg stump. Gets on top of the bounce nicely and drops it pitch side with soft hands
just evades Uthappa's hand at backward point. Short-ish again and Dhawan slices hard from underneath. Uthappa stretches to his right and can't hold on
length ball on middle stump, punched back at the bowler on the up
good length just outside off, pushed into the covers on the up
attempted offcutter lands on a length but is down leg side

has him with the bouncer. The batsman has reviewed though, after what seems like a top-edge has been taken at slip....it's off the helmet. Got in an awful position for the hook. So bad, in fact, that the bat isn't anywhere near the ball. Thumps the top of the helmet and hangs up for Rana. No damage to the batsman from that impact. Life's good.
good bouncer but it's the second one! Free-hit coming up. Russell wins the battle, following Goswami down leg side with this bouncer, but it's come at a cost
opens up the off side again! Superb stuff from Goswami. This one is overpitched on off stump and he uses the room to slice it through cover point
short ball clears Karthik! This explodes from the pitch. He bangs it into the corridor and it keeps on climbing after passing the batsman
smart. Very smart batting from Goswami. He's dismantled Russell. Leaps to cover the bounce of another short one in the corridor and caresses it between point and backward point
tossed up at off stump, gets on his knee and drills it along the floor to long-off
well fielded. Overpitched ball outside off, bludgeoned off the front foot but Rana lunges to his right and stops one-handed at cover point
short of a length on off stump, dabbed to short third man
short of a length on middle stump, punched straight to midwicket off the back foot
short of a length at leg stump, tickled to short fine off the back foot
full at middle stump, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot
short of a length slider outside off, cut into the turf off the under-edge
short of a length on the stumps, tapped into the leg side with soft hands
loopy length ball outside off. Goswami reaches out for the aerial drive over off side but doesn't get to the pitch. Just manages to clear cover with the chip
full on middle stump, driven down to long-on
guides it past short third man. Chawla made to pay for his leg stump line. It's full, it's fast enough - Dhawan shovels it past the fielder
short of a length and cramping him. He pushes it back down the pitch
short of a length outside off, opens the face and runs it to short third man
so simple. Gets to the pitch and calmly lofts this over long-on with a clean swing. Narine doesn't get grip or turn outside off because of that big stride
short of a length on leg stump and pulled straight to midwicket
length ball down leg side, misses on the sweep
short and wide outside off, looks to cut and is beaten on the outside edge
short of a length outside off, punched to long-on off the back foot
flat on off, and turning away from the batsman. Flat-batted back to Kuldeep off the back foot
full on off, but turns into Dhawan this time. Cuts it to cover point for a quick run, but he played that shot from very close to his body. Always a dangerous option
flighted on leg stump, and he plays the reverse sweep! That audacity. Quick to adjust his position, and then drags the shot behind square
flighted on middle and off, and Goswami attempts the late cut. Mistimed to short third man this time
pitches outside leg, but spins across the batsman's body. Defended
good length on off, and Dhawan goes deep into his crease this time. Pulls it along the ground in front of square, and that shot eventually beats wide long on! Ends the over with a boundary
wild! Short on leg stump, but going down the leg side. He's lucky that the batsman had shuffled across to the leg side as well. Hits his shoulder guard and goes to the keeper
good length outside off, and he backs away to slap this cut past the infield. Enough time to take the second run as well
good length on leg stump, and angling into the batsman. He backed away to make some extra room, so the bowler did well to follow him. Punched towards cover with soft hands
good length outside off, and that's been whipped off the back foot to the vacant midwicket region. Searles goes chasing behind it, picks it up, and has an aim at the striker's end. Misses.
full toss, but very wide outside off. Goswami mistimes the cut to sweeper cover for a solitary run
back of a length on off, and this time the pull has been dragged to the sweeper fielder on the leg side. They jog across for the run
ooo, googly! Full on middle, and turning into the batsman. Chops it towards the leg side for a quick run
on middle, and turns it off the back foot to the midwicket region. Calls early for the single
flighted on leg stump, and Dhawan pushes it nochalantly to the long-on region. Comfortable single
length ball on middle, and Williamson bends his knees and then pulls this along the ground to the square boundary. Perfectly placed
good length on off, and turning away from the batsman. Nudged to the cover-point region, and calls it early for a run
on middle, and angling into his pads. Rocks onto the back foot and punches it past the non-striker to long on
good length on off, and turning away from Dhawan. He punches it away from his body, but finds the man at deep extra cover
full on middle, and the front-foot defense finds his outside edge. Goes to short third man, but that doesn't stop the batsmen from stealing a single
full just outside off, and driven down the ground to long off for a jogging single
misfield! Allows SRH to take another run. Full on middle, and the batsman comes down the wicket. Misses the slog, but manages to play it to backward square. The infielder can't collect
half-tracker on off, and pulled along the grass to deep midwicket
good length on off, and turning away from Dhawan. Drags his shot to deep midwicket for a jogging run
nice, juicy full toss outside off, but Williamson can't put it away. Miscues a drive to mid off
full on leg stump, and that's been clipped off his toes to cow corner. Gets KW on strike

over wide long on! Flighted on middle and leg, but Williamson comfortably gets his front leg out of the way and then thumps it towards the leg side. Too slow from Kuldeep, which gives the batsman that extra second
good length on middle, and it's the wrong'un this time. But Williamson drags it off the backfoot to deep midwicket with ease
length ball outside off, and then turning into KW. Cut off the back foot to the man in the deep
on middle, and angling into his pads. Williamson pushes it off his pads to the vacant square-leg region, and there's enough time to come back for the second
full on off, and straightens after pitching. Defended off the front foot
full on middle, but turns sharply into his pads. KW can't get bat to ball, and it hits his pads. Impact on leg stump, but would've gone down the leg side
full on off, and pushed off the front foot to mid off
full on middle, and he's down on one knee to sweep it behind square! Prasidh Krishna manning that region
length ball on off, and Williamson shuffles across to the off side and nudges it to the square-leg region. Played with gentle hands, and that actually allows them to take the second

Narine drops it! In the air for ages, but it was one that swerves a lot. Full on middle, and Dhawan's leg-side whip was skied towards the off side. Rana, however, has the presence of mind to aim at the stumps. It's broken the bails, but also allows Sunrisers to steal an extra run
visionary! Williamson exposes his leg stump even before the ball was bowled. And when it pitched on leg stump, KW just whips it off his pads, and sends it over the fielder at fine leg!
different angle, but the same result! Oh dear, KKR are losing the plot aren't they. Full outside leg, and Williamson gets down on one knee and paddles this over fine leg once more
length ball outside off, and this time it's been muscled to the man at cow corner. Took the pace off, Searles

back of a length outside off, and Williamson's forced to reach at it. Goes for the cut anyway, and he's perhaps timed it way too well! Straight to Russell at deep point, and the slower ball fetches Searles the big wicket!
starts off with a late cut. Length ball outside off, which he pokes to the fielder at short third man
flighted on middle stump, and comfortably driven past the non-striker to mid off
good length on off, but the wrong'un comes into Dhawan's pads. Tapped towards the leg side
full on leg, and Dhawan clips it off his pads to deep backward square
full on off, and turning away from him. Defended towards short cover
good length on middle, but sharp turn away from Dhawan. Flat-bats it to long off and completes his fifty!
full outside off, and wide enough for Pandey to free his arms. Drills this drive to sweeper cover
short and wide outside off. Starts off with the offcutter, and Pandey mistimes a cut to point
good length on off, and Pandey opens his bat's face, but finds the man at point once again
full just outside off, and that's been whipped! Great use of the wrists, and placed excellently to the cow-corner region
short on middle, and that's fiery! Pandey hops across to the leg side in a bid to get away from the ball's line
back of a length, slower ball. Pandey tries to cut it over point, but he's completely deceived! Goes through to DK

full on middle, and this time he drills a drive past extra cover. Oh dear, a basic fielding error by Chawla at wide long off. Makes a mess of a fielding opportunity in the deep, and gifts Sunrisers some extra runs

given! Slower ball, on off stump, and Dhawan misses the big slog towards the leg side. Deceived by the lack of pace, and the ball hits his front leg. Impact in front of middle, and Gabbar's gotta go. Time out as well
back of a length outside off, and that's been fended from near his face. Tapped to the cover region
width offered outside off, and that's been cut off the back foot. Beats point, but third man does well to clean up
length ball on middle, but angling down the leg side. Pandey flicks, and helps it on its way to fine leg
short! On off, but always going over the batsman's head. Extras
good length on middle, and once again worked off his hips to fine leg. Chawla the fielder there
slower ball to end the over. But wide outside off, which allows him to free his arms. Thumps a cut to the man in the deep
good length on off, and turning into his pads. Worked towards the deep square-leg fielder
full on off, and in Pathan's slot. Goes for a big one, but toe-ends it unfortunately. Mid on, Uthappa, settles under it, and holds on to this catch. Narine strikes!
good length outside off, and enough width for him to play the late cut. Played with soft hands, but well intercepted by short third man!
good length on middle, and turning towards the leg side. Clipped off his hips to short fine leg on this occasion
good length on off, and offspin from Narine. Whipped towards midwicket off the back foot
quicker ball on leg stump, but that's too wide. Extras
full outside off, and driven to cover point off the front foot. They'll take the run

almost a yorker on middle, that he tries to play the straight drive to. The shot ricochets onto his boot and then goes to the bowler's hands. Prasidh's asking for the catch! They're going upstairs, but the ball actually hit the ground before hitting Pandey's boots. False alarm
good length outside off, but angling into Pandey. He checks his punch, and glances it towards backward point on this occasion
attempted yorker on leg stump, and that's been inside-edged to the square-leg fielder
full on middle, and he gets his front foot out of the way to get his bat swinging. Muscles it over wide long on thereafter!
back of a length outside off. He backs away and punches it square to the man in the deep
a yorker on leg stump, and Brathwaite manages to get enough behind that to play it down the ground. Long off cleans up
back of a length on off, and that's way too quick for Carlos. Tried to pull, finds the top edge. DK races forward and completes a comfortable catch. Russell wins the battle of the West Indians
full outside leg, and he backs away before inside-edging an on drive to deep backward square
full on leg stump, and that's the short arm jab from Shakib. Excellent timing off the bat, but the fielder in the deep puts in the hard yards
slower ball, but a length ball. Shakib settles deep into his crease, and pulls it over the square-leg umpire!
good comeback! Short on off, and going over Shakib's shoulders. He tried to ramp it over DK, but can't get bat to ball
full and wide outside off. But a well-aimed yorker. Shakib tries to ramp it past short third man, but misses. DK collects and that's well done by Russell

full toss outside off, and that's been slogged towards the leg side. It's a flat shot, but Rinku Singh, the substitute, displays some excellent athleticism in the deep. Slides and takes a diving catch running forward. Prasidh applauds!
pinpoint yorker on leg stump. The batsman did well to get his toes out of the way
creamed! Full outside off, and allows Shakib to free his arms. Drills this drive to the extra-cover boundary. Oof, what sound off the bat
good length on off, and too close to his body for the pull. Comes off the bat's top half, and Narine's under it at short fine leg. Great death-overs bowling from the youngster

back of a length outside off, and he tries to send this over cover! The slog finds the bat's outside edge, and that's a skier! Rana's at fine leg, but DK has called for the catch. Takes it from almost near the boundary, and then falls over due to the momentum. Fourth wicket for Krishna!

back of a length on off, and he fails to connect with the short ball! The batsman's trying for a suicidal run, and DK throws down the stumps. The fourth wicket of the over! Sunrisers finish on 172 for 9
big inswinger to start. But it's a tad short of good length. Lynn keeps it out, taps it back to the bowler
short of a length on off stump, defended off the back foot
chopped away easily. Short of a length and some width outside off. Lynn stays shuffles back a little and bisects cover and point
nicely played but can't get it past mid-off. Outswinger, full and wide outside off. Leans in and drives firmly, right off the middle of the bat
how did you do that Narine? Ridiculous stuff! An inswinging yorker coming in at middle stump. He opens his stance, and digs it out to third man from less than a yard in front of the stumps
whack. Poor ball and he slaps it away. Short of a length with a lot of width. It's well in front of cover
wide bouncer first up. Narine goes after it but is too slow to get bat on it
inside edge this time. Length ball skidding in at leg stump. Steps out and swings at it, gets runs wide of short fine
over extra cover. Finally gets one off...well, somewhere close to the middle. Length ball outside off, swings clean under this and opens the face a touch to get it off the outside half of the bat
full outside off and bunted straight to mid-off
slower ball, short and skidding down leg side. He steps out and swings at it. Can't hit
now he misfires the yorker. Pushes it down leg side from around the wicket

clears the long-on boundary! Sandeep has gone for 20 in his first over. A slower ball. Narine looks like he knows it's coming. Steps out and meets it at the pitch in front of middle stump before launching it flat to long-on's right
kncukle ball that floats away at an off stump line. Lynn solidly behind the line to defend off the back foot
swatted away! Not connected too well, but this is Lynn, and this is the norm. Clears the ropes easily. Short ball into the body and he gets the slog out quickly
short of a length at middle stump, pushes it into the off side from the crease
thumped over mid-off. The line and length is predictable - short of a length and in at the body. Lynn backs away in anticipation. Gets a knuckle ball that sits up nicely
yorker on middle stump. Backs away again and is forced to jam this to mid-off
overpitched ball on the legs, but he can't get bat on this. Looks to flick and can only pick up a leg bye with the deflection
tossed up full outside off. Lynn through the cover drive early, gets an inside edge that tickles through square leg
poor ball. Dragged very short and Narine waits for it to come on before spanking it to the square leg boundary
clears long-on. Slogs this high. He's beaten in flight a tad but has enough reach to get it off the middle and just get it over Pandey
short of a length on off stump, punched firmly to long-off
tossed up on off stump, defended solidly on the front foot
yorker. Perfect. Lynn can't do more than get his front toe out of the way and dig this out
misses the length this time and is punished. With some force. Overpitched this time on off stump and Lynn drills this between bowler and mid-off
bouncer outside off, lets it go after making room. That got a little too steep after he'd set up for it
short of a length outside off, backs away and chops to sweeper cover
good length outside off. Leans in to try and jab off the front foot. Thick inside edge to midwicket
under edge through to the keeper on the bounce. Short ball outside off, gets too close as he tries to cut
in the air but down to third man. Anxious jab with hard hands at a length ball outside off and it's a thick outside edge
length ball on the pads. Looks to flick it fine, but can't get bat. According to everyone but the keeper, who collects and appeals excitedly. No review. Yeah, it's off the pad
short of a length just outside off, slices to third man who is very fine
low full toss outside off, mistimed flick straight to midwicket
low full toss at middle stump. Drives inside-out but can't beat mid-off to his left
graceful. Uthappa springs up quickly after his forward press and lifts this pull shot neatly over midwicket. Full control.
bouncer dug in too short for him to attempt a shot. Looked higher than head-height from the front view, but play on says the umpire
length ball, skidding through rapidly and spinning away outside off. An obligatory waft, beaten
length ball just outside off, pokes it through cover off the front foot
short of a length and spinning away outside off. Gets on the back foot and pushes to sweeper cover
googly at a length outside off. Shuffles, gets the front foot press in and flicks this into the midwicket region
length ball on middle stump, gets on the front foot and flicks to deep midwicket
length ball at off stump, defended off the back foot
mistimed slog over deep midwicket. Length ball slanted into him. Gets outside the line of leg stump and lifts it 87 metres. Yep. Off the inside half.
short ball outside off, backs away and is so eager to wallop this behind point, he ends up losing his shape at the last moment and missing it
yorker on leg stump, tapped into the mid-on region
full ball outside off, leans in and drives to long-on
short of a length and angled into the corridor. Backs away and under-edges a cut towards mid-off
length ball wide outside off, gets down and sweeps to long leg
plans the reverse sweep and gets outside the line of off stump to set up for it. But it's a googly and it takes the inside edge before dribbling past the keeper on the leg side

trapped on the pads but they won't review the not-out decision. It's a googly that he tries to whip behind square off the back foot. Hits him on the back foot at middle-and-leg....did they think it was going down?
length outside off, swept along the floor to long leg

dropped off his own bowling. Uthappa goes with the slog sweep and gets it off the toe-end. It hangs high in the mid-on area. He's running backwards and looks to be in a bad position as it comes down. Swerves away from him as he follows it and bounces back off the turf to hit him in the face. Not an easy chance, that one
drops it short on middle stump, pulled to deep square
length ball outside off, and allows Lynn to free his arms. Cuts it to point, and the fielder can't hold on to it. Allows them to complete the run
flatter, and full outside off. Pushed off the front foot to cover point by Uthappa
overpitched just outside off, and that's been muscled down the ground past Shakib's left. Long off's there though
length ball on off, and he backs away to carve it to sweeper cover. Uthappa wants the second, but Lynn does well to end him back. Would've been harakiri
full on off and drifting into Lynn's pads. Fended off the front foot
flat outside off, and angling into Lynn again. He backs away and cuts it between point and cover
yorker on off, and that's been dug away well. Managed to get his bat down and squeeze it towards the off side
back of a length outside off, but the ball stays low! Uthappa considered pulling that square, but checks his shot at the end. Lets it go to Goswami on the bounce
good length on off, and Uthappa shuffles across to the off side. Works it behind square this time, and calls early for the second run
full just outside off, and Uthappa check drives over Lynn's head. A chip actually, which saves him. Lands just short of long on
slower ball outside off, but Lynn's been waiting for that length ball. Lines it up, gets his front leg away, and then slogs it over the long-on boundary. Fifty! Ninety-six metres
length ball on off, and slapped off the back foot to cover
length ball on off stump, and Uthappa makes some room. Attempts to lift it over cover, but slices this over the infield instead
full on middle, but straightens after pitching. Lynn thumps it straight, between the umpire and the non-striker, to long on
full on off, and in Uthappa's arc. Big stride forward, and struck over the man at long on. Classic Robin!
deft! Best of both words from Uthappa. It was full outside off, but Uthappa uses the depth of the crease to bring out the late cut. Goes between point and short third man
length ball on off, and worked off his pads to the vacant midwicket region
full on off, and that's some sensible cricket on display. Defended off the front foot
the reverse sweep doesn't come off. Full outside off, and Uthappa goes unconventional
length ball outside off and turning into the batsman. Backs away and punches it down the ground at long on
full on off, and swept across the line to the man in the deep. A comfortable walking single
length ball outside off, and punched to the cover region
full, but wide outside off. Driven along the ground to Dhawan at deep extra cover
full outside off, and he's down on one knee to sweep it to the man at deep backward square

full on off, and in his arc! Lynn swings through, and hits it flat to wide long-on, but Pandey's in the deep! Takes the catch, but lobs it up as he's going over the line, then comes back, and finally completes the catch. Classic T20 catch
full on off, and angling into DK. Tapped to midwicket
length ball outside off, and DK tries to glance it fine past the keeper's right. But can't get bat to ball, and the delivery sneaks past the outside of his bat
good length on off, and shaping into the batsman. Fended with soft hands towards the cover region, and he's off for a quick single
yorker on off, and that's been fended down the ground to the man at long on
good length outside off, and angling into him. Carved off the back foot to cover point, but the non-striker sends the batsman back
low full toss on middle stump, and whipped off his pads to deep backward square

full on off, and defended back to the bowler. He wants the single, but turns back eventually. Bhuvi, though, picks up the ball and has a shy at the stumps. Breaks it, but the batsman had dragged his bat in
back of a length outside off, and he mistimes the pull to midwicket. Good stop by the infielder
length ball on middle, but angling down the leg side. Karthik swivels, and then drags it over the fine-leg boundary. Seventy-seven metres!
good length, but wide outside off. Plays it away from his body, but still manages to punch it beyond the fielder at cover. In the air for a while
almost a yorker outside off, but DK manages to drive it to cover. They're taking the quick run, and KW's throw gets the direct hit. But the batsman's in, and now they take another run
length ball on off, and he tries the reverse paddle. Plays it uncomfortably to short third man
full on off, and pushed to wide mid on off the front foot. Forces the bowler to chase behind it, which allows the KKR batsmen to complete the second run
full outside off, but it's the googly! Sharp turn into the batsman, and he tries to defend. Takes the bat's inside edge, and then onto his pads
full just outside off, and this time Uthappa manages to read the turn. Picks the legbreak, and then smashes it over Rashid's head
huuuuuuuuge! Full on off, and he brings his front leg to the pitch of the ball, before depositing it over wide long on. Rashid's in disbelief
leading edge! But falls in no man's land. Full on off, and he tries to flick it towards the leg side. Goes to cover point instead. Final time out of the night
full on leg stump, and the batsman some room on the leg side. Tries to play it towards midwicket, but misses. Hits his pads and goes towards short cover instead
heavy ball. Full outside off, and driven square to the man in the deep. Easy single

falls to the pull once again! Wide outside off, but short. And that sends Uthappa chasing after it. Top-edges it, and Goswami runs towards square-leg to complete the catch. Brathwaite does the 'Run D World' dance
full outside leg, but goes down as a wide. Karthik did try to flick it fine, but can't get bat to ball
pulled with disdain! Back of a length outside off, and DK picks the slower ball early. Thumps it to the cow-corner boundary thereafter. Flat, and one bounce four
full toss outside off, and muscled to the wide long-on boundary for a single
back of a length on off, and Russell goes for a wild swing of the bat. Misses completely
full, but wide outside off. Forced to reach at it, but still manages to drive it safely past the cover region. Man in the deep
short on middle, and Russell makes room to pull it away. Misses again!

back of a length on middle, and Russell ain't done trying to pull.Connects this time, and top edges it to fine leg. Good effort by Sandeep at fine leg, but the scoreboard won't show that. Diving effort, but dropped
full just outside off, and Russell winds up for a big slog. Tries to send it over long off, but toe ends it this time. In the air for ages, and mid off settles under it
slower ball, full outside off. Too wide, says the umpire
good length outside off, and punched off the front foot to sweeper cover. Easy pickings
yorker just outside off, and that's been played with the bat's open face. Glanced to deep point
yorker on leg stump, but ends up as a very low full toss. Clipped off his boots to deep backward square
full on off, and pushed off the front foot to the midwicket region. No one's there, so long on has to give it a big chase. Enough time to sneak in the second run
good length outside off, and angling slightly away after pitching. Tries to pull, but the ball goes under his bat. Through to Goswami
back of a length outside off, and this time he manages to drag the pull to deep midwicket
full on of, and Rana backs away to make some extra room. Drives through the cover region. Man in the deep though
yorker on off, and that's been squeezed away to point. DK wants the single, but no chance. KKR need five off the final over to secure playoff qualification
full and wide outside off, but Rana manages to find the boundary! Reaches at it, but manages to drill this cut past point. Deep point's dive is futile. Scores are tied
good length on off, and Rana succumbs! Tries to play the pull, but he's mistimed it to fine leg. Bhuvneshwar the man there. Drama?
slower ball, and outside off stump. Attempts the drive but deceived by the pace. Goes past his bat's outside edge
low full toss on middle, and that's been tapped to long on. KKR qualify into the IPL playoffs! Celebrations in the KKR dugout. Hugs in the camp.
130kph, beaten outside the off stump by a length ball angled across. No swing, it nipped away
135kph, good length, hint of shape but mostly holds it's line and he leaves
133kph, good length, shaping back nicely into off, he presents the full face and pushes this towards mid on
129kph, perfect length, shaping back a touch, he defends half forward into the on side
134kph/83mph, back of a length on off, he's jumping back and defending to mid off
134kph, back of a length, some bounce outside off, he's jumping back and across and defending to cover-point
pulled off the hip behind square! 137kph, into the hip, he got back and pulled with great control placing it behind square and it raced away!
139kph, good length top of off, he is back and defending with soft hands towards mid off and immediately calls for a quick single
139kph, shorter and swinging down leg and rightly called wide
133kph, shorter outside off, he's jumping back and across knocking this down
133kph, good length, angled across, he's happy to leave watchfully
135kph, over-pitched, Finch climbs into a powerful off drive, Shoaib Malik at mid off misfields, it bursts out of his hands and away for a couple
beaten, 135kph, good length, nipping across, he plays the line but doesn't follow as it zips past the edge
130kph, shorter on middle, he jumps back and turns this behind square for a single
beaten, 133kph, good length, touch of shape away outside off, Warner's feet were anchored and he poked at it but it didn't catch the edge
smashed over square leg into the stands! Crack! This was banged in at 143kph but it sat up, he was waiting and smashed a pull shot flat over midwicket and it went 10 rows back!
141kph, short outside off, Finch is up on the toes punching off the back foot very well wide of mid off for a couple
135kph, fuller into leg stump, he tucks this behind square off the front foot, they run well to pinch a couple
edged but it goes wide of second and runs to third man. 140kph, good length, nipping away, he hung the bat out but the thick edge flew safely through fifth slip region
thumped through midwicket! 141kph hit me short ball, Warner, says thankyou and I'll crack this through midwicket with ease!
half volley, outside off, Warner doesn't move his feet but he times a push very well through cover, it nearly runs all the way but the boundary is so small they only get two
137kph, good length, angled across and angling further, Finch leaves
137kph, good length, fourth stump line, angled across, decisive leave on the front foot
back of a length, outside off, he jumps back and across and defends
128kph, good length, nipping back, he's half forward gets a thick inside edge onto pad. He was late getting the bat down
135kph, good length angled well wide and Finch leaves
beaten fending away from the body at ball that nips away sharply well wide of off
134kph, back of a length, gathers pace off the surface and hits him on the thigh pad as he tries to work to leg
136kph, back of a length on middle and leg, he is again taken on the thigh guard trying to work to leg
139kph, fuller on middle, he's forward defending into the on side
135kph, back of a length, nipping away, he's squared up and beaten, beautifully bowled
134kph, short and lifting into the ribs, he's back and knocking this down well behind square
141kph, fuller, he drives well but Hassan's knocks it down in his follow through
133kph, wide of the crease, angled down the leg side and a wide
lovely glance off the pads! Too straight on leg stump, Warner held his balance and clipped it off the oads through square leg with superb timing
136kph, good length, angled into middle and off, he defends from the crease off the inside half of the bat and it runs behind square
128kph, shorter length, on off, he's jumping back and across and knocking into the on side
good length, 134kph, angled across, he sits back and late cuts with control to third man
134kph, good length, angled into off, he defends half forward, gets a thick inside edge, with the bat well infront of pads and it runs to fine leg
back of a length, top of off, he's jumping back and across and defends
140kph, full down the leg side, Sarfaraz is diving and not gloving it cleanly but no bye is available
square drive on the up! This is some shot! There was width but it wasn't a volley, he leaned into it and drove with the chest open, thumping it through point
lovely back foot punch! Just a bottom hand jab to a short of a length ball wide of off. Placement and timing were from the top shelf
good length, angled across, he leaves this alone
132kph, shorter into the ribs, he's back and knocking this down into the leg side for one
134kph, full on off, he pushes on the front foot wide of mid off for a single
134kph, back of a length, fourth stump, he's back and across and defending to cover
fuller, 141kph, on off, he pushes to cover, calls yes then no, Warner has to scamper back but he's home comfortably
beaten by a 143kph, good length delivery angled across and nipping further as Finch was stuck on the crease jabbing at it
half volley, driven firmly back at Hassan, he gets a touch with the right hand and saves a boundary as the timing is superb, it nearly runs all the way anyway
short into the ribs, he jumps back and jabs at it and it runs fine away for four leg byes off the body
131kph, good length on leg, he tucks this through square leg for a single
140kph, fuller length outside off, Finch steps forward and plays a quality cover drive straight to cover
136kph, back of a length, he's jumping back and across and knocking this down to midwicket
139kph back of a length, he's punching off the back foot to backward point but Babar makes a good save
leading edge pops up short of backward point. That climbed off a length, he fended at it but it fell safely
good length on off, he's back and defending
139kph, good length, this climbs off a length, Warner knocks it down awkwardly. That surprised him
135kph, short and wide, he's back and cracking a cut to deep cover-point
137kph, back of a length on middle, he's back and across, pushing this to mid on and pinching one
half volley on leg stump, a gift, Warner just ease this through midwicket, with control for a couple
good length, angled across, he is happy to leave on length and line
139kph, full and straight, he's sitting back and clips this neatly through midwicket for a couple
140kph, good length on leg, he's taken on the thigh guard, it's high and not hitting the stumps, it rolls behind square for a leg bye
142kph, over-pitched, Warner plays a lovely cover drive, just a push, Imam has to sprint from deep cover-point to dive and save four
good length, 140kph, top of off, Warner pushes from the crease to cover
good length, middle stump, 142kph, he's defending from the crease back to the bowler
134kph, back of a length on off, he's back and working this forward of square
138kph, good length outside off, he drives without timing to cover
137kph, good length outside off, he's forward opening the face and running this to the gap at gully

dropped by Asif at slip! Finch was back to a good length ball angled across, trying to thrash this through point with an angled back, thick edge flew head high to Asif Ali at first and it bursts through his hands for four!
short on the hip, he glances this fine past the keeper! Salt in the wounds. Too straight and Finch adds four more just tickling it fine
shorter on off, he's back and working this behind square
full on leg, he's hanging back and flicking this behind square
134kph, high bouncer, he tries to upper cut and over first slip but misses
back of a length, 139kph, wide of off, he's back and late cutting to wide third man
140kph, short on the hip and he pulls beautifully into the gap behind square! Control and placement the key here. He played that very well
138kph, back of a length, top of off, he's back and defending

huge appeal for LBW given not out. Pakistan review. He was hit deep in the crease just at the top of the pad. No bat. It pitched in line, hit in line, just clipping the stumps! Not out because it's umpire's call! Pakistan retain the review. That was closer than it looked live. It looked like it might have pitched outside leg

nearly a run out! Then an overthrow. It was full and wide, he steered it to Babar at backward point and took off, Warner sent him back, he had to dive back to beat the throw but no one was backing up in the ring so they get a run
full and speared down the leg side
137kph, full on middle, he jams the bat down in defence
good length, 141kph, angled across, he leaves this alone
very full, 143kph, on off, he's defending from the crease back to the bowler
good length, 142kph, on off, he's defending half forward
driven straight of mid on and Shoaib misses it! Nice stroke but Shoaib made a meal of it diving to his left and he went all over it
full and drifting down leg, in comes off pad and runs fine
edged and dropped by Sarfaraz! Shorter and he tries to cut, gets a thick edge and Sarfaraz can't claim it. Tough chance. It was a solid deflection
short, he's back and cracking this through point with power!
launched over wide long on and way back! Tossed up and this is juts a step hit, he lofts it through the line over wide long on into the crowd
full, and straight, punched straight back down the pitch, looping over the bowler's head and into the non-striker's stumps
pushed onto the back foot by a tight leg-stump line, but that's an over-step, and a free hit coming up ...
very full and straight, well bowled in the circumstances, clubbed hard into the covers but straight to the fielder
down on one knee for the sweep, no contact
sliding back into the crease, defended back to the bowler
half a yard too short, Warner rocks back to slap a drive past short cover, a slight misfield allowing the single
flipped off the toes to the leg side
round the wicket, hitting the deck hard outside off, and helped with the angle off the pads to the leg side
over the wicket, angled into the right-hander, very full length, nurdled to midwicket
extra heat in that delivery, Finch loses his bottom hand in a fence into the gap on the leg side
stretching forward, driven to mid-off
back of a length, pressed to cover
clears the front dog and goes 'woof!' into the stands! That's massive, high over long-on, just in the slot to be slogged!
spanked with insolence over cow corner! Hard, flat, pelted over the short boundary!
slower delivery, more flight outside off, dabbed behind point
good finish, head over the ball as Warner leans forward to defend
short, leg-sided, whisked behind square with a roll of the wrists
oh dear, anoither free hit coming up
on the back foot, nudged to the leg side
beats the inside edge with a pearler! Lovely seam position, explodes off the deck outside off, and curls past the off stump!
full length, full face, planted through long-off! Perfect full face of the bat, leaning his weight through the line. Lovely
this is terrific batting, a wider line but again a full length. Warner changes his alignment, leans into the covers this time. And pierces the field with aplomb!
round the wicket, speared down the leg side. It's not happening for Pakistan today
on the hips, a tuck to the leg side for the single
hops across the pitch, leaves the ball with a ludicrous flourish, bat pointing at the bowler in his followthrough, like a Courtney Walsh impersonator
on the back foot, nurdled to the leg side
inside-edged block to short midwicket. A sharp single
decent length to start his spell, drawing Smith forward on off stump
outside off, a cross-batted bosh to deep cover
flicked off the pads with more circumspection this time, and takes the single
another sizzling delivery outside Warner's off stump! That combination of angle into the left-hander, allied to nip off the seam in no predictable direction, is playing havoc with his alignment!
short and fierce! Warner limboes inside the line as Sarfaraz takes at head height!
fenced into the leg side, Warner prods forward uneasily with bat and pad together, but a loose return gifts an overthrow! Oh dear...
hops wider on the crease, spearing the ball in towards middle and off. Warner squares up in defence to repel all boarders
nudged into the covers, meeting the full length with firm wrists. This duel is compelling viewing
round the wicket, lobbed onto a good length, Warner leans forward with a full face of the bat
tossed up, met on the full, caressed through the covers! Easy peasy
round the wicket, a spinner's no-ball! Honestly, that's hopeless ... free hit ...
leans back, hauls a freebie pull high over long-on! It plops over the rope, into and out of the hands of a Pakistani spectator ... standards are low either side of the rope today ...
back of a length, flapped out to deep square leg
looped into the blockhole, Smith retreats to leg in an attempt to make some room through the covers
slowly progressing hand grenade, Warner stays deep in his crease to defend for his life
well bowled again, straightening a touch on off stump, and blocked
full length, driven back to the bowler, who snaffles in his followthrough
extra bounce outside off, Warner lines up a crash through the covers but is beaten
slow turn from back of a length, punched on the up to extra cover
short and wide, biffed to backward point, but without much timing or placement. Nevertheless, the 200 is up
one hand comes off the ball as Maxwell drives into the covers, and beats the short fielder for another single
too short, and clobbered into the gap at midwicket! That's just easy pickings, choose your spot and slot it!
gets a touch greedy on the lofted drive, and pulls his stroke to the long-on fielder, on the bounce
defended on a tight line
too short, too easy! Maxwell picks the lack of length from the hand, strolls deep, deep into his crease, and butchers a pull in front of square!

elegance! Onto the front foot this time, a beautifully presented, full face of the bat, like a drinks waiter bending his knee to deliver a mojito. Over the rope, and talking of drinks ... made mine a double!
edged off the toe to fine third man! Short and wide, he tries to cut, gets a thick edge off the bottom of the bat and it runs fine
134kph, back of a length, wide of off, he cuts to wide third man for a single
139kph full angling across, he's hanging back, feet anchored, he drops the bat on it dragging it to midwicket

Bowled him! 141kph, full and straight and through the gaping gate! That's why you need pace to Maxwell. His feet were anchored, he was hanging back but exposing middle and off, he played outside the line, it went straight through the wide gate between bat and pad and crashed into the stumps!
143kph, low full toss, he gets a thick outside edge to third man
low full toss, 142kph, he checks a drive firmly to cover on the bounce
tossed up on leg, he skips down and drives inside out to long off
floated up on off, he pushes gently on the front foot to cover
short and wide, he's back and cutting to deep cover-point
floated up on off, 81kph, he is forced to defend from the crease to cover

edged between keeper and first slip! A hundred for Warner! He's ecstatic! His first since the ban and his 15th in ODI cricket. It was a good length, he was caught on the crease, pushing, edging, slip was wide and went straight between them. Warner's smile was broad and his celebration showed how much it meant
back of a length on off, he's punching this behind point wide of third man and he pushes hard to get two
play and miss trying to cut one that jags back in from wide of off
good length, 143kph, on off, he defends behind point for a single
fuller on off, he drives firmly to mid off
full again, 140kph, on off, he drives but mistimes back to the bowler
dropped at third man! This was short outside off, he just upper cut it straight to Asif Ali at third man and he drops a sitter at waist high! My goodness ... what can you say?
short ball, lifting outside off, he's fending and missing as it climbs past the edge
half volley, he drives firmly on the front foot to mid off
back of a length on off, he's pushing it to point
full on middle, he turns this through forward square for a couple
140kph, lifting from a length, climbing over the outside edge as he tried to cut
short and fractionally wide, he late cuts to wide third man
back of a length, on off, he's caught on the crease and checks his shot and defends

caught at deep point! Imam holds on finally! This was fuller outside off, Warner tried to launch it down the ground, he sliced it high off a thick outside edge, it flew very high to deep point, Imam came in off the rope and takes the catch clutching it to his chest
145kph, back of a length outside off, he's back and opening the face to run it third man
141kph, good length, top of off, he's caught on the crease but defends
138kph, back of a length on off, he pulls with control to deep square for a single
141kph, good length, top of off, he defends on the front foot with soft hands
139kph, full on leg stump, he clips this firmly through forward square to the sweeper
137kph, back of a length outside off, he stays leg side, opens the face and runs it to third man
good length, top of off, he pushes on the front foot to cover-point
139kph, fuller, angled into middle and off, he mistimes a drive to wide mid off but goes with the stroke
angled into leg stump, 139kph, he clips this nicely through midwicket, the man at deep square has to run around to cut it off, they get two
driven powerfully through mid off but sloppy fielding from Shoaib! That should have been stopped. Instead it raced away for four
138kph, fuller on off, he drives, manipulating the face to get it through cover-point to the sweeper
135kph, full on middle, he drives to mid on who is on the circle
good length, angled into off, he slices this off a thick outside edge along the ground to gully
pulled powerfully over mid on! 140kph chest high short ball outside off, he swivelled on it and slapped a pull shot over mid on and it went over the rope on the second bounce
opens the face and glides it fine of third man! Brilliant batting from Khawaja! It was short outside off, and the control to get it fine was very skilful, using the pace
short again outside off, he's running this off the back foot to third man
attempted yorker gone wrong! Full toss driven through cover with ease! It was a gift and he just had to place it in the gap and he did
short outside off, it climbs and beats the edge as he flashed a cut shot
beaten outside off, he tries to run this to third man but is beaten by the angle
118kph, slower ball on the pads and he flicks this off the pads to deep square leg
138kph, full outside off, he square drives firmly to deep cover-point
132kph, pushed way wide of off, too wide for Khawaja to reach
fuller on off, he elegantly drives but straight to cover
135kph, back of a length, takes him on the backside, as he tries to pull, it runs fine for a leg bye

caught at mid off! It was a full length, it just stops in the surface a touch, he drives in the air straight to Wahab on the circle at mid off and he clutches onto it awkwardly! He held it and that's all that matters
131kph, yorker speared into off, he jams down and keeps it out
flash and miss trying to cut a ball too full but wide of off. It was 131kph and zipped through off th surface
130kph, outswinger, wide of off, he shapes to play but withdraws the bat late
good length, 131kph, top of off, he is back and punching this wide of mid on
swing and a miss trying to drive a 131kph fuller ball wide of off that swung back past the inside edge late
he drives firmly to cover, Hafeez shies at the non striker's needlessly and no one is backing up. They get two
140kph, angled in, good length, he's cramped and defending from the crease
141kph, full and angled into off, he's caught on the crease again defending
he drives to mid off and takes on the throw from Shoaib and beats it comfortably! Good running
driven between cover and mid off! he picked the 119kph slower ball, gave himself room and drove it into the gap with mid off up
120kph, slower ball, good length, it bites in the surface, he is forced to defend into the off side
shorter length into the hip, he pulls fine to fine leg

caught at long off by Shoaib! Amir again! Cross seam delivery, length on off, he tried to launch it over long on, he got under it as it stopped in the surface a touch, he skied it to long on, Shoaib is in from the rope and takes a comfortable catch
130kph, shorter outside off, he sits back and runs this to third man
full outside off, he drives powerfully to deep cover-point
good length, 117kph, slower ball, he defends off a thick outside edge to backward point and they get one
135kph, back of a length, angled into the hip, he's taken on the thigh guard
pulled over midwicket and into the gap! It was a short ball but not high enough, he pulled in the air, into the big gap at midwicket and it lands safely and reaches the rope
back of a length, 138kph, angled in, cramping him for room, he's taken on the thigh again
119kph, slower ball, he steps across and flicks this fine but Wahab makes a diving save on the rope and prevents two
144kph, back of a length outside off, he opens the face and runs it to third man
148kph, slung in full towards off, he swings hard and gets a thick inside edge that runs behind square

caught behind off the inside edge! Good catch by Sarfaraz low to his left. It was full outside off, Coulter-Nile had it feet anchored and played for more tail across, it held it's line, caught the inside edge, just missed off stump but Sarfaraz was sharp moving low to his left to claim it
141kph, good length, on off, he defends from the crease
145kph, short and angled across, climbing off a length, he misses trying to cut
138kph, cracking bouncer, Cummins nearly falls over backwards trying to duck underneath
full on leg stump, he clips this behind square to bring the 300 up
138kph, angled into middle, he pushes towards cover and they pinch one
141kph, full angled into off, he whips this from off stump to long on

caught behind! 134kph but this rears off a length and catches the gloves on the way through to the keeper! Good short ball, Cummins was surprised, tried to lean back and cut but the bounce and pace was too much, it comes off the gloves and an easy catch for the skipper
141kph, full on off, he is camped on the crease, gets a leading edge after closing the face and it runs to cover
137kph, short into the ribs, he's uncomfortable fending this away into the on side
136kph, cracking bouncer, he tries to pull but is beaten for pace and bounce
slower ball banged in, he pulls without control, it hangs in the air for a while but falls short of fine leg
slower ball angled into middle, he clips this behind square for a single

LBW! Superb yorker! Carey reviews. It was full and tailed into the front shoe, he got it out of the way but it hit the back pad infront of leg. No bat involved by the looks. Nothing on ultra edge. Ball tracking says ... OUT. Pitched in line, hitting in line, smashing leg stump! Good decision. Even better bowling.
129kph, good length angled across, he drives on the up through cover-point to the sweeper
full angled down leg, he flicks this fine of fine leg, Shaheen makes an excellent diving stop to save four

caught at long on! Five for Amir! He deserved that. he has single handedly dragged Pakistan back. This was full in the slot, but slightly off speed, he drives in the air flat down the ground but not long enough anf Shoaib takes the running catch
tight line and length, on the back foot, but an over-step! It's a free hit coming up! In fact, it shouldn't have been called, but too late now...
good wheels! Zipping through a wild pull, no contact whatsoever. Justice is done in the end
wicket-to-wicket line, blocked stoutly on an off-stump line, gathered at midwicket
back of a length, off-stump line, tough to take on that sort of ball so Fakhar shoulders arms and accepts it as a sighter
sizzler! Pitches on the left-hander's off stump, goes with the angle, climbs past the outside edge as Fakhar holds his line
this one goes like a 88mph offbreak! Pitches on off, turns a mile off the seam
over the wicket, outside off, hitting the seam and climbing through to the keeper as Imam drives uppishly with hard hands

back of a length, the first hint of width of the innings, so Fakhar climbs into the cut with hard hands, Richardson at third man is expertly positioned and gobbles the flying edge. That was a sucker punch, and Pakistan's hopes of a composed start are already looking wobbly
on the back foot, cautiously blocked into the off side
through to the keeper on a tight off-stump line. Babar leaves well alone
full length, blocked on the back foot in front of all three stumps. Solidity is the order of the day
stand and deliver! Babar waits for the over-pitch outside off. No footwork, but none needed! Just launching the hands through the arc and away to the point boundary!
head over the ball, solid block
back of a length, angled into the legs, nudged to midwicket
short, and clattered! Imam takes no prisoners with that pull! A decent bouncer, well directed, but he's right on top of the stroke, rifling it through square leg!
91mph, into the toes, but Imam is well placed to block it back down the pitch
tight line, back of a length, defended with a compact stance to mid-on
right up to the toes, hint of outswing, solidly into line to defend. Australia on top but signs of composure from Imam in that over
back of a length outside off, anchored in the crease in anticipation of the short ball, and dabs down to gully from under the nose
solid once more, drawn forward from the crease by a length ball on off stump. Blocked
half-forward and defended again. Babar is staying very neutral in his footwork, refusing to commit forward or back
on the back foot, blocked down into the crease
outside off, and this one takes off from the deck! Another beauty, but Imam to his credit refuses to be drawn into a nibble as he holds the line of off stump
short, slashed, clear of the slips! Short again from Starc, but on a wider line. Imam's reflexive pull takes a fat toe-end and soars over the cordon!
too full, too obvious! Imam knew it was coming, the attempted yorker, but with no swing, it was a simple flick through the leg-side from a well-set, well-balanced batsman!
outside off, back of a length, and a cautious, judicious leave. No need to chase those!
full once again, but sliding into the pads, and clipped sweetly through fine leg! All of a sudden, Pakistan are galloping along!
very full, tailing into the timbers, blocked on the back foot
the sequence continues! Full, straight, open-faced, and a poised pongo-ing through the covers! He might as well have used a snooker cue to pot that one through the gap
back of a length, tighter line, dabbed down into the crease
solid block, back to the bowler
finds the edge this time as Imam pushes with hard hands! But falls short of slip, surprisingly. That was a genuine nick
on the back foot, worked to the leg side
pinged off the pads, out through the leg side. Babar's bottom hand comes off the bat as he reaches round to time his clip, and it sizzles to the rope!
short, pulled, another boundary? Nope, gathered at deep midwicket, and it's a rare single!
outside the left-hander's off stump this time, tapped down into the covers
full face, and pushed on the up to mid-on
outside off, lifting off the deck a touch, and nudged down to third man
round the wicket, angled into the left-hander, Imam hops back and across to defend
back of a length, climbing past the shoulder of the bat as Imam curtain-rails inside the line
chopped down from back of a length, and inches past the off stump! Lucky lucky...
back of a length, outside off
that is a thing of beauty! Babar's timing has been like a jazz drummer today! A stunning on-drive, feet slightly splayed to allow a measured push through the line to whistle to the rope. Gorgeous
through to the keeper outside off stump

short, and slapped straight to Richardson on the fence! That's a body blow! Babar's drives alone were going to win this game at a canter. But he's lured into a response to the bouncer, and doesn't come close to getting his wrists over the ball. Dragged down from way over his head like an amateur fly-fisherman, and backward square is in business again
outside off, hits the seam and jags. Rides the bounce into the gully
round the wicket, outside off, an open-faced poke to backward point
reaching for the ball outside off, and poked to point
a wristy drive to the cover sweeper, can't quite get to the pitch as Maxwell targets a wide line
banged in short, helped off the legs to backward square
very full, attacking the toes, nudged to the leg side
pushed back into the crease, and defended on off stump
width outside off, flashed firmly through the gully
outside off, keeps a touch low as it scuds through to the keeper
leaning forward, solid defence on off stump
gallops out of the crease, and cracks a furious lofted drive through the covers! Who cares where it goes, so long as it goes!
on the legs, flicked to backward square
bunted into the leg side with a delicate deflected pull, kept lower than anticipated but watched it well
outside off, through to the keeper
round the wicket, looped onto a good length, stabbed to cover
a fraction shorter, a hurried cut, but can't place it past the fielder. A missed opportunity
angled bat, blocked to the off side
a flowing drive to long-off. Confident obduracy
worked to the leg side, another well-stolen single
tremendous clumping drive! The spirit of Babar lives on! A fractional over-pitch, and the Professor lets his weight-transfer do the rest
back of a length, tighter line, hops into line to defend to the leg side
open faced drive out to point, tight lines from Richardson
lofted into the toes, Hafeez drops to one knee on the sweep ... doesn't nail it, but places it square of the sweeper!
settles for the dab off the toes to the leg side
good footwork, advancing to meet the leg-stump line, and pushed with a full face to long-off
slower loopier delivery, into the toes, tucked to the leg side
130kph, back of a length, on off, he's back and working this through square leg
129kph, back of a length, he's up on his toes and square driving off the back foot through point
130kph, good length, fifth stump line, he is back and angling the bat, using the pace to run to third man
130kph, shorter length, on off, he's back and tucking this around the corner
short and wide and cracked past point! He waited on the width and thrashed it behind point. Cummins diving on the rope couldn't make the stop
130kph, angled well down the leg side and called wide
131kph, good length, he strides forward and punches a drive through cover
an edge flies through gully to third man. It was a good length, hint of shape away, he was caught on the crease and closing the face but the edge flies safe
146kph, full and straight, he hangs back in the crease and defends back to the bowler
139kph short ball, pulled in the air but safely forward of square for a single
143kph, full half volley, he drives very nicely straight to mid off
147kph, but slanting down the leg side and called wide
139kph, bouncer, well directed, he ducks under it early
full and straight, he drives to mid off with control
good length, top of off, he sits back and opens the face to run into the gully for a tight single. Maxwell fields and hits at the striker's but Imam is home
Imam charges and it's fired way down the leg side
short into the ribs and he is jumping back and tucking this square
130kph, back of a length on a fourth stump line, he's squared up a touch defending into the off side
131kph, fuller on off, he's back and defending from deep in the crease
131kph, back of a length on off, he's jumping back and defending
127kph, short and swinging too wide of off and rightly called
129kph, back of a length, hint of shape, he pushes off the back foot with an open face to wide third man
144kph, short ball directed at the body, he pulls awkwardly off the gloves towards fine leg along the ground
142kph, short of a length, off stump line, he's jumping back and defending onto the pitch
superb cut shot past backward point! Short and wide and he got on top of the bounce, thumping it through backward point to the rope
146kph, full, almost a yorker, he pushes on the front foot to mid on
141kph, good length, some width, he is back and running this to this man with control
high bouncer, Hafeez ducks, it was very high, Hafeez glared at the square leg umpire looking for a wide but there is no call
131kph, fuller, he drives slowly to mid off, Lyon, the sub, is on the circle and Imam beats him easily
short ball, he's back and pulling through forward square to the sweeper
134kph, good length, angled across, he's back and running this to third man
full, on off, he pushes with nice timing back past the bowler for a couple
134kph, back of a length, he's back and defending into the on side
133kph, good length, nipping across and it beats the bat as he tries to defend
137kph, shorter wide of off, he's up on his toes cutting through cover-point to the man in the deep
play and miss as he got too close to a ball to cut. It was 139kph and it zipped off the surface
136kph, good length, he defends from the crease into the off side
141kph, fuller, on off, he drives firmly but back at Cummins who makes the stop
139kph, bouncer, he tried to hook but it took off and flew over his head. There were jeers from the crowd who thought it was wide
good length, he opens the face and runs this with control to third man
play and miss again getting too close to cut a 134kph length ball
skips down the track and lofts this over mid off! He advanced to create a half volley, stayed leg side and lifted it over the top

caught down the leg side! It was short down the leg side, would have been a wide if he left it, he tried to pull, got it off the glove and it floated through to Carey who took the catch easily! What a time to fall!
good length, nipping back, he is on the crease and defending late, getting it off the inner half of the bat to fine leg
143kph, good length wide of off, he sits back and dabs this neatly to third man
139kph, short and wide of off, he mistimes a cut to cover-point
140kph, bouncer, well directed, the skipper ducks low and under it easily
sweep from off the stumps to wide fine leg! Clever shot. They have to attack him and this was a well executed sweep behind square
drag down short ball, he's back and slapping a pull shot to deep midwicket

he's hit a full toss straight down deep square leg's throat! Finch makes the breakthrough! Oh no! This was a filthy full toss, it should have been hit to London, he just tried to place it, and hit it straight down Starc's throat on the rope, he held his nerve and took it. Finch raised both arms aloft sheepishly.
nearly a run out! Shoaib nearly run out without facing a ball! Srafaraz pushed to mid off, Warner swooped, Shoaib was slow to go, the throw was just wide but Shoaib was out if he hit. Goodness
140kph, full on off, he digs this out into the on side

caught behind! Brilliant catch from Carey. Cracking delivery. It was quick, a good length, nipping back off the seam and cut Shoaib in half, it caught the inside edge, Carey flung himself to his left and took a one-hander!
