beaten prodding at a cracking delivery outside off stump!
136kph, back of a length outside off, he defends off the back foot pushing it to point
fuller on off, 141kph, he pushes neatly with the full face through straight mid on for a couple
drifting way down the leg side, Carey misses it, and they get two wides
drifting into leg stump, he tucks this behind square but can't get one
he steps way outside leg, cuts a ball from outside leg to cover
shorter on middle, he's back and punching this down to long on
flatter on middle, he's forcing this off the back foot to long on
flatter on middle, he stands tall and punches to long on
he walks outside off, working this through square leg, they push for two but can't get it
132kph, back of a length, he's back and late cutting this to third man
130kph, short ball, he pulls with control well forward of square and they get a couple
attempted cut, comes off the bottom edge and runs behind to to the keeper

caught behind! 134kph brute of a ball that took off from back of a length! It was a cross seam delivery outside off, it really climbed as he tried to run to third man, it caught the shoulder of the bat and flew through to Carey who took the catch head high
this is pushed down the leg side and called wide
good length on middle, he's back and forcing this to the gap at cover
tossed up on middle, he works this off the front foot behind square
edge past the keeper and there's no slip in! It was short and he gave room to cut but got a genuine edge that went fine and Warner could not chase it down
flatter on off, he defends on the front foot
fuller on off, he drives back to the bowler
135kph, back of a length on off, he's back and working this around the corner for a single
136kph, but sprayed down the leg side
good length, top of off, he defends from the crease into the off side
swatted over square leg! Wow! 133kph bouncer that was quite high, he reached and swatted it flat over the fence! Like he swatting a fly on the roof!
full in the arc and he swings through the line launching it high over long on! That was in the slot and he was ready. He hits a long ball!
big swing and miss outside off as there is some extra bounce
short ball, he's back and pulling behind square to the sweeper
full, he drives firmly along the ground to long on
pinged through the covers! Orthodox drive, high front arm and it skitters away... Play straight, lad, you'll not go wrong
short and wide, pace off again but Hasan latches on to a brutal slap over cover! Flayed over the ring and away, four more!
pitched up, 134kph/83mph and clipped on the drive to extra cover
over the wicket, pitched full on off and tapped into the off side half forward
short ball, 145kph/90mph from Starc but Sarfaraz is comfortable pulling a single
shuffles into line on off and tapped to extra cover
ouch, that's gonna hurt in the morning... short and spitting venom as Wahab fends it away with a combination of arm, glove and body
tight on off stump, Sarfaraz presses out and blocks
dug in at the body, 142kph/88mph as Wahab backs off and fends to the leg side
back of a length and Wahab works this around the corner for one
length ball outside off, 135kph/84mph and driven past backward point, who gets a hand on it but can't prevent a run
touch short of a length, blocked square with a slightly open bat face
short of a length outside off, Sarfaraz runs it down to third man
banged in and Wahab hops back, prods it down to the leg side
full length and drilled into the covers
short of a length, 143kph/89mph and worked off the hip to fine leg
full outside off, nibbling in a fraction to clip the inside edge as Sarfaraz pushes forward
short of a length and nudged off the hip to fine leg
banged in, 135kph/84mph and Wahab fends it into the leg side for one
defended in front of the stumps
back of a length, 143kph/89mph and pushed down the track past the bowler, they hustle through for one
short but taking the pace off, Wahab has a massive yahoo across the line... and completely fails to connect
short and rising outside off, Sarfaraz dabs it behind backward pointq
slightly back of a length on the pads, slower ball and Wahab flips it uppishly into the leg side, they come scampering back for two
length ball on middle and off, Sarfaraz defends
woof, that's gone! Smoked into the crowd at deep backward square leg! Short ball and dealt with equally curtly (not Ambrose) by Wahab. Pakistan still in with a glimmer, here
back of a length, 137kph/85mph, Wahab jockeys across on off and defends
short, slower-ball bouncer down the leg side, Wahab flicks and misses - not called wide, though, much to the annoyance of the Pakistan contingent in the crowd
fullish, blocked square on the front foot
dragged past off stump, just a scrap of bottom edge for four! Beats Carey and zips to the rope, you should be so lucky, Wahab!
lobbed up and heaved over the leg side, looks to be bouncing away but Coulter-Nile pulls off a well-timed intervention on the rope! Just the single
pushed through and dabbed into the leg side
back of a length, Wahab waits and tucks it down behind square for one
angled in, 134kph/83mph and flicked behind square by Sarfaraz
full length, wide of the stumps and Wahab jabs down on it, squeezes one more to third man
over the wicket, speared full outside off, dab and a miss from the crease
slung down full on middle and leg, Wahab calmly works it through square off his pads
short of a length outside off, Sarfaraz ticks along with a glide to third man
round the wicket, short over the stumps at 148kph/92mph, Wahab gets into line
fired in full and whipped off the pads, one more to fine leg
slower ball, loops out as a full toss and Wahab dinks it behind square, Cummins is coming round at deep backward point, but he makes it back for two with a full-blooded dive!
pitched up and slashed off the outside edge to third man
short and wide, slapped through point off the back foot
early move across from Sarfaraz, miscues the pull to short midwicket... and Wahab then has to dive for his ground backing up!
short and room for a late slap to third man, just a single to finish the over
short ball neatly played, a back cut fine... but third man is well positioned to prevent more than a single
over the wicket, dug in short and sliding leg side as Amir jerks under it... called wide
short of a length, 139kph/87mph and Amir pushes off the back foot and narrowly fails to nick off in near-identical fashion to Wahab

145kph/90mph full toss, Amir drags on! In no position to drive, all the weight going back and a thick inside edge judders the base of middle stump! Starc bringing the Mortal Kombat styles here, 'Finish him!'
pitched up, swinging late as Afridi pokes and gets an edge into his pads
pitched up and squirted off the pads through backward square
round the wicket, pitched full and tapped away
good length and he draws him out, nips this past the outside edge
short of a length, climbs to hit the splice as Afridi angles his bat
run out backing up! Maxwell seals it for Straya! Leaps to take the ball one-handed at short extra cover, then fires a throw at one-and-a-bit stumps to leave Sarfaraz well short! No dramas, mate
Faheem finds a good length straight away, and the delivery is defended from the crease
nice lines from the bowler, and Hendricks stands at the crease to defend an off stump delivery back down the track
nice and full, angling in towards the stumps, and Hendricks presents the full face to defend
angled across Amla, but nice and full, and Amla props half forward to defend
whipped off the pads with grace and ease by Amla, you can't bowl there to him. Shinwari's line was just off, heading too leg side, and Amla made no mistake
skidding off a length, and with a better line from Shinwari. Amla hops to defend
Shinwari tests Hendricks on an off stump line. The batsman is neither forward nor back, and as the ball rolls to cover there's no time for a single to get him off the mark
Hendricks leans over and angles his bat at a pacy delivery on off stump, 141km/h, and collects a single down to third man
Hendricks takes his bottom hand off the bat as he stretches forward and swings through a drive at a full one, but it's mistimed to cover point
Faheem pulls his length back a touch, and Hendricks rolls his wrists over the ball but can't beat midwicket

this time he beats midwicket! Wonderfully placed by Hendricks. Again Faheem's length is just a little on the short side, and his line is straight, but his time Hendricks makes sure to flick the ball square to beat the fielder on his right
better length from Faheem, and a touch of wobble through the air too as Hendricks comes forward to defend
cleanly driven, on the up, through point. All class from Hendricks. He's forward to meet the ball, and angles his bat on contact to beat point with a checked drive
Faheem zones his line in tight on off stump, and this time Hendricks leans forward to defend back down the track
Amla thrusts his hands out at a wide-ish delivery outside off, and collects one to third man
Shinwari gifts a length delivery down the leg side, and Hendricks just needs to put bat on it. His flick has the beating of short fine leg, and that's another boundary
much better line from Shinwari, landing on middle and angling towards off stump. Hendricks defends under his eyes
skidding through at 139km/h on a full, off stump line, and Hendricks' defence is just a little rushed as he jabs the bat down
Shinwari digs one in short, but Hendricks rocks back and rolls his wrists over a pull to find the man out at deep square leg for one
Amla triggers across to off stump, but a full ball rushes through wider of the stumps and he raises his hands to let it through
Hendricks chops down at a full ball, just outside off, and it's placed well enough past point for the batsmen to rush back for a second
wicket to wicket from Faheem, and Hendricks is happy to defend into the off side
Hendricks is all light feet and high left elbow as he comes forward to drive, but again he finds the cover field
just short of a good length, and Hendricks sends the ball gliding off the face of the bat down to third man for one
Faheem slings one down nice and full, on an off stump line, and a becalmed Amla is forward to defend
a touch too straight, and Hendricks flicks over the ball to collect a single through midwicket
Shinwari finds the inside half of Amla's bat with a rising delivery on middle, but the ball rolls into space and they steal a single
Shinwari hits the deck at 138km/h, Hendricks coming half forward to defend
speared down full outside off, and Hendricks chops to cover
drifting in to beat the flick, and there's an appeal as ball strikes pad. But it's headed down the leg side
Imad's line moves a little wider, Hendricks presents the full face to tap the ball back to him
drifting down the leg side, and Hendricks clips with the drift to find a singe through square
tight lines, and Amla comes forward watchfully to defend
slung down the leg side, and Amla helps it on its way to collect a single to deep square
Hendricks steps forward into a checked drive that is well timed, but intercepted by a tumbling fielder at extra cover
dug in short and fast at 143km/h, but Hendricks is equal to it, rocking back to pull out to the fielder at deep square
fired in full and straight by Shinwari, from around the wicket, to hurry Amla's defence
Shinwari hones in on an off stump line, and Amla tries to manufacture some width but he can't beat point
well bowled! Again Shinwari tucks Amla up, offering no width at all from around the wicket. Amla aims a slightly flat-footed jab at the ball, which takes the inside edge and rolls to short fine leg
a freebie for Hendricks, and he doesn't miss out. Imad sends a full one down the leg side and Hendricks clips it easily past the fielder at short fine
drifting in once more on the breeze, but this time the line is better and Hendricks misses a flick
full and wide outside off, and Hendricks' drive goes straight to cover
once again Imad draws Hendricks forward into a drive, but once more the shot goes straight to the cover fielder
three in a row! Imad is settling into a groove after the loose start to the over, and a third drive pings cover
just a touch too straight, but Hendricks keeps finding the field, this time on the leg side
eased through wide mid on! Just a little full, just a little straight, but that's more than enough for Amla to send the ball racing through wide mid on for a well timed boundary
straight lines once again from Faheem, but Amla's flick finds the fielder at fine leg this time
floated full on off stump, and Hendricks continues to keep the fielders busy with a drive to cover
Hendricks uses his wrists to work the ball into the leg side, and Imad is caught napping at mid on. Sarfraz gives him a bit of an earful after Hendricks and Amla steal a single
deft touch! This is all placement and wristwork from Amla, who waits on a rising delivery outside off and then dabs his bat down at just the right moment to send the ball fine down to third man
Amla steps into a slashed drive, but the ball is half stopped by a tumbling point fielder and it's just the one

chipped in the air and high out to wide long on! There's a strong wind blowing across this ground, and Hendricks hit his shot with the wind and timed it perfectly. Didn't bother keeping it down, and the ball nearly carried for six
a touch shorter outside off stump, and Hendricks punches in front of square for one
Amla is forward to drive, but sends the ball straight back to the bowler
perfect placement on the cut! There are two men behind square waiting to stop the cut, but Amla threaded his shot right between them to collect four
pushed through flat and fast outside off, Amla misses his cut
starts with a loosener down the leg side, but it's not unduly punished and Hendricks can only get one with a whip to midwicket
Amla gets across to the off stump and works the ball right between midwicket and mid on for a rushed single
flicked with authority by Amla, the ball racing through square leg before being picked up by the sweeper
nudged off the toes by Hendricks, and the man in the deep on the leg side has more work to do
Hafeez lands one outside off, and Amla punches through cover for one
beaten outside off! This one actually gripped and turned, and Hendricks wasn't expecting it
great stop on the boundary from Hafeez! This looked like four after Hendricks stayed back to thrash through cover, but Hafeez sprinted around the boundary and even put in a dive to cut it off
Hendricks steps forward and flicks the ball off his pads for a single through square leg
full and straight from Hafeez, and Amla comes forward to drive to long on
a touch wider outside off this time, and Amla's drive can't beat mid off
landing on a middle and leg line, and Amla waits on it before whipping the ball down to fine leg
Hasan's line also starts very straight, and Hendricks leans into a very handsome on drive. Imam puts in a dive at mid on, half stopping the ball, and they're kept to two
seaming in off the track, and it possibly keeps just a little low as Hendricks can only get an inside edge on his glance
full length, and aimed right at the stumps. Hendricks doesn't move his feet much, defending from the crease
Hendricks punches a rising length delivery from the crease, and collects a single out to the cover sweeper
looped up outside off, and Hendricks immediately looks to get after the bowler with an aggressive sweep. But he keeps the shot down and collects one out into the deep
wonderfully bowled by Shadab, the ball dipping on a middle stump line and then ripping away from the bat. Amla defends
ah, and after that great delivery he offers up tempting width and Amla doesn't miss out, thrashing a square drive through point, all along the ground for four
Hendricks is forward to defend to point
the ball skids on off a lenght, beating Hendricks' pull on the under edge and striking him on the thigh
excellent end to a strong over from Hasan, and all Hendricks can do is defend back down the track

Shadab continues, and after Amla slips while playing a sweep and is struck on the pad, there's an appeal and a review. Not out is the call from the umpire. The ball landed very full, but outside leg stump it seems. Yep, not much going for that review, and perhaps it was one of desperation. Not out
nicely full and straight, and Hendricks stretches forward to defend
Hendricks whips his wrists over a full one, but the ball rolls straight back to Shadab

slog swept in the air, and Hasan makes no mistake at midwicket! Hendricks had looked to sweep Shadab as soon as he came on, but the shot has proved his undoing, the ball taking the top edge and presenting Hasan, at midwicket on the edge of the circle, with a fairly straightforward chance. He holds on, despite a bit of wobble in the breeze as the ball came down, and Pakistan have struck
short of a length outside off, backs away and cuts to sweeper cover
full toss on middle stump, driven to mid-on
short and wide outside off, chops to third man's right
short of a length and in at the corridor. Looks to punch through cover and is beaten on the inside edge
length at middle stump, defended into the leg side off the inside edge
length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
length and in at off stump. Defended solidly on the front foot
length and angled in at off stump. Looks to punch through the off side on the up, gets an inside edge onto thigh
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper
length ball sliding on at off stump, defended off the inside half on the front foot
beaten. Draws him forward with a loopy full ball outside off and spins it past as he leans in for the drive
length at middle stump, defended to short fine off the inside edge
short of a length at off stump, punched to long-off off the back foot
length outside off, looks to drive on the up, gets an inside edge through midwicket
short of a length just outside off, opens the face and runs it down to third man
length outside off, punched to mid-off on the up
length and in at middle stump. Tapped to mid-on and they catch him flat-footed as they steal the single
length at leg stump, flicked to deep square' s left
length at leg stump, flicked to midwicket
short of a length and wide outside off. Cut firmly to sweeper cover
length at off stump, stabs with hard hands on the front foot. Lobs it to the bowler's left
length and wide outside off. Driven firmly on the up to long-off
length outside off, driven on the up to extra cover
tossed up at off stump, to the pitch, driven with the turn to sweeper
short and wide outside off, rocks back and punches hard to sweeper's right. Shinwari hurries and lunges to his right to pull it back in

past slip! Superb bowling. Length ball dipping in at leg stump, drawing him towards it with the drift. Then spinning away as he looked to defend. Thick outside edge whizzes past slip's outstretched left hand
full on middle stump, driven with the angle to long-on
length at middle stump, driven on the rise to long-on
length at off stump, defended to short third with soft hands
length ball wide outside off, driven to sweeper on the up
short of a length and turning away. Steps out and under-edges into the pitch
oh shot. Waits for one, after being eager all innings long. And it works. Short of a length and just outside off. He's on top of it and he chops it past point
length at off stump, driven on the bounce to extra cover
short of a length and wide outside off, stays leg side of it and slices with quick hands to bisect point and short third. That is fifty for Amla
length at leg stump, nudged into the leg side off the back foot
length and angled in at leg stump, poked into the leg side off the front foot
length ball wide outside off, left alone
full and down leg side, can't get bat on the attempted sweep
length outside off, driven on the up to cover
short of a length outside off, chopped to sweeper's left
full on leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket
floated up at off stump, driven to long-off with the turn
length outside off, tapped to point off the back foot
length and in at leg stump, tapped to midwicket off the bck foot
length and pushed through at middle stump, stabs from the crease and gets an inside edge onto pad
length outside off, reaches out and drives to extra cover
full outside off, driven to long-off
floaty length ball at leg stump, whipped through square leg off the back foot
floated up at length on off stump, pushed to extra with the turn
tossed up at middle stump, steps out and drives to midwicket off the thick inside edge
short of a length and in at leg stump. Flicked to deep square
short of a length and in at leg stump. Dabs to fine leg with the angle
short of a length on leg stump, dropped behind square on the leg side with soft hands
shot. He's very powerful, this guy. Length ball wide outside off. Stretches his arms and slaps it on the rise to send it flying past short extra
length at leg stump, dropped into the leg side with soft hands
length outside off, gets forward, opens the face and runs it down to third man
tossed up slow at off stump, driven to extra cover
length at off stump, driven to long-off
full at leg stump, jammed back down the pitch
short of a length outside off, late chop, straight to point
full and floated down leg. Leans in and flicks to short fine's right
length outside off, sliced to sweeper cover. That's fifty for the stand
short of a length outside off, opens the face and punches firmly on the rise. But Shadab leaps to his right and stops
length ball slanted down leg. Looks to flick and gets a pad on it. Sarfraz lunges low to his left to save runs
short of a length on off stump, gets on his toes and clips to deep square
length outside off, blocked off the front foot
length and in at off stump. Walks down the track and pokes back to the bowler
short of a length on off stump. Drops it in front of point with soft hands

given caught behind but Rassie reviews. Looking to reverse sweep a full ball outside off that's turning away. He was pretty low so I imagine there'll be contact of the bat with the ground. This could be a tricky one...yes there is contact with the ground, but long after the ball has passed the bat. We'll be saved some confusion then. The ball is close to the forearm as it rises into Sarfraz's gloves...and the forerarm is where there is a minute disturbance. Nothing when ball passes bat or glove. He will survive this. Mandatory check for lbw of course. No chance of that. Decision overturned.
floated up full outside off. Reaches out to drive through the covers, gets it to long-on off the inside half
length ball skidding through outside off. Opens the face and runs it to short third off the front foot
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper's left
length outside off, blocked to extra cover's left
short of a length outside off, skidding on. Looks to close the face and punch to long-on. It goes straight back to the bowler
length and in at leg stump, flicked with the angle to fine leg
inside edge to the fine boundary! Stays around the wicket and angles it into the corridor at a length.He looks to drive on the up and away from the body. Loose. But rewarding
short of a length at off stump, defended to point off the back foot
full and in at off stump, punched firmly past the bowler, with the full face offered
length at off stump, blocked on the front foot

survives being bowled and then a run-out! Length ball wide outside off. Chucks the bat at it, away from the body again. Gets an inside edge to fine leg's right. Amla doesn't want the second and he says no. Rassie isn't looking is down three-fourths the way. Runs back as Sarfraz picks up the throw and lobs it to the other end...where no one is at the stumps. Poor from...well, everyone involved.
short of a length outside off, chopped to point with an open face
full on off stump, driven back to the bowler with the turn
short of a length outside off, stabs to point off the back foot
full at off stump, driven with the turn to long-off
length at middle stump, driven with the turn to long-off
dipping length ball at off stump, driven to long-off with the turn
length outside off, driven on the up to sweeper cover
short of a length at off stump, walks down the pitch and flicks to deep square
short of a length and in at off stump. Opens the face and runs it to third man
length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
short of a length outside off, pushed to extra cover on the up
length and in at leg stump, flicked to fine leg's left
length on off stump, defended off the back foot with soft hands
length and in at leg stump. Looks to shovel it behind square, cops it on the pad. Deflected to third man
full at middle stump, jammed to midwicket off the inside half
length outside off, tapped to point on the rise
short of a length just outside off, sliced on the up to point
length and in at leg stump. Looks to flick, cops it on the pad
length and wide outside off. Throws his hands at it to try and go through extra cover, gets an inside edge to fine leg
length outside off, tapped to point
short of a length just outside off, punched to extra cover on the up
length and slanted in at off stump. Looks to jab at it through cover, gets an inside edge onto pad
length outside off, punched on the rise to sweeper cover
length and rising up at off stump. Gets forward to try and poke through cover. Inside onto body and a single pitch side on the leg side
aimed full and straight, and Hasan continues to target the stumps. Tapped back to the bowler, who tumbles in his follow through to field

in the air, but short of the diving fielder at midwicket! It was a slower ball and he was much to early in the stroke ... but then the ball hit the breeze, and Hafeez couldn't get in quickly enough from midwicket to take the catch
back of a length, just outside off, and Amla is content to just ride the bounce and collect a single to third man
full outside off, van der Dussen throws himself into a drive but rather over-hits the ball, which dribbles tamely to cover
Amla hops at a back of a length delivery on middle, glancing off the hip behind square

fifty for van der Dussen! And he gets there with a beautiful full swing of the bat, golf style, sending the ball arcing over long on. A fifty on his T20I debut, and now one on his ODI debut, and a timely one too
short from Faheem, and it's a slower ball too at 114km/h, but van der Dussen reads it and swivels a pull into the deep
aimed at Amla's pads, and he whips in front of them to collect another single into the leg side
effort ball from Faheem, and van der Dussen muscles it into the leg side

Amla works his wrists over a length delivery, and the call for a second comes early. Amla has to hustle to make his ground, and even puts in a dive, but he's safely home before the throw comes in to Sarfraz. Not the best throw, it must be said
short outside off, but Amla can't make the width count, playing his cut a little early
this time Amla places his cut through the infield, and it's cleaned up by the sweeper
Hasan sends one down the leg side, and Amla puts bat to ball to collect one more

short from Faheem, but van der Dussen responds well with a cracking pull. Some hard running from the boundary rider lets him cut it off, keeping them to two. And that's the hundred stand between these two
Amla continues to do an excellent job of rotating the strike, working another single behind square on the leg side
Rassie lets his bottom hand do the work, fetching this ball into the leg side. An early call puts the boundary fielder under pressure, and they're back for a second as the throw goes wide
beaten outside off! Somewhat against the run of play, this. It was a slower ball from Hasan, and just died off the track outside off, beating van der Dussen's outside edge
beaten outside off, van der Dussen flashing at one that gripped and bounced past the outside edge
turn and bounce outside off, but Amla rides it well to place a single through the covers
flighted up outside off, van der Dussen waits on it and then times a drive out to the cover sweeper
very full outside off, and Amla slaps the ball to long off for one
crunched into the leg side by Amla, looking to be proactive
Rassie swings mightily, but much too early at Faheem's slower ball, and a slug is mistimed into the leg side
pushed through a little quicker outside off, and Amla is rooted to the crease as he thrusts his hands out at the ball and is beaten on the outside edge
this one slips out as a low full toss, van der Dussen heaving the ball out to long leg and hurrying back for the second
full, and it's firmly slapped back past the bowler. Long off sprints around to clean up
Rassie slaps a cut, but straight to the point fielder
he comes well forward to the ball, pushing a one-handed drive to cover
van der Dussen is forward again, and this time he threads his drive to long off
finally Amla breaks the boundary drought! He hadn't hit one since the 24th over, but now Amla stays deep and places his cut right between the two fielders to collect four
much fuller and it's driven this time, the extra cover fielder getting a hand to it to take the sting out of the shot
Amla gets across to the off side and glances the ball to fine leg
flapped up and over long leg! This was all about the added pace on the ball. Van der Dussen got across to off and bent down very low, aiming his slog sweep out into the leg side
and four more! Shinwari pulled his length back, but Rassie read it very early and muscled a front foot pull right into the gap between midwicket and long on
that's better from Shinwari, coming around the wicket and aiming a yorker at Rassie's toes. It's dug out into the leg side, and they hustle a single
Amla checks his on drive, getting the ball to long on for one
he's forward to drive, swiping hard at the ball to get it to long off
tossed up outside off, and the most Rassie can get is a single to long off
some turn and bounce, but it's a little too short so Amla can wait in the crease to work the ball into the leg side
looped up on middle, this might've been the wrong 'un, but Rassie reads it to push a single to cover
a bit of extra bounce from Shadab, and van der Dussen fends into the leg side

beauty! Shadab flights one on off stump, drawing Amla forward before the ball dips in front of him and rips past the outside edge. It takes a good ball to beat a batsman on 91*, and that was an excellent one. Sarfraz whips the bails off, but his back foot was grounded the entire time
well bowled by Hasan, firing in a quick yorker at 139km/h. Rassie digs it out down the ground
Amla presents the full face of the bat to drive to long off
in the arc! Hasan drags one down and Rassie lifts it with a front foot pull, with the wind and way over square leg. It was the attempted offcutter from Hasan, but it was much too short
that's a much better length, right up at his toes, and Rassie digs it out into the leg side to raise the 150 stand between these two
nice little yorker from Faheem to start, and it's dug out to long on
Amla flicks across his front pad to collect another single to midwicket
full toss from Faheem, van der Dussen slugging it into the leg side
well bowled, quite wide outside off, but well inside the line and very full, the ball zipping under Amla's flashing drive
back of a length, just outside off, and Amla collects one more down to third man
full and straight, Rassie can't get under it and so collects a single down to long on

a high full toss is slapped down to deep mid off! Van der Dussen falls seven short of a debut hundred. He went for the big shot, and it was on given the delivery, but didn't quite get enough on it, the ball going straight to Shoaib Malik in that position. The crowd cheers van der Dussen from the field despite him missing out on the milestone. He's looked the part!
full, outside off, and Miller is off the mark with a nudge through cover
looped up on middle, Miller works the ball to wide long on and they sprint back for the second

mix-up in the running! This could easily have been disastrous. Miller slapped a drive to cover and both batsmen were ball watching, a bit of yes-no as they meet mid-pitch, but in the end Miller makes it to the non-striker's end
worked with the spin into the leg side
Amla comes down the track to flay a wristy drive down the ground, but just the one
Miller waits on a short-ish ball, but his cut is stopped at backward point, just the single

what a way to bring up the hundred! Amla bends slow, slog sweeping and getting an excellent connection right out of the middle. Amla raises his 27th ODI ton with his first six of the innings. Not the most free flowing knock he's ever played, but then again this pitch hasn't encouraged too much strokeplay. Top effort
full, on his legs and Miller shuffles across to punt the ball in the air and wide of long on
Hasan aims full, Miller flicks off his toes to collect one to square leg
full and straight, Amla carves a drive down the ground, but along the turf and long on cuts it off
Hasan aims full once again, and Miller comes forward, angling his drive to send the ball out to the cover sweeper
top delivery from Hasan, firing in a quick yorker at 138km/h and right up to the bat. Amla does well just to dig it out
very full once again, Amla chopping hard down at the ball to get a single to long on
what a start, pinpoint yorker from Faheem and the best Amla can do is dig it out back to the bowler
and again! Amla set himself for a paddle scoop over short fine, but the delivery was too full and too wide of him for Amla to put bat to ball
sliced by Amla, to the right of point, who cuts it off and they're kept to one. Top over from Faheem so far
wide yorker, outside off stump, and Miller flashes right over the top of. This is a magnificent death over
Miller puts bat to ball, clubbing a drive through cover as Faheem just misses his mark and offers a half volley outside off. The placement is good, and Miller closes the innings with a boundary
length ball fired across off stump, left alone
short of a length just outside off, defended to point off the back foot
length at off stump, defended into the covers
length outside off, left alone
length outside off, defended to point off the outside half
full and just outside off. Driven firmly to mid-off
length ball just outside off, leans in and punches to mid-off's right
full and just outside off, driven to point off the outside half
length at off stump, defended off the back foot
short of a length on middle stump, defended off the back foot
short and flying over the stumps, cramped as he looks to pull.
length at middle stump, defended to mid-on off the back foot
length ball just outside off, plants the front leg out and punches it firmly past the non-striker
shot! Deftly done by Fakhar. Short of a length on leg stump, climbs on top of it with his toes and nudges it through square leg with a closed face
length ball just outside off, angled bat as he punches this down the pitch
length on leg stump, looks to flick, cops it on the thigh
length outside off, punched to mid-off's right

pumped! Wow! Incredible hit. Short of a length ball rising across him and he just skips down the track, winds up and swivels towards midwicket as he slices with a flat-bat - straight over the non-striker! Some connection that

caught at point but the umpire says not out. This is a bouncer. He looks to hook and it seems like that's come off the helmet. Fakhar seems confident about it. And the umpire too. South Africa review...and they will lose their review. Good decision. That's straight off the left side of the helmet. He smiled after it, so there's no seeming damage done either.
length ball at middle stump, clears the front leg and has a slog at it. Dragged down to fine leg off the inside half
shot. Gorgeous from Imam. Full on middle stump, half a stride across and a gentle flick with soft hands. Races through midwicket
length at middle stump, blocked to mid-on off the front foot
in the gap. Short ball up at the chest. Watches closely, swivels, and places this hook between fine leg and deep square. Fully in control and all along the floor
length ball pushed across the corridor, left alone
length at leg stump, nudged through square leg off the inside half
length at middle and leg. Defended to midwicket's left off the inside half
short and wide outside off, cut firmly, straight to backward point

carved away. Short of a length outside off, stays leg side of it and slashes with quick hands. Gets it between gully and backward point
length at middle stump, defended into the leg side on the front foot
length at off stump, defended off the back foot
length outside off, defended to gully off the back foot
short ball across off stump, a subdued pull to mid-on's left

beaten. Short of a length and slanted across off stump. Hangs the bat out and is beaten
length outside off, mistimed drive on the up to mid-off
short of a length outside off, punched to extra cover on the up
short ball slanted down leg side. Swivels to try and hook. Gets a top edge. It sails over short fine and then the boundary
length at middle stump, defended into the leg side off the back foot
length outside off, punched wide of mid-off on the up
short of a length at leg stump, clipped to deep square off the back foot
short outside off stump, pulled to deep square
full and wide outside off. Looks to chop it behind point, beaten on the outside edge
length outside off, tapped to cover on the up
full and wide outside off, gets the front leg out of the way and drills it to mid-off
crisp on-drive, but he fields in the follow through. Overpitched ball just outside off and this was neatly punched
length at leg stump, flicked to deep square's right
short of a length across outside off, opens the face and runs it to third man

taken at fine leg! Another short ball, another wicket for Olivier. It's difficult to control the hook shot against Olivier. His short ones rise more steeply than others, similar to Jacques Kallis' surprise short ball. This one is climbing across off and gets too big for Fakhar. Fine leg hangs under it and it swerves to his right. But he watches closely and holds on low
short of a length outside off, punched to extra cover on the up

length at off stump, defended into the covers
short of a length outside off, backs away and stabs to backward point

gets one through. Length outisde off. Not the best connection on the drive on the rise, but this goes wide of short extra
short of a length and rising up above off stump. Rises up with it and jabs it through midwicket with a short-arm pull
length at leg stump, clipped to fine leg with the pace
bouncer flies down leg side. Dropped too short to make him play as well
length outside off, poked to mid-off on the up
oh lovely. Short ball outside off, hardly any movement of the feet but the head is so still. Pulls this wide of mid-on
length at leg stump, flicked to midwicket

length outside off, punches with an open face, finds backward point
length outside off, looks to flick through midwicket, can't get it off the pitch
short of a length outside off. Looks to pull, gets it off the toe to mid-off
length at leg stump, flicked to fine leg
length at off stump, closes the face on this and gets a leading edge to point
short of a length just outside off, looks to chop to third man and gets an inside edge to the keeper
length at off stump, stays tall and punches this firmly past the bowler on the rise. Class. All class.

length ball wide outside off, throws the bat at it, no feet. Thick outside edge. Ugly runs at third man
short of a length at off stump, flicks to midwicket's right and is sent back

length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the front foot

short of a length outside off, shovels this to deep square
looped up full on middle and leg, and it's tapped back to the bowler who tumbles to field in his follow through
legbreak from Immy, but no great turn and it's flicked to short fine leg by Babar
pitched up outside off, and Babar leans into a languid drive. Good shot for one
Phehlukwayo comes around the wicket, Imam opening the face on a delivery outside off to raise the fifty stand

wonderful placement, and a deft touch! Great awareness of the field placements too, Babar waiting in his crease and dabbing down at the ball at the very last moment to send a late cut past the man at short third for four
legbreak, looped up outside off, and Babar is forward again to drive to cover
in the air and past the bowler! Babar chipped his drive in the air and just past Tahir's outstretched left hand
floated up invitingly by Tahir, who is bowling noticeably slowly so far in this spell. Slower than his usual darts, at any rate, and Babar's drive is stopped at cover
turned off the toes into the leg side, but short fine leg cleans up
Imam keeps his left elbow high and checks a neat little drive to get the ball to long off
length outside off, driven along the floor to long-off and that is fifty for Imam
length at off stump, driven back at the bowler, who fumbles
length at middle stump, driven to long-on
slider bowled full outside off. Gets the front leg across and drives to long-on
googly, short and wide outside off. Cut to sweeper
full outside off, driven to sweeper cover
short of a length just outside off, defended to point's left off the back foot
length at middle stump, flicked to mid-on on the up
length at off stump, gets deep in the crease and tickles to deep square
yorker outside off, jammed to point
full and angled in at off stump. Looks to lean in and nudge into the leg side. It rolls back at the bowler off the outside edge
short ball outside off, absolutely carted off the back foot with a pull, but deep square puts in a slide to his right and saves
googly at leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket
length ball slanted in at middle stump, flicked to deep square
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper's left
short at the ribs, pulled to fine leg off the inside edge
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Backs away and nudges to third man
short outside off, hooks along the floor to deep square
short at the waist, gets deep in the crease and caresses it to deep square with a pull
length on off stump, blocked into the off side
short of a length outside off, punched to sweeper cover
tossed up at a length outside off, looks to drive through cover, gets an inside edge through midwicket
length outside off, sliced to sweeper cover
low full toss outside off, driven to long-off
floated up full on leg stump, flicked to long-on
full on leg stump, clipped to midwicket
short of a length just outside off, opens the face and runs it to third man
length at middle stump, poked to midwicket off the back foot
short of a length just outside off, looks to dab it fine. Can't get the thick edge past the keeper
short of a length at leg stump, shoveled to fine leg's right
full outside off, driven along the floor to long-off
length ball floated up at off stump, poked down the pitch off the front foot
length at off stump, thick inside edge to short fine as he looks to defend
length at off stump, drops it pitch side on the off side, can't steal the run
length at middle stump, steps out and flicks to long-on
short and wide outside off, backs away and cuts to sweeper cover

he's got him! Oh dear. Reeza can't believe it. Faf can't believe it. Mickey Arthur does not want to believe it. It's a short ball coming in at middle stump. He backs into the leg side and wants to punch through cover. But he's pushed at it too early and lost his calibration. Completely misses it. And the ball hits middle stump. Soft, soft dismissal.
length and just outside off. Punched firmly on the up to the bowler's right
short of a length outside off, steps out and stabs this to third man's left. Superbly placed
length ball across off stump. Looks to run to third man, beaten on the outside edge
full outside off, half a stride and punched straight to extra cover
length outside off, steers it to third man with an open face
length outside off, blocked on the front foot
short and just outside off, backs away and cuts late to find the point boundary
tossed up at off stump, blocked on the front foot
length at off stump, steps out and drives to long-off
stumping appeal! It's being looked at. This length ball skidded straight on as Hafeez looked to defend for the offbreak. Back foot out of the crease briefly...but back in. Not out.
length at off stump, flicked to long-on
tossed up at off stump, driven to long-off
short of a length at leg stump, flicked to fine leg's right off the back foot
length outside off, punched to sweeper's left on the up
short of a length just outside off, defended to extra cover off the back foot

drags it wide of mid-on. Off the toe-end, but he's safe. He's a stump-to-stump bowler, made an entire career like that. That also makes him somewhat predictable if you're willing to take him on. And Hafeez does that by stepping out. It's short of a length and he swipes across the line to get this to the boundary
length outside off, slices to point's left
length at leg stump, flicked uppishly, but safely to the right of midwicket
length outside off, sweeps along the floor to deep square
short and wide outside off, backs away and hammers a cut to sweeper's left
short of a length and turning into the pads. Dabbed to square leg off the back foot
floated up outside off, driven to sweeper
length ball at middle stump. Steps out and cops it on the pad. It deflects into the off side and Hafeez calls for the single
full ball, drifted away outside off. Crouches and looks to run this past third man with an open face. Beaten on the outside edge
short of a length outside off, opens the face and runs it down to third man
length and in at middle stump. Tapped to midwicket off the back foot
short of a length at off stump. Looks to jab through cover, gets an inside edge onto pad

length and in at middle stump. Punches towards mid-off and calls for a single. Imam not moving, because short extra cover is running at it. There was a run in the end, but Imam errs on the side of caution
shot! Oh so good. Length ball outside off, lovely lean into it, full transfer of the weight and a nice swing to tap this wide of mid-off
run-out chance. That looked close. Length ball at leg stump flicked straight to short fine. Hafeez was sent back again and was really lunging in the end as the throw missed
length outside off, square drive on the up, straight to point
overpitched outside off, driven firmly, but straight to mid-off
length at off stump, drops it to cover's right with soft hands
in the air but it is sublimely timed and well placed again! Full and just outside off. Gets in too early for the drive, but adjusts the wrists and checks his drive. Whistles to mid-off's left
length ball wide outside off, left alone
short ball at middle stump, pulled to deep square's right
length at off stump, blocked to extra cover on the front foot
length at off stump, dropped in front of point with soft hands

holy smokes! That has gone FAR. He can't go wrong when he steps out against the fast bowlers. Second time today, second six. Runs down at this length ball, picks it up from an off stump line and crunches it on the up, right off the middle of the bat. Far over the wide long-on boundary. What a hit.
length at leg stump, flicked to deep square
slower ball at a length outside off. Defended into the off side
length at off stump, blocked on the front foot

is this a dropped chance? Yes! Imam is too early into his drive, chipping it back to Tahir's left. The bowler went at it one handed, and ended up palming away. That could be a costly miss, albeit off a very difficult chance
and Hafeez rubs it in with an edge/cut through the vacant slip area and down to third man. Where is the slip? Not in position, and Hafeez slashes it intentionally fine to the boundary

Olivier strikes! He was the difference between these two teams in the Test series, could he be the difference between them in this opening ODI? Olivier speared the ball in full, even as Imam jumped out at him and looked to smoke the ball over cover. But he slices underneath the stroke, and Reeza Hendricks sprints in from the deep to hold the catch, which is a splendid effort, especially after he appeared to dislocate a finger earlier
a bit of a lazy waft outside off by Hafeez, with no great conviction, and he's beaten on the outside edge
Hafeez swivels on the back foot to pull and the connection of bat and ball resonates, but there's a man out in the deep to keep them to one
wonderfully played by the experienced Shoaib, riding the bounce well as Olivier digs in a bouncer and glancing off his armpit and down to fine leg. Sang froid
Shoaib attempts to repeat the stroke, but this time it gets a little big on him and he pops the ball close in on the leg side
this one slips out as a full toss, but Shoaib can only manufacture a single to long off
looped up outside off, Hafeez stretches out to drive through cover
pushed through a little flatter by Tahir, 92km/h, and it's defended back to him
Tahir holds this one back at 82km/h, but Hafeez reads the flight very well and checks a drive out to deep cover
Shoaib presents the maker's name in a neat little drive of his own, and a single to long off is the result
Olivier aims full and Shoaib drives, but he can't get it past mid off
back of a length from Olivier, but the ball doesn't get up off the surface and Shoaib is in no danger as he hops to glance the ball out square
Hafeez brings up the 200 in emphatic style! He gave this everything, swiping at the full ball and hitting it with the end way, way over long on and onto the roof of the stand there
perhaps a touch predictable from Olivier, who immediately reverts to the bouncer, and it's misdirected short and well wide of off
short again, but Hafeez was waiting for it and nails his pull out to the man at deep square
metronomic start from Pretorius, aiming for the top of middle stump. Hafeez has a look and taps the ball back at him

Hafeez sets himself for the paddle scoop, but Pretorius spots him and fires the ball down wide of off. Not to be outdone, Hafeez makes a last moment adjustment and squirts the ball down to third man instead
nice and full from Pretorius, Shoaib tapping to cover
Pretorius is hunting a yorker, and this isn't quite on the mark but it's full enough to get Shoaib digging the ball out into the leg side
shorter this time, but it's outside off and Shoaib stands tall to guide the ball to third man for one

wrong 'un from Tahir, but Hafeez has seen it all before, jumping out like Trumper to meet the ball on the full and hammer it way over wide long on. Rabada was waiting for the catch, instead he watched the ball sail over his head
there's a cry of 'catch it!' as Shoaib's drive flies in the air but wide of any fielder
landing on leg stump and spinning across Hafeez, who taps back down the wicket
and he starts with a cutter aimed at middle stump that spits a little off the track, Shoaib copping a blow to the thigh

bowled 'im! South Africa needed a wicket, and Phehlukwayo has struck. The delivery was on a length, just outside off, and Shoaib was just trying to guide it down to third man, as has been done umpteen times tonight. But the ball nipped in to him off the surface, cramping him for room, and ultimately sliding off the bat and straight onto the stumps
Phehlukwayo aims full and straight, and a becalmed Hafeez is happy to play the ball watchfully, tapping it back to the bowler
tight lines from Phehlukwayo, and Hafeez has no width to work with as he props forward to defend

Phehlukwayo loses his line just a little, and Hafeez seizes on the opportunity to glance the ball through midwicket. This fairly pinged off the middle of the bat, didn't over hit it, just timed to the rope
full and straight, and Sarfraz pushes it back to the bowler

Tahir's off, arms spread in celebration! The ball was pushed through flat and fast, but it gripped in the surface to beat the outside edge and hit Sarfraz on the back thigh. Up goes the finger, but not so fast! Sarfraz reviews it. Where did this pitch? On middle and leg. Where is it headed? For the stumps. Three reds after the review, and Sarfraz has to go. Two quick wickets!
Shadab stretches forward to sweep, but the ball bounces off his thigh and towards short third man as they pinch a single
another dot, Phehlukwayo aiming at a full length right at the stumps. Hafeez strides forward but he can only get it back to the bowler
Phehlukwayo pulls his length back a little, and it's not full enough to drive but not short enough to pull, Hafeez tapping it back to him
pushed through on a leg stump line, with little turn Hafeez just plays the ball on the angle to collect a single through square leg
pushed through at 94km/h, Hafeez coming forward to drive to long off
too short from Tahir, and Shadab hangs back to swipe the ball through cover. Hard running brings two
nudged to short third man, and the hustle another quick single
on a length, outside off, and Shadab opens the face to send the ball to third man
Rabada aims full and fast at 142km/h, Hafeez nurdling the ball into the leg side but not into a gap
just short of a good length once again, and Shadab hops in the crease before punching the ball through cover point, a hard sprint bringing two more
Rabada floats one fuller, and Shadab is forward to drive but aims his shot straight at the cover fielder, who keeps Hafeez alert with a shy at the non-striker's end
an attempted yorker that slips out as a low full toss, and Shadab digs it out to long on for one
full, just outside off, and Shadab turns the strike over to Hafeez by chopping the ball into the off side

bad ball, great shot! Hafeez eases the pressure by walking across to off stump to paddle a full toss outside leg stump down to the fine leg boundary. Olivier must have been aiming for the yorker, but that would have been a big wide had Hafeez not hit it

what a shot! This is ice cold from Hafeez. Olivier is trying to do too much, and another attempted yorker slips out as a full toss. Hafeez spots it early and chips the ball over mid off with a checked drive, wonderfully executed
nudged into the leg side, and there's room for a single that keeps Hafeez on strike
a rising delivery, outside off stump, is guided down to third man for one
dug in short by Rabada, Shadab arching his back as the ball gets big on him and aiming a dinky ramp over the keeper, only to hit fresh air
short again by Rabada, and this one is dug in with a little more vim at 142km/h, Shadab ducking well under it
slower ball from Rabada, just outside off, and Shadab waits and waits before dabbing a cut to third man. The ball goes to Tahir's left, and there's room for a second
pulled in the air ... but well short of any fielder, and it's cut off before the boundary as they sprint through for one
this will help! Shadab clears the front leg at a length delivery, flat-batting a brutal shot straight back over the bowler's head
Olivier pulls his length back, Shadab hops to find a single to gully
in the air ... and safe! Olivier bettered Hafeez with a bristling short ball, a top edge swirling high in the air but plummeting safely down even as Klaasen charged back to try and catch it
aerial once more off the bat of Hafeez, but this time it's a pull of rather more authority, the ball dropping well in front of the square leg fielder
what's happened here? It's another short one from Olivier, and the ball hits Hafeez on the shoulder on its way through to Klaasen. No major drama

they're level! Olivier's bouncer terrorized Pakistan through three Tests, but this track doesn't have the same sort of pace and bounce and Hafeez dismisses the short ball from his presence with a crisp pull. Mickey is smiling on the balcony. So is Sarfraz
and there it is, Shadab digs a yorker out down the ground and the job is done, Pakistan win by five wickets with five balls to spare
good length ball punched off the back foot to long on.
wide sprayed way down leg, lucky not to go for five as Alikhil slightly deflects it and stopped in the end by fine leg in the ring.

sloppy from Rahmat Shah. Short and wide on sixth stump, poor ball but should've been stopped for a dot. Instead Rahmat with a matador effort at point pulling his red cape back while bending right and it slips through to the rope.
googly lands short and spins away from Liton, tapped to point.
good length ball on the stumps, clipped through square leg.
fullish length on off stump, defended on the front foot and the ball square to forward short leg.
good length ball spins sharply into Tamim with some extra bounce. Defended with one hand coming off the bat.
good length ball on fifth stump, left alone as Liton shoulders arms.
good length ball on middle stump, defended to midwicket.

like butter! Short of a length ball on fourth stump, leans back to push this behind point. The ball melts off the bat as Rashid chases in vain. Mujeeb with a slide into the boundary rope for dramatic purposes.
full on leg stump, chipped uppishly but just short of mid-on.
good length ball on fifth stump, Liton chases it with no footwork, ball keeps a touch low to 'oohs' from the crowd.
short of a length on off stump, guided with soft hands off the back foot to third man.
full on off, defended on the front foot.
full on off again, stock off-spinner, defended.
good length ball with a touch more flight at 84 kph/52 mph punched to long-on.
full on off, defended back down the pitch.
short of a length on off stump, Tamim goes back to defend as it spin in, inside edge goes through square leg for a run.
short on fifth stump and spinning in, Liton goes back and clips it with ease through to long-on.
overpitched on off stump, whipped through midwicket, but sluggish outfield slows up the ball 10 yards short of the rope.
good length ball on off stump, defended on the back foot back to Dawlat.
fullish lengh swinging in from off stump line to middle, tentative push forward and the ball flies toward mid-on off one bounce.

short of a length on off stump, prodded toward cover. Tamim thought about a run before shuffling back to his crease and now starts gesturing to Liton at the non-striker's end so they're on the same page.

nearly! Tamim has had trouble keeping the ball on the ground early in his innings. Another drive uppishly toward mid-off but Asghar Afghan is lead-footed and more or less falls over trying to flail his arms at it. Never came close to getting a hand to it whereas a more agile fielder might have created a chance.
beaten! Dawlat pitches this full on fourth stump, it swings away to beat Tamim's attempted drive.
good length ball, spinning away carom ball, defended.

full on off, drives in the air to short cover and Afghanistan are claiming a catch! Watching live I thought it definitely short hopped and Liton is standing his ground. Hashmatullah Shahidi is the fielder. It's 50/50. He lunged forward and the ball lodged in his right hand with his left hand coming off. His head was up high, didn't look at the ball going in to protect his face so he may genuinely not have known if it carried or not. And the third umpire has decided it is OUT! Third umpire is Aleem Dar. The soft signal on field was out and he said he didn't see anything conclusive to overturn on the mic'd up conversation. Those kinds of catches are regularly overturned. It'll generate plenty of debate for sure. It looked awkward at any rate as both hands were not under the ball, just the right one.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on.
goes back to a short ball and flicks to midwicket.
full on off, defended to midwicket.
short on the stumps, clipped to deep midwicket.
short on the stumps, clipped to deep square leg.
short on off, pushed to wide long-off.
good length ball, defended to square leg.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended to point.
good length ball on leg stump, clipped behind square leg.
full on off, driven square to backward point.
full on leg stump, flicked to deep square leg, thought about a second but Rahmat denies it running in from the deep.
good length ball on off, goes back to clip to midwicket.
short on off, tapped between cover and point, they set off for a dicey run taking on Shinwari, another weak fielder who throws off balance and drags Alikhil well wide of the stumps.
full on the stumps, tapped gently into midwicket.
full on fourth stump, clipped to midwicket.
short on off, spinning in, fought off to cover.
flighted on a good length on off, goes back to clip behind square.
good length ball angled in, defended to cover off the back foot.
fullish length on off stump sliding into middle, punched off the back foot to cover.
flighted more at 49 mph/78 kph on the stumps, driven to long-off.
good length ball clipped through the leg side.
good length sliding down leg, Shakib goes back to whip off his pads but is late, it deflects off the straps to short fine leg.
good length ball punched to midwicket.
quicker ball darted in flat on leg stump, clipped straight to square leg.
fullish length on fourth stump, defended on the front foot.
slightly short on the stumps, pulled to Shahidi into the ground at midwicket.
full and angled down leg, Alikhil prevents five wides.
good length ball on middle, punched off the back foot to midwicket.
full on middle, driven to wide long-off.
full on off, reaches forward and pushes this to midwicket.
good length, goes back to push this just wide of Shinwari diving at midwicket, cut off at mid-on.
purring shot. Meow! Short of a length on off, Shakib rocks back to give this ball a scratch behind the ears through backward point. Roars from the Bangladesh fans.
good length ball on middle, pushed to long-off.

full on off, nudged forward to Nabi's right, dives to knock it down but not cleanly and they take off for a run. Shy at the stumps from extra cover charging in and misses with no backup, leads to an overthrow.
full and tapped softly to mid-off, Naib way back on the ring and can't charge in to deny it.
overpitched on middle, clipped past midwicket in the ring, long-on can't deny the second.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended on the back foot down the pitch.
knee high full toss on fourth stump, flicked to long-on.
good length ball on off stump, punched on the back foot to long-on.
good length ball on off, punched back to Mujeeb.
full pitching outside leg stump, flicked with ease behind square.

good length ball angled across Shakib, leading edge balloons awkwardly through point as he aimed for midwicket. No fielder there as the man was pushed back to sweep on the rope and it lands safely for a run.
short of a length pitching outside leg and angled to middle, flicked off the back foot through midwicket.
good length ball on the legs, nudged behind square and Shakib hustles straightaway for a pair with the second completed quite easily.
good length ball angled into the legs, clipped off the pads straight to deep backward square.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to backward point.
wicked shahp turn! So wicked in fact that it spins past the guidelines outside off, wide called.
flighted on middle and slides on, natural variable turn from Nabi. Defended to midwicket.
short and wide, spins away sharply again, Shakib wanted to slap through cover but too slow and taps it gently to point.
full on off and driven to long-off.
good length on the stumps, clipped off the back foot through midwicket.
good length ball on fourth stump, slapped behind point, Najibullah can't stop this with a sliding effort in the ring, well wide of him in fact.
full outside off, tapped to the off side.

shimmy down the pitch and wham! Tamim has had enough and finally unleashes a flat batted drive to a full ball outside off, bat turns in his hand somewhat as it's not hit cleanly but well enough to race through mid-on.
short of a length on off, guided with an open face to third man.
short on fourth stump, pulled behind square, cut off by deep backward square.
good length ball on fifth stump, guided again to third man.
full on the legs, whipped off the pads behind square.
short on the stumps, help yourself at 125 kph/78 mph. Tamim smokes this pull through midwicket.
good length ball on middle, straightens but Shakib is up to the task defending.
full and very wide, driven to extra cover, diving stop by Shinwari.
good length ball on off, goes back to tap this to square leg.
full on off, Tamim stretches forward to prod this back down the pitch.
slightly short and wide on sixth stump, guided behind point.
good length ball with plenty of pace off, Tamim holds the hands back to guide it to backward point again, not wide enough for a run.
short on the legs, tapped behind square off the back foot.
googly, full and defended.
short on off, defended on the back foot.
googly pitching outside leg, goes back to flick to midwicket but not wide enough for a run.
flighted full on the stumps, driven to long-on.
good length ball on fourth stump, punched off the back foot to long-off.
good length on fifth stump, punched to extra cover.
full on off, defended to midwicket.
too short on the legs, and cranked through midwicket. Sweeper with no chance.

castled! Nabi with the rope a dope the ball before floating up a sucker ball to get Tamim on the back foot, this time zips one in slightly quicker and flatter on a good to fullish length at 82 kph/51 mph, Tamim into the habit of consistently going onto the back foot when he should've come forward for this, this one skids on from fourth stump line to crash into off stump, beating the back foot slap. Bangladesh momentum arrested temporarily.

double-strike for Afghanistan! Rashid gets a good length ball pitching on middle stump to straighten and skid on but Shakib calls for the review! Looked stone dead live. Hit on the knee roll with Shakib striding a touch forward. And ball-tracking shows it's going over the stumps on height! Great review by Shakib. Is there any doubt that this is his tournament?
full and spinning down leg. Wide called.
good length ball on the legs, clipped through midwicket.
good length ball pushed to the off side.
full and wide, left alone.
full on off, defended on the front foot.
googly spinning in from off stump on a good length, punched through the off side to cover sweeper.
full and wide outside off, touch of swing as Mushfiqur chases at this, beaten badly. Almost called wide on the line.
short and wide, cut behind point to the sweeper.
fullish length on off, defended into the ground.
full on middle, driven to midwicket.
fullish length angled across fourth stump, defended to point.
bouncer angled down leg, called a wide more on line than height as the ball didn't really bounce much, just passed Shakib ducking.
good length ball angled across, guided into the ground just wide of slip, Nabi, intentional shot. Asghar Afghan on the rope stops it at third man from being four.
full outside off, leans in and drives with the turn to long-off
full on off, driven to long-on
short of a length and just outside off, stays inside the line and delicately pokes this past slip with an open face. That ball went straight on
length on off stump, pushed through cover off the front foot
short of a length outside off, chopped to backward point
full on leg stump, flicked to deep square
length and just outside off, stabs away from the body and gets this to mid-off who is under sufficient pressure to put in a stray throw. Overthrows
short of a length and slanted in at the hips. Uses the angle to glance to fine leg
short and just outside off, gets back and rolls his wrists over this pull shot to deep square's left
thick edge as this swings away late in the corridor. He looks to flick but his feet are rooted and he isn't close to it. Flies down to third man
short and wide outside off, left alone
slower ball at a length just outside off, looks to drive and gets an edge that rolls out to the keeper
length and in at leg stump, flicked to deep square
full and just outside off, driven to long-on
short of a length and turning in outside off, under-edges a late cut to backward point's left. He sprints and dives, gets a hand on it, but not a clean stop
length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
full outside off, looks to drive and gets a thick outside edge to sweeper's left
full on middle stump, flicked to midwicket
length on leg stump, tickled to short fine off the front foot
length on middle stump, tapped to mid-on's right
short of a length outside off, chopped to third man's left
short and wide, allows it to come on and chops to sweeper's right
beaten. Short and wide outside off, looks to cut but this jumps up off the surface to beat the outside edge
top edge goes over the keeper. Short and wide outside off, similar to last ball. Jumps up again. But this time he's looked to pull and has closed the face on this
short of a length in the corridor, chopped to third man's right and a misfield allows the second
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper
length and turning away from off. Looks to flick, can't get enough power on it
short at middle stump, gets deep in the crease and pulls to deep square
short and just outside off, cut to sweeper cover
length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
nicely placed. Length and pushed flat outside off. Decent ball against a straight bat. Mushfiqur has come down and swept it though. Before it can turn, and well in front of square
edged but no slip now. Length ball pushed across off stump, slight curve away. Played with soft hands though and gets a second to third man's right
short and wide outside off, cut straight to point
slapped back past the bowler. But it's a long boundary and long-on cleans up to his right. This attempted legbreak is dug in short and he has plenty of time to get back and flat-bat it
full on leg stump, flicked between fine leg and deep square
length on middle stump, punched on the up to long-on
slower ball at a length on middle. Plants the front leg across and flicks to fine leg
beats the inside edge and the keeper! Gorgeous old-fashioned offbreak. Drifts away, lands on a length and cuts back to beat the gap between bat and pad
full on middle stump, flicked to midwicket's right...and a fairly straightforward take is misfielded
length on leg stump, clipped straight to short fine
length at off stump, opens the face and pokes this to cover's right
short of a length just outside off, sliced to short third
length at middle stump, quicker than usual. Hurriedly pushed to short fine off the inside half
length and just outside off, tapped on the rise to mid-off
length and just outside off, chopped straight to point on the up
length outside off, looks to drive on the up, gets it off the bottom part of the bat to mid-off
length in the corridor, flicked to midwicket
length and just outside off, driven on the up to point
short of a length just outside off, punched back down the pitch and it is a maiden
length outside off, blocked on the front foot
length and just outside off, shuffles to flick but is forced to push it down the pitch
length on middle stump, flicked to midwicket
length outside off, pushed to extra cover's right with soft hands
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper
overpitched outside off, driven straight to extra cover
inside edge as this curves back furiously from outside off. Full and he wants to drive again. Foot is planted right across the stumps. Would have been in serious trouble against a quicker bowler
length on middle, punched to long-on on the up
short and wide outside off, cut to point
slower ball at a length on off, leans in and tucks this to short fine's left off the front foot
legcutter, back of a length and just outside off. Flicks to midwicket's left off the back foot
length at middle, shuffles and clips through square leg off the front foot

he's got him! Shakib not reviewing. Length ball skids past the inside edge as he gets forward and raps him in front of middle stump. Was that angling down? Could have been, but Shakib doesn't think so. And he's right, replays confirm. Walks straight off. Mujeeb has done it. He has quietly had a very good World Cup. Today he's made an opening. Shakib was playing for the offbreak, this cut back in
length and in at middle stump, defended on the front foot
length at off stump, punched back to the bowler
length on leg stump, flicked to midwicket
length at off stump, drops it towards square leg with soft hands
length outside off, driven on the up to extra cover
length and in at off stump, defended into the covers

run out appeal sent upstairs. Direct hit at the non-striker's end...he's just in. Whew. Rather lazy effort from Sarkar at grounding the bat, but he's in by a frame or two. Had tapped this on the rise to mid-on with soft hands
overpitched outside off and a sweet connection on this expansive cover drive. But it's straight to sweeper cover
length outside off, hangs the bat out and stabs to third man's right. It's a poor throw and Sarkar makes it back for the second
length outside off, pushed towards to the non-striker
length on leg stump, flicked to midwicket's right
short of a length on middle stump, gets deep in the crease and pulled to long-on's right
full on middle stump, flicked down to long-on
beaten on the flick as this is a googly. Bowled with the wrist so he expects a legbreak, but he's beaten outside off

lbw decision review by Sarkar. He's caught right in front of middle to a full ball, trying to flick it. It's a legbreak this time. Has it done enough to miss leg? The stump is half visible on the early replay...and tracking says it is clipping it. Umpire's call. Bangladesh retain their review, but they've lost Sarkar - who already looked quite lost at No. 5. Liton was probably pushed up today to counter Mujeeb, and we've seen why
full at middle stump, driven firmly back to the bowler
beaten. Length and wide outside off. Looks to drive with front leg far away from the pitch of the ball
short and wide outside off, thick edge down to third man as he looks to cut
length outside off, square drive straight to point
length and in at middle stump, defended solidly on the back foot
good length ball on fourth stump and straightening, defended to the off side.
short on off, tapped off the back foot through the covers.
flighted full at 90 kph/56 mph, driven through wide long-off, but not wide enough for a second.
googly spinning in off a fullish length from fourth stump, defended on the front foot and an edge squirts to short third man.

good length ball clipped to midwicket off the back foot. Mushfiqur turned and wanted two but doesn't see that Mahmudullah is limping to the non-striker's end for the first run. He's hobbling quite badly in fact and is down on the ground now as the physio rushes out to work on his right calf. Cramping up five balls after the drinks break. Hmm...
good length ball pitching on leg, Mushfiqur goes back to clip behind square.
full on middle, whipped through the leg side for one.

good length ball prodded to cover, Mahmudullah hobbles out of his crease looking for a run. Mushfiqur wasn't going to risk selling himself out for a partner on one leg. Shinwari fields in the ring and spins to fire wildly past the stumps with Mahmudullah well in. The line of the throw makes it impossible for a back-up fielder to be in position and they steal an overthrow.
fullish length on fifth stump line, Mushfiqur goes to drive through cover, inside edge thuds into his feet.
good length ball on middle stump, defended to extra cover.
short of a length with width on fifth stump line, opens the face to run it to third man.
short but well outside off on sixth stump line, Mahmudullah drags a pull through wide midwicket.
good length ball on middle, defended off the back foot to Rashid.
short on fifth stump and straightening, slapped off the back foot to point sweeper.
googly lands short spinning in from sixth stump line, easily read off the pitch and tapped behind point.
flighted full on off at 86 kph/53 mph, defended on the front foot.
fuller and zippier on middle at 92 kph, defended back to Rashid.
good length ball lands on off stump line and spins sharply to beat a flat footed fishing reel poke from Mahmudullah.
short of a length ball on middle angled into the hips, Mushfiqur can't flick it away off the thigh.
fullish length on off stump, guided fine to third man.
offcutter angled in from off stump, hops back to nurdle this to third man.
slower bouncer on the body, Mushfiqur cramped for room trying to uppercut and beaten. The ball bounces before Alikhil behind the stumps.
full on off, driven to mid-off, tumbling stop moving left saves it from being four.
fullish length on fourth stump, driven in the air, not in control of it, but well wide of cover as it dribbles toward the sweeper.
full and defended toward cover.
flighted full on off, pushes for a run in front of point before a gimpy hobble for the non-striker's end.
quicker ball darted in at 96 kph/60 mph on off stump, defended to point.
full, quicker ball down leg, well stopped by Alikhil.
short of a length ball on middle, goes back to tuck behind square.
full on middle, driven to long-on.

fullish length on fourth stump, swept in front of midwicket and they sneak a second taking on Mujeeb's from deep midwicket. Awful relay, even worse backup by Shinwari who has been poor all day in the field and Mahmudullah shockingly pinches not just the second but also an overthrow. Village from Afghanistan.
good length ball, spins past a back foot slap.
good length ball on the stumps, pushed to the cover sweeper.
flighted very full on leg stump, pushed straight to midwicket.

glorious from Mushfiqur! Shuffled outside off stump seeing fine leg up in the ring to create the angle to sweep this very fine. Rashid bowled this on fifth stump and Mushfiqur continues with the sweep getting it fine through fine leg.
good length ball on off, no footwork, edged to point.
short on off, cut behind point to the sweeper.
short on off, flighted at 74 kph/46 mph, plenty of time to go back and cut through point.
Sumptuous! Short on fourth stump, back foot swat over cover in the ring. Timed well enough to beat cover sweeper and long-off converging.
good length ball on the legs, clipped to fine leg in the ring.
quicker and fuller on off stump at 92 kph/57 mph, pushed through point.
Shot of the day! A fraction of width offered by Gulbadin on a good length, square drive by Mahmudullah beats Najibullah's dive at backward point.
another slower ball this time on off stump, pushed to Najibullah at backward point who denies the thought of a run.
slower short ball on the legs at 100 kph/62 mph, keeps the hands back to paddle pull to long leg.
short ball on the stumps at normal pace, pulled behind square. Mujeeb circles around from long leg to flick to Rashid coming over from deep midwicket to turn four into two.
slower ball lands very full on off, chipped uppishly just short of short midwicket.
good length ball spinning in, punched to cover.
flighted full on leg stump, clipped straight to the man at 45.
short on the stumps at 86 kph and spinning in, fought off to the left of Nabi who denies a single.

short on fifth stump, slapped straight to cover on one bounce but a frankly awful misfield by Gulbadin turns a dot into two as the ball scurries toward the sweeper. Didn't try to get any of his body behind it. Another Matador red cape effort in the field pulling the hands back.
full on the stumps, clipped to midwicket. Sliding stop by Shahidi.
slower ball lands on a length on sixth stump, Mahmudullah with a premeditated shuffle flays this over cover to the sweeper.
