good length outside off, but angling into his body. Worked off his hips to the fielder at midwicket
good length outside off, and fended off the back foot. Well stopped by the bowler on his followthrough
soars into the long-on boundary! In the slot outside off stump, and Asif has a golf swing at this delivery. Punished
full on leg, and he tries to whip it away to mid wicket, but a leading edge takes the ball to cover instead
good length outside off, and cut away off the front foot. The ball rolls away to third man, but Babar puts in the hard yards, and manages to come back for two. Eighth fifty for Babar!
full, but wide outside off. Babar throws his hands at it, and crunches this to the fielder at deep extra cover
full outside off, and beautifully driven off the front foot. Timed so well, but goes straight to the fielder at cover
full on off, and he uses his wrists to caress this shot to long on. They walk across for one
back of a length outside off, and soaring over Asif's shoulder and into the keeper's gloves
beats long on! Full outside off, and Asif's big backlift allows him to tee off for this shot. Swings across the line, and connects well to earn six
good length outside off, and he misses the uppercut over shord third man. Through to Murray
short and wide outside off again, and Asif can't get bat to ball once more. Looks to cut it over point, but can't connect with the shot
full outside off, but Asif goes down on one knee to drive very square. Finds the fielder in the deep though
low full toss outside off, and this drive has been squeezed to deep extra cover. Pakistan cross 300
aims for a yorker on off stump, but Asif manages to dig this away to long on
good length outside off, and that's been crunched to the cow-corner boundary. Picks the slower ball early,and swings across the line. Lands just before the ropes
full outside off, and that's been lifted inside out over cover! Another slower ball, but Babar had no trouble picking the pace

back of a length outside off, and this time Babar carves it over point with soft hands! Chase for the infielder to the boundary, but he manages to parry the ball back as they come back for three. The umpires want to have a look whether the fielder touched the boundary or not
low full toss outside off, and this has been sliced to the fielder in the deep. Tried to go for the big shot over cover
low full toss outside off, and that's been walloped to the extra cover boundary. What great timing, but the man's there in the deep
ouch! Asif Ali is down on his knees. Looks like he's hurt his rib cage. Short ball on middle, and Asif couldn't pull this away. Took his eyes off the ball, and has paid the price for it

full and wide outside off, and Asif reaches out to try and carve it behind point. But the batsman misses this slightly quicker delivery and goes into Murray's gloves. Appeal for caught behind, but the umpire isn't interested

sliced to third man! Wide outside off once again, and this time Asif manages to reach out and drive away from his body. But the bat turned in his hand, and Asif miscues this straight to the fielder at third man
good length on off, and he flat-bats a pull to wide long on
good length on middle, and Sarfraz rides the bounce, before turning it around the corner for a single
knee-high full toss on off stump, and Babar whips this to the cow corner boundary for two. Only four runs off the over
full outside off, and tapped to point for a quick single
full outside off, and that's been check-driven over cover! Good use of the bottom hand to lift it over the infield. Classy
full on off, and Babar walks across the line before swing through to the cow-corner boundary! Off the bat's sweet spot, and the ball goes way beyond the fielder manning the ropes
knee-high full toss on middle, and this has been flicked over square leg! Almost goes for a six. Fourteen in three balls now...
slower ball, but short outside off. Babar simply settles onto the back foot and slices this over point. No real timing off the bat, but still enough to take the third run
full toss on off, and worked to the wide long on fielder. Nineteen off the over
short ball on off, and he rides the bounce, before nudging to square leg for a single
back of a length outside off, cut away to third man for a single
back of a length outside off, and that's been ramped to third man for a walking single
full outside off, and that's been creamed to the extra-cover boundary! Small backlift, but goes hard onto his shot, and smacks this four to get to his nineties
slower ball bouncer on middle, and Babar pulls over square leg with ease. Once it crosses the infield, the ball races away to the boundary. Babar on 95
full outside off, and he opens his bat's face to run it down to short third man. Keeps the strike for the final over
short ball outside off, but Babar waits for the ball and runs it down fine to the third-man boundary! Eighth ODI hundred for Babar Azam. The second fifty came off just 17 deliveries
steered past short third man for four! Classy. Yorker outside off, and Babar sticks his bat out to run it fine
yorker, but too wide outside off. Left alone by Babar
full, and wide outside off. Babar stretches out and drives to wide long off
wide outside off once again, and the umpire has no choice but to spread his arms wide
back of a length outside off, but Sarfraz plays a late cut to third man for one. Gets Babar back on strike for the final two deliveries
slower ball, but wide outside off. He muscles this cut to cover
wide yorker to end the innings. He sticks his bat out and steers this to point for a single. Pakistan finish on 364 for 4!
back of a length, starts just outside leg and straightens in slightly. Masakadza misses the flick and is hit on the thigh pad
back of a length, close to off stump, blocked into the off side
well left. Full, pitching on middle and off and continuing with the angle across. Watches it well, sees there's no swing back, and raises his bat over his head
back of a length on leg stump, tucked away to long leg
ooh, nearly. On the fuller side of a good length, slanting across and inviting the cover drive before curling back in late. Goes for the drive and inside-edges past leg stump
back of a length, a little wider outside off, lets it come on and dabs to backward point
back of a length on middle and off, defended to short extra-cover
good ball, slanting away from off stump from a good length. Kamunhukamwe was unsure whether to play or leave, and ends up edging it just wide of the diving slip fielder
short, a little too far from the body to connect with the cut, maybe, or Kamunhukamwe was late on the shot
well bowled. Fuller, slanting across to off stump, defended to short extra-cover. Not much of a stride forward
back of a length on off stump, defended to cover point
back of a length, straightens slightly towards off stump. Wanted to punch through the covers, ended up dragging it back to the bowler
back of a length on off stump, this one's slanting away from wider on the crease. Defended into the covers
back of a length on middle and off, punched back towards the bowler
too full, too straight. Masakadza pulls his front leg out of the way and clips it away neatly, wide of mid-on

ooh, overambitious. An in-between length, angling away into the fifth-stump channel, and Masakadza is caught in an in-between position, weight on the back foot and looking to drive with an angled bat through cover. The ball beats his outside edge
back of a length on off stump, defended into the covers
play and miss. Length ball slanting away from off stump, and he goes for the drive and ends up playing inside the line
this one straightens in towards off and middle, and Kamunhukamwe stays leg-side of the ball and punches to short extra-cover
shortish, close to off stump. Gets on top of the bounce and chops it to backward point
back of a length close to off stump, defended to cover point

hooked for six! Junaid looks to surprise him with the bouncer, and it's a good one too, getting up to shoulder height around middle stump, but he deals with it brilliantly, opening up quickly and swivelling to swat it high over the long leg boundary
back of a length outside off, punched to cover point
length ball on off stump, continues to leave Masakadza with the angle. Left alone
back of a length on middle stump, punched to midwicket
length ball, straightens in towards middle stump to cramp Masakadza slightly, defended back to the bowler
back of a length close to off stump, punched to extra-cover
back of a length once more, a touch wider of off. Looks to drive on the up to mid-off but extra-cover moves quickly to intercept
back of a length, slanting across to off stump. Stays slightly leg-side of the ball to guide it down to third man

ooh, nearly a caught-and-bowled! On the fuller side of a good length, on middle stump, and Masakadza is into his drive too early. Hits it in the air, just over the bowler's head, and it comes quickly so Junaid ducks under it, wisely
back of a length on leg stump, goes back to tuck it to square leg
shortish, close to off stump, defended to cover point
back of a length on off stump, defended into the covers
back of a length close to off stump, punched firmly to mid-off
back of a length on off stump, punched back to the bowler
fullish, angling across to off stump and straightening a tiny bit. Wants to defend down the pitch, ends up playing it to midwicket off the inside half of the bat

shot! That's a Masakadza special. Jumps a couple of steps down the pitch and across his stumps, and flicks this good-length ball from off stump, against the angle, over backward square leg. It's lodged itself on a corrugated tin roof over one of the stands there
full on off stump, driven to the left of extra-cover, with a high left elbow
back of a length on off stump, punched to cover point
back of a length on off stump, defended into the covers
back of a length, angling across to off stump. Uses his wrists to play that back to the bowler. Didn't really get back and across, stayed leg-side of the ball
back of a length on off stump, lets it come and defends to cover point
back of a length on off stump, punched to extra-cover. Both these left-armers have bowled with terrific control
once again, back of a length on off stump. This time Kamunhukamwe makes himself room, goes deep in his crease, and punches it away between backward point and cover point
back of a length on leg stump, goes back to tuck it to square leg
slower ball, slanting away from off stump. Masakadza looks to defend and the ball leaves him like an offcutter and beats his outside edge. Bounces once more before reaching Sarfraz
fuller, outside off, driven with a lot of bottom wrist to extra-cover
back of a length on off stump, waits on it and dabs to third man
shortish, angling across to off stump. Hops to ride the bounce and defends, inside-edges into his pads
shortish, close to off stump, angling away from wide of the crease. Rocks right back and stabs it to the right of third man. Timed beautifully and it just races away
back of a length, down the leg side, misses the flick and there's a bit of an appeal for caught behind as Sarfraz tumbles to his left. Probably flicked his thigh pad on the way
length ball, straightening towards top of off, punched to short extra
shot. Takes a big step forward and across to whip this from outside off to the right of mid-on. Alert fielding keeps it down to one
back of a length outside off, lets it come on and steers it to the right of third man
back of a length, angling into off stump, defended back down the pitch
back of a length on off stump, looks to get on his toes and force it away through the infield. Straight to cover point, though
length ball on off stump, and that's a pretty unique shot. Clears his front leg, opens himself up, and just muscles it over long-off with a lot of bottom hand
length ball outside off, and that's been tapped to cover
full just outside off, and he tries to drive to cover. The ball angles slightly away, and goes past his bat's outside edge
good length outside off, and punched square off the back foot. Beats point, and a couple more for the Zimbabweans
full just outside off, and he tries to drive straight. The ball hits his inside-edge, and ricochets onto his pads
good length outside off, and steered to the cover fielder for one
yorker on middle, and he does well to dig this down to mid on
full outside off, and pushed to cover
flatter on middle, and punched down the ground to long on
length ball on middle, and he shuffles to the leg side to make some room. Then carves a cut to point
length ball on off, and that's been punched down the ground to long off. Fifty partnership!
tossed up just outside off, and crunched through to the fielder at deep extra cover
full on middle, and he opens his front leg to free his bat's movement. But the straight drive is swiftly blocked by Nawaz
back of a length on off, and tapped off the back foot to cover
full just outside off, and that's been driven square with the bat's open face. Man in the deep
golf swing! Comes down the ground, and meets this delivery on the full. Swings the bat through the ball's line, and the connection is excellent! Over long on
full on off, and he offers the bat's full face to drive straight. Stopped by Hasan though
good length outside off, and tapped to cover point for a quick single
full on middle, and worked away to midwicket. They want a single, but Masakadza sends his younger partner back
good length outside off, and carved off the back foot to cover point
full on leg stump, and he misses out on the sweep. Goes down the leg side, so Zimbabwe earn an extra run
full on middle, and driven down the ground to long on
length ball on leg stump, but going down the leg side. Another freebie
good length on leg stump, and he goes onto the back foot to defend
full on leg stump, and he's down on one knee to sweep! Picks this from middle stump, and places this angled sweep very fine past the infielder
full on off, and pushed away to the fielder at cover. Mistimed
good length on off, and he backs away to pull. Drags it too straight, and it's gone straight to mid on!
good length on off, and the block takes the bat's inside edge. Ricochets onto his pads thereafter
back of a length on middle, and Masakadza is pretty surprised! Goes for the pull anyway, and he top-edges it beyond fine leg

sends two stumps flying away! Squares Masakadza up. Length ball on off, and the ball angles slightly away after pitching. Masakadza tries to drive straight, but the ball goes past his outside edge, and uproots off- and middle-stump. A funny celebration too - Hasan chooses not to do the blast celebration, and instead asks his friend Shadab to celebrate for him. Remember, Hasan pulled a neck muscle the last time he tried to do that.
back of a length outside off, and he runs it down to third man. Gets off the mark
attempted yorker on leg stump, but the ball goes down leg. Wide, says the umpire
full on off, and Masvaure comes forward to defend
full on middle, and he comes forward to defend once more
full on off, and angling into the right hander. Defended to the leg side
tossed up on middle, and hits his front leg while the batsman tries to work it towards midwicket. Big appeal for lbw, but not given by the umpire. The angle would've taken it down leg stump
full on leg, and this time it's been pushed to midwicket for a quick run
full just outside off, and defended off the front foot to mid off
full outside off, and he comes forward to defend down the ground
tossed up on leg stump, but he gets behind the line of the ball, and drives back to the bowler
full on leg, and going down the leg side. Sarfraz dives to his right and stops the ball, but the umpire calls it a wide anyway
full just outside off, and he drives inside the line of the ball. Expected the ball to come into him, but the ball jagged away, and went past the outside of his bat
full on off, and Masvaure digs this away to the square-leg fielder. He's overstepped
yorker on leg stump, and Murray manages to get his toes out of the ball's way. The ball, however, raps him on his front leg, but the ball trickles away to square leg
full on middle, and that's been whipped off his toes to the vacant cow corner region. Chase for the fielder from midwicket
good length on off, but tailing into Murray's body. Defended to midwicket, and off they go for another run
full on off, and he raises his back leg to go through the line of the ball. Driven to mid on
full just outside off, but slower in the air. Defended with soft hands. Drinks as well
good length outside off, and the ball stayed low! He tried to cut, but the ball snuck under his bat, and Sarfraz does well to hold on
full on off, and he takes a big stride forward to defend. Sarfraz says, 'bohut acha (very good)' to his bowler
full on middle, and worked away to the leg side for a walking single
good length outside off, and the ball's spinning into the left hander. Tries to cut it away, but misses the shot completely
full on middle, and driven down the ground to long on for a walking single
tossed up outside off, and he opens his bat's face to run it down to point
back of a length on leg stump, and that's been paddle swept to fine leg
tossed up outside off, and that's been driven expansively. Struck with some ferocity, but straight to long off
tossed up on middle, and that's been whipped off his toes to the fielder at deep midwicket
full just outside off, and defended to mid off
tossed up on off, and the wrong'un comes into Murray. Mistimed to mid on
full outside off, and spinning away from the batsman. Sticks his bat out, and defends to point
full and wide outside off, and he comes down the wicket to drive. Played to the cover fielder
length ball outside off, but spinning in sharply. Worked off his hips to square leg
full just outside off, and worked away to the on-side off the front foot,. Played to mid on
good length just outside off, and he goes onto the back foot, before nudging this to square leg
length ball outside off, so Masvaure checks his shot. Punches past short mid on to the fielder in the deep
full outside leg stump, and spinning down the leg side. He misses out on the sweep and the ball hits the keeper's pads
full outside off, and spinning into Murray this time. Fended back to the bowler
tossed up on off, and he tries to drive straight. The ball turns away, and induces the bat's outside edge. Flies away to square leg thereafter
good length on off, and worked away to the leg side. But the ball turns away, and takes the top of his pad and goes to short third man
full outside off, and spinning further away. He sticks his bat out, but the ball goes past his outside edge
turn and bounce! Full outside off, and spinning away from Murray once again
tossed up outside off, driven to extra-cover
back of a length, turning into middle stump, punched to long-on
length ball on off stump, defended back to the bowler
shot. Fullish on off stump, clipped away crisply to the left of deep square leg
tossed up outside off, defended to extra-cover
a touch closer to off stump, driven to extra-cover
flat length ball on middle and off, goes back to punch it back to Shadab
loopy full-toss on off and middle, swept down to long leg
shortish outside off, pulled to the left of midwicket. Was looking for the single to long-on but the fielder in the circle moved quickly to cut it off
quickish length ball on off stump, Murray defends without really striding forward, just collapsed his back leg
shortish outside off, pulled to long-on
beauty. Floated across towards off stump and he comes forward to defend, playing for the turn. Continues to slide on with the angle and beats the outside edge
shortish outside off, jabbed to sweeper cover
length ball on off stump, clipped to midwicket
down the track and Nawaz gets it to drift away from off stump a bit. Driven back to the bowler
back of a length on off stump, punched into the point region
back of a length on off stump, looks for the punch to long-on but doesn't get any power on it, cramped for room. Midwicket moves across to field it
googly, tossed up outside off. Looks to drive into the covers, ends up hitting it back to the bowler
fuller outside off, driven hard into the covers and extra-cover, diving right, can only half-stop it and slow it down
length ball turning in towards off stump, nicely defended down the pitch. Masvaure's been getting into good positions against spin so far
length ball turning down leg, tucked away to long leg
flat slider angling into off stump, defended back down to the pitch
tossed up wide of off stump, presses forward for the push to sweeper cover
tossed up full on off stump, driven down to long-off
looks for the cover drive, ends up hitting it back to the bowler. Dangled it up slowly and got it to drift into the left-hander
quicker, angling into off stump, goes back to work it through square leg
nice length outside off, gets forward for a push into the covers
lovely length again, dips and turns in towards off stump. Nice checked drive to long-off
tossed up full, wide of off, driven to long-off
shot. Tossed up on middle stump and he makes himself room and chips it inside-out, over extra-cover, against the turn
length ball turning in from middle and leg. Gets forward and works it through square leg
full on off stump, driven back to the bowler
ooh, dropped. Flicks this full one against the turn, with a lot of power, and it doesn't quite stick as Malik moves to his left at midwicket to take this chest-high chance
back of a length outside off, chopped into the backward point region
a bit of flight outside off and Murray goes after it, sinks onto his back knee to slog-sweep over the midwicket boundary
down the track, gets inside the line of this full one angling into his legs, and chips inside-out to long-off
length ball turning in towards off stump, defended back to the bowler
length ball on off stump. Looks to use his wrists and play it down to long-on but midwicket moves quickly to his left to cut it off
fuller, driven down to long-on
back of a length, sliding into the pads, worked away through square leg
tossed up on off stump, clipped to midwicket
tossed up on middle stump, clipped away to deep square leg
flat legbreak just outside off, goes back and whips to midwicket
fuller, angling slightly down leg, and Murray plays that very well, gets his head over the ball and glances it away to the right of short fine leg
googly, didn't pick it. Dips sharply wide of off stump and he drags his intended cover drive to midwicket
tossed up wide of off again, driven down to long-off
length ball on off stump, sliding on with the angle. Goes back to slap it to cover point
flighted ball on off and middle, driven back firmly to the bowler, who fumbles it and lets the ball roll into the covers

down the track and Junaid Khan drops a straightforward chance. Doesn't get close enough to the pitch to loft it safely, and it goes hiiiigh in the air, towards long-off running in off the rope. He's sliding forward to catch it near his waist, and the ball just slips through his grasp
back of a length, sliding into leg stump, worked into the square-leg region
shortish, pulled through midwicket
length ball on middle stump, clipped to straight midwicket
back of a length, angling across to off stump. Defends with soft hands into the cover region to pick up a quick single
length ball on off stump, defended into the point region
fullish outside off, eased off the front foot to sweeper cover
digs in the bouncer, climbs too high to worry Masvaure, who just sways perfunctorily to let it pass
length ball close to off stump, defended to extra-cover
full, angling down leg. Misses the flick and Hasan lets out a big appeal for lbw, but it's angling too far down leg
yorker close to off stump, opens his bat face and steers it down to third man
back of a length outside off, punched to sweeper cover
nice length on off stump. Comes forward, lets the ball come to him, and clips it gently to the right of midwicket
back of a length close to off stump, punched to the left of backward point
length ball turning into middle and leg, clipped to backward square leg
flighted ball outside off, driven to long-off
flat, angling down leg, too quick for Murray to connect with the paddle sweep
quickish length ball on off stump, defended to midwicket
length ball on middle, and tapped back to the non-striker

full on off, and he's lifted it over the non-striker! Looks like it's going to clear mid-on, but the ball dips late, and therefore Asif must jump forward to take the catch. Breaks a 78-run partnership
welcomed with a yorker. Aimed on off stump, and Moor does well to keep the ball away
full on off, and tailing into Moor's body. Tries to drive, but the ball is inside-edged onto his pads
back of a length outside off, and the cut has been mistimed to third man. Gets off the mark
full on off, and he leans into a straight drive off the front foot. But strikes it straight to Hasan
length ball on leg stump, and blocked off the back foot
good length on leg stump, and Moor whips it off his pads to the leg side
good length on off, and angling across Moor. Pushed to cover
good length on middle, and pushed to mid off off the front foot. They take off for a single
full on off, and driven away from his body. But finds cover once again
back of a length on leg, and the batsman sways away from the ball's line and lets this go to Sarfraz. Maiden over
length ball outside off, and he blocks it off the back foot. Rides the bounce to defend
back of a length outside off, and Murray pulls this over midwicket. Mistimes his shot, but manages to clear the infield. His highest ODI score
back of a length outside off once again! Murray attempts the pull once more, and this time it's been drilled to mid on. Falls just short of the fielder there
full outside off, and pushed to cover point for a quick single
good length on off, and it's too close to the batsman for the late cut. He gloves it - past the diving keeper's right - to third man for a single
full on off, and that's been drilled past midwicket! Slogs across the line, and muscles this between the two fielders on the leg side
full on off, and flicked off his toes to the fielder at deep midwicket
full on off, and defended off the front foot
length ball outside leg stump, and turned off his pads to the leg side. Wants a single, but the fielder comes swooping in to cancel those thoughts
full on middle and leg, and that's been tapped away to the fielder at midwicket
yorker on off, and he does well to dig it away to the off side
yorker on middle again, but Murray has a swipe at this - across the line - and mistimes a shot to midwicket
tossed up on leg stump, but angling down the leg side
flatter on middle, and he rocks back to get inside the crease. Punched to mid on

pushed over the boundary! Fakhar the guilty man. Full on off, and he slogs across the line. Fakhar was near the mid-wicket boundary, but his one-handed attempt is dropped, and eventually parried over the ropes
good length on middle, and zipping straight through. The ball stays low, and Murray does well to keep this out

middle stump! One too many, and Murray falls three runs short of a maiden half-century. Tossed up full on off, and Murray goes down on one knee to slog-sweep behind square. You-miss-I-hit stuff from Nawaz
low full toss on middle stump, tapped past the non-striker to long on for a single
good length on off, and he goes onto the back foot to punch
length ball outside off, and that cut shot has flown to Shadab at point! Tries to take a flying catch to his right, but the ball pops out of his hands. Goes down as a dropped chance
full on middle, but angling across Chigumbura. Defended to cover
slower ball, on a length on middle stump. Chigumbura looks to defend off the front foot, but the ball angles across his bat and goes into Sarfraz's gloves
attempted yorker on middle, but eventually is a full toss. Driven down the ground to mid off
full on middle and leg, and defended off the front foot. Intercepted by Amir on the followthrough
slower ball on middle stump. Pushes this length ball away to cover. Just one off the over
length ball on middle, and he shuffles across to the off side, whipping away to square leg for one
tossed up on off, and driven with the turn to long off for a single
tossed up on leg stump, and that's been driven inside-out to the bowler
flighted outside leg stump, and he paddle-sweeps this fine down the leg side! Sarfraz is not pleased
good length outside off, and cut with the spin to point
full on middle, and Chigumbura comes forward to push this back to Nawaz
good length on off, and he rides the bounce to defend. Played to mid off
yorker on middle, and Moor does well to dig this out of the blockhole. Played back to Junaid
full on off, and driven away from his body to cover
slower ball, on a leg stump. Whipped off his pads to the vacant midwicket region for a jogging single
slower ball on middle stump, and Chigumbura looked to tee off for a big shot, but he eventually check-defends to the off side
full outside off, and that's been crunched over long off! Such sweet followthrough of the bat as he drives this for half-a-dozen! What a crack
tossed up on middle, and driven to cover
full outside off, and he's through his drive too early. Off the bat's top half, and goes almost into cover's hands

appeal for lbw! But not given. Length ball on off and he came down the ground to defend. Misses the shot as the ball hits his front leg. Impact was in front of off stump, so wonder what the umpire was thinking there
full on off, and thumped down the ground to long off
good length on off, and he goes onto the back foot to defend and see the over out
back of a length, close to off stump, defended into the covers
low full-toss close to off stump, driven to extra-cover
shortish outside off, steered down to third man
length ball angling into off stump from wide of the crease, defended back towards the bowler
back of a length on off stump, gets on his toes and clips to midwicket
fullish on off stump, driven to mid-off
back of a length outside off, googly. Stays a bit low and Chigumbura inside-edges his attempted back-foot punch past leg stump
shortish outside off, flat-batted to long-off
tossed up outside off, driven to sweeper cover
flat googly turning into leg stump, goes back and whips to deep square leg
another googly, tossed up and turning in towards off. Presses forward to defend into the on side
shortish outside off, stabbed to backward point
shortish, angling into the body. Looks to tuck it into the leg side and gets a blow on the glove instead
short, a bit of width, cracked away nicely, placed it well to the right of third man
yorker on off stump, jams his bat down on it and gets an inside-edge that rolls into his feet
short, angling into the body, gets up to chest height and he swivels nicely and plays a controlled pull out to long leg
short, some width again, and now it's Moor's turn to pick up a square-cut boundary. Hits it further in front of third man than Chigumbura did
length ball angling into off stump, defended to extra-cover
sharp turn outside off from a good length. Presses forward to defend and it rips past his outside edge
tossed up wide of off, driven to the left of long-off
beauty. Gets it to dip and spin away sharply, a little wider outside off, to beat Moor as he drives away from his body
googly, pitches on a good length and he hits it back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat. Wanted to drive into the covers
fuller, plays a checked drive into the covers
quickish length ball turning away from off stump, gets back and across to defend with soft hands
full, angling into middle stump, clipped away through square leg
length ball outside off, defended into the covers
slower ball, cuts in from off stump and is probably missing leg stump. Misses the flick and prompts a big lbw appeal
Length ball, nips in from outside off. Misses the flick and is hit on the pad again. Outside the line, I guess, and maybe an inside edge too. Not much of an appeal
another slower ball but this one is short, and he holds his shape nicely and pulls it just beyond the rope at deep midwicket
low full-toss outside off, driven to sweeper cover
fuller, driven to the right of sweeper cover
quickish legbreak on off stump, a touch short, goes back to punch through cover point
googly, too short and the wide line telegraphed it too. Goes back to punch to sweeper cover
floated up full on middle and leg, clipped past the diving bowler to long-on
short, turning down leg, pulled to long leg
half-tracker on off stump, pulled hard to the right of long-on and the fielder has to dive to save the boundary
shortish outside off, stabbed into the covers
back of a length close to off stump, punched towards extra-cover, who moves quickly to to stop it
back of a length on off stump, punched to long-off
full, almost in the blockhole, on middle stump. Driven to long-off
tossed up full on off stump, driven to extra-cover
flighted ball on off stump, driven back to the bowler
length ball on off stump, presses forward, lets it come on, and defends into the gap to the left of extra-cover
quickish length ball on off stump, defended into the point region
tossed up full on middle stump, driven to long-off
full on off stump, pushed to short cover
long-hop turning in from outside off, and Moor clatters it over the midwicket boundary
slants it wide of off, Moor leaves it alone
shortish on middle and leg, pulled along the ground to deep square leg
back of a length outside off, punched to extra-cover
length ball on off stump, goes back and clips it back to the bowler
loopy and slow outside leg, sweeps to long leg for one
inside-edged fine past the leg stump for four. Fortunate four for SA. Just short of a good length and angling away outside off, Qdk does not move his feet much, jabs at it and gets away
much fuller and straighter, Qdk presses forward and drives it handsomely between midwicket and mid-on for an emphatic four this time
full and curving into leg stump, patted only as far as mid-on
Three boundaries in the first four balls for Qdk. Floated too full and outside off, he leans into it and drives it on the up between mid-off and the covers
back of a length and skidding into Qdk, he hangs back and squirts a single to square leg
starts off with a short ball outside off, Qdk gives himself some room and slashes to backward point
Qdk steps down the track, meets a short ball on middle, and punches down the ground for one
full and sliding across off from round the wicket, Amla pushes to mid-off and chances a single. There's a mix-up between the wickets and Qdk is sent back. A direct hit from Thisara could have had Qdk
flatter and faster, defended by Amla off the back foot

Dananjaya de Silva strikes with the new ball for Sri Lanka. Back of a length and swerving away outside off from around the wicket, front-of-the-hand variation from Dananjaya de Silva. Amla scoops it straight into the lap of extra cover and bags a duck
short and darted across off, defended to the leg side off the back foot
pushed through on off, tip and run to the covers
tosses an offbreak on off, jammed to mid-on
back of a length and skids back in from round the wicket, de Kock goes on the back foot and inside-edges it away to the leg side
short and breaks back in, this is punched back to Akila off the back foot
high full-toss on middle, slipped out of the hands? This chest-high full-toss is pushed back. No-ball called, of course
Happy birthday, Reeza! Half-tracker on middle, begging on its knees to be smacked away. And the birthday boy obliges. He rocks back and carts it into the stands beyond midwicket
arrowed into the pads, tucked away to the leg side for one
Qdk takes this full one from the stumps and dares to reverse sweep. He paddles it away fine of short third man.

slider on the pads, Qdk now ventures a slog sweep, and takes it on the pad, as the ball wanders away square on the leg side. Dananjaya appears for lbw, but this heading down leg. De Kock and Reeza chance a leg bye. But Sandakan swoops down on the ball and throws it to Dananjaya, who takes the bails off to catch Qdk short. Qdk was ball-watching and ultimately pays the price. Lazy running from him
hit towards midwicket for a run
Duminy shimmies out, Dananjaya held this back and draws an inside edge to the leg side
and Reeza welcomes him back with a delicious back-foot punch through the covers. Reeza gets on top of this short ball outside off and laces it away
deftly done, Reeza. Slower offcutter outside off, Reeza waits for it to arrive, then deliberately opens the face and runs it fine of short third man for four
slower back of a length ball outside off, Rajitha has the batsman reaching out for the ball, stabbed to the covers
back of a length and outside off, punched to backward point, where there's a diving save
back of a length on the hips, this offcutter is deflected away to square leg again
tossed on middle, driven to mid-on off the front foot
Reeza ventures down the track, gets too close to the pitch of this full ball outside off and squeezes it back to him

Akila hits the off stump and gets rid of the birthday boy Legbreak from Akila, good length, angling in at off from over the wicket, dips, creating distance between the bat and the pitch as the batsman throws his hands at a big sweep. The ball then turns away to hit the top of off. Lovely bowling from Akila
and he brings out the reverse sweep right away. Stretches out and hits it to backward point
Klassen charges down the track, manufactures a full-toss, and simply belts it over the top of mid-on
good length and skidding in to ping the thigh
starts off with a short dart on middle, which is punched off the back foot to mid-on
dragged short and spinning away outside off, Klaasen reaches out and toe-ends it through the covers. He had no clue about the googly
full and straight, Klaasen shuffles across and sweeps it flat and hard behind square leg. The ball purrs away to the boundary
another googly, breaking away outside off, Klaasen flubs a pull away to the leg side
fast skidder on middle and leg, punched back to his right again
good length on off, pushes a single down to mid-off
darted on middle, short and that's punched firmly down to long-on by Duminy

Dhananjaya belts out an appeal for lbw, umpire Palliyaguruge shoots him down. Sri Lanka challenge the on-field not-out decision. Straighter one on middle, Duminy aims a reverse sweep and misses. He is rapped on the front pad below the knee-roll. Heading down leg? Nope, hitting leg, and the tracker returns three reds.
full and outside off, pushed to cover-point
short and outside off, goes deep in the crease and forces a single down to long-off
swept flat and hard to deep midwicket from outside off
dangled up just a shade outside off, Miller stretches out and brings out a sweep of his own. Placed between deep midwicket and long leg for four
good length and turns away outside off, Miller taps it solidly to the covers to round out the over
back of a length on off, cracked down to long-off for one
on a length and just a shade outside off, tipped in the gap at cover for one
offbreak, turns outside off, Miller now surges down the track and hits it to wide long-off
full-toss on leg or just outside leg, reverse-swept away through backward point
ooooh, that nearly trickled back onto the stumps! Short and darted back in, Miller is beaten on the inside edge on the back foot. The ball grazes the thigh and rolls back towards the stumps
The wrong'un works for Sandakan! Tossed up full and spins away outside off, Klaasen wants to swing it over the covers. Instead, slices an outside edge to Mendis at point
dangled up wide outside off, no shot from Andile
Sandakan cleans up Andile for a duck. SA six down and sinking in Colombo. Looped up on leg stump, Andile dares to reverse sweep and only drags it back onto the stumps
full and breaking down the leg side, off the pad and runs fine for four

The wrong'un works again for Sandakan. Rabada has been given out lbw, and he chooses to review. Back of a length and breaks back in from outside off to ping the back pad on the knee-roll in line with off. Rabada did not read the variation like most of his team-mates. Impact: umpire's call on off stump. Sandakan rounds out a triple-wicket maiden
tossed up and breaks away outside off, Miller skies a slog sweep wide of deep square leg
wrong'un, swerves in from wide of the crease to hit the pad, but sliding down leg
turning down leg, leg-side wide
another googly or an offbreak? I can't pick him either. Rips in from outside off and chops the batsman into half. How did that miss off stump?
back of a length and spins away outside off, beaten again is Miller. Miller would not have picked it even if it was written in font size 72
swept from leg stump behind square
low full-toss on off, patted down the ground for one
ripping googly again! Full and swerves away past the outside edge
full on off, whipped to deep midwicket
dangled up on middle, Miller sizes it up and reverse sweeps it flat and hard behind point. Risky but effective this time
back of a length and spins away outside off, punched back to Sandakan off the back foot
looped up on the leg stump, tickles a sweep to deep square leg
short googly, nips away outside off, Dala throws his bat at ball and flashes it to the off side
short offbreak, turns away outside off, Miller jumps back and carves the ball to the covers
full and drifting into the pads, glanced to short fine leg

Chandimal runs in and settles under this skier at the short midwicket region. Tossed-up offbreak on middle, doesn't spin much but bounces, Miller aims for a sweep and top-edges it to Mars and the ball eventually drops into the hands of Chandimal
big-turning googly, spins back in to beat the inside edge and hit the back pad. This looks very close, but not given. Was it doing too much?
fired on off, stabbed back to Akila
full on the stumps, driven down to long-on
Dala leans back to this short ball outside off and cuts to deep third man
Udana hits a splice-jarring length, on off, jabbed to sweeper cover
lifter, angling away outside off, lavishly beats the hook of Dala
short and wide outside off, Dala stays beside the line and flashes a cut to deep point
short on middle, hacked down to long-on
slower short ball outside off, Dala jumps back and punches up to point
short and skids back in to rap the pad. The batsman nearly falls over
backs away outside leg, Rajitha follows him with a short ball and hits the splice as the ball sneaks away to the covers
just short of a good length and outside off, Dala stays beside the line, opens the face, and punches a single to deep third man
short and outside off, chopped hastily to point
edged and taken by Chandimal behind the stumps. Back of a length, angling in, then cutting away outside off. Change-up from Rajitha. Lungi aims to hack it over midwicket but only nicks it off
short and outside off, down the track and battered over the covers
off-stump yorker, stabbed to mid-off
back of a length and shaping away outside off, Shamsi tucks his bat inside the line and lets it go to Chandimal

SA have been bowled out for 98 - their lowest total in T20Is. Shamsi has now nicked off for a duck. Back of a length, angling in, and swerving away outside off. Shamsi has his feet rooted to the crease, swings and edges it to the keeper
back of a length and slanting away outside off, 144ks, rushes the batsman, inside-edged to the covers for one
short and attacking the body, 140.6ks, fended off to long leg
back of a length and outside off, Kusal Perera punches uppishly but to the right of mid-off
Rabada strikes with his fourth ball. Just short of a good length and outside off, Kusal Perera short-arms it away into the lap of Shamsi at mid-on
back of a length and outside off, opens the face and steers to deep third man. Rabada's front foot has strayed
banged in short on middle, 143ks, emphatically beats the hook

ripping inswinging yorker from Rabada, rushes the batsman, and hits the back pad even before Mendis brings his bat down. This seems to be darting down leg, though. Not given lbw. Duminy calls for a review. Oh, ball-tracking suggests it would crash into leg stump. Two wickets in the first over for Rabada
back of a length, bouncing, seaming away outside off, Chandimal is caught on a fishing expedition. Beaten in the channel
full and outside off, sliced to deep third man off a thick outside edge
sharp nip-backer, seams back in from outside off, chops de Silva into half, off the top of the back pad and lobs to the keeper
full and seams back in to have the batsman falling over the flick and ping the pad, but this is heading down leg as well
short and outside off, de Silva flashes and sends an inside edge past leg stump
short and rising outside off, Chandimal rises with it and punches up to mid-off
short and angling into the hips, de Silva camps back and turns the ball away to midwicket
back of a length and angling into the hips, de Silva picks up and miscues it over midwicket
short and angling into a back-foot push to mid-on for one
dug in short on middle, chest-hunting ball, de Silva, swivels on the back foot and pulls it flat and hard behind square
back of a length and outside off, opens the face and punches to point
short on off, swatted away to the right of mid-on
banged in short and outside off, nearly 140ks, de Silva is late onto the hook and the top edge flies over the keeper's head fine of deep third man for six
de Silva gets on top of a short ball outside off and pumps it to the covers
full and angling into a front-foot flick to mid-on
length and outside off, de Silva stays leg-side of the ball and hits through the line. Flayed away through the covers
back-to-back fours for de Silva. Back of a length and outside off, goes on the back foot now and punches to the left of short extra cover this time
full and angling into off, opens the face and runs the ball to point
low full-toss angling into the pads, flicked away behind square on the leg side for four
back of a length and outside off, punched to mid-off
back of a length and outside, opens the face and steers to point
just short of a good length and outside off, punched on the up through the covers
short and outside off, de Silva lets the ball slide off the face to point
full and turning down the leg side for wide
darted flat on leg stump, Chandimal drops down to one knee and slugs a sweep behind square for four
tossed slower and higher on middle, Chandimal sweeps again, this time he sends the ball sailing over square leg for six
looped up on leg stump, breaks away, this googly is diffused to the covers
slider on off, pushed to mid-off off the front foot
short and spins back in, chipped off the back foot to the left of Shamsi
short dart outside off, stabbed back to Shamsi off the inside half
full on the stumps, forward and driven to mid-on's left
back of a length and slanting into middle, 143ks, de Silva deploys a solid stride and defends the ball to the covers
back of a length and speared wider outside off, de Silva reaches out for the ball with his hands and punches on the up. He sends it clattering through the covers
short and outside off, de Silva gets on top of the bounce and punches straight to short cover now
short and slanting into middle, pushed back to Rabada. And he has overstepped again
back of a length and keeps low outside off, slower ball, de Silva has a big whoosh at it. He is too early and the ball sneaks under his bat to Qdk
rapid bouncer on middle, rushes the batsman into a hook and beats him
short, angling into leg stump. Gets up to chest height and Dhananjaya puts it away easily, pulls it over backward square leg for a flat six
another short ball, but this time Dhananjaya has to drag his pull from quite wide outside off. Hits high on the bat and balloons in the air for Phehlukwayo to take a simple catch at midwicket
back of a length, close to off stump, defended into the point region
short, wide, and Chandimal puts it away, gets on his toes to lash it away through point
flat length ball spins in quite sharply from outside off. Mathews defends off the front foot
a little slower, on middle stump, clipped watchfully into the square-leg region

oh my, this is a blinder at short leg! Mathews came forward to flick this, and it came right off the middle of his bat. Klaasen hardly had any reaction time there, but he's thrown himself to his left and caught it one-handed. Unbelievable
tossed up on leg stump, clipped to midwicket
fuller, on middle stump, clipped away to deep square leg
Shanaka gets behind a short ball outside off and diffuses it to the covers
full-toss angling into a little flick to the left of short midwicket
bouncer, sails through to the keeper, as Shanaka swerves out of the way of harm
just short of a good length and outside off, he lets the ball slide away to deep third man off the face
rising short ball on off, Chandimal hops, skips, rides the bounce and taps it down to the off side
full on the stumps, presses forward and drives a single to the right of mid-on
pitches it too full and outside off, Chandimal collapses his back knee and drives it to wide mid-off
looped up on off, spins away a wee bit, this wrong'un is blocked to cover
fired on off, Shanaka gets inside the line and sweeps flat and hard past leg slip for four
dropped short on middle, Shanaka jumps back in a flash and hammers a pull to the midwicket boundary. A hat-trick of boundaries for Shanaka
full and fizzes back in to catch the pad, but this is surely heading down the leg side. Duminy reviews out of desperation. Ball-tracking confirms it's missing leg
short and slanted into the hips, picked off to fine leg
pitched up and outside off,Shanaka leans into a drive and eases it through the covers
full and outside off, throws his bat at ball and swishes it to mid-off
back of a length and angling into middle, Shanaka has a big leg-side hoick and watches an inside edge hit his pad

Shanaka holes out to deep square leg. Short, hip-high ball on middle, Shanaka attempts to pull it away but does not connect well enough. He closes the face and top-edges it to birthday boy Reeza in the deep
bouncer on off, flies through to the keeper, as Chandimal ducks under it. Too high, and the square-leg umpire calls it a wide
short on middle, Chandimal leaps off his feet and fends it off to the off side
Shami storms through the defences of Thisara with a wrong'un. Thisara's time is over in Colombo. On a length, starts outside off, Thisara does not pick it, and has his stumps rattled
short and spins back in, this googly does not spin that much, punched up to mid-off's right
full on middle, Akila presses forward and smothers it
drifts in from wide of the crease and screams away outside off, Akila plays inside the line and lets it go. Shamsi ends with 4-0-26-2
short on off, hops and fends it off to cover
bouncer on middle, ducks under it, too high and that's another wide
Dala hits a hard length outside off - neither driveable nor pullable - spliced wide of the covers
short on middle, clipped to fine leg
overpitched and outside off, driven through the line to the right of mid-off
on a length and outside off, steered to point

The chase tightens in Colombo. Chandimal watches his team-mates crumble around him. Slider on middle from round the wicket, Akila stays leg-side of the ball and looks to belt it through the covers. He does not touch it at all. The middle stump takes a beating
full-toss, angling into leg stump from over the wicket, patted to the leg side for one
darted on leg stump, jabbed to midwicket
short and breaks in, draws an inside edge to the leg side
wide of the crease and slides on outside off, Udana searches for the ball... and misses
back of a length and slanting in at off, leans back and jabs to point
short and angling into a push to mid-on
just short of a good length and outside off, Chandimal jumps back and flays a cut to the left of sweeper cover. Klaasen in the deep throws himself to his left to stop the ball
full-toss, on the pads, whipped away to deep midwicket
good length on a fourth-stump line, Chandimal stretches out, meets the pitch, and push-drives the ball to the left of Amla at short cover

Shot, Udana! He seals it for Sri Lanka with a text-book style straight drive. With short leg in place, Ngidi pitches it up on middle, 143.2ks, Udana picks up the length. He presses forward and drives it smoothly straight past the bowler

caught behind first ball! Comes out braving the cold, goes back for an early coffee. #SmallMercies. Australia, meanwhile, are elated. Stanlake pitches it up outside off, has Zhuwao chasing after it. Normally, that would have screamed through the cover point boundary. But in this case - because of the lack of footwork - he just nicks through
back of a length and outside off, leaves it. Hint of awayswing in the air for Stanlake
struck on the body as Masakadza looks to flick a shortish delivery angled into him
draws him into a lazy old drive and that away swing - that very late away swing - takes it past the outside edge. Stanlake's looking mean today. #WhatElseIsNew?
looks for the blockhole now and Masakadza brings down a straight bat to save himself
good length ball on middle, defends stoutly
knocks it down gently straight of midwicket for a single. That's more like it. Mire playing close to the body, covering the line of a ball angled into middle
pokes outside the off stump as Richardson hits a fuller length. Masakadza is stuck in the crease but his hands lunge out to meet the ball. Soft hands though, which is good

dropped by the debutant! Jack Wildermuth tries to get under the skier at third man as Masakadza slogs wildly. The back of a length ball leaps off the top edge and starts to dip as it nears the fielder. Wildermuth has committed to take it reverse cup and even ends up diving forward in a desperate attempt to pull it off. In the end, it pops out. Really should have taken it the normal way
fuller delivery on middle, he turns it into the leg side
hangs back and flicks a shortish delivery through midwicket
angles a short of a good length delivery in at off stump, Masakadza plays late, chopping it to point for a quick single
goes short and Masakadza hoicks it through midwicket. Powerful strike. Standing tall, telling the bowler who's boss

another one that he digs into the pitch, this one coming up towards Masakadza's chest. The batsman pulls, gets struck on the glove, and as the ball wanders to square leg, he slinks through for a single

rippper! It beats Mire's outside edge and goes hunting for the off stump. Prey escapes predator by the smallest margin as the ball bounces just over it. Sensational stuff from Stanlake. Hitting the deck on middle and getting late away movement
full on middle, Mire blocks to cover
shortish and outside off, he dabs it to third man. Sensible batting. Controlled batting.
extra bounce as Richardson bends his back and goes short. Mire goes for the pull on instinct and mistimes it to deep midwicket

chops on! A short and wide delivery that deserves to be cut through cover point ends up pinging off the inside edge onto the stumps. Seems like Masakadza is fooled by a throttling down in pace. A wicket each in the Powerplay for Australia's quicks. That's job well done
too short, and it even leaps over the wicketkeeper Carey to run away for four
zips through past the top edge as Musakanda goes for a cut shot
shortish and outside off, glides it down to third man
taps the back of a length delivery into the covers for a quick single
a hint of width and that's enough for Mire to exploit; lovely late cut, along the ground to third man
a slower ball, but he hits the deck with it. Musakanda reads it all perfectly, pulls his bottom hand off, nudges it to the left of the pitch and pinches a single
short and wide and Musakanda latches onto it with a vengeance. Cut with all of his power to the point boundary
keeps going short and wide - but this time he makes sure it travels higher. Musakanda looks for the upper cut, but can't catch up with it
tosses it up on off stump, drives to cover
goes back to a flatter delivery on off stump and pats it to extra cover
looms over the flighted delivery in leg stump and deflects it to the left of short fine leg
full on middle, pushes it back at the bowler
stands tall against a back of a length delivery outside off and punches it through to deep point
slower ball that deceives Mire. He's set up to launch it over the leg side, thinking it's length and it's in the slot. But the lack of pace makes him think twice and in the end leave it outside off
takes the pace off again, but Moor is looking for it, adjusts his bat swing appropriately and flicks a straight one to long leg
spots the variation, hanging back until it finally arrives in his half of the pitch. Little late cut thereafter sends it down to third man
tosses it up on middle and leg, Moor defends

leading edge... swirling away past the shoulder of Tye, running back from cover.... lands safely. Superb bowling from Agar, even if it doesn't result in a wicket. Lobbing the ball up over the batsman's eyeline and getting it to dip and turn so that a hit straight down the ground becomes a panic-stricken wait for Moor to see if he's still alive in the game
clears the front leg again as Agar targets leg stump and hits the length ball down to long-on
flatter and fuller on off stump, Moor drills it back to the left-arm spinner
good length ball outside off stump, the batsman pushes it through cover point
gets up off his toes so that he can hit the short ball on top of its bounce and send it scampering away to the left of both point and the sweeper cover. Good technique
bouncer, which keeps coming in at the batsmen. Moor drops his wrists and avoids contact
defends a shortish delivery to the right of point
pulls a rising delivery from outside off to long-on. Not enough room, and perhaps more pertinently, too much bounce for him to properly time the ball
opens the face to guide a good length ball to third man
flirts with a back of a length delivery outside off and is comfortably beaten. Tiny bit more bounce than Moor is ready for
he's forced back into his crease by a short ball, coming up towards his chest. Moor does well in the end, to use soft hands and blunt it by his feet
goes for a bouncer outside off, but it may just have wandered too high for its own good

direct hit would have knocked Mire out! Maxwell is the man at point, cutting the angle very well as he runs to his left to grab the ball and take a shy at the strikers' end. Decent shot from Moor, but not the best judgment of a run
slogs a back of a length delivery to long-on
sharp pace again as he goes full and outside off. Mire camps on leg stump, not really keen on getting in line with the delivery and so ends up comfortably beaten
short ball now, only a shade outside off stump. The lack of room, and that it comes near his shoulder, makes Mire decide not to dabble with it
swishes outside off - this one giving him a little more width to free the arms - but Stanlake's got too much heat on the ball
rocks back to slap the short delivery outside off to point
yorker on off stump, Moor digs it out
back of a length and outside off, slaps it to point
works his wrists over a shortish delivery on middle and finds a couple between long-on and midwicket
backs away, prompting Tye to follow the batsman and go as short as he can. But with this pitch already offering plenty of bounce, the ball soars over Mire's head as he leaves
good length ball on middle, which is turned through midwicket. Mire plays with soft hands looking for two and he gets it
slogs a length ball outside off to deep square leg

knuckle ball utterly deceives Mire, and for a second time, it only just misses his stumps. Stanlake had a chance at knocking out his off stump earlier in the day. Now Tye comes within inches of messing the middle one up. A slog with no luck or skill attached to it
clatters a short ball outside off away over deep midwicket. Good work in getting on top of the bounce to connect as cleanly as he did
and there's the little bit of luck a batsman needs. Stoinis goes to top pace as he tries to bounce Moor. He goes for the pull and gets a top edge over the keeper
slower ball on middle, Moor taps it to point. That's the fifty partnership
scoops a length ball on middle stump over the short fine leg fielder. That's 19 off the over already
knuckle ball, bobbles out to become a yorker too. Mire keeps it out
another very quick delivery on middle, Mire nudges it to cover for a single
tries a slog sweep, but mistimes it so badly the wicketkeeper gets to it
reverse sweep now, and it s a superb shot, simply because Agar is bowling quick and at off stump, with third man and point up. Mire spots the flaw in Australia's plans and exploits it superbly
makes room and lashes a short ball over deep midwicket, into the grass banks. Brutal hit from Mire and Zimbabwe have finally got their groove on. Thirty-two runs off the last two overs.
spots Moor making room and so slows his pace down and plants the ball wide outside off. Clever bowling earns a dot
he's worried that Moor would be making room again and goes too wide outside off. Penalised
back of a length and outside off, Moor looks for a late cut but is beaten

carves it over the top - and he really has timed the pants off it - the only problem is it sails straight to deep point. Moor takes on the long boundary and comes up short. He had to hit out though, with only four-ish overs left
back of a length and outside off, slashes and misses
full and outside off, slices it to deep point
full on off stump, he nudges it towards mid-on
shortish on off stump - no pace on it though - as Chigumbura knocks it down towards where short midwicket would have been
stands tall and pulls a slower short ball out to deep midwicket to bring up his second fifty in successive games
cramps him for room with a top-pace delivery on off stump. Chigumbura mistimes a late cut to point
top edge, taken by square leg running in! It's a short ball, not really affording him the room to swing his arms. Also comes onto him too quickly, leading to a mis-hit.
full and outside off, Mire slogs away, but gets a leading edge over short third man. Knuckle ball deceives the batsman, but he still profits
massive! This time he nails the back of a length delivery off the middle of the bat and it sails over the backward square leg boundary. Mire's on fire. (Had to be said)
good length ball on off stump, blocks behind point
wide yorker - perfectly executed. Even Mire can't make something out of it.
runs outside off to try to try and scoop the ball - but the perils of premeditation is that he has missed out on a full toss, which he could have hammered over the off side
backs away and hammers a short ball over extra cover. What a shot! The timing on it! The sound of it leaving the bat!
full toss outside off, smears it to the left of the sweeper cover. Two balls faced, two super shots for boundaries. Malcolm Waller is just what Zimbabwe needed right now
drills a near yorker on leg stump out to extra cover
looks for another yorker on middle, Mire gets it off the inside edge to short fine leg

taken by deep square leg! Good work from Tye, and it's his go-to delivery too. Change of pace, which is perfect against a batsman wanting to slog everything. Waller goes for a pull, mistimes it and ends up being caught, and quite easily at that
full and outside off, slaps it to extra cover

full and straight. Mire goes across the line for a slog over wide long-on - he kinda has no choice but to play shots line that - and makes no contact. That means the ball has a clear path to uproot off stump. Fifty wickets in T20s in 2018 for Tye
full toss outside off, Mavuta smashes it to the point boundary
back of a length and outside off, blocks to point
shortish and on off stump, pulls through wide mid-on
slower delivery, well wide outside off, Masakadza skews it to deep point
full and outside off, slaps it to mid-off

walks across outside off, trying to smash the ball over the top, perhaps a lot straighter than mid-off. But that's where it goes and Marcus Stoinis, running back, takes it over his shoulder. Fine effort to give the debutant a first ODI wicket
full and drifting into the pads, Finch tries to dab it fine, but he can't make contact with the bat.
stays around the wicket to the left-hander too, and Carey pulls the flatter delivery outside off to deep midwicket
backs away outside leg, but Masakadza follows him with a quicker delivery. Finch flicks through midwicket
keeps pushing it through in line with the stumps, Carey blocks
flicks another back of a length delivery from off stump away to deep square leg
opens the face to steer a short delivery outside off to point
unsettles the left-hander by targeting the body - Muzarabani is well over six-feet tall, so its no surprise that he's getting awkward bounce. Single off a flick behind square leg
tries to glance the ball, sliding down leg, to the boundary but he can't touch it
tries to pull a short and wide delivery - perhaps off pace as well - and gets an inside edge to deep square leg
lifts a good length ball straight down the ground - but this has gone high. Mid-off and mid-on are racing after it, but the ball lands just in front of them both
shortish on off stump, defends
shapes to pull, but he doesn't read the pace of the ball off the pitch properly and mistimes the shot so badly that it doesn't even go too far off the pitch
turns a fuller delivery on leg stump through midwicket
run-out chance as the left-hander digs out a yorker and the non-striker thinks there's a single at cover. Carey sends Head back and a dive saves the Australian
goes for the slog sweep and gets struck on the back leg. But Masakadza's delivery pitches outside leg so the lbw appeal won't stand
full delivery outside off, Carey smacks it through extra cover. Pace on the ball making a difference in favour of Austrlaia
short on middle, he pulls to deep square leg
stands up tall behind a back of a length delivery on off stump and defends to point
drifts down the leg side and Head doesn't make contact with the flick
rises with the bouncer on middle and off stump and blunts it by his feet
slower ball on leg stump, Head works it to deep square leg
short and outside off, Carey glides it behind point, but the fielder does well, putting in a dive
blocks a shortish delivery down the pitch and sets off looking for a single. Realises it's not there just in time
strays down the pads, Maxwell misses out on the flick
tucks a good length ball outside off through square leg

stays put in his crease to defend another rising delivery from Muzarabani. His lines to the left-handers has been very very good so far. Head gets an inside edge on this occasion and Maxwell scampers through for a single
full and outside off, he drives to point
full and outside of, Head lashes it to point
drives in solid fashion to cover. Tiripano hitting good areas on and around off stump
walks down the pitch - showing he's under pressure over the lack of runs. Tiripano bangs it in short, and it wanders past Head's shirt, and right over leg stump
gets under the short ball to lift it over the keeper and away to the third man boundary. Upper cut, well executed
walks out and across his stumps again to flick through to mid-on
prepares a flick shot, but the ball not coming onto the bat puts him off. It eventually ends up deflecting off the pads to short fine leg
full on off stump, Maxwell pushes it to mid-off and pinches a single
short and wide, but since it's slow as well it beats Head's cut shot
full and outside off, Head drives sweetly through the covers
nicks it past the keeper! Taking the pace off is working big time on this pitch. It's offering extra bounce as well and both of those combine to mess with Head's cut shot
short and on leg stump, he pulls to long leg
leading edge first up as he tosses it up on leg stump and Head is lunging for the ball, meeting it too early
pushes it through down leg. Head looks for a flick, no luck there. but he does get a wide and then rushes for a single as the keeper fumbles the take
flights it on off stump, Maxwell plays for turn, but the drift into the right-hander secures an inside edge
drives through the covers for a couple. Australia almost solely concentrating on singles and twos to recover lost ground
short and wide, Maxwell cuts to deep point
shapes to pick a short ball off middle stump over square leg. But he's into the shot too early and ends up hitting it off a leading edge to point

struck on the helmet Head is into a pull shot and goes through with it too soon. The ball strikes him on the side of his head. He doesn't seem to be in any sort of trouble though. Sends Maxwell, who is looking for a single, back and then later the physio too.
pulls a short ball away behind square leg
flicks a shortish delivery to long leg
slower ball outside off, Head drives to mid-off for a single
dipping slower ball on middle, Maxwell presents the full face for a single to long-on
flicks a short one from middle and off stump to deep midwicket
short ball, which Head pulls past Masakadza's left. The throw from the deep hits the stumps direct at the striker's end and ricochets for an overthrow

shifts his weight back against the shortish delivery and flicks it behind square leg. Smart footwork from Head, who wants a second. He needs to hurry. The throw from Muzarabani is right next to the stumps... Replays have it very very tight... and Head may well have been in by a frame. Those zing bails might have helped there.
works a good length ball off the back foot towards square leg
shovels it all the way over the extra cover boundary! Maxwell is reaching out - it would have been a wide had he missed it - but Maxwell still manages to hit it with monstrous power
pushes it through on off stump, Maxwell is waiting for the change in length as he calmly flicks through midwicket
skids through past the pads of Maxwell even as he tries to flick it away. Deflection off the pad puts the keeper off from collecting it
smashes it over long-on! Simply done by Maxwell as he meets a half volley with the full face and ensures it has enough of his strength to take it all the way
rank delivery - short and down leg - Maxwell pulls it away to the left of long leg. Muzarabani saves a boundary
quicker delivery outside off, Maxwell pushes it to long-off
flatter delivery on middle, Maxwell clears his front leg and punches to midwicket
googly on middle, Head hangs back and turns it to square leg.
shapes to slog a legbreak over long-on but hitting against the turn - especially when the ball is way outside off - is rarely helpful. Maxwell is beaten
googly on off stump, Maxwell swings it around to short fine leg
comes down the track and though the bowler tries to stump him by sneaking the ball down leg, Head is able to flick it away to deep square leg
quicker delivery on middle, Maxwell goes back to block and gets an outside edge through point
defends a full delivery on off stump towards point. Another straightforward single
shimmies down the pitch and lifts the length ball on leg stump away to deep midwicket
backs away and smears a full delivery on leg stump over to the extra cover boundary. Brutal strike, one that showcases his bottom-hand strength
shortish on middle, Maxwell taps it to the empty spaces at mid-on and midwicket to take a couple
good length on off stump, defends
full on middle, Maxwell turns it to long-on
shortish and outside off, Head slaps it past the left of point
length ball, asking to be hit and Maxwell doesn't disappoint. Presses forward and launches it over midwicket.
short now, and Maxwell pulls it away to the left of deep midwicket
gets the late cut going but he can't beat short third man
short and outside off, Maxwell cuts to the sweeper
loops the googly up so very wide outside off. Maxwell thinks about it, but settles for the wide
pulls a short ball away to deep midwicket
shortish and outside off, Head cuts it behind point
shapes to slog a tossed up delivery on leg stump, but it spins the wrong way, so he has to chop the ball into the off side for a single.
cuts the flatter delivery to point
googly on off stump, Maxwell defends, reading the variation just about well enough
dropped but it is a seriously difficult chance because Head rushes down the pitch and gets an outside edge while trying to loft over the covers. Could have had him stumped too.

length ball - offering Maxwell room to free the arms too - and he takes full toll of it. Winds up and launches the bad ball over long-on to bring up his half-century. Points at both of his eyes in celebration, while the umpires bring out a new ball.
good length on middle stump, defends
short and wide, Maxwell pummels it straight down the ground. Another powerful hit for six
spears a quick delivery in at leg stump, Maxwell inside edges it
inside edges a short ball and it wanders out to long leg. Muzarabani's bounce is still so very unsettling
drives straight to short cover! With Australia almost to the finish line, their top-scorer hits a length ball off the bottom of the bat straight to Chigumbura
gets his shuffle on to work a back of a length delivery on off stump away to deep midwicket
slower ball on leg stump, Head taps it towards square leg
good length on middle, Maddinson defends
rises with the short ball and steers it quite nicely to deep third man
goes for a pull seeing the length short, but it's also a slower ball and that deceives Maddinson as he is hit on the body. Still, Australia get a leg bye with Head calling him through for a single
full and outside off, drills it to mid-off

caught at square leg! Two wickets in two overs - are Zimbabwe still in this? Maddinson goes for a pull shot but the ball is at him a llittle quicker than he'd like. Miscues it for Muzarabani to come into play as he dives forward to take the chance
full on off stump, he tucks it to the right of long-on, with soft hands, to ensure he can get a couple of runs before the deep fielders get a look in
pulls a slower short ball out to deep midwicket
works a good length ball on leg stump out to deep square leg
good length ball outside off gets Stoinis forward with a defensive push. It results in an outside edge that wanders away to deep third man

goes straight up! Long-on is right on the edge of the boundary. Masakdaza, alancing himself as well as he could, takes the catch reverse cup. But he is starting to overbalance, so he flicks the ball back into the field of play. So close for Zimbabwe... So close...
full and outside off, Agar drives to cover. Stoinis at the other end is looking for a single, which is why Waller takes a shy at the stumps and gives away two overthrows
back of a length and outside off, steers it to deep point
starts with a short ball that goes way wide outside leg
slower ball outside off, Agar flashes and misses as it spins away from him. Harsh call from the umpire to label that a wide though. Doubt it was.
good length and it's the offcutter again. Agar pokes and misses
low full toss which Agar inside edges onto pad. Stoinis, the better batsman of the two, races away to steal the strike.
slower short ball, which Stoinis pulls for a single to deep square leg
smacks it to mid-off and just sets off. Masakadza fumbles as well, allowing Australia's desperation move to succeed, despite his recovery and subsequent direct hit
low full toss, which Stoinis smashes over square leg and it's Australia's game
good length outside off, nicely onto the frontfoot and pushes it to the cover fielder
full on off, drives it along the ground to cover fielder
back of length, onto the backfoot and pushes it away to short mid-wicket
good length outside off, onto the backfoot and punches it to cover fielder
back of length on off, pushed to covers of the backfoot again
good length outside off, lets it through to the keeper
tossed up, goes for the reverse sweep first ball he faces of mujeeb, connects well but finds the point fielder
flighted up, reverse sweep again but gets a edge this time onto his backleg and just away from the wickets
flighted outside off, onto the frontfoot and does a defense
tossed outside off, another reverse sweep and the same result doesn't connnect and gets hit on the pads
tossed up, goes for a reverse sweep again but misses and hit on the pads, loud appeal but not-out as he may have got an inside edge on it
good length into the pads, tries to flick it towards mid-wicket but gets hit on the pads, loud appeal but not-out is the call, down the leg is the signal by the umpire
full outside off, onto the frontfoot and does a defense
onto the frontfoot and drives it to the cover fielder
back of length outside off, punches it on the backfoot but to the point fielder
full on middle, drives it to short mid-wicket fielder
full and straight, drives it on the rise straight past the umpire for a boundary
flighted on leg, sweeps it and gets a quick run at short fine leg
quick and flat on leg, driven down to long-on for a run
flighted outside off, switches and drags it past cover fielder for a boundary
down the leg and wide given
flighted up, goes for a reverse sweep this time and plays it straight to point fielder
down the leg again and kept well by shahzad, wide given by nigel llong
tossed up, goes for a reverse sweep again and connects but finds the fielder again
flighted up, plays a sweep away from square leg for a couple
full outside off, drives it to the cover fielder
good length on middle, plays a lofted on-drive for a boundary at mid-wicket
back of length outside off, comes down and tries to guide it down thirdman but plays it straight into the hands of Ihsanullah at the slips
good length outside off, lets it through to the keeper
full on leg, drives it away to mid-wicket for a couple
tossed up on leg, onto the knees and slog sweeps it over square leg for a flat six
flighted outside off, well once again a reverse sweep attempted and missed
tossed on middle-leg, nudges it away to square leg for a run
flighted on middle, onto the frontfoot and does a defense
back of length on middle-leg, onto the backfoot to nudge it but gets hit on the pads as it spins down towards leg
back of length outside off, cuts it along the ground but straight to cover point fielder
full outside off, onto the backfoot and does a defense
full outside off again, moves back and cuts it past point for a couple
good length outside off, onto the backfoot for a push but misses it
tossed outside off, stands straight up and slogs it straight over long-off for a six
tossed on leg, nudges it nicely of his pads away to short fine leg but no run there
flighted on off, tries to play a inside-out drive over covers but plays it straight into the throat of mid-off at the top of the circle
quick on middle-leg, onto the frontfoot to defend and gets inside edge away to on-side for a quick run
tossed outside off, goes for a sweep but gets a bottom edge and taken cleanly by shahzad behind the stumps, wickets in quick succession for afghanistan
quicker ball first up to sikandar and driven nicely straight by sikandar to the bowler
good length outside off, lets it through to the keeper
good length outside, pushes at it of the backfoot but misses it, dawlat is the getting some late swing going on here
good length outside off, punches it of his backfoot but to the cover point fielder
back of length outside off, pushes it into the pitch towards point with soft hands for a quick run
good length outside off, lets it through to the keeper
