flatter and quicker on middle, Pandey turns it to midwicket

short ball, which doesn't really come on, and Pandey awkwardly inside edges a swipe to midwicket. Beautiful over from Shakib, replete with all that makes him a great bowler. Changes of pace, trajectory and line - and all of them were impossibly subtle
gets fifty and brings Colombo to its feet! A simple flick through midwicket does the job

comes down the pitch but doesn't get to the ball, so he makes sure to drive along the ground to deep cover. Good bowling from Nazmul, slowing it right down, giving nothing for the new man to work with
full on leg stump, works it to long-on
smacks a full and wide delivery to long-off
very full on middle, and Rohit digs it out from the blockhole to extra cover
fierce straight drive, and good on Nazmul to bend down and thrust his hands at a ball which might well have been singeing the turf as it left Rohit's bat
scoops the full delivery from around the wicket to the right of cover
lifts a full delivery outside off to long-on
punches the back of a length delivery to extra cover
slower short ball, completely messes with Pandey's bat swing as he inside edges the pull to square leg
steps out of his crease and drives the full one on leg stump to long-on

taken at long-on! Rohit's gone and Bangladesh have pulled ahead in this final! India's captain has been timing them like a dream all night. But this time, going for a slog sweep at a ball that doesn't really give him enough room, he skews it high rather than long
shortish on off stump, pushes it down to long-on. That's Vijay Shankar's first ball in T20Is. What a time to face it...
full on middle, drives to extra cover
slower ball on leg stump, he flicks it only as far as short fine leg
it's on a length on middle stump, Vijay Shankar lets it come on and whips it to the right of deep square leg
outside edge wanders over third man to bring up Pandey's first boundary of the night. It's full and wide, he looks to smear it over cover, but will take the result anyway
slower ball outside off, he is beaten by the lack of pace as he outside edges to short third man
yorker on off stump, Shankar can only keep it out
carves the short ball outside off out to deep point and Mushfiqur is yelling himself hoarse as the fielder gives up two
full and outside off, Pandey slogs to long-on
full and outside off - it's the cutter - and Shankar's loft over cover just doesn't come off. There's a slip in as well from Shakib. Good captaincy
another cutter, and Shankar has no clue. Looks to swipe it over midwicket, and ends up getting hit on the body.
full toss, outside off, Pandey smears it to the point boundary, well to the left of the deep point fielder. Looks like he's finally getting his timing right

yorker on middle, Pandey slices it to deep point and races back for the second as well. The throw is flat but it's just wide enough that in the time Mushfiqur takes to guide it onto the stumps, Pandey is safe
in the slot outside off, but Pandey skews it out to long-on, along the ground, mistiming it

yorker on middle, Vijay digs it out and looks for a single. It's very risky, Sarkar only needs to go a couple of steps to his right to collect it. The throw is underarmed. Vijay gives up. But the ball misses target

run-out chance at the stirkers' end, after Pandey drills the yorker back down the pitch and looks for a single again. Sarkar collects the ball, hurls it at the stumps and breaks em perfectly. Replays however indicate Pandey got his bat down in time
swings wildly and the back of a length ball outside off goes away unpunished
good length ball outside off, Shankar looks to punch it through the covers, but the offcut beats him again. Outrageous skill from Mustafizur
full and outside off, it grips in the pitch and darts sharply past Shankar's swishing bat. He's not happy it's not been called a wide
full and outside off, goes for the slice behind point, and is again beaten. Four balls, each time beaten. Mustafizur is on the cusp of bowling a maiden in the 18th over a final! What a talent!
strikes him on the body as he shuffles across and looks to swing it over the leg side.  Pandey gets his partner through for a leg bye

taken at long-on! What an over from Mustafizur! He's the game-breaker! Continues bowling full and wide outside off. Pandey does manage to get bat to it, but his slog has no timing. Wicket maiden from Mustafizur in the 18th over
low full toss and DK pummels it over long-on! Comes in, sets himself up, standing outside his crease, and lifts the ball straight over Rubel's head. This T20 is see-sawing all over the place!

heaves it to the right of long-on! And Colombo goes beserk! DK gets his back leg outside off, sets up a strong base, and slogs the half-volley away to the boundary. Rubel's yorker goes wrong and India's hopes rise up

and it's outta here again! DK is in #BossMode. This is the six Mahmudullah hit to bring Bangladesh into the final and now he watches it from the opposition camp as a full delivery on leg stump is heaved over square leg.
slower ball outside off, DK looks to cut, but he misses it. Mushfiqur goes for the appeal, but there is plenty of distance between bat and ball
comes down the track and hammers the back of a length delivery to long-off

scoops it to the long leg boundary! What an innings! Rubel is one of Bangladesh's bankable bowlers because of the pace he generates. But here all of that pace has worked in India's favour. Like here, with fine leg up, DK brings that shot into play by first moving way down leg to draw the bowler outside off, then gets in position, down on one kneeand sends it soaring away into the night sky
full toss down leg, Vijay Shankar can't get bat to it, he can't get a bye either -might have been run-out if Mushfiqur had hit - but the umpire does his job and calls a wide.
length ball, perfectly set up for the smash down the ground, but Vijay Shankar is unable to put bat to ball.
full and outside off, drives to extra cover for a single
yorker outside off, DK skews it out to deep point and it's only a single
picks the gap at third man! It's a very full ball outside off, and that tiny bit of room is just what he needs to plant the open face down on it and send the ball between point and third man
length ball around middle and cutting the batsman in half as Zazai was neither forward nor back, nice carry to the keeper as well
length again, around middle and leg, defends it towards short midwicket, Rabada tumbles in his followthrough but all good. Some repairs at the landing area
a touch fuller this time, around middle and off, Zazai pushes it towards covers without much foot movement
fuller again, just around the off stump, defends it towards cover-point from the crease
short of length on the stumps, 141 kph, but looked like it came slower off the wicket, Zazai was early into the flick, gets struck on the thigh
a full toss on the pads and flicked away behind square leg, off the mark with a boundary
fuller around the off stumps, comes forward and defends confidentially
length ball once more and angling away from the right-hander, left alone once again. Good carry to de Kock
short of length this time and much closer to the batsman, good bounce as well, Noor Ali sways away
length ball on the stumps, and leaving the batsman, Zazai was once again looking to work it on the leg side, gets squared up
in the air but safe. Length ball and Zazai goes for the pull, fails it middle it but it falls in no man's land towards midwicket
short again, Zazai cannot help but go for the pull, not in the full control but swivels to keep it down, a single to fine leg
length ball on the stumps and angling in towards the batsman, Zazai flicks it towards fine leg
length ball in the channel and angling away, Noor Ali looks to drive on the up, more of a push to be honest, gets beaten
back of length around off stump, stays back and taps it towards point, still not off the mark
and he is off the mark. Fuller outside off, and Noor Ali finally connects a drive, not from the middle of the bat but enough on it to beat the point fielder on his right and go all the way
fuller again, on middle and leg this time, taps it towards short midwicket for a quick single
short of length but down the leg side, Zazai leaves it alone and collects a wide
short of length on the stumps, dabs it behind square leg for one
short of length around off, goes for the pull but ends up dragging it towards deep square leg
length ball around off, comes forward to block, gets an inside edge on to the pads
length ball around off, comes forward and blocks. Once again the ball finds the inner half and deflects on to the pads

length ball around off and Zazai once again clears his front leg and goes for the pull, ends up top-edging it towards midwicket, Morris chases it from mid-on but the ball is always going away from him. Gets his fingers to it but the ball keeps travelling towards the boundary line. Van der Dussen puts in a desperate dive but cannot prevent the boundary
fuller around off and goes for the drive, it was in the air but between cover and point and that's back to back four for Afghanistan
length ball on the stumps, gets behind the line and defends it on the leg side
length again, around middle and off, defended on the off side this time
length ball around off, comes forward this time and opens the face of the bat to defend it towards covers
fuller on the stumps, comes forward and drives it back towards the bowler
short of length around off, gets on the back foot and looks to punch it through extra cover, mistimes it towards the bowler
short of length outside off, gets on his toes and taps it towards point
snorter! Length ball outside off, takes off after landing, Noor Ali does well to pull his bat away in the end, de Kock collecting it near head height
short of length in the channel, too far from the batsman to invite any interest, left alone
fuller on the stumps and angling in, Zazai misses the flick and gets beaten. An appeal for lbw but was going down clearly
goes for the yorker but the line is outside off, Zazai looks to jam his bat at it, misses
short of length outside off, Zazai goes for the cut but it's too close to him and also he's late on the shot, gets an edge but well short of de Kock
slapped through extra cover! Length ball outside off, Zazai backs away and flat-bats it through the off side for four
length ball on the pads, tucked away towards the right of short fine leg for one
short of length and moving away from the batsman, who takes his eyes off and sways away
short of length on the pads, looks to flick it away and misses, gets hit on the thigh

finally South Africa get their field positions right! Length ball around off, Zazai knows one way to deal with those, backs away and goes for the pull, doesn't quite middle it and van der Dussen takes a low catch sliding in from deep midwicket
length ball around off, defends it from the back foot
short of length outside off, in the corridor, left alone
short of length around off, stays back and defends it towards covers
short of length around off, defends it towards cover-point with an face
short of length outside off, Noor Ali sways away from the line
length ball around off, pushes at it but the bat turns in his hands, was in the air for a bit but well short of the bowler
short of length outside off, defends it on the off side from the back foot
short of length outside off, stays beside the line and dabs it towards cover-point
short of length outside off, and whipped past the diving cover fielder on left for four
a touch fuller outside off this time, and Noor Ali goes for another drive, in the air this time as he ends up slicing it. Well short of the point fielder
fuller around off, comes forward and drives but fails to beat the cover fielder

fuller and much closer to the batsman this time, Rahmat Ali comes forward and turns it towards midwicket, Morris sprints in from mid-on and has a shy at the bowler's end. A direct hit and Rahmat would have been on his way back. Instead he's off the mark

did it carry? Doesn't look like. Length ball outside off, Noor Ali moves towards the ball and pushes at it, gets an outside edge but looks like it landed just short of du Plessis at second slip. He's not sure and they are going upstairs. Soft signal is not out and it stays not out as replays show it was just short of du Plessis
length ball outside off, stays back and punches it towards extra cover
length ball outside off, goes for the drive and misses as the ball jump up after landing
fuller on the stumps, looks to flick it on the leg side, gets an inside edge on to the pads
fuller on the stumps, drives it towards short midwicket
length ball outside off and another outside edge as Rahmat is stuck at the crease. De Kock was moving towards the leg side and cannot reach there in time. For Amla first slip, it lands too short
length ball outside off, left alone by the batsman this time
short of length around off, defended towards cover-point from crease
length ball around off, stays on the back foot and defends on the off side
short and way outside off, tennis-ball like bounce. Noor Ali leaves it alone, a glance at the square leg umpire in hope of a wide, but not called
length ball around off, comes half-forward and defends
length ball around off, defends it with an open face towards point
fuller on the stumps and driven back towards the left of the bowler, was in the air for a while but Morris cannot reach there, the mid-off chases it all the way and pushes it just inside
length ball on the stumps, gets behind this and pushes it towards short midwicket
short, attempted bouncer but Noor Ali picks it up early and pulls it over square leg for four, that brings up the fifty as well for Afghanistan
length ball in the corridor, left alone
fuller around off, comes forward and drives it gently between the stumps and the non-striker, mid-on cuts it off
short of length outside off, steered past the point fielder for a couple
bouncer on middle and leg, Noor Ali had no problem in ducking under that
short of length outside off, looks to push at it, gets an outside edge but there is only one slip where Amla can just watch it go towards third man, a tumbling stop there by Tahir to keep it to two

fuller on the stumps, Rahmat Shah looks to flick it away and misses, struck in front and given. Rahmat has a discussion with his partner goes for the review just in time. The only question is if it was heading down. Pitched in line, impact in front of middle and leg, and would have gone on to just clip the leg stump. Umpire's call there and that means Rahmat has to walk back
length ball on middle and leg, dabs it towards square leg
fuller around off, was looking to defend first before changing his mind, tries to leave but too late. The ball hits the face of the bat and dribbles towards third man
a thick outside edge past backward point, was fuller around off, Noor Ali was looking to flick it through the leg side, gets lucky and collects a couple of runs to the right of third man
length ball around off, stays in the crease and defends it towards cover-point
a touch fuller on the stumps, gets behind this and blocks down the wicket
short and wide, cuts it off the back foot, beating the diving backward point on his left
fuller around off this time and Noor Ali brings out the extra-cover drive, gets a good stride in but somehow doesn't get enough power behind it, mid-off cuts it off
short of length around off, sways away from the line
fuller outside off, squeezes it towards point, no run though
full and straight, in the slot for a drive, but one hand comes off the bat as it is mistimed into the covers
pounding out a good length outside off, shaping towards the cordon and left well alone
ploughing away outside off again, another judicious leave from a very determined and watchful Hashmatullah
lays bat on ball this time, an uppish waft out to short cover
short and sharp, Hasmatullah leans inside the line to leave it alone
driven with intent to mid-off, can't pierce the field

absolutely plumb! Full, straight, shaping in... a waft across the line, and I can't believe they are reviewing this one! Aha ... there was a tickle of an inside edge! That'd be why then! He had a chat with Hashmatullah before reviewing, which suggests he wasn't sure he'd hit it either!
fast and back of a length, zipping through to the keeper, once again no stroke
flicked from outside off down to third man, a deft swish of the wrists
a touch of inswing on a good length, shaves inside a loose drive, through to the keeper
another leave-alone ... whatever the plan is, it isn't changing in a hurry
tighter to the pads, nudged off the hip down the leg side
shaping across the left-hander, Hashmatullah draws his bat inside the line to leave alone
an extra grunt of effort behind that delivery, as Noor is beaten by a beauty outside off, that really climbed off the deck
outside off, curling away, through to the keeper with no stroke offered
tight line to off stump, stabbed into the covers with minimum footwork

driven, with hard hands, outside off, and a fat edge is gobbled at slip! Precisely the restart that South Africa needed. Hasmatullah was lured by one that seemed just that touch too close to leave alone, but the angle kept taking it away from his best intentions
over the wicket, tight line to the right-hander, who props forward to block

bowled him first ball! That's a massive arrival, a ripper of a googly, pitch-perfect, on off stump, twisting through the gate as Noor has no idea what's hit him. Catch me if you can, you can imagine the rest from Tahir!
tossed up, onto the toes, flicked to the leg side to get off the mark

looped up, leading edge, Tahir gobbles the catch in his followthrough and flees the scene as if he's just scrumped an apple from an angry farmer! This is an utter meltdown from Afghanistan, completely unsettled by the interruption. Asghar was playing across the line outside off, again no clue which way the ball was biting. There's trouble at t'mill now...

back of a length, outside off, a flaccid waft of a cut, and he's only gone and wrecked his own stumps! Nabi was the glue in this lower order, the man who might be relied upon to rebuild. But that was too close to cut and the under-edge does the rest!
wider on the crease, fired in towards off stump. Blocked to cover
banged in short, sways inside the line
back and across, nudged to the leg side
short and lifting sharply past the nose as Ikram sways
looped up, into the blockhole. Defended
flicked to the leg side, from deep in the crease
beaten in the flight, but adjusts well to crunch a drive past short cover
outside off, poked to point off the back foot
round the wicket to finish the over, another probing full length, clipped back to the bowler
this is a lovely set of deliveries, hitting a good length and letting the ball blab as it climbs past the edge
fully forward, angled into the gap on the leg side
firmly blocked once more, an excellent over in the midst of an excellent spell
on the back foot, punched with an open face to short cover
full length once more, dipping on the left-hander's off stump and deflected to the leg side
stretching forward and blocked back down the pitch
another googly, twisting from a middle-and-leg line and blocked to cover
full length, speared into the toes and clipped to deep midwicket
quality shot! They've been a rarity in this innings, but that is a truly pleasing cover drive, high elbow, full face, into the gap
back-to-back boundaries! But he doesn't know much about this one, a flimsy drive, inside-edged over his leg stump!
solidly forward and another good-looking drive straight to the man this time
fuller, faster, 137kph, thumps the pad as it angles down the leg side
fully forward to block
attempted sweep, deflects off the knee! Outside the line so no appeal, but Amla at slip can't intercept
belted through the covers, a half-stop cuts off the boundary as the sweeper tidies up
short and sharp, but sliding down the leg side as Rashid ducks
another bouncer, good aggression but leg-sided again. A yorker in the pipeline?
length this time, as Rashid swings into a violently ambitious pull but can't connect
formidable bludgeoning! That's the Afghanistan we know and love! Clearing the front foot, cowboy-ing through the line and dispatching a murderous drive through the covers!
flicked back to the bowler, meeting the full length
hopping onto the back foot, defended with intent
lots of air, dipping on the crease, luring a smoked kipper of a lofted slog, inches short of short midwicket!
back of a length, poked wide of point for the single
back of a length, slapped on one knee through cow corner. Effective thwacking
short and to the point! A sharp lifter from just back of a length, cracks the gloves as Rashid chooses to stay in line for once...
outside off, nipping off the seam, through to the keeper
round the wicket, cramping the left-hander with a tighter line into the stumps. Uneasily blocked down into the crease
back of a length, climbs past the edge as Ikram curtain-rails his bat inside the line
ripper! Nibbling off the deck from a full length outside off, genuinely beaten on the back foot
thumped down the ground, meeting the low full toss with a loose swing through the line
round the wicket, hitting the deck hard, defended from the back foot
tight line on the left-hander's off stump. Blocked once more with a cordon of two slips lurking
flipped off a full length to mid-on
over the wicket, tailing into the right-hander, solid block and a bit of a mix-up in the running. Rashid isn't interested
yee-har! Well, why not... very full, have a slash, what's the worst that could happen? Well, it somehow misses the stumps, so not that ...
swept with authority through backward square! That's lovely timing and placement
swept again, beats the field again! A touch more hurried, a quicker slider, but it was missing leg, and Rashid helps it on its way

crashed over the leg side, but van der Dussen is right back on the rope! It was a quicker delivery, and Rashid picked it well, but he needed to get under the ball more to clear deep midwicket. That's probably curtains for Afghanistan, but it was fun while it lasted...

slogged into the sky to seal the deal! That was short and to the point. Back of a length, whack it wherever ... except straight up in the air of course. Any number of fielders could have converged, but the skipper took responsibility, standing almost on the umpire's toes to gather.
length ball in the corridor, left alone by Amla
length once more, but way outside off. Amla, who has taken a leg-stump guard, is not interested
straighter this time, once again on the similar length, punches it towards short midwicket
on the pads this time, Amla goes for the flick but misses, a leg-bye as the ball rolls to the left of the keeper
short of length around off, de Kock was looking to play but withdraws at the last moment as the ball jumps at him after landing
angling in towards the batsman, pitched on a length and kept coming in, de Kock shoulders arms, and the ball passes over the stumps, Ikram fumbles a bit behind the stumps while collecting
length ball around off, defended from the back foot
a touch fuller and Amla goes for the drive, cannot get past the cover fielder
short of length outside off, Hassan too getting that extra bounce, left alone by Amla
short of length around off, Amla gets on his toes and punches it towards short midwicket
short of length outside off, punches it behind point for one
fuller around off, comes forward and flicks it towards short midwicket
length ball outside off, a bit of away movement off the seam, left alone by Amla
length again, but still outside off, no movement as Amla shoulders arms once more
length around off, comes forward and defends solidly towards covers
length ball on the pads, Amla goes for the flick but misses and is struck on the thigh
length ball outside off, looks to drive on the up but ends up chopping down towards extra cover
length ball outside off, de Kock was looking to play at it but changes his mind in the end
short of length outside off, opens the face this time to guide it towards third man
fuller around off stumps, comes forward and drives it towards mid-off, finds the fielder with pin-point accuracy
fuller again, drives it towards the left of mid-off this time, only a single though
short of length outside off, dabs it down towards third man once more
length ball on the stumps, de Kock stays back and blocks
length ball on the pads, flicked away towards square leg for one
short of length outside off, Amla goes for the cut but ends up chopping it towards covers

length ball on middle and leg, Amla once again fails to connect the flick. An appeal for lbw but not given. Was heading down it looked like but Afghanistan want to review this. Replays confirm it would have missed the leg stump easily
short and Amla swivels to pull this one, not in full control though. Dribbles towards fine leg
length ball in the corridor, left alone by Amla. He's taking his time here
another short one, 137kph, Amla goes for the pull but was late on the shot, gets an inside edge on to the body
short of length outside off and moving away, Amla sways away from the line
short of length outside off, Amla rises with the bounce and punches it towards cover-point
short of length on the stumps, looks to work on the leg side, gets an inside edge on to the pads
short of length outside off, looks to flick it towards midwicket, gets an inside edge on to the pads
short of length outside off, surprises de Kock by the movement and extra bounce who was looking to push it on the off side, withdraws his bat a bit
length ball on the stumps, de Kock stays back and defends
short of length outside off, punches it towards point, straight towards the fielder
short of length around off, de Kock stands tall and punches it back towards the bowler. That's 11 dots in a row, de Kock is a bit frustrated
fuller around off and de Kock drives it through extra cover, finds the gap and the boundary to break the shackles
length ball in the corridor, left alone by Amla
short of length around off, Amla goes back and across and taps it towards square leg for a quick single
a tad fuller around off, drives it towards extra cover, didn't middle it though
length ball outside off, left alone by Amla once more
fuller on the stumps and Amla shows his class this time with an on-drive, presents the full face of the bat and the ball races away towards the boundary
short of length around off, Amla looks to duck first but realises it's not bouncing much and drops his hand as well. That's the benefit of keeping your eyes on the ball
starts with a short one and de Kock doesn't miss out. Rocks back and pulls it towards the vacant deep midwicket area for four
short again but quicker as well, 97kph. De Kock goes back and punches it towards extra cover
a googly this time from Rashid, defended from the back foot
length ball around off, de Kock goes back and looks to turn it towards short fine leg, gets an inside edge on to the pads
length ball around middle, taps it towards short fine leg off the back foot
a touch fuller on the stumps, de Kock comes forward and pushes it past short midwicket, and gets a single to long-on
fuller on the stumps, drives inside out towards mid-off
length ball on the stumps, comes forward and taps it towards short midwicket
length ball on the stumps, pushes it towards short midwicket from the front foot
short of length outside off, punches it towards the left of Asghar this time who covers the ground quickly to keep it to one
short of length outside off, looks to punch on the off side, ends up chopping it into the ground
short of length outside off, a googly. De Kock slices it towards short third man
length ball around off, punches it off the back foot towards short third man, gets a single this time
a full toss on the stumps, thumps it towards the left of long-on for a couple
short of length outside off, goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
length ball on the stumps, pushes it on the leg side
short of length outside off, de Kock goes back and off ground to pull it towards long-on
short of length outside off, doesn't bounce that much, Amla pulls it towards deep square leg, fielder there
short of length outside off, pushes it towards backward point
fuller on the pads, flicked away towards deep square leg
short of length around off, a quicker one at 94kph. Amla goes back to cut and gets beaten
too full this time, on the stumps, Amla drives it back towards the bowler, Rashid dives to his right, gets his fingers to it. Just a single to long-on in the end
length ball around off, defended from the crease
length ball around off, de Kock goes back and cuts it behind point for a couple
short of length outside off, goes for the cut, gets an outside edge that races past short third man
short of length outside off, punches it towards cover-point for one
fuller outside off, opens the face of the bat to steer it towards point
short of length outside off, goes back and punches it behind point for one more
short of length on the stumps, goes back and pulls it towards deep square leg
short of length on the stumps, goes back and pulls it towards deep square leg
fuller around off, de Kock looks to drive it through extra cover, gets a thick outside edge towards point, a bit of sloppy work allows an extra run
pitched up on the pads, flicks it towards deep square leg
length ball around off, de Kock looks to cut it square, gets an inside edge into the ground
length ball outside off, cuts it straight towards short third man
length outside off, steers it towards extra cover for one
slower in the air, length ball around off, Amla defends from the crease
fuller around off, de Kock goes down on one knee and and slog sweeps it towards deep midwicket for four
short of length outside off, chops it towards short third man, a bit of misfield there and they come back for the second
fuller and flatter at 95kph, de Kock comes forward and blocks
fuller around off, Amla comes forward and looks to work it on the leg side, gets a thick outside edge behind point
brings out the reverse sweep, a premeditated one to a delivery fuller around off, beats short third man
length ball around off, stays back and defends
pitched up on the stumps, flicks it towards deep square leg
short of length around off and middle, goes back and dabs it towards square leg, de Kock was eager for a single but Amla sends him back
a touch fuller around off, looks to smash it through covers but loses his shape, the ball hits the inner half and rolls on the leg side
short of length around middle and leg, de Kock goes for an aerial pull, one-bounce to Rahmat at deep midwicket but makes a complete mess of it and lets it go through
a slower one on the pads, flicked along the ground this time, Rahmat does better this time
floated around off, de Kock skips down and looks to work it on the leg side, an inside edge on to the pads
fuller and wider this time, driven towards deep extra cover but only one there
length ball around off, Amla moves back and across and looks to flick it away, mistimes it
Amla playing some unorthodox shots here, fuller around off, Amla goes deep and lofts it behind square leg for four
length ball around off, defended down from the back foot
full length, on off stump, steered with an open face through backward point
solidly into line, on off stump
swinging into the blockhole, clubbed to short midwicket where it is stopped with a tumble
clouted up and over the leg side! Didn't get a proper hold on it, but that was dangled outside off stump and boshed with glee into space at long-on
a slow-turning offbreak, outside off, tapped to backward point
round the wicket, looped into the slot, de Kock yawns into a one-kneed dump over the leg side, but doesn't get a hold of it
outside off, a bit of a harsh wide as de Kock misses with another smear
firmly forward, head over the ball on off stump

belted through the leg side, but that's a stunning intercept! Mohammad Nabi at midwicket, reaches to his right, snaffles a fast-travelling slap off the toes, de Kock is a bit stunned by that, he thought he'd picked his spot well enough
firmly into line to block
looped up outside off stump, pushed to cover
googly, hard to read that one, and Amla barely does ... squirts it away through the leg side in a tangle of limbs
slides down the leg side, but he was a long way across his stumps
reverse sweep, a trademark stroke, not quite nailed
pushed onto the back foot to defend
leans back for the cut, placed out to the cover sweeper
an ambitious mow, dribbles to the leg side
on the back foot, blocked to mid-on
head right over the ball, a full-faced block. Proper cricket!
more lift off the deck outside off as Nabi slides this on with the arm. Amla is beaten on the cut
worked back towards the bowler, on the leg side. Tidy over
slammed into the leg side! From nowhere, fireworks!
right behind the ball, blocked again
a bottom-handed flick to long-on. Lalalalala ...
reverses the hands for the sweep, misses
hurrah, he's nailed another one! Back of a length, banged through cover with a scything cut
lots of air, launched down to long-off ... there's fielder lurking but it falls just short!
driven with no footwork, into the off side
cheeky ... a slower-ball bouncer, loops into Amla's arc, so he opens the face to run a single to third man
bouncer, and Andile sways inside the line
short once more, too short this time as Phehlukwayo doesn't even think of a stroke
yorker! Well bowled, right into the toes, dug out with no idea where the ball has ended up. Right at his feet is the answer ...
fired down the leg side ... very delayed from the umpire, who was perhaps wondering if the ball had clipped the pad
full and straight, and pushed to mid-off ... for the love of God ... won't someone have a swing!
flicked to leg ...
over the wicket, hits a length on off stump, 81mph and Burns blocks into the covers crabbing across
bit of shape back in to the left-hander, defended towards midwicket
Burns shakes his tail feather, squints at mid-on, blocks
good line, 134kph/84mph and hitting the seam as Burns gets across his stumps and leaves
touch short, probing in the channel and nearly drawing the batsman into playing, Burns whipping his bat out of the way at the last moment
pushed through quick and flat from round the wicket, goes back and cuts as the ball skids on
tossed up and met with a solid front-foot block
floated up, bit of drift towards leg stump, prodded away to midwicket
flatter outside off, Burns cuts firmly and it squirts out of the grasp of the man at point, Malinda Pushpakumara... trundles just short of the rope
goes round the wicket, angled in around off stump and defended to the on side
pitched up and worked for one more off the legs
pushed through, slightly leg side and Jennings drops back, clips the ball through square leg
drops a touch short, Burns rocks back and cuts as the ball spins away, hits the toe of the bat
flighted around off stump, presses out to defend
goes back and cuts again, this time there's a single to the man at point (Mathews, not Pushpakumara, now)
zipped through, still not much in the way of turn, Jennings defends
banged in short, Dickwella springs high to take the grab above his head and then let rip an appeal... Lakmal seems less convinced, though he goes up, but umpire Ravi didn't see any top edge there
length, Burns comes across and defends
testing line, 84mph, this nibbles in a fraction as Burns defends, gets a thick inside edge
fullish, this time Burns shows it the full face in defence
tapped down to the leg side
flat delivery, straightening on off, Burns blocks
pushed through outside off stump and Burns cuts firmly, Mathews makes a tumbling stop at point
back of a length in the channel, 136kph/84mph and Burns stabs it down towards point
slightly short again, outside off and Burns defends, hits the inside edge and deflects on to his thigh pad
pitched up, swerving in under the eyeline, driven smartly back along the ground but straight to mid-on
gets into line, defended square
fired in straighter and Burns works it down to the leg side - another maiden for Lakmal
presses forward on off and defends towards cover
drifting in and worked into a gap on the leg side
tossed up and defended

bowled, kisses the top of off! Dilruwan strikes, the length was perfect and Burns misses trying to cut off the back foot! Misjudgment from the opener, who had looked the more composed of the two... done by the ball skidding on
overpitched, full on off and YJB just belts it matter-of-factly through the covers, races away across this glassy, sun-baked outfield for four from his first ball
shuffles into line and lets the ball go outside off
slightly back of a length, 134kph/83mph and Jennings drops the hands
over the wicket, length and nipping in a fraction, defended solidly
length on off stump, YJB shows it a diligent straight bat in defence
tossed up on off and Jennings attempts to reverse-sweep, first time we've seen that today
over the wicket to YJB, touch short outside off and driven crisply off the back foot
full on the stumps, Jennings connects well with a reverse-sweep but picks out the fielder again
pushed through, this straightens a touch, defended going back
leans into a cover drive, stroked for one
over the wicket, pushed through and turning on off stump, paddled fine and that will run away for Jennings' first boundary

he's picked out the freshly positioned catcher straight away! Flicked off the pad and into the bread basket! Jennings lingers, perhaps wondering why he played that shot, maybe hoping it hadn't carried... but after consulting together, umpires Ravi and Gaffaney are happy to send him on his way. Straight off the face of the bat and snagged a couple of inches above the turf, Pushpakumara chips in with his fifth ball!
round the wicket, spinning in with a tweak of the wrist, defended to leg
this spins and hits the inside edge, deflects on to the pad but pinballs short of slip
floated up, loopy stock ball from Sandakan and YJJB sweeps with the spin for one
full and flighted, punched back to the bowler
tossed up and turning in from outside off, punched away off the back foot
tossed up around off stumps, comes forward and blocks
given air once again, blocked on the front foot
slower again, on middle and leg, pushed gently on the off side
swept from outside off, from the middle of the bat, gets four to deep midwicket
a touch fuller, around off stump, Bairstow comes forward and offers a solid textbook block

tossed up outside off, Root was looking to work it on the leg side, comes out of the crease and gets beaten in the air. And so does Dickwella as the ball spins past him. That would count as a missed stumping
fuller this time, turned away towards short midwicket for a quick single
fuller outside again, Bairstow comes forward and looks to block. A shout for lbw but it looked like there was some inside edge involved, the impact might have been outside off too
pitched up once more, Root comes forward and smothers it
a low full toss on middle and leg, tucked away towards square leg

a huge shout for caught-behind. Denied but Sri Lanka have reviewed. It landed around middle and spun away as Bairstow pushed forward. Nothing on the UltraEdge as replays confirm. It didn't hit the body, so the third umpire isn't checking for lbw. And that means Sri Lanka have lost the review
pitched up on the stumps, Bairstow doesn't over-commit himself this time, stays back and balanced and defends it towards cover-point
full and down the leg side, sweeps it towards fine leg to bring up England's 50
another sweep, Bairstow this time takes it on the full and sweeps hit firmly towards the deep square-leg boundary
another boundary, this time on the other side of the wicket, it was short and wide, Bairstow quickly transfers his weight back and cuts it past deep backward point
swept behind square this time from outside off, once again taken on the full and struck firmly, gets a couple
Sandakan shortens his length this time, Bairstow comes forward and looks to defend, an inside edge on the pads
swept finer this time, towards fine leg for a single
length ball, comes forward and blocks it
fuller on the stumps, drives it inside out towards long-off
uses his feet and comes long way down the track, it was bowled on leg stump, Root was misses the flick but no chance of lbw, way too down as I said
tossed up on the stumps, comes forward and blocks
swept for a six this time! Was full but on leg stump, Bairstow unleashes the slog sweep this time and sends it over the square-leg boundary
Root now, sweeps firmly, takes it from way outside off and lofts it towards the vacant deep midwicket region
length ball, on middle and leg, punched towards long-on for a single
looked like a googly, pitching way outside off though as Bairstow doesn't time the sweep well, rolls towards the right of the keeper
tossed up on the stumps, comes forward and defends
fuller on the stumps, flicked away by Root but the short-leg fielder intercepts
length ball, around off and middle, blocked
tossed up outside off, a big stride forward from Bairstow to smother it
goes past the outside edge again! Pitching on middle and spinning and bouncing away as Bairstow looks to work it on the leg side
a touch fuller and wider, defended on the front foot
driven inside out with the spin, was uppish for a while but away from the diving short midwicket, gets a single
flatter and quicker, coming in with the arm, Root goes deep and defends
fuller outside off, Bairstow stays in the crease and defends
tossed up on middle and leg, looks to flick but gets an inside edge on the pads
tossed up around middle and leg, spins past Root as he looks to glance it away, Dickwella couldn't come around quickly to prevent byes
flighted around off, comes forward and blocks
length ball, just outside off, Root comes forward and blocks
pitched up once again, around off and middle, blocked
full around off once more, pushed towards covers
fuller around off and middle, flicked towards short midwicket
tossed up outside off, Bairstow pushes forward, gets an inside edge on the front pad
short of length outside off, goes back and punches it towards covers

spins back sharply this one as Root was looking to cut, gets hit on the pad. A big appeal for lbw, and denied. Lakmal thinks for a while before going for the review. Sandakan's foot is just behind the line there, perhaps a millimeter. No bat involved there but the impact is just outside off, there goes Sri Lanka's second review as well
paddles it fine, takes it on the full and comes back for the second
length ball, around middle and leg, flicked away towards square leg, straight to the fielder
length ball, around middle and off, Root goes back and defends
here's the sweep once again, taken on the full and swept towards square leg
length ball, hardly any turn this time, comes forward and defends, an inside edge on the pads
length outside off, stays along the line and punches it on the off side
fuller this time, comes forward and drives straight to extra cover
length ball, on the stumps, goes back and blocks
use of feet by Root to come down the track and take it on the full, pushes it towards long-on to bring up the 50-run stand
length ball, on the stumps, Bairstow stays back and blocks
brings out the sweep this time, hits it hard towards deep square leg for a couple
length ball, on the stumps and spinning back, chopped towards short midwicket
another sweep, even better connection this time, bisects the two fielder in the deep and races away to 40
length ball, on middle and leg, flicked towards square leg
full outside off and swept wide of mid-on, England are sweeping it to all parts of the ground now
length ball on middle and leg, Root stays back and keeps it out
a paddle this time, gently done and comes back for the second before fine leg cuts it off
fuller outside off, driven to extra cover
fuller outside off, comes forward and pushes it back towards the bowler
tossed up in the air, just around off, Root comes forward and defends
length ball, on middle and leg, Bairstow moves across and sweeps, leg slip comes in the way
pitching down the leg side and spinning further away as Bairstow was shaping up for a flick
swept past the leg slip this time but there is some protection at fine leg
length ball, just outside off, Root drops it in the covers and sneaks in a single to bring up England's 100
swept towards fine leg by Root this time, gets a single
over the wicket, hits a length as Root comes across and blocks
pitched up, Root gets a stride in and strokes the ball to cover
sliding in full and straight, Root works it behind square on the leg side
fullish on middle and leg, YJB bunts it towards mid-on
length outside off, 135kph/84mph as Bairstow presses forward, gets an inside edge and that rolls into a gap leg side
on to the front dog and blocked towards mid-off
pushed through and turned to the leg side
over the wicket, flat on off and Bairstow works it with the turn, square leg tidies up
pushed through, Root defends from back in the crease
pitched up, tailing in a touch as Root punches to mid-on
full length, met coming forwards and dinked into the covers
good length and prodded away on off stump
wider line, 135kph/84mph and Root drives away from his body, well stopped by the diving Dhananjaya in the covers to prevent a single
fullish in the channel, Root is forward and drives with an open bat face through backward point
angling in on off, watertight defence from Bairstow coming forwards
floated up full, turned into the leg side
flatter on off, YJB defends
tossed up nice and high, Root defends from the crease
advances down the pitch once again and drives to long-on
slighlty back of a length in the channel, left alone
fuller outside off, met on the front foot but there's no timing in YJB's drive
suffocating lines from Lakmal, preventing Bairstow from freeing his arms... defended again. Good test for the patience of England's new No. 3
dug in short, decent bumper over off stump but YJB crouches out of harm's way
another bouncer, 136kph/84mph and again he takes evasive action
flighted, this spins sharply down the leg side as YJB flicks at it
drops a touch short, Bairstow brings out the heavy-duty rhubarb and clubs four through point
floated up, spinning a touch to hit the thigh pad
flatter delivery, YJB punches to mid-on off the back foot
tossed up and swept, flat and hard for one into the deep - that's his fifty, first in his new berth up the order. Wave of the bat, and on he goes
flicked off the legs, shouts of 'catch!' but that hasn't carried to midwicket! Kusal Mendis scampers across after it on his knees
pitched up, cutting his fingers over it, Root pounces on a drive but picks out cover
full in the channel, tailing back in slightly as Root gets forward
pitched up, 129kph/80mph and driven to mid-off
floated up on off stump, Bairstow is down and sweeping through backward square
flighted, Root steps out and pings a drive to mid-on, misfielded but Bairstow doesn't want to risk the run there

round the wicket, tossed up and straightening... Dilruwan goes up for lbw, but Gaffaney shakes his head! That looked mighty close to me, but SL have no reviews left. Was a touch leg side, maybe height the question?
floated up and clipped into the leg side coming down
tighter line, rolls his arm over on off, Bairstow is forward in defence
tossed up and straightening a touch, forward block from YJB
gives it a tweak, full and smothered again
drops short and that is battered like a piece of cod from Whitby Bay, cut powerfully through point for four!
floated up full, YJB gets out to defend this time
stays round the wicket, Bairstow flicks through midwicket
pushed through and YJB stays in the crease to defend
another big lbw shout, Bairstow hit on the pads sweeping aggressively... not given! Again Gaffaney shakes his head, again it looked close; again SL can't go to the DRS
lobs up the stock ball, spinning in but it's a touch short again and Root this time hammer-of-Thors a cut for four
worked away to the leg side
tossed up and Root is low to dab a reverse-sweep fine for a couple more
floated up on off, pushed to cover
tossed up and defended

oh dear, that wasn't part of the script... Root's top-edged a slog-sweep to midwicket! Wicket for Sandakan and it's the big one, England's captain and tone-setter; he's played that shot regularly and well, but this time loses his shape and perishes to what looked an ungainly hoick
slips in the googly but it's short and leg side and Bairstow raps a pull into the deep for one
stays over the wicket to the lefty Stokes, flighted outside off, tapped away
HUGE appeal, Stokes playing across the line and hit in front of off stump! No reviews and S Ravi shakes his head! Might have been just spinning too much
extra bounce, skidding on outside off as Stokes cuts hard and misses
tossed up and straightening on the stumps as Stokes defends
swept fine from outside off, a single to short fine leg
fuller around off, comes forward and blocks, bat-pad close
short of length and spinning away, Stokes was looking to cut it away, extra bounce beats him
pitched up on middle and leg this time, comes forward and blocks
fuller, just around off, blocked on the front foot once again
pitched up further, Stokes stays in the crease and defends
length ball, in middle and leg, blocked
a touch fuller on the stumps, driven towards long-off for a couple
short of length, on the pads, flicked away towards square leg
fuller on the pads, flicked away towards midwicket
short and down the leg side, Stokes goes back and pulls it hard, four to backward square leg
length outside off, spins it away and Stokes leaves it alone
fuller and outside off, pings it towards extra cover
down the leg side and spinning further away, Bairstow shows no interest there
much better, tossed up outside off, defended on the front foot
left alone but that wasn't too far away from the off stump. It was a touch fuller outside off but Bairstow lets it go, he covered his stumps though
length ball, on the stumps, goes back and punches it towards short midwicket
use of feet this time to drive it down the ground for a single
short and wide from around the stumps, Bairstow goes back and cuts it in front of covers for four
length ball, coming back in and cramping the batsman on this occasion, chopped on the leg side
length ball, around middle and leg, stays in the crease and blocks
a touch fuller this time, comes forward and blocks
a touch fuller around off, Stokes comes forward and blocks
fuller on off, turned away towards mid-on for a quick single
length outside off, goes back and cuts it late, gets a couple to deep point
goes for the sweep this time and gets a single to backward square leg
full down the leg side, goes for the sweep but misses
drops short this time and Stokes is up to it, rocks back and pulls it towards deep midwicket
fuller around off, driven towards the right of the bowler who makes a diving stop
pitched up again, driven towards extra cover on this occasion, straight to the fielder
goes for the reverse sweep this time and beats the man at short third man
fuller outside off, pushed towards covers
edge but falls short of de Silva at first slip. Was a length ball and Stokes was again playing back, pushes at it and gets an outside edge, all safe in the end though
too full this time but doesn't that doesn't stop Bairstow from sweeping it towards square leg
another reverse sweep but a good stop there but short third man, prevents a boundary
length outside off, comes forward and pushes it on the off side for a quick single
fuller this time, comes forward and turns it on the leg side
dropped short, Stokes goes back pulls it... on to his own shoe
length outside off, defended on the front foot
tossed up outside off, Bairstow looks to drive, gets an edge but falls short once again
length outside off, punched back towards the bowler off the back foot
length outside off, comes forward and smothers
fuller around off, driven but straight back
slower in the air, pitching on a length around off, defended with soft hands
length around off, comes forward and defends
swept and swept well, was full around off and Stokes hits it towards the vacant deep midwicket region
length around off, goes back and defends
struck on the full this time as he looks to sweep square, a big appeal from the bowler and the keeper. Denied again and the Sri Lanka players are not very pleased, that looked close
short of length outside off, goes back and punches it towards deep extra cover
swept firmly this time, behind square for four but a bit of hobble as he set off for the run
length ball, defended on the off side
length outside off, surprised Bairstow with some extra bounce there, who withdraws his shot at the last moment
length ball, just around off, comes forward and defends
length ball, on the pads, flicks it away behind square leg
length ball on middle and leg, clipped towards short fine leg
a low full toss, pushed towards long-on to bring up the 50-run stand
short of length outside off, goes back and punches it towards long-off
tossed up outside off, comes forward and looks to defend but the ball beats the inside edge, Bairstow got a big stride forward, impact too might have been just outside
almost squaring Stokes off there, length ball, Stokes was stuck in the crease as he looks to defend, the ball spins away and hits the outer half
fuller outside off and driven towards extra cover
length outside off, defended on the off side
pitched up, driven towards long-on for a walking single
fuller outside off, Bairstow looks to sweep but misses, he's not feeling comfortable, hobbles away after the ball, might be some cramps
down the leg side, Bairstow looks to flick but misses, a big appeal for caught-behind but the umpire is not interested. UltraEdge shows a bit of spike as the ball goes past the bat
length ball, defended from the crease
length again and another block
keeps coming in with the angle and beats the bat to hit Stokes on the pads, was going down
fuller on the pads, flicks it away towards square leg
length around middle and leg, comes forward and blocks
short of length, goes back and punches it towards long-on
length ball, on the pads, flicked away towards deep backward square leg
length ball, just around off, stays in his crease and blocks
uses his feet this time and lofts it over the bowler's head, all the way for a six, just an extension of arms and off it goes
length outside off, defended very watchfully from the crease
round the wicket, tossed up on off and punched back to the bowler stepping across
tight line, flighted and straightening a touch, YJB blocks
defended down the track
flattish delivery outside off, YJB is back in the crease and chopped towards cover
round the wicket, defended on the front foot
Stokes goes back this time, worked through the leg side, raises the England 200
stays in the crease and flicks to the leg side
over the wicket to Stokes, spinning in to hit the pad as he plays back... heading down leg
floated up full, Stokes reverse-sweeps, slip takes the catch - bump ball, though. He'd nearly set straight off looking for one
floated up full on the stumps and Bairstow sweeps, looks to be hobbling his way up the other end... maybe just a bit stiff, after a long day out in this heat
full and in the slot, Stokes carves himself a big slice of pumpkin pie! The full thanksgiving over midwicket for six!
on the stumps, YJB defends
flatter outside off, Bairstow drops back and stabs into the covers
floated up and paddled away fine on the leg side for a couple
flat delivery outside off, goes back and opens the face on it for one
on the stumps, worked away through the leg side, they'll come hustling back for two... that's a half-century for Stokes, grafting hard after a difficult start
tossed up on middle and off, leans out to defend
flighted, skipping on outside off, YJB dabs a back-foot shot for one through point
pushed through and driven hard into the ground, Pushpakumara does well to grab it on the bounce leaping above his head
floated up on off stump, Stokes strokes it down the ground for one
slows his pace up outside off, spinning in and glanced towards backward square leg from the crease
drops back and defends outside off
oooh, leg slip nearly in business... Tickled off the pads, a bit like Keaton Jennings earlier today, but bounces short of Dhananjaya
flighted, goes for the sweep this time, loops up and over the head of leg slip for a couple! Maybe came off the forearm, but the runs go next to his name in t'book
tossed up on leg stump, poked away
bowling round the wicket, Bairstow goes for an aggressive sweep but doesn't get hold of it
pushed through and Bairstow flicks it off the front foot, into a gap square on the leg side and they hurtle back for two - YJB moves on to 98
floated up and defended on the front foot

floated up, straightening on the stumps, Bairstow sweeps behind square - that's his hundred, greeted with a throaty roar! Off comes the helmet, a ruddy grimace in celebration as he looks to the stands! A century on his comeback, England's first at No. 3 for two years
drops short and Stokes collars him, muscled away through backward square leg
tossed up on off, defended
ripping break from off stump towards leg, Buttler struck on the knee roll! Must have been heading down leg, umpire Ravi unconvinced
Bairstow defends on off stump
floated up and defended on the front foot
angled in flat with the arm and YJB turns it to the leg side
tossed up outside off, tapped square from the crease
Sandakan lobs the ball up nice and high, Buttler defends
pitched full but around leg stump and he can clip it square with the turn to get off the mark
flighted, nice bit of drift and dup, then spins back sharply from outside off, just past the timbers as Bairstow leaves, a little uncertainly

tossed up full and YJB sweeps, skids into the front pad, SL go up for lbw again... Umpire Ravi demurs! Maybe outside the line of off? Bairstow looks like man who's just fallen off a treadmill, heaves himself up off his haunches
floated up on the stumps and this is swept for one
angled in, sliding down the leg side
flighted, outside off and met on the front foot
looped up on leg, maybe the wrong'un but Buttler flicks it away without drama
floated up full and defended pressing forwards
lobbed up outside leg, Bairstow misses with an attempted sweep
flighted, gets across to defend
flat delivery on the stumps, defended pressing forwards
on the stumps and flicked into the leg side for one
lobs up a full toss outside leg, Buttler clips it through backward square

bowled 'em, Bairstow's done! Went for a big hoy over midwicket, the ball dipping and slipping through to hit leg stump! Sandakan has his third, ending a special innings from YJB, who has sweated buckets and deserves a rest in the sheds
pushed through from over the wicket, defended square
flighted, taken on the full and clipped out to the cover sweeper
round the wicket, tossed up and blocked
full toss outside off, Moeen bunts it away
pushed through on middle and leg, Buttler goes back in the crease and nudges square
pushed through and Buttler attempts to force a cut, nearly succeed in chopping on
connects sweetly this time, too full and Buttler glides across to ram four through the covers
now they go up for caught behind... but umpire Ravi isn't interested! Big spin from just outside off for Sandakan, but I think it did just too much!
length ball from around the wicket, cramping the batsman for room, chopped towards short midwicket
fuller outside off, smashes it straight to mid-off
down the leg side, looks to paddle but misses
just goes over the leg slip, but off the thigh. Length ball, spinning back as Buttler looks to glance it
flighted outside off, beats the bat as Moeen pushes at it
flatter and quicker this time, outside off as Moeen leaves it alone
fuller on the stumps, Moeen defends as the ball takes the inner half and rolls towards square leg
tossed up outside off, slapped towards mid-off from the front foot
tossed up on the stumps, clipped towards short midwicket
length ball, pitching outside off and leaves the batsman to beat the outside edge as he looks to defend
fuller outside off, nudges it towards extra cover
pitched up on the pads, tucked away towards square leg
fuller outside off, pushes it towards covers
on the stumps and spinning back sharply, flicked towards short midwicket
fuller on the stumps, defended on the leg side
short of length outside off, punches it towards cover-point for a single
length outside off and spinning away, Moeen leaves it alone
short this time, goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
slower through the air, length outside off and left alone
length outside off, goes back and punches it towards covers
sweeps and sweeps well, length ball and spinning away but Moeen hits it all along the ground, in front of the square
length outside off, this one comes slower off the surface, Moeen waits for it before defending
a touch fuller this time, defended again
fuller outside off, Moeen drives it to the right of the bowler
length ball, pitching middle and spinning down, helped on its way by Foakes for a single
fuller outside off, chips it uppishly but in the gap through extra cover, long-off comes across to cut it off
short this time, swivels to pull it behind square, but only a single
fuller outside off, Foakes digs it out to mid-off
a low full toss on off and middle, Moeen uses his wrists to work it towards deep midwicket for a couple
fuller and spinning away, Foakes comes forward and blocks
length ball, on the stumps, defended on the back foot
length around middle and off, Foakes plays back and blocks
another length ball and Foakes once again goes back and blocks
a tad shorter, just around off, Moeen comes forward and blocks
length outside off, punched towards the right of the bowler, who dives across to make the stop
fuller outside off and driven gently towards covers
pitched up again, comes forward and defends
length ball, stays in his crease and blocks again
fuller outside off, pushed towards extra cover
dropped short and Foakes goes back and pulls it hard, not from the middle but enough on it to take it to the square-leg boundary
swept firmly and beats the man at deep square leg once again, back-to-back fours for Foakes
length ball, angling down the leg side, Moeen is happy to let it pass
dropped by Karunaratne at first slip, length ball outside off, Moeen pushes and gets an outside edge, but Karunaratne grasses the chance
fuller on the pads, turned away towards short midwicket
beats the outside edge this time, length ball, Moeen looks to defend but plays inside the line, beaten
gets an under-edge on this sweep as it goes past the stumps, gets a couple of runs to fine leg

an appeal for lbw and given! Moeen reviews straightaway. It was a length ball and came in with the arm, Moeen was playing for the turn, gets beaten and is rapped on the pads. But replays show it would have missed the leg stump, more agony for Sri Lanka
gone this time, Foakes it's. Was a length ball, Foakes goes for the cut but it was too close for him, Dickwella pouches the outside edge
fuller on the stumps, comes forward and blocks
fuller outside off, comes forward and pushes it away
a touch fuller around off, Rashid comes forward and blocks
length ball, comes forward and defends, the ball hits the glove on its way to the pads
beats the outside egde. Length ball outside off, Rashid was looking for the spin and gets beaten as the ball goes straight on
drifting leg side and tickled around the corner for one
pushed through outside off and glided for a single
lobbed up full, defended towards backward point
steams in and hits a length, 83mph outside off, tight leave but Rashid judges it well
full in the channel, driven firmly but can't get it past cover
good length, threatening to come back a touch, no stroke... and Lakmal jangles his wristbands in frustration
good length, still a touch wide, Rashid shoulders arms
full, on the pads and Rashid whips like he's a member of Devo, all bottom-handed insouciance for four through midwicket!
back of a length, worked away through backward square for a couple
round the wicket to Rashid, solidly defended off the back foot outside off
more on middle, defended to short leg
swept over leg slip as Rashid hits the ball into the ground. Away for four. All runs will be precious here
outside off, and Moeen is not interested
lovely flowing push through the covers. It was there to be hit, and Moeen's not the sort to miss out on a caress through the covers!
on a fullish length on off. Defended
defended through point and they take the single on offer
on leg stump and worked through backward short leg for a single
short of a length and Moeen defends to short leg
a shimmy down and defended. When will Moeen launch this over, if at all?
back of a length, defended through cover and no run taken
hint of turn and Broad defends back
tossed up outside off, Rashid pushes to deep mid off for an easy single

who can take a five-fer? The Sandakan can, that's who! Broad bowled round his legs! Immediately tries to sweep to a very full ball and beaten. This is so full it should have been a full toss. England collapsing quickly, and no Sammy Gunnar Solskjaer to bail them out this time
pushes forward outside off, thick inside edge through square leg for a single
back of a length, worked through the covers and it's an easy single
outside off, no turn this time and Leach defends
dances down and defends back. Leach keen to settle in to a long blockathon spell
left alone once more. Athers comments that Broad is running off a shorter run
finally goes straighter, on the pads, and defended. Broad definitely off a shorter run up
tight line outside off, left alone
tighter line on off. Gunathilaka defends
defended to short mid-wicket. Karunaratne has no intentions early doors of doing a Leach
full on off, Karunaratne pushes it to mid on and they take a quick single
on leg again from back of a length, worked to short leg
lucky for Gunathilaka! Goes for the sweep but doesn't connect at all well. Top edge, but lands at 2/3rds fine leg. True no man's land
Broad dangles this carrot outside off, but Karunaratne's not interested in a nibble
again kept outside off, again DK says no thank you
full this time, a bit wider and it's left alone
hint of movement away, and left alone once more
Broad goes back to the outside off line, and it's left comfortably alone
round the wicket on a length to off. Defended
Gunathilaka pushes forward and defends to short leg
outside off this time, and it's another solid prod
very, very full. Defended back to Leach
on leg this time, defended with as much fuss as Mrs Doyle making a cup of tea, and it's a maiden
encouragement for Broad. Bit of extra bounce outside off and Karunaratne fiddles at this. Carries through to Foakes
dropped! Flew to Root at slip, he moves to his right and he can't hold on. Worse for England, it's away for four. Root din't get a hand on it, as that hit him on the wrist. That flew quickly
on middle and Karunaratne is back to being solid
on off and defended this time. A great contest between these two
stifled appeal for LBW as Leach goes full, but two sounds, so probably an inside edge. Indeed, a big olde edge
back of a length, Gunathilaka doesn't play a shot and they try to sneak a couple of leg byes. No shot offered, so dead ball called
full on middle. Defended back
full toss as Gunathilaka wanders down the track. Worked down to long on for a single
left alone outside leg, a probing over nonetheless
back of a length, defended to short mid-wicket
outside off, Gunathilaka leaves well alone
back of a good length, defended
good line outside off, forward defence from Gunathilaka
again in that corridor. Just a smidgen too short for Gunathilaka to worry about playing
on off and there's a moment's hesitation as this is driven to mid on. Fortunately for Sri Lanka, no definitive call of a single taken
back of a length, pushed into the off side and they take a single
forward push from Karunaratne, defended to short mid-wicket
back of a length this time, defended to the same area
good length from Leach, defended by DK
defended to short leg as Leach probes
full and straight, tight line, solid defence
very full once more, still at a decent pace, high-elbowed defence, back down the track
shuffling down the pitch, nudged to the leg side
reverse-swept, and superbly so. Oodles on bat into the stroke, whistling through the now-vacant backward point
flicked to the leg side
on the pads, tucked to the leg side
outside off, turning away, nudged down to third man
blocked to the leg side
another fine bit of bowling, less menace than the first ripper, but probing away outside off with appreciable turn
chiselled to short midwicket where it is half-stopped
swept high and hard out to the leg side! Brief shouts of a catch, but Broad at square leg can't pick it up, and Burns at midwicket is sent floundering

Jennings bags another blinder! Absolutely roasted into the leg side as Gunathilaka galloped down the pitch, but Keaton, under the lid, shimmied along the intended line of the shot, like a well-trained goalkeeper, then somehow absorbed the wallop into his midriff, toppling backwards to cushion the blow and secure the breakthrough for England! He's
round the wicket, looped onto a good length, defended to the off side
attacking the toes with a looping full length, calmly driven into the covers
firmly forward, head over the ball, blocked back down the pitch
round the wicket, clipped to the leg side, another single to the cause
round the wicket, looped into the blockhole, with men all round the bat
driven firmly, lots of bottom hand, into the covers
flicked on the up into the leg side
sharp turn from back of a length, nudged to the off side
beaten outside off... sharp turn on a probing line
a scudding drive, inches wide of Bairstow at long-off! Absolutely clobbered, but he was forced into the gamble by Leach's probing line. Nearly!
on the back foot this time, tidy work as Dhananjaya defends
chipped in the air, just short of mid-on! The pressure is building all the time ...
too short from Leach and that's excellently dispatched, leaning back to glide through the covers
reverse swept, and superbly timed and placed. Stokes rushed round from slip but couldn't intercept
outside off, swished airily to deep point
good bounce from outside off, a cramped cut to cover
on the back foot, tucked calmly to the leg side
elegance! Slotted sweetly through the covers as Moeen serves up a hint of width. Lovely shape in the high-elbowed drive
a fraction too short as a sighter, languidly pulled out to deep midwicket
attempted pull as de Silva takes on the googly, and Foakes can't grasp the deflection as the ball seems to brush glove, bat, something ...
full first up after lunch and pushed through wide mid off for a single
good line on off, over the wicket, and defended
full from Broad and Karunaratne carefully drives to Moeen at mid off
on middle, defended through the leg side and they briefly think of a single. Plenty of scurried 'no's
finds the edge, but doesn't carry! Karunaratne is looking to drive, gets a thick edge which doesn't carry and it's away for four
on off and Karunaratne returns to being Mr Blockington. No run
too short first up and pulled with the imperiousness of a mollusc. Smashed through backward square leg to bring up the 50 partnership
much fuller on middle and watchfully defended
full on middle and leg, defended to short leg
flighted full and driven to short cover
back of a length, DDS behind it with full funk
good length outside off, solidly defended from Dhananjaya
good length on off, Dhananjaya carefully plods his bat in front of this
back of a length, pushed out to short cover
bit of turn, but nice and slow so Karunaratne can cut out to cover for a single
forward then back from Dhananjaya and defended to point
class in a biscuit tin! Lovely shot from Dhananjaya, who gets down the track and drives sweetly through mid off. Gorgeous
back of a length and worked to short leg
tossed up and driven down to long on. Dhananjaya looking in fine fettle
worked through the leg side and they get a single
outside off, solid defence
full on off, driven to mid on. Broad's keeping a very probing line on the whole

outside off and nearly a moment of brilliance from Stokes. They think it's an easy single through point. Stokes swoops, turns and throws, and it just misses the stumps. Dhananjaya would have been in trouble had that hit
very full on leg, clipped out to the boundary rider at deep mid-wicket
slog sweep goes wrong, but it lands safe. Dhananjaya having a few moments and he nearly perishes. Lands in square leg region. Denly as a sub fielder can't get there from mid-wicket
full outside off, DK defends
full on the pads, clipped silkily out to deep mid-wicket. Dhananjaya back on strike
short and outside off, DDS cuts to backward point
full on off, bunted back to Leach. Sri Lanka still somehow only one down
Karunaratne jabs down on this, as Broad goes back to outside off
again keeping it outside off, Karunaratne watchfully defends
oh that's sexy! A sumptuous straight drive. I genuinely gasped after that, that's how gorgeous that was
off the outside half of the bat through cover point. Just a hit of turn from Leach
full with plenty of flight and Dhananjaya defends
very full once more and solid defence once more from Dhananjaya
full on leg, another smothered defence
full once more from Leach, who's searching for just that smidgen of turn, and defended once more
round the wicket, back of a length and DK defends
outside off, Karunaratne probes forward
too short, and cut out to cover with enough time for them to trot like otters through for a single
outside off, defended
full but Karunaratne's to the pitch and defends back to Root, who hurls it into Foakes
fuller this time and it's defended once more
full on off and it's defended to point
shorter this time and straighter, defended back
slider down leg. Hits the pads, but going down leg. Something for Leach to work with
full on middle, defended
too short and cut comfortably out to deep point
tossed up and very full. Dhananjaya's to it and defends
on the pads but too far down leg. Takes a smattering of the pad and rumbles away for four leg byes
back on to the outside off line. Karunaratne defends once more
driven gracefully to short cover
shortish, Dhanajaya waits for the turn and cuts out to deep cover
full and flighted, defended back to Leach
Dhananjaya pushes forward as Leach sticks this on off. England trying to build some pressure here
slightly short so Dhananjaya can rock back and milk this down to long off
tossed up, driven through deep cover and that's Dhananjaya's 50. A couple of strokes of fortune, but he's been resolute
full from Moeen, driven to short cover
just a whiff of drift, driven down the ground for a single
appeal for a catch at short leg. There were two noises, but will Root review? He chooses not to
swept finer than Miller singing Johnny Cash and that's the 100 partnership up. The first for Sri Lanka this series!
sweep like Bert from Mary Poppins. Out to deep square leg just for a single
solid push forward as Leach goes outside off
short, waits for the turn and cut to cover
on the pads this time and worked to short square leg
full on middle, DDS smothers
driven down the ground and they meander through for a single
swept round the corner for a single
a touch short, worked through point
tossed up, driven to short cover, no run
on middle this time, Karunaratne smothers it
back of a length, tucked to the leg side
flicked down to long on
reverse swept, but straight to backward point
fended back down the line of the ball, high elbow, full face
good line, straightening from round the wicket, and blocked
blocked into the covers, shuffling on the back foot to keep things lively
back of a length from round the wicket, slow turn, nudged off the back foot to square leg
leaning out of the crease to block
leaning back on the cut, chopped into the covers
on the back foot, defended on the line of off stump
turning down the leg side, slow spin from back of a length, helped on its way
inside-out drive into the covers, watching the spin intently
tossed up and blocked urgently on the crease line
another big legbreak, but back of a length this time
short and turns sharply but slowly, steered out to deep cover off the back foot
looped onto a better line and length, jabbed in the air for a split-second past short leg
outside off, and through to the keeper
too short, too wide, too easy! Dabbed backward of point, Bairstow gives chase and slides well, just about keeping his foot off the rope as he clambers round to field
tossed up, and defended into the off side. More sharp spin but de Silva's footwork is equal to it
firmly blocked back down the line of the ball
a wild wipe! Rashid serves up a tempter outside off stump, and it keeps low as the swing of the blade finds thin air
lots of air, dipping late as Karunaratne advances. Short leg tidies up
turning down the leg side this time, but not by much! Just grazes over the bails as Foakes gathers
full and straight, a sweet drive as de Silva connects well, but straight to short cover
short and hauled down to backward square leg. Stokes mixing his length up
driven hard into the off side
low full toss, hint of outswing, firmly plinked to cover
shuffling into line on the back foot, blocked back down the pitch
on the pads, and clipped to the leg side
on the back foot, defended back down the pitch
worked off the toes, out to the leg side
walloped through the leg side as Rashid drags this one down a touch. Moeen in the deep tidies up
thumped back up the pitch, very full from Rashid
drilled into the covers, very full length
shorter, and swished through the leg side with an urgent pull
massive appeal from Stokes, but that's surely sliding down! Very full from Stokes, piercing the defences with a fast skiddy length, but they opt not to review
full length once more, and blocked
probing length on off stump, angled bat, stabbing the ball to cover
reverse sweep, that's beautifully played, as fine leg skids round to save the boundary
driven on the up, past the tumbling Rashid and down to wide long-on

flicked to Jennings at short leg! It's that man again, and it's another very sharp piece of work, albeit the easiest snaffle he's had for a while. It came quickly off the face of the bat, as Rashid dipped a full length into the toes, and Jennings plucked the offering in two hands, low to his left
very full, blocked back down the pitch
short and sharp, Mendis ducks
full and aggressive, thumping the pads but not especially adjacent to the stumps
back of a length, stabbed down off the hip to square leg
pushed back into the crease, short leg gathers
banged in short, and through to the keeper
punched on the up to the leg side
nudged into the leg side
banged in short, lollipops through to Foakes

ouch! Pinned in the ribs! That's taken the wind out of Dimuth's sails. Short and sharp from Stokes, rearing nastily from just back of a length, and thumping him right in the ribcage. The physio is out. He'll have a nice welt there by the end of the day
short again, but that's well played by Karunaratne, anticipating the bouncer, staying on top of his pull, rolling the wrists to fine leg
short again, ducked
plenty of slow, low turn, worked to fine leg from outside leg stump
back of a length, worked through mid-wicket. Easy singles on offer
