shortish on off stump. Looks to pull and ends up bottom-edging towards short fine leg
length ball pitching outside leg and angling into the stumps. Looks to flick and misses, and Kumara aborts his lbw appeal quickly
full outside off, driven to mid-off
full outside off, driven to deep point
back of a length, slanting away from off stump. Shuffles across to work it through square leg
back of a length, close to off stump, punched to deep point
good ball, in the blockhole close to off stump. Blocked into the on side
back of a length, close to off stump. Looks to punch into the gap between short extra and mid-off, and the former fielder throws himself to his left to stop the ball
back of a length on off stump, lets it come on and chops it to third man
full on off stump, clipped away to deep square leg

down the track and he gets exactly the line he wants. It's on his pads, on a length, and he whips it away in the air, but into the gap to the left of deep square leg. Looked like the fielder there - Lakmal - was a little late picking it up, and didn't move to his left quickly enough
slower ball, back of a length, pulled to long leg

ooh, nearly another wicket. Fullish, slanting away from off stump, but not quite full enough for the drive. Has to reach for it, and ends up spooning it in the air, but he finds the tiniest of gaps between the diving fielders at short extra-cover and mid-off
on the pads now and Miller flicks it away gratefully into the huge vacant spaces to the right of deep square leg
short, rising ball on off stump. Gets on his toes and chops it down by his feet. Wanted to play that towards backward point, I think, but didn't get the connection he wanted
starts with a wide, fired down the leg side. Duminy can't connect with the pull
fuller now, on leg stump, swept firmly along the ground to deep square leg
length ball angling into middle and leg, clipped into the square leg region
tossed up fairly wide of off stump, good work with the bottom hand to drag that sweep to the right of deep square leg
floated up wide of off, driven to the left of sweeper cover to bring up his second fifty of the series and the 27th of his career. He's looking properly dangerous now
full at Duminy's feet, clipped to short fine leg
tossed up slower, on a good length on leg stump. Defended with the turn into the covers
full on middle stump, driven to long-off
shuffles across his stumps and out of his crease now. Clips this middle-stump ball into the fine leg region
length ball outside off stump, driven to long-off
back of a length on leg stump, punched to long-on
length ball sliding on towards leg stump. Looks to drive down the ground, playing for turn, and it takes his inside edge and rolls to backward square leg
tossed up on middle and leg. Stretches out low and reverse-paddles through backward point
good length on leg stump, clipped watchfully into the on side
down the track and Akila shifts his line wider. Driven to sweeper cover
back of a length, turns from middle to off. Goes deep in his crease to whip this to long-on. Only three from the over, not a whole lot of ambition from these two batsmen barring that missed sweep

shot. That was fairly quick and fairly full outside off, and he gets down low in a flash and brings quick hands into play to sweep powerfully past deep midwicket, who didn't have a long way to move to his left
fullish outside off, defended into the covers
full on off, steps out and clips to midwicket
length ball on off stump, and Miller opens up his front leg and gets down low to slog-sweep along the ground, this time to the right of deep midwicket
another slider, going down leg. Miller is cramped for room as he tries to work it leg-side, and is hit on the back leg
length ball sliding on towards off stump. Makes a bit of room and squeezes it to the right of cover, who makes a good sprawling stop
quick and full outside off, and Duminy aims a reverse-sweep at it. Doesn't make contact, but does enough to unsight the keeper, and the ball runs away for four byes
slower outside off, swept to deep midwicket
low full-toss on middle stump, driven to long-on

shot. There's that slog-sweep again. Makes hitting room by getting his front leg out of the way, and he needed all that room because it was pretty full. Then he gets down low and launches it high over wide long-on
well done. Akila saw him switch hands for the switch-hit and bowled it wide of off (leg) stump. Sweeps it over the man at short third man and picks up four more
full, on the stumps, clips it, looking for long-on, and the bowler moves quickly to field it
back of a length on leg stump, tucked off the hip to the left of deep square leg
back of a length on off stump, clipped gently to the right of deep midwicket. No one in the circle in front of square on the leg side
short, close to off stump, pulled to the right of deep midwicket, where Dhananjaya stretches out his right hand to stop it
length ball slanting away from off stump. Shuffles across and misses the flick and the ball rolls off his back pad to the left of the diving keeper
short on off stump and that's a fortuitous boundary for Duminy. Goes hard at this pull, and bottom-edges it to the left of the man at short fine leg
shortish on off stump. Chopped into the backward point region for a quick single

in the blockhole - a low, dipping full-toss, actually -  on leg stump and that's dragged away for another four. Clears his front leg and swipes hard at it, and the bottom edge races away to the right of long leg
full-toss on the pads, and that's a bad ball. Clears his front leg and just whips it away to the left of deep square leg
short on off stump and he clubs it away. Clears his front leg and clears the midwicket boundary with ease to move into the 90s
slower ball on off stump. Makes a bit of room and carves it to the right of the fielder at deep point. 23 off that over
length ball slanting away from off stump. Lofts it to the left of the fielder at sweeper cover, and the fielder just about cuts it off with a sliding save
slower ball, full outside off. Shuffles across and clips to deep midwicket

full outside off, and Duminy misses out on a hundred. A splendid innings comes to an end, as he steps across his stumps and looks to swing this over the leg side. May have wanted to go a little squarer, but it was a slightly off-pace ball from Thisara, and he ends up hitting it straight down the throat of deep midwicket
low full-toss, slanting away from off stump. Opens his bat face and steers to third man
short, shoulder-high ball on off stump, leans away to make a bit of room, and Phehlukwayo is off the mark with a boundary. Just opens his bat face and steers it to the right of third man
back of a length on middle and leg, worked away to deep backward square leg
flat, angling into the pads, worked to short fine leg
very full on leg stump, jabbed back to the bowler
a bit slower now, still quite full on middle stump. Swept to deep backward square leg
length ball on middle stump and Phehlukwayo can't beat short third man with his reverse-sweep. Not enough pace on that ball from Dananjaya
fuller, driven to long-off
big appeal for lbw, and that isn't given. Very full, on or just outside leg stump, and Miller plays all around it. Pitched just outside leg, I think
wide half-volley, and Miller plays a flat-bat drive, in the air, to the left of sweeper cover. Poor delivery
slower length ball on off stump, and Miller clears his front leg, waits, and whips it away over square leg. This is his 11th ODI fifty

low full-toss on off stump, and Miller picks out deep midwicket. Clears his front leg, but can't get the leverage to get the elevation he wants. Dhananjaya takes a good catch, moving backwards, at just around head height

full on off stump and Phehlukwayo puts it away, though perhaps not where he wants. Makes room to hit it over the covers, I think. Ends up getting a thick edge that runs away between backward point and short third man
length ball on off stump, slapped away hard to the left of sweeper cover
short outside off, carrom ball, slapped to deep point
shot! Phehlukwayo has been brilliant so far, very decisive with what he wants to do. Low full-toss on middle stump and he reverse-sweeps over backward point
a bit slower now and Phehlukwayo is out of his crease in a flash to launch it high over long-on. Made a lot of room, and Akila couldn't do anything about it, even as he tried to fire it down leg
quicker one, ends up sliding it down the leg side
full on off stump, doesn't quite get to the pitch with his lofted drive and ends up chipping on the bounce to sweeper cover
full on the stumps, whipped to deep square leg
sees Phehlukwayo looking to make room and fires it wide outside off stump - too wide. Keeper fumbles and they run a bye as well
now he bowls a wide outside off stump to the right-hander too. This is really difficult, a spinner bowling the last over against a rampant side
finally, lands one in the blockhole. Looks to clear his front leg and whip it away, only manages a thick inside edge into his front leg
length ball angling across off, left alone
back of a length on leg stump, cramping Tharanga for room. Flicks to midwicket to get off the mark
almost played on! Nagging length outside off, and his attempted punch takes the inside edge to fine leg
back of a length on off, and takes the top of his pads before going through to the keeper. Appeal for lbw but it bounced way too much
full and wide outside off, and going further away. Looked like a wide, but not given by the umpire
full just outside off, and through to the keeper's gloves. Left alone by Tharanga. That's the end of the first over
length ball outside leg stump, but cramping Dickwella for room. Mistimed to the off side
length ball on middle, and defended off the front foot. Played to the leg side this time
back of a length on middle, and he opens his bat's face to run it down to point. Three dots
full outside off, and driven on the up past cover! First boundary of the innings as it races away to the fence
yorker just outside off, but Dickwella manages to shovel this back to the bowler off the front foot. Tried to drive through cover though

length ball outside off, and he comes down the wicket before driving - off the bat's toe end - past cover point! The fielder there dives to take a catch, but he can't get his fingertips to it, and that's the over's second four
length ball outside off, and cut away off the back foot. Straight to point
good length on leg stump, and Tharanga taps this towards the midwicket region for a quick single
good length on middle, and the ball's angling away from the left hander. He sticks his bat out and steers this rising delivery to deep point
back of a length on middle, and defended off the back foot. Cramped for space
full outside off, and driven firmly off the front foot. But mid off's there, so they settle for a single
pace! Raw pace from Rabada. Short ball on leg stump, and the ball's gone past Dickwella even before he could prepare to pull
full outside off, and he throws his hands at this. Cuts it hard, but drops just in front of Miller at point
full on off, and lifted over the infield! Goes all the way beyond the long-off boundary. Sexy shot!
drops his length this time. Lands on middle and pushed to cover for a quick single
straight to short cover! Faf makes no mistake. Full on off, and the drive pops into the infielder's hands. A couple of feet on either side and that would've been a boundary
slogs across the line! No time wasting from Perera here. Full on off, and struck over the long-on boundary. Boom!
good length on middle stump, and tapped to the leg side off the back foot. They scamper across for one. An entertaining over comes to a close
full just outside off, and check-driven off the front foot. Almost pierces the gap, but Hendricks' dive at cover point stops the boundary
full on middle, and that's a check-drive over mid on! Just a simple follow through of the bat, and Tharanga sends this into the wide boundary on the leg side
good length on middle, and he opens his bat's face to steer this down to third man
full outside off, and he pins a straight drive to mid off. No run
back of a length on middle, but he defends the rising ball from near his face
full on off, and the on-drive takes a leading edge and goes past cover instead! Enough time to come back for a couple
full outside off, and lifted with the angle over cover! Just past Duminy's outstretched hands, and off he goes to give it a chase
good length on middle, but the slower ball has been picked by Tharanga. Pulls over the infield, but the shot doesn't have enough behind it to go for four

soft! Off the bat's top half and Sri Lanka have now lost both openers. Short ball on middle, and the pull goes straight to square leg. Easiest of catches as Tharanga checks his bat's face on the way back to the pavillion
full on off, and defended off the front foot to mid off
edged past the slip cordon! Safely through to third man. A short ball outside off, for which the batsman stuck his bat out
full on off, but he's smashed this through the ball's line. Except, the shot comes off the bat's toe end, and somehow manages to clear mid off
back of a length on off, and Mendis ducks under this ball's line
length ball angling in, and nudged away to the leg side off his hips
good length on middle, and worked off his pads to the leg side
good length outside off, and the leg-side clip takes a leading edge to third man
good length on middle, and Perera comes forward to defend through to mid off
good length on middle, and pulled to fine leg

length ball outside off. KP is a little early on his attempted cover drive, and the bottom hand takes over. Ends up dragging it down the ground, past the diving bowler and between him and the non-striker

and again! Short this time, outside off. Goes hard and too early at the back-foot slap, and ends up flat-batting it down the ground, into the same gap between the bowler and the non-striker. This time, in fact, Mendis has to duck at the other end to avoid the ball
back of a length on leg stump, worked away through square leg
short, rising ball gets up to shoulder-height, just outside off. KP looks to hook against the angle, can't quite middle it, but keeps it down into the square-leg region
length ball on off stump and KM goes after it. Opens up and slogs it over mid-off
slower ball, full and fairly wide outside off, left alone
short ball, but he's cramped for space. Mistimes a pull to the leg side

length ball on middle, and he tries to muscle this into the leg side. But the ball was too close for the pull, and he's sliced it in the air. It's a skyer and Shamsi gets under it at mid on, but drops the ball, much to the fans' delight
length ball outside off, and Perera stands tall to slap this past cover! Some power

slow finger of death! But Perera wants to review. Has a chat with his partner, and asks for it. Was a length ball outside off, but angling into his pads, and hitting him on the back leg in front of middle stump. What does the replay say? It says 'umpire's call' with the ball clipping the top of leg stump. The decision stands, and Perera must go back!
length ball outside off, and punched through to the fielder at mid off to get off the mark
back of a length outside off, and he defends off the back foot. Mulder coming around the wicket to Thisara
angling down leg, and Perera has no trouble flicking this fine past the keeper's left! Beats short fine leg too
wide outside off, Thisara tries to cut it away, but the ball stays slightly low and sneaks under his bat. Through to QdK on the bounce.
full on middle, and that's a picture perfect straight drive down the ground for a boundary. Just to mid off's left

short outside off, and Perera tries to pull. Drags it from outside off, and it's in the air for ages. Faf is getting under it from square leg, but his diving effort is not good enough! But what's worse is that Faf may have injured his right shoulder. Out comes the physio...
full outside off, but through to the keeper with the batsman missing the drive. Mulder takes a fall on the pitch, but he looks okay
full and wide outside off, and Thisara goes for an expansive drive. He misses, and the umpire calls it a wide
good length on middle, and nudged off his hips to long leg. Enough time to jog back for two
good length outside off, and he defends firmly off the front foot. Played to mid off
good length just outside off, and punched back to mid off. Another dot
good length outside off again, and Perera blocks off the back foot. Played to cover on this occasion
back of a length outside off, and Thisara ducks away. But the ball doesn't bounce much, and therefore goes to the keeper at chest height
full outside off, and he swings through the ball's line. Chipped over mid off, and Duminy gives it a mighty chase
full on middle, and pushed to mid on for a quick single
good length on middle, and pulled along the ground to the deep midwicket boundary

slower ball on leg stump, and going down the leg side. Was there an edge though? QdK and Mulder think so. They're reviewing. And the South Africans were right! Spike off the UltraEdge when the ball passes the bat. Umpire Llong must change the decision! Amla and Miller also had a chat with the bowler before they went up for the review.
full on middle stump, and defended to the leg side
good length outside off, and tapped to cover off the back foot. No run on offer though
full outside off, and driven away from his body. But off the bat's toe end as it dribbles away to cover
full on middle stump, but going down the leg side. The umpire spreads his arms wide
slower ball! Lands just outside off, but Mendis remains patient. Defended back to the bowler
length ball outside off, but angling into Mendis. Takes a giant stride forward and defends
good length outside off, and that's been beautifully cut past the fielder at point. Work for Ngidi at wide third man, but he manages to intercept
full on middle, and worked away - off his pads - to the fielder at cow corner
good length outside off, and tapped back to the bowler off the back foot
full just outside off, and defended to mid on with soft hands for a quick single
full on middle, and the straight drive comes off the bat's inside half. Rolls away to mid on instead
good length outside off, and Mathews backs away to drive through the covers. Gets a good connecton too, but Hendricks - the debutant - puts in a diving stop to slow the ball down
full on off, and the front-foot defense takes a leading edge to mid on. Keeps Mulder and co. interested
good length outside off, but Mendis opens his bat's face, and guides this down to third man for a jogging single
full on leg stump, and flicked off his pads to long leg. Another single added to sri Lanka's total
slower ball, but full outside off. He muscles a drive to mid on, but can't make the most of it
yorker on leg stump, and shoveled over to mid off
good length outside off, and punched to mid off once more
good length on middle, and worked away to the leg side
length ball down the leg side. So wide that Mathews doesn't even bother chasing
length ball on off, but he comes down the ground - converting it into a fuller ball - before chipping this over the long-on boundary. Mathews means business!
good length on leg stump, and he swivels to pull! Placed perfectly to the right of the fine-leg fielder
full just outside off, and pushed to mid on off the front foot
fullish outside off, driven to the left of mid-off. Was in the air briefly
back of a length outside off, pushed to the left of mid-off
back of a length, a little wider. Looks to play that through point, I think, with an open face, and ends up edging it to third man
back of a length on off stump, defended to backward point
length ball on off stump. Calls for one after clipping this towards mid-on, but Mathews isn't interested and he has to turn back. Would have been risky in any case
shot. Shortish outside off and he leans back, waits, and chops it to the left of the diving backward point fielder. Third man runs around to tidy up
full outside off. Wants to drive this through cover, ends up playing a little early and hitting it towards long-on instead, off the inside half of the bat
full outside off, defended to short cover
shot! Length ball close to off stump and he stands there, waits, and clatters it away between extra-cover and mid-off, flat-batting it at the top of its bounce
back of a length on off stump, lets it come on and guides to third man
back of a length on middle stump, clipped to deep square leg

short outside off, gets up to shoulder height. Keeps his pull down, but in the process of rolling his wrists over ends up not getting the power he'd like on the shot, and midwicket moves quickly to his right to stop it

back of a length outside off. Stops on Mathews a little as he tries to punch into the covers, ends up playing it back towards the bowler. Maybe he needs to get more side-on to play that through the off side
back of a length outside off, punched to short cover
back of a length again, a bit of away movement after pitching. Defended into the covers
back of a length on off stump. Shuffles across and clips to the right of midwicket
steeply rising bouncer outside off, Mendis can't put bat to it as he tries to ramp it over the keeper
dug in short again, this time it gets up just over Mendis's right shoulder. He pulls it in the air, but on the bounce to deep square leg
back of a length, turning into the pads, tucks it to the left of backward square leg
fuller now, on leg stump, gets on the front foot to clip to deep midwicket
tossed up on off stump now, offers a little more swinging room. Mendis clears his front leg slightly and slog-sweeps to the left of deep midwicket
full on off stump, clipped to long-on
flatter length ball on middle and off, comes forward to defend with the turn into the on side
length ball on middle and off, possibly the googly. Mathews blocks it back to the bowler
short outside off, just gets up to chest height, and Mendis pulls it away confidently, to the left of deep square leg
length ball close to off stump, defended back to the bowler

short again, this one's banged in harder and rises over shoulder-high. Mendis goes for the pull again, and has to drag it from outside off as well. Can't keep it down, and Mulder takes an excellent low catch running in from the square-leg boundary. End of a promising innings
back of a length, slides this down the leg side, and de Silva can't connect with the flick off the hip. Sri Lanka's more famous de Silva loved that shot
slower length ball outside off and de Silva doesn't pick the change of pace. Presses forward to defend and the ball goes past his outside edge and bounces again before reaching the keeper
short, angling down the leg side. Another wide as de Silva misses the pull
fullish outside off, left alone
back of a length on off stump, shuffles across to clip to midwicket
floated up slow outside off, driven to long-off
dips onto a good length on off stump, defended with the turn to midwicket
back of a length, turning from middle to leg. Goes deep in his crease to work it to long leg, past the diving leg gully fielder
full outside off, driven to long-off
short, googly spinning away from off stump, slapped away to deep point
shortish, a bit of inward movement towards off stump. No room for an attacking shot and de Silva defends into the off side
short on middle stump, pulled to long leg
fullish outside off, can't time his drive and it rolls slowly to short cover
nicely timed, but too close to the fielder. Length ball, a bit of width, and Mathews drives on the up with an open face, and backward point moves quickly to his right to stop it
slower ball, full and wide outside off. Mathews misses the flat-bat square drive, and Nigel Llong doesn't signal wide but possibly thought about it
short, angling into off and middle, pulled round to deep square leg
shortish outside off, slapped to the left of backward point
on the pads, clipped to short fine leg
back of a length, turns in towards leg stump. Steps across and tucks it to short fine leg
slower now, more flight, on middle stump. Looks to drive inside-out, through mid-off maybe, and ends up playing too early and dragging it through midwicket with a lot of bottom hand
quicker one, not short enough to go back and whip through midwicket. Turns in quickly and hits him on the back pad, but strikes him outside the line of off stump
loopy full-toss, and Mathews is quick to get on the front foot and swipe that away, one bounce, to the midwicket boundary
back of a length close to off stump, defended towards backward point
shot! Length ball outside off, and he uses the hitting room to flat-bat that, on the up, between extra-cover and mid-off
length ball outside off, a touch shorter than the previous one. Presses forward and dabs with an open face to third man
ooh, looks for the off-stump yorker, and nearly sneaks through as Mathews makes room for the inside-out cover drive. He's lucky he makes just enough contact to dig it out back to the bowler
full outside off, driven to short cover
back of a length on off stump, clipped to deep square leg
down the track, meets this flighted off-stump ball on the full, and powers it back down the ground, into the boundary to the right of long-off
another loopy full-toss, this time wider outside off, swept hard and along the ground to deep midwicket
googly, short enough to read it off the pitch and defend in front of off stump
the stock ball, turning into his pads. Clipped to short fine leg. Sri Lanka haven't quite managed to beat that fielder yet
tossed up on leg stump, gets on the front foot and clips to midwicket
back of a length on leg stump, clipped to deep square leg
fullish, angling into off stump. Drives a little early, aiming for mid-off, ends up playing it to midwicket off the inside half of the bat
slower ball, shortish outside off. Pulls hard but straight to midwicket. Dhananjaya hasn't really been finding the gaps so far
short again, comes in towards middle stump. Swivels to pull to the left of long leg
full on middle stump, clipped to deep midwicket
short, angling way down the leg side, left alone
full on the pads, clipped away nicely and long leg has to throw himself to his right after a big sprint to cut that off. Phehlukwayo the fielder, does a fine job of keeping it down to two
back of a length on off stump, defended into the on side, with the angle
flighted and full on middle stump, jabbed back to the bowler
back of a length, turns into the pads, clipped to backward square leg

big appeal for lbw as Mathews misses the sweep. Given out, but it seemed like it might have been going down leg. Mathews turns and begins walking back before realising he can review this... Finally decides to take the review. No bat on it, let's see what ball-tracking says... pitches on about middle stump, and it's turning just enough to clip the outside of leg stump. Umpire's call, and that means Mathews will have to walk back
floated up on middle and leg, clipped to square leg
full on middle stump, defended to midwicket
tossed up on off stump, driven to long-off
fullish outside off, driven to sweeper cover
full on off stump, defended with the angle into the on side
back of a length on middle stump, clipped to deep square leg
back of a length outside off, steered past Duminy, diving left from backward point, with an open bat face
back of a length, angling into off stump. Defended from the back foot, and the ball drops down onto the batsman's left foot
back of a length outside off, and that's beautiful timing, punched with a vertical bat to the right of deep point
tossed up slow on leg stump, driven to mid-on
short, wide, slapped away to the left of backward point
full outside off, driven to long-off
tossed up slow and wide of off and Dhananjaya gets down on one knee and drives in the air, deliberately, to the left of extra-cover
floated up on off stump, clipped to midwicket
back of a length on leg stump, goes back and works it to deep square leg

short, angling down leg, pulled to the left of long leg and Phehlukwayo does good work, at first, to put in the diving save, before losing control of the ball and almost letting it roll to the boundary, before mopping up once more
length ball outside off, punched pleasingly on the up to deep point
back of a length on off stump. Wanted to punch that through cover, ended up hitting it back towards the bowler off the inside half of his bat
full on off stump, the angle across him gives him an extra bit of room and he uses that to free his arms and loft this over wide mid-off
length ball slanting across to off stump. Stays on the back foot to defend and gets opened up as he plays this to backward point
shortish on leg stump, worked off the hips to the right of deep square leg
tossed up on off stump, and he goes for the reverse-sweep. Not sure if that's where he wanted to place it, but it rolls off the face of his bat and nutmegs the keeper
he certainly hits this one where he wanted. Tossed up outside off and he gets forward to slog-sweep with a whip of his wrists, to the square leg boundary
back of a length, turning down leg. Tucked to short fine leg
flat length ball on leg stump, worked away through square leg
short and wide, cut away to deep point
back of a length on off stump, lets it come on and steers it to third man
length ball outside off, presses forward and guides to third man with an open face
full on middle and leg, driven to extra-cover
length ball angling into leg stump. Stops on him a little as he tries to flick, and it pops up briefly in the air towards the non-striker
bouncer outside off, Akila can't connect with the attempted ramp over the keeper
yorker angling into off stump, watches it well and jabs it out to deep point
good length on middle, and Akila backs away to carve a punch through to cover
half-tracker on leg stump, and that's been pulled off the back foot to deep mid wicket
full on middle, and he comes down the ground, before drilling a drive to long off
full on leg stump, and he sweeps to the backward square boundary. Man there though
full just outside off, and defended away towards cover
good length outside off, and it's been cut off the back foot to the sweeper fielder on the boundary
back of a length outside off, and he tiptoes before guiding this down to third man for one
short on off, and defended from near his face off the back foot

back of a length outside off, and pulled over the fielder at deep backward square! Great connection, and perhaps a bit of a top edge too. But that's what Sri Lanka need. Well, atleast ten more of them
back of a length again, and angling into Dhananjaya. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket on this occasion
good length outside off, and Akila tries to ramp it over the keeper. Misses out on any connection though
short on middle, and forcing the batsman to duck! The umpire, though, thinks it's wide
cramped for space again, but Dananjaya manages to drop his hands on this short ball, and taps it to the leg side for one
reverse swept! But straight to short third man. Full ball on leg stump, and Dhananjaya adjusted beautifully
full on middle, and driven off the front foot to mid on
length ball outside off. Spinning away from the left-hander, and cut to point for a quick run
full on middle, and this has been worked off his toes to the vacant square leg region
full on leg stump, and he uses his wrists to whip it away to square leg. Rotating the strike as much as possible
full just outside off, and he comes down the ground to drive. Played to long on, and that's his fifty!
full outside off, and he throws his hands at it, and manages to slice a drive behind point. It races away!
length ball angling in, and he mistimes a pull to the leg side. In the air for a while, but drops short of midwicket. Done in by the slower ball on this occasion
good length outside off, and he sticks his bat out to try and ramp it fine past the keeper's right. But QdK's diving effort to his right stops the ball, and saves three runs for certain
good length outside off, and cut off the front foot. Finds point though
good length outside off, and Akila tiptoes to tap this psat the fielder at point for one
tossed up on middle, and the straight drive comes off the outside of the bat. In the air, but drops just short of Rabada at short cover
full on middle, and driven to short cover once more
full on leg, and he comes dancing down the wicket, before lifting it inside-out over extra cover! Playing with a lot of heart
good length outside off, and furiously cut off the back foot. Beats forward point, but the fielder in the deep manages to intercept
full on off, and defended to short cover
back of a length on middle, but very awry from Phehlukwayo. Goes down the leg side
steered past short third man! Short and wide, and he opens his bat's face to deliberately edge this fine between the keeper and the infielder to his right
length ball wide outside off stump, but he fails to play the cut. The ball sneaks under his bat and goes to QdK on the bounce
good length on off, but once again taking the pace off the ball. Dhananjaya tries to pull, but misses the shot, and ouch, that's hit his groin!
good length outside off, and he pulls this down the ground to long on for a walking single
full on off, and he drills a drive to the leg side. Finds midwicket though. Was timed well. If only it was placed better...
length ball outside off, and the ball is going further away from him. He backs away to cut, and the ball beats the fielder at point!
overpitched outside off, but Dhananjaya makes room and plays a very late past point. Chase for the fielder, but he manages to pull the ball back
full outside off, and he goes down on one knee to try and sweep. Mistimed to the fielder in the deep
full outside leg stump, but Dananjaya yorks himself by coming down the ground. Shoveled to short cover
full outside off, and he goes for a wild swing across the line. Misses completely as the ball goes through to QdK
back of a length outside off, and his attempted punch comes off the bat's toe end. Goes straight down the ground to mid on as the batsmen exchange a quick single. Sri Lanka reach 250
back of a length outside off, and he tries to flat-bat it over the bowler's head. Off the bat's toe end, and mid off makes no mistake! The momentum shifts heavily towards the visitors once again
welcomed with a slower ball outside off. Driven to mid off for a quick single
short on off, and the attempted pull is top edged over the keeper's head! They'll take that
good length on middle, and defended off the back foot
right in the gut! Length ball angling in, and he misses out on the pull. Hits his body thereafter as Lakmal whimpers away to the off side
sees the batsman coming down the ground, and he bowls it short on leg stump. Forced to nudge it to the sweeper fielder on the leg side
good length on leg stump, but spinning into his pads. Flicked off the back foot to the fine-leg fielder
full on leg stump, but spinning down the leg side
full on leg stump, but the lbw appeal is turned down! He missed the leg-side flick, but looks like the ball pitched outside leg stump. Shamsi wants to review but stand-in captain QdK shakes his head
flighted on off, and spinning into Lakmal. Defended
full on leg stump, but spinning down the leg side. Lakmal tries to work it fine, but it hits his front leg instead
full outside off, and he tees up for the big shot. But all he can do is mistime to long on. He'll keep strike
short on off, and he pulls with the delivery's angle. Straight to Mulder in the deep, but on the bounce
good length outside off, thumped to mid off

slower ball outside off, and he launches it over extra cover! This is glorious from Dhananjaya - the lone warrior for Sri Lanka! Proper follow through of the bat, and that's his highest ever ODI score

good length outside off, but the attempted slog to the leg side does't come off. QdK holds on to it as the bowler appeals for a catch. Umpire Llong says no, but QdK is convinced. They review. Is that out? Looks like the ball went under his bat, and there's a thick under edge on UltraEdge. Oh dear, a beautiful innings comes to an end as South Africa go closer to a 3-0 lead
attempted yorker that's eventually a low full toss on leg stump. Tapped to midwicket
length ball on middle stump, and spinning into his pads. Worked down the ground to long on
full outside leg stump, and spinning further down the leg side
dream ball! Full on middle, and spinning enough to go between bat and pad! Crashes into leg stump as Jayasuriya misses the straight drive
good length outside off, but spinning further away from the left hander. Through to the keeper
full outside off, and defended off the front foot
good length on leg stump, but spins into middle and off. Fended off the back foot
good length outside off, and he goes for a big slog towards the leg side. Mistimed to deep midwicket
back of a length outside off, and soaring over Kumara's shoulders. Held by the keeper from near his face
good length outside off, and fended away to cover off the back foot
good length on leg stump, and he misses the flick fine past the keeper. Hits his arm guard
very full just outside off, and defended back to Ngidi. He has a shy at the stumps, and even breaks the middle stump at the striker's end, but Kumara was always inside the crease
good length outside off, and pulled away in front of square! Duminy gives it a chase, and parries it back from wide long on
good length on middle, and Lakmal shuffles across to the off side, before slogging behind square to the fielder in the boundary
full outside off, and the attempted slog over cover is sliced! In the air, but falls in no man's land. Mid off missing
good length outside leg stump, and he opens his stance to slog tp deep midwicket
full on off, and that's been drilled! Showing the rest of his team how to bat. Clears his front leg, and thumps it to the long-on boundary
turn and bounce! Full outside off, and spinning away from the batsman, eventually going into Amla's hands at first slip
good length outside off, and punched back to the bowler off te back foot
full outside off, but Lakmal's in the mood to tee off for every ball. Clears his front leg, but the attempted slog goes to midwicket
good length and slanting into off stump from over the stumps, Rohit camps back, tips the ball in front of cover point. Searches for a quick single but is sent back by Dhawan
similar length and attacking middle stump, Rohit gets right behind the line in defence. Played back to Rankin
fuller than a good length and straying into the pads of Rohit, 134ks, he plays around his front pad and flicks between square leg and midwicket to get off the mark
Dhawan takes a length ball on the up and laces it to Dockrell at cover-point. He throws himself to his right to intercept this hit
full on middle and leg, accurate stuff, 132ks, defensively pushed back to Rankin
shorter and angling across off stump from over the wicket, Dhawan gets on his tippy toes and fends if away to the covers to round out the first over - a good one from Rankin
low full-toss, angling into middle and leg, patted away to the right of mid-on
on a length and on a fourth-stump line, Rohit presses forward, meets the pitch, and blocks solidly to cover
full and straying into the pads, deflected away fine past the diving keeper for four leg byes
back of a length and outside off, Rohit aims to pump it through the covers but the ball does not come on. Inside-edged away to the leg side
full and angling in from wide of the crease, but the line from Chase is too straight, Rohit searches for an on-drive but instead inside-edges it away past short fine leg for four
full and just a shade outside off, driven through the line to mid-off
Thompson drops a return catch? Floated full and outside off, Dhawan looks to drive on the up but plays early and scoops it in front of the bowler. It does not carry to Thompson
here comes Dhawan: races down the track and launches it over mid-off with great authority. He gets close to the pitch and hoists this full ball away for a boundary
Thompson pulls his length back and attacks the body of Dhawan, tucked into the midwicket region for one
leg-side wide, Rohit can't connect with a flick
short on off, cramps Rohit for room, chopped to the keeper's right for one
Dhawan now launches a six over mid-on - the first of the day. On a length and outside off, right in Dhawan's hitting arc. He pumps it over the leg side for a huuuuge six
Dhawan jumps a long way across off, this is on a back of a length and angling into middle. Having got inside the line, the opener glances it away past the keeper's right for another boundary
Rohit leans back, rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and steers to backward point
a bit too full and outside off, Rohit stays leg-side of the ball and lifts it inside-out over extra cover. Hit with utter nonchalance
full and angling into the pads from wide of the crease, Rohit falls over the flick and wears it on the pad
back of a length and angling in towards off stump, Rohit gets his head over the ball and blocks it back to Rankin
kicks up from a length on off, Rohit loosens his grip and diffuses it to point
overpitched and outside off, Dhawan lines it up and creams it over the top of mid-off for another four
very full on middle stump, Dhawan presses forward and taps a single down the ground
back of a length and homing in on off, Rohit leans back and chops straight to short third man
short, wide, Rohit shifts his balance onto the back foot again and nails a cut past point. Easy peasy for India
dug in short on middle, Rohit rides the bounce and works a single wide of midwicket. Fifty up for India
very full and sliding into the pads, picked off to deep square leg
short on off, no room for Dhawan to free his arms, so he chops it beside his feet

Dhawan charges down the track and cops a blow on the helmet. He steps out, meets a big short ball, but is in no position to hook it away. Dhawan is struck on the grille of the helmet. He's okay and gives the thumbs up
pitched up and outside off, belted through the line but straight to mid-off

good length and angling away outside off, slower cutter, Dhawan aims to drag it away over midwicket against the angle. Instead, he skews it over Simi Singh at backward point. He dishes out a full-length dive after running back but the ball swirls away from his reach
that's another meaty blow. He hares down the track, takes it on a half-volley, and lifts it over Chase's head for another six. Dhawan and Rohit making it look as easy as eating a sandwich
non-turner outside off, Rohit presses forward and eases a single to sweeper cover
pushed through on off stump, clipped with the angle through midwicket for one
full and drifts in on off stump, Rohit bunts a single down to long-on
short, flat dart on off stump, Rohit hangs back and nurdles it to the midwicket region
Dhawan uses his feet, Dockrell drags his length back on middle, tip and run to the leg side. India keep ticking in Dublin
sliding in on middle from around the wicket, Dhawan hangs back and dabs a single in front of square on the leg side
back of a length and sliding in with the arm, nudged to leg for one more
dragged down outside off, Dhawan ventures deep in the crease and forces a single to deep midwicket
wide of the crease, angling into the leg stump, Rohit forays down the track, gets close to the pitch and swings it languidly over midwicket. Clears the bigger boundary with no fuss
tossed up and breaks away outside off, Dhawan aims to slog-sweep it across the line and against the break. Instead, he sends a top-edge over the keeper and gets away
on a length and outside off, Rohit punches on the up to sweeper cover
Dhawan misses a reverse-sweep and wears it on the thigh pad instead
short and outside off, drags a pull to wide long-on
Rohit uses his feet, the spinner goes short and outside off, stabbed to the bowler's right
short arm-ball, short-armed away through midwicket off the back foot
Dhawan stays leg-side of this short ball outside off and carves a cut to the right of sweeper cover. India continue to soar in Dublin
back of a length and outside off, the ball does not come onto the bat, punched away to mid-off
short and angling in, chopped from off stump to deep third man
short of a length and angling away outside off, laced through point
very full on middle and leg, 136ks, Rohit, having backed away outside leg, has ample room to biff it over extra cover
slower short ball down the leg side, helped to fine leg for one
too full on the pads, picked off through midwicket
and there goes Dockrell. Fifty for Dhawan. An imposing jump down the pitch to cart this short of a length ball over deep midwicket
paddles it straight to short fine. A length ball pushed through outside off and he's across off stump very quickly with the stride
quick again but too short. It's spinning down leg too and all he has to do is tap this on its head to beat short fine
length on middle stump, swatted straight to deep square
short of a length ball fired in at middle stump. Stays deep in the crease and tickles it through midwicket off the back foot
mix-up but also a fumble at extra cover. Full ball at off stump. Rohit jams it out to the fielder who can't hold on as the batsmen struggle with their decision before eventually going through
full and wide outside off. Dhawan steps out and meets it on the full, but toe-ends it to long-off
full toss outside off. Leans in and caresses it to sweeper cover
yorker length wide outside off. Has to reach out and drill this. Can't beat long-off. Good bowling...
full ball outside off. Yorks himself and drives straight to extra cover off the toe-end
misses a full toss because he's looked for the reverse sweep. Not a bad option. He knows the line that's coming - full and wide, very fast outside off. Can't get bat

an offcutter at a length on off stump, taps it on the up to extra cover and calls for a tight single. Just makes it at the non-stirker's end. It was in the air as he collided with the bowler while trying to get back in the crease. It's a fifty though. What's next?
sweet! Length ball on middle stump, opens up his arms and pummels it on the rise to send it flat over midwicket
length ball outside off, slapped on the up to sweeper cover
beaten. Walks into the off side to try and ramp one fine. But this is a full and wide ball
offcutter, full and down leg side. Can't get bat on the attempted swipe
full toss wide outside off. Gets his attempted drive off the bottom of the bat. Finds sweeper cover
miscues yet another one. Full and wide outside off, thick outside edge to third man as he looks to drive
full toss outside off, makes too much room and hits it straight to extra cover
full ball on the stumps, gets a big inside edge as he looks to slug this over the leg side
full on off stump, drilled down to long-off
full toss wide outside off, makes too much room again, but he manages to slice it this time. Wide over point
full toss outside off, reverse sweep straight to sweeper cover
oh boy. An old-fashioned heave. Full ball on the stumps and he gets right under this, on one knee, to pick it up and over midwicket
yorker outside off, jammed straight to backward point
oh what a shot. A short-arm punch over the bowler. It's an attempted yorker, he meets it on the full. But there isn't much time to dig this out. He does it anyway
yorker wide outside off, taps it to short third man

a top edge lands wide of long-on, running in and to his right. Dropped catch, really. Rohit looks to sweep, is through the shot early. Thompson runs in and has to lunge to his right in the end, but that wasn't too difficult
backs away and then jumps back into line to enable a thick outside edge over short third man. Too much room. Chucks himself at the wide length ball and gets lucky
yorker at leg stump, jams it to long-on

takes it! You wouldn't know it from his exasperated reaction. Stuart Thompson. Runs in from long-off and has to lunge again. This time he makes no mistake. Dhawan gets under this full ball but it's off the toe-end and loops up for the fielder. A smashing innings ends.
thick outside edge as he chases at this length ball outside off for a drive. It bisects backward point and short third man
nicely timed. Length ball outside off again and this time he climbs into it nicely. Drives it on the rise to long-off's right. He can't stop it after making the ground
misses the full toss. Screams in frustration. That was a thigh high full toss with a lot of width. He was looking to dab it past third man
full outside off, driven down to long-off
genius. Full toss wide outside off, but he has managed to stretch across and whip this to the square leg boundary with a sweep
yorker length and in at the stumps. Gets the front leg out of the way and chips it towards long-on
full ball on the leg stump. Goes too hard at it with the slog and ends up getting a thick inside edge down to fine leg
short and very wide. Raina won't chase.
full toss outside off. Can't get the full swing under this slog. Hits it straight to long-on

easy. Overpitched on middle stump. The front foot has gone out of the way long before the ball arrives. The hands have come under it just at the right time. Jumps into the 90s with this sightscreen crusher
yorker outside off, sliced to sweeper cover
attempted wide yorker. Just misses his mark and get's called up
just wants it to be over. But he'll bowl another. Looks for the bouncer, manages to get it over the batsman's head
short ball on the ribs and a very awkward short-arm pull from Raina. He's backing away and looking to nudge it into the leg side, but he gets a top edge that deep square leg takes comfortably
length ball outside off. Steps out and miscues an attempted lofted drive. Gets it between extra cover and mid-off
short ball wide outside off. A lovely looking chop away from the body, but deep point is in position
finds the backward square boundary. Short of a length ball on the stumps. Gets his front leg up and swipes it sweetly
short of a length outside off, cuts off the under-edge to deep point
full ball outside off. Walks across and looks to flick. Miscues. Gets it to deep midwicket off the toe-end
attempted bouncer. Too far wide. Left alone
yorker just outside off. Looks to squeeze it through the of side. Gets it back to the bowler on the bounce
get out of the way. He has bludgeoned this. An overpitched ball on off stump and a murderous swing under it to send it past the cameraman straight above the sightscreen
falls short of mid-off, who Rohit will be disappointed not to clear. It's a length ball on off stump, there's room and he's looking to go inside-out. Can't get the middle of the bat on it
holes out to deep midwicket. Runs down the pitch against the short ball and is cramped for room. Still manages to get a full pull shot out of it, but it's not got enough to clear the boundary

bowled him! A tired shot from Rohit, who misses out on a third T20I ton. It's a length ball on leg stump. Everything you want at this stage. He slogs at it and can't get anywhere near making contact. It tonks the top of leg stump
past the glove as he looks to play the hook. And not called wide. This bouncer looked to be well down leg side.
another at deep midwicket! Length ball on leg stump, clears the front foot and slogs, finds the fielder. As easy as that. Four wickets for Chase.
helicopter to get this yorker over the bowler's head. A good ball, but Pandya is almost side-on to this as he makes space for his bat to come down under the ball. Clears the boundary with ease
outside edge as he steps out and meets this full ball in front of middle stump. Slight swing away as he's looking to jab it through midwicket
length ball on leg stump, flicked straight to square leg
length ball slanted in at off stump. Defends with a dead-bat, into the pitch
knuckle ball. Full outside off. Gets down to try and sweep and cops it on the pad. It pings into the covers
short of a length in the corridor. Allows it to come on and drops it into the off side, behind point

top edge taken by mid-on. Too fast for the pull. Awful position with the legs, not optimal with the hands. Stirling not close to being behind the line of this. It loops up and Kuldeep takes this just behind the umpire
length ball speared in at off stump. Defends into the off side
oh that's close! It's got to be bat, if that's not out. Front foot planted right across the stumps as he seemingly misses this attempted flick....oh yes, there is an inside edge. Good decision.
length ball down leg side, whips and misses
nicely put away. Gets up with the bounce on this short of a length ball and lofts it handsomely over square leg
length ball jagging back in at middle stump. Looks to whip it, deflected into the gully region off the back thigh, possible inside edge on that
misjudged and let go. Chahal runs in from square leg and doesn't get near it as it sways away. Length ball on leg stump, launched high up. No distance at all. He ran in gingerly, Chahal
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Slides under his bat as he looks to cut
length ball just outside off, drags it to mid-on on the rise
slower ball at a length on middle stump, hangs deep and tickles this to short fine
short of a length at off stump, defended into the off side
uses the pace and finds four past short fine. Short and into the hips. Tickled with the angle
short of a length at middle and off, jammed into the covers on the up

dropped! Oh Rohit Sharma. Didn't have to do a lot at all. It's a slower ball and he miscues the slog. Rohit at short midwcket is already under it. Yet, somehow, he manages to get far away enough for him to be reaching well in front. No one else close to him. Just a poor effort.
short of a length outside off, looks to pull, beaten on the inside edge
short ball slanted into him. He's looking to back away and cut, but can't get bat on it
short ball, delivered as an offcutter. Backs away and can't time the punch through the off side
another slower short ball. Looks to tickle this hook fine, but gloves it to Dhoni on the bounce
and another. Shannon not enjoying this pace off the ball. Short slower ball into the thigh. Can't get more than an inside edge onto thigh guard as he looks to whip this
slower ball, good length, leg stump. An easy hoick and he gets it to deep square's right
slower bouncer on leg stump, hooked to fine leg

oh yesssssss! Sweetly connected! Six slower balls in a row is not exactly hiding it. Shannon knows now. And it's nice and looped up at leg stump too, on a length. Uses his reach to get to the pitch and muscle it over midwicket
Balbirnie is waaay too early into a slog-sweep. This is the knuckle ball from Bhuvneshwar, barely 115ks, he cops a blow on the helmet, and the back-flap gets detached. Some repairs for him
just short of a good length and outside off, seam-up ball, run away to short third man
knuckle ball, short, drifts in on off, jabbed to midwicket off the inside half
short, wide, Balbirnie having jumped outside leg has plenty of leverage to crack it in the gap at point. The ball purrs away to the fence
pushed through on middle, not much turn, punched up to sweeper cover
tossed on off, dips, creating distance between bat and pitch. Drags a sweep to short fine leg off the inside half

Chahal hangs it up outside off, it dips, creating distance between the bat and the pitch again. The ball also breaks away further, well past the reach of the advancing Balbirnie. Simple stumping for Dhoni
dangled up outside off, Simi stretches across off and paddle-sweeps it away to long leg
lobbed up and spins away outside off, Shannon dares to slug it against the break. Slog-swept over the bigger midwicket boundary for six. Lovely connection from Shannon

Chahal responds with a flat wrong'un, zips in, Shannon aims for another slog-sweep and is hit in line with off stump. This looks close. Not given by the umpire. Well, well... The tracker returns three reds. No DRS in this series, however
short and kicks up outside off, Simi rises with it and fends it off to point
short and arrowed into the body, Simi rides the bounce and helps it to long leg
too full and straying into the pads, Shannon tickles it away fine of long leg and fetches a boundary
banged in short and outside off, the batsman aims leg side and skews a leading edge to third man
lifter outside off, 124ks only but springs off the surface to beat the hook
short and attached with width outside off, Simi latches onto it and smears it away to the left of backward point and right of deep third man for another four
tossed up liberally and outside off, heaved away to wide long-on off the inside half
Simi shuffles across for a sweep but this length ball breaks away and beats him
loopier and spins away outside off, driven with the break to sweeper cover this time
Shot, Shannon! Floated up and spins away outside off, Shannon stretches out, gets closer to the pitch and slams a slog-sweep over midwicket. Right off the meat of the bat
shorter and breaks away outside off, chopped away from the body but it drops in front of backward point
nice and full, spins in, Simi is hit on the pad as he does not make contact with a flick
Simi chips a leading edge straight into the lap of short cover. Kuldeep tosses up a wrong'un, it leaves the right-hander and dips. Simi uses his feet, eyes up the leg side, and hands a catch to Kohli
goes for an adventurous reverse-sweep right away but misses as the ball breaks down the leg side
tossed up, spins in, beats the sweep, but this seems to be missing off stump
pushed through on middle and leg, Shannon clears his front leg again and blasts it into the stands beyond square leg. Muscled away by Shannon
speared outside off, slashed away to the right of sweeper cover
back of a length and spins away, sliced to point
flighted nicely and spins away outside off, Wilson stays leg-side of the ball and carts it inside-out to sweeper cover
flat and wide outside off, slapped away to the off-side sweeper again
keeps it short and wide, cracked away to the left of sweeper cover this time
good length, starts outside off, and spins in, shovels a sweep to deep midwicket
reverse-swept from the stumps but can't beat Chahal at backward point

Another big shout for lbw from Kuldeep, umpire Hawthorne raises his finger this time. This was pretty adjacent. Quick fizzer from over the wicket, full and skids on middle, Shannon plays around it and is pinned in front. Failed paddle-sweep. End of a fine innings from him
on a length and outside off, tossed up liberally, Kevin O'Brien lines it up, presses forward and smokes it straight over Chahal's head like a boss
full and breaks away outside off, flat-batted over short cover, sweeper runs across to his right to mop this up

O'Brien aims to clear the boundary again. No dice. Dhawan runs across to his right from wide long-off and snaffles this. Tossed up, full outside off, breaks away further, O'Brien lifts it down the ground but gets more height as opposed to distance. Ireland five down and sinking in steep chase
Pandey claims a catch at short cover but this is a bump ball.  Drilled through the line to short cover. Hat-trick averted
slower through the air on middle, he bends forward and blocks to the leg side
googly, spins back, but the length is short, allowing him to punch to sweeper cover
down the track and driven away past the left of the diving bowler. Kuldeep throws himself to his left and attempts a return catch but the ball bursts out and rolls down to long-on
floated up on middle, gloves a reverse-sweep as the ball rolls past slip. Given as a leg-bye, though
overpitched and outside off, not much turn either away, the left-hander stays leg-side of the ball and creams a drive to sweeper cover
starts on middle and breaks away, he eyes up the leg side but slices it off the outside half over backward point
googly, leaves the right-hander, chipped away past the right of Kuldeep
good length and outside off, stabbed away over extra cover
short and just a shade outside off, leans back and punches to sweeper cover
short and wide outside off, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover
back of a length on middle, Thompson steps away outside leg stump and fiercely flat-bats it between covers and mid-off. Dismissive
banged in short on middle, swings his hands at a hook, as the ball flies to deep square leg

Thompson holes out to Hardik Pandya at long-on. This was lobbed up on middle, nice and full, Thompson gets under it and swings it in the air but does not clear Pandya. India three wickets away from 1-0
tossed up full and outside off, Dockrell stretches out, then collapses his back knee to launch it inside-out over long-off for six
drags a sweep from outside off to deep midwicket
Kuldeep Yadav celebrates his fourth wicket. Delicious wrong'un, pitches on middle and leg and breaks away to hit off stump. Poynter does not read the variation and simply plays down the wrong line
short and holds its line outside off, forced off the back foot to cover. Kuldeep finishes with 4-1-21-4
Dockrell uses his feet and chops a shortish ball past leg stump
slower, short ball outside off, heaved away to wide long-on
slower short ball outside off, 116ks, Rankin looks to run it to third man. Beaten in the end, however
slower full ball on leg stump, jabbed away to square leg
short on off, a whirl of the wrists sends the ball to midwicket

Bumrah spears in a yorker from wide of the crease and pings the base of off stump. Dockrell moves away outside leg and exposes all three stumps. Bumrah hits off with a pin-point yorker. It's waaay past the reach of Dockrell who had ventured outside leg
too full and outside off, swing and a miss now
middle-stump yorker, jammed down to mid-on
short and hits the splice as the batsman fends it to short cover
back of a length, ducks back in, and bounces over middle stump as Chase attempts a leg-side heave-ho and misses
stays leg-side of a full ball outside off and squeezes it to the covers
back of a length and nips away slightly to beat the lousy waft in the channel
Rankin uses his feet, dug in short on middle, forced down to long-off
110ks knuckle ball on middle, full, jammed to the covers
slower ball outside off, 115ks, the batsman waits for it to arrive. Then stabs it away to the covers
Rankin backs away outside leg and comes down the track, Bumrah bangs it short and targets the rib cage, fended off to the covers
full, pitches outside leg, swings in the air, catches the pad and rolls behind to Dhoni
Rankin backs away outside leg, speared full on middle, stabbed away to deep third man off the toe end
splice-jarring length on middle, hit to the covers
really full on middle - not quite a yorker - Rankin steps away outside leg and jabs it down the ground past the right of Bumrah

Bumrah drops a return catch but India claim a thumping win to launch their tour of the UK. This was very full on middle stump, belted back to the bowler. The force of the shot ensures the ball bursts out and his his knee
full on off, and he slices a hard drive to wide mid off. Duminy gets his body behind the ball and somehow manages to intercept
good length on leg stump, and nudged to square leg for a jogging single
in the air! But just short of cover. Full outside off, and Dickwella drives with hard hands. The ball turns in his gloves, and he falls just in front of the fielder
angling into Dickwella's body, and he comfortably turns this around his hips to the leg side
good length on middle, and he flicks it off the back foot to the leg side
full on leg stump, and Perera offers the bat's full face to drive to mid on
full and slanting in on middle and leg from round the stumps, patted down the ground
full and attacking the stumps, forced back to Mulder
much fuller and outside off, Kusal drives it firmly to short cover off the front foot
good length on middle, Mulder draws an inside edge to midwicket region
he rides the bounce of this short one outside off and diffuses it to backward point
back of a length on the hips, worked away to square leg, where Mulder, I think, fumbles and allows a single
just short of a good length and outside off, Kusal leans back and slaps it to point
wicket-to-wicket line, back of a length, hit back to Andile off the back foot
Kusal stays leg-side of this short ball outside off and spanks it to the covers
fuller and nipping away just a shade outside off, tight leave to round out the over
driven off the pads to short midwicket. There's a misfield, a mix-up, no runs in the end
Kusal fetches a back of a length delivery from outside off and swats it mid-on, where Shamsi tumbles to his right to stop the ball
pitched up on off, driven straight of  mid-off for another single

Mulder belts out an appeal for lbw. This might have pitched outside leg. Then swings in the air to have the batsman falling over the flick and ping the front pad. Yes, pitched outside leg. SA did well not to review it
floated full and outside off, Dickwella chases a drive and misses
pitched up on off stump, squeezed to mid-off off the front foot
good length on off stump, chopped to deep third man
full on middle, forward and pressed to point with an open face

Andile breaks the stand, has Kusal holing out to mid-on. Andile pulls his length back and shifts his line wider outside off. Kusal can't get on top of the ball as he aims a pull. He splices it to the right of mid-on, where Lungi runs around and makes this catch look simple
he rides the bounce of a short ball outside off and diffuses it to point
shuffles across off and works a length ball to short midwicket
full on middle, forward and drilled back to the left of the bowler
bouncer, angling in at the body from round the wicket, Dickwella is up to the challenge. He sways his upper body out of the way

Another rib-hunting short ball, 134ks, this floors Dickwella. He collapses and grimaces in pain. Man down. Dug into the middle of the pitch, angling in at the body, Dickwella ventures across off and defects the ball into the middle of his ribs as he aims to turn the ball to midwicket. Dickwella needs medical attention. And this results in a hold-up in play in Dambulla
length on off, nudged defensively to the leg side
back of a length on a fourth-stump line, Dickwella wants to force through the covers but an inside edge sneaks away to the leg side
pitched up on off, forward and driven back to Andile
Andile runs one past the outside edge. Good length, angling in towards off, tricks Mathews into playing for the angle but the ball seams away late past the bat. Little gem from Andile
Shot, Angelo! Crunched down the ground. Overpitched and outside off, drilled through the line past the left of Andile and right of mid-off
full and sprayed down leg, wide
slower ball outside off, stabbed away to the left of short cover
back of a length and angling into a leg-side flick past midwicket
on a length and pushed wide outside off, belted over the infield. Sweeper cover mops up in the deep
full and angling into a tight front-foot defence back down the pitch
pitched up and outside off, forward and driven straight to mid-off
back of a length on a fifth-stump line, a back-foot punch to mid-off ensues
Mathews hops, skips, and tucks this short ball to long leg for two
lifter on middle, 131ks, Mathews hunkers down
full on middle from round the stumps, Dickwella ventures outside leg and spanks it away to the right of mid-on. Bam!
good length on leg stump, Dickwella stretches forward and pushes to mid-on
Dickwella shuffles outside leg and the bowler chases him with a sharp bouncer. Fended off to midwicket
full and wide outside off, left alone
good length and holds its line outside off, can't make Mathews play again
full and outside off, eased down the ground off the front foot
back of a length and skidding in to catch the thigh pad
lobs a full-toss outside off, swatted down to long-on
another full-toss, on off, whipped off the front foot to deep midwicket
full and angling across off, front-foot defence back to the bowler
tossed outside off, Mathews leans into a drive and hits the ball to long-on
starts on off, grips, and breaks away past the outside edge. Lovely ball to end the over
short and angling in at off, Mathews fends back to Rabada
on a length and outside off, driven on the up to short cover
back of a length and outside off, ignored
short on off, Mathews pats it down
back of a length and hits the splice, defended to the off side
full and outside off, Mathews carves a drive to mid-off. Maiden for Lungi
tossed up and drifting down leg, paddled away fine on the leg side. Amla chases hard and slides, but the ball wins the race
flighted on off and turns away, Dickwella inches forward and pokes it to the covers
another sweep, this is hit flat and hard to deep square leg
tossed on middle, non-turner, whisked back to JP's right
dipping low full-toss on middle, played back
short and angling across off, Mathews goes deep in the crease and punches it down to long-on
back of a length and pushed through down the leg side, Mathews snicks it fine on the leg side for four. Help yourself, Angelo
full on middle, presses forward and knocks the ball into the vacant spaces at square leg
dragged short and fizzes away outside off, Dickwella uses the pace and bounce and late-cuts to third man fence

First fifty in what ages for Dickwella? Seam-up short ball outside off, Dickwella feathers it fine on the off side past the keeper and finds the third-man boundary. He blows kisses in the direction of the change room and celebrates the effort
short and outside off, forced to the covers
tossed on middle, forward and dabbed to the leg side with soft hands
overpitched on middle, and Dickwella goes for an expansive sweep. Struck straight to the diving short fine leg fielder
full outside leg stump, and Dickwella whips this behind square to short fine leg. Hundred for Sri Lanka as the fans go up in a roar
full on middle, and Mathews' attempted on drive is sliced to mid off instead. Played softly enough for them to run across to the other side
full on off, and down he goes on one knee to sweep behind square. Played to deep backward square leg
full outside off, and he shovels an on drive to midwicket. No run
full outside off, and Mathews drags a drive towards the on side again. Intercepted by Duminy
full outside off, but gripping and spinning away from Dickwella. He tried to make some extra room too, and therefore the ball's too far from him to cut. Into de Kock's gloves
length ball just outside off, and Dickwella carves a square cut off the back foot to the player in the deep
full on middle, and Mathews carefully sees this through onto his bat. Drives to midwicket
full just outside off, and comfortably pushed to cover for a quick single
full on off, and Dickwella walks across to the off side, and then drags the sweep behind square! Dive in the deep by the fielder, but that was well struck. Fifty partnership too

full just outside off, and Dickwella backs away to drill a drive to deep extra cover. They want the second, and it could be close if the throw is on the stumps. But alas, it's far away from Shamsi, and Dickwella scampers back before the danger got too much
full on off, and pushed off the front foot. Stopped by Duminy running to his right
full just outside off, and swept to fine leg
full just outside off, and driven to long on off the front foot
full just outside off, and he smothers the turn with a front-foot drive
full on off, and Dickwella shovels this over cover. Lands at a safe spot, and wide long off needs to race forward in a bid to stop them from taking two
full on off, and Mathews comes dancing down the wicket to slog. But the ball turns inwards slightly, and therefore takes the inside of Mathews' bat. Mistimed to the leg side
full just outside off, and he opens his bat's face to tap the delivery to point
good length outside off, and Mathews takes a step back before punching to mid off

full on leg, and he tries to play it fine past the keeper. Comes off his thigh, and de Kock does well to stretch to his left and stop the ball from sneaking through for a boundary. Appreciated by Phehlukwayo
soft appeal for caught behind but the umpire calls wide. Short on middle, and Dickwella attempts a wild pull behind square. The ball goes over his shoulders as Dickwella misses the shot completely
chipped over midwicket! Full on middle, and he simply whips it over the infield with ease. Played the shot slightly too early, and therefore went into the air. But overall, a rathers safe shot
good length outside off, and Dickwella's jab through the covers gets him a single
wide outside off, and Dickwella has enough time to execute a slap shot. But he can't find the gap, as Faf's diving effort at cover stops the ball
full on middle, and turned off his toes to square leg for an easy run
full outside off, and Mathews goes fishing outside the stumps. Taps the ball to cover, but there's no chance of a single on this occasion
full on middle, and Mathews brings his bat down to work the shot towards square leg. Calls early for the single, and off they go
full outside off, but Dickwella is comfortable in dragging the sweep from outside the stumps, and depositing it to the man at a square-ish fine leg
half-tracker on leg stump, and Mathews steers a grounded pull to deep midwicket
back of a length outside off, and Dickwella fails to execute his back-foot punch. Takes the bat's inside edge and ricochets onto his pads

played on! How often does Dickwella get out that way? Loose ball outside off, and Dickwella goes for the cut way too early. The ball hits the bottom of the bat, and drags this onto his off stump. Phehlulkwayo celebrates hard and Dickwella cuts a forlorn look as he makes his way back for 69
full on middle, and he uses his wrist to nudge a push to deep midwicket. Gets off the mark
length ball angling in, and Mathews swivels to pull to deep backward square. Mulder throws his body near the boundary, and his acrobatic effort stops the boundary
wide outside off, and Mathews punches towards the off side. But it goes straight to the fielder at cover
length ball outside off, and Mathews plays a dab down to third man for one
floater outside off, and driven to wide long off for a single
full outside off, and he brings out an expansive drive. Goes to cover on the bounce though
full on off, and pushed with the angled bat to the off side. Miller dives to his right to intercept
full on leg stump, and Shehan uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball. Tapped to the leg side
wide outside off, and cut off the back foot to the sweeper fielder in the deep
just past the outside edge! A slider outside off that's always angling away. Mathews tries to defend away from his body but the ball goes past his outside edge
flicked off his pads to the leg side for a walking single
angling into his body, and Mathews rides the bounce to pull to cow corner
good length outside off, and tapped to cover off the front foot
good length outside off, and Mathews offers his soft hands in a bid to steal the single. But his defensive shot goes to cover just a tad too quickly
good length outside off, and Mathews sticks his bat out, turns its face, and then runs this fine past the keeper for four. Third man was too wide in the deep. A deliberate shot, make no mistake
good length outside off, and punched to mid off to see the over out
full outside off, and he muscles a drive to the off side. But can't breach the infielders at cover
tossed up on off, and Shehan comes forward to defend. Played to the off side
good length outside off, and he shuffles backwards to try and cut square. Finds point though
good length outside off, and Shehan stays back for the late cut. Jabs at this, and manages to play this fine past first slip! He was itching for a release shot, and he finds a nifty boundary
a slider that comes into the batsman's body. He goes onto the back foot and works it tot he leg side
yorker on off, and Shehan manages to dig this back to the bowler
full on his pads, and Mathews flicks to midwicket for a quick single
good length outside off, and Shehan runs forward to disrupt the bowler's length. Meets this near his hip, and flicks it square to the leg side for one

full outside off, and his attempted straight drive is played way too early. Comes off the bat's toe end, but he manages to chip it just beyond Rabada's left hand. Beats mid off too, and the crowd goes loud as the ball reaches the boundary

is there an appeal for obstruction? Faf is asking. Soft signal is not out. Length ball on middle, and he works it towards square leg. Mathews takes off for the single, but he's sent back by Shehan. He falls while turning, and then dives back to reach the crease with Faf aiming at the stumps. But hold on, has he changed his running line a bit too much? That's what Faf is asking. Shades of that Jason Roy incident here. But the third umpire deems not out. Looks like Mathews didn't obstruct the fielder's view of the stumps
good length outside off, and fended off the back foot
attempted yorker on middle, and he has no trouble to clip it away to square leg
tossed on leg stump, nudged to square leg
full on leg stump, tickled straight to short fine leg
flat dart on leg stump, tickled to short fine once again
straight ball on middle, Mathews presses forward and clips to short midwicket
tossed up and spinning away outside off, stabbed to long-off
tossed on off, laced down to long-off off the front foot
full and straight, nurdled to deep square leg
back of a length and slanting in at off stump, Shehan hangs back and works to midwicket
back of a length on off, jabbed back to Mulder
dug in short and outside off, swatted wide of deep midwicket
worked to the left of short midwicket
tosses one up outside off and gets it to spin away, no shot
dangled up outside off, drops down to one knee and paddle-sweeps to fine leg
Shehan leans back and chops from outside off to backward point
dragged down outside off, Shehan looks to whack it through the covers. Nearly chops it on. The ball ultimately rolls past leg stump
slower through the air, full and turns away, carved off the front foot to backward point
chest-high short ball on middle, Mathews sizes it up. Swivels beautifully on the back foot and pulls with great authority behind square on the leg side
back of a length on middle, Mathews jumps across off stump and clips it gently to short midwicket
back of a length and just a shade outside off, patted to the covers
bouncer outside off, Shehan thinks about the ramp but pulls out at the last moment and allows the ball to leap into the gloves of the keeper
very full and outside off, smeared to mid-off

back of a length and floated down the leg side, Shehan aims a flick. Was there a deflection behind? Not given out caught behind by Paul Reiffel. SA review the on-field not-out decision. They're pretty confident they have their man. Ultra Edge detects a spike, and Shehan has to go. He can't get enough bat and feathers it behind
good length and fizzes back in, strikes Mathews on the pad as he misjudges it
floated up on leg stump, glanced to square leg. Sloppy. SA concede overthrows
floated up on middle, Thisara stretches forward and smothers it
shooter. Does not bounce at all. Scoots through at ankle height to Qdk outside off
that's a jaffa from Shamsi. Looped up on off, the flight draws the batsman forward, the dip creates distance between bat and pitch, and the turn takes it past the outside edge
pushed through flatter and quicker outside off, quick turn, beaten on the outside edge once again
