back of a length and outside off, stabbed away in the gap between backward point and gully for four
lifter outside off, Shafiq ducks under it
picked off the pads through square leg for four. Chipped in the air to short leg's right
full and on off, Shafiq gets right behind the line and defends tightly
on a length and outside off, Babar presses it to the covers
back of a length and outside off, punched up to the covers
short and wide, crashed straight to point off the back foot
full and straight, delightfully driven between midwicket and mid-on. Babar has timed it to perfection
short and outside off, Babar skips back and smites a pull over midwicket. Bam!
full on off, defended
back of a length and outside off, punched away to the left of short cover
short and outside off, 136ks, does not bounce as much as Babar expected it to. Sneaks under his pull. Was there a deflection there? Off the trouser and through to the diving keeper
full and right up Babar's driving arc. He lunges out and creams it through extra-cover. Whoa
Babar stays leg-side of this short ball outside off and cracks it away through cover-point. Punched away with great authority
short and outside off, this does not bounce much, Babar sways his upper body out of the way
pitched up and outside off, delectable cover drive. Shafiq leans into it and lets his hands flow through the line
back of a length and angling in from outside off, left alone
short and outside off, Babar throws his bat at it and does not connect with the ball
su-weeet cover driving. Full and outside off, eased in the gap. Hamza chases it hard and tracks the ball down even with pads on
short and extra width, Shafiq pounces onto it and smears it away through point for four. Cut away off the back foot to the left of the fielder
back of a length and skids back in at 140kph to smack the pad
full and too straight, knocked away to long leg
on a length and just a shade outside off, blocked solidly
full on the pads, tucked around the corner
short on the body, fended to the leg side off the back foot
looks like a fast legbreak outside off, forced to short cover
short and outside off, Babar rises on top of the ball and punches on the up but can't get it past short cover
very full and tails in a touch on off, draws a leading edge to mid-off
full and rolls through to the keeper as the batsman lets it go
full and slanting into middle, Shafiq stretches out and chips the ball to mid-on
full and attacking the stumps, 137ks, played back down the pitch
back of a length and strikes the splice as the batsman loosens his grip and fends it back
too full and straight straight, a whirl of the wrists sends the ball away to the left of deep midwicket. Good work in the outfield for Markram late in the day
back of a length and holds its line outside off, a back-foot force to mid-off ensues

fast legbreak outside off, takes the outside edge and rolls to the third man region. They hare across for three. Bavuma chases hard and throws it to de Kock, who already had his gloves off; he effects a direct hit at the non-striker's end, but Shafiq is in
floated full and outside off, driven to short cover
back of a length and kicks up outside off, tickled away to gully
Babar shuffles across and defends this length ball on middle to the leg side
back of a length and just a shade outside off, Babar gets right behind the line and blocks
bouncer outside off, Shafiq arches his back and lets it go
another one dug into the middle of the pitch, Shafiq evades it
back of a length and wider of off, Shafiq ignores it
very full on off, jabbed to the leg side
short on top of off, Babar gets right behind the line and keeps it out to round out the day
bouncer at an off stump line, ducks under it
yorker just outside off. Jammed into the leg side off the inside half

falls short of mid-off! Babar will always go for the pull. Almost costs him this time. It's not as short as he thinks it is. And it's wide and seaming away outside off. Half-pull and it lobs off the toe-end as he checks the shot. Mid-off won't get there
short and wide outside off, left alone
short at off stump, defended on the back foot
hits the right bicep or possibly the right side of the chest as he drops the bat to let this pass. Short ball dips in at him
great hands from Shafiq. 23rd fifty for him. Overpitched delivery at leg stump. Leans in and uses delicate hands to turn this square of square leg with a flick
full at off stump, blocked on the front foot
length ball just outside off, blocked on the front foot
length at off stump, dead-batted into the off side
length ball wide outside off, left alone
length ball slanted in at off stump, blocked on the front foot
short ball rises steeply in the corridor. Drops the gloves and lets it go
length ball outside off, left alone
outside edge past second slip. Short ball up in the corridor. Looks to punch but that gets too big on him. Thick edge flies wide of the cordon

got him! Doesn't give you a chance, this guy! Short ball again. Just gets so steep when he hits that length, more so than any other bowler in this line-up. Babar wants to get on the back foot to defend this. It's not a bad option at all. But it gets to throat height and he can't control it from there. A glove and QDK takes a simple catch

bowled him! He continues this double-wicket over trend! Third time for him in the Test. Sarfraz is hanging back in the crease expecting a bouncer. They've just brought in short leg. It's a trap. This is a short of a length and ball and it tonks the top of off, coming in with the angle. Sarfraz is too late on the defence
shot! Length ball in at off stump, and a good forward stride to punch firmly on the up past the bowler
spanked away. Loose bowling from Philander. Short, wide, not too quick. Stands up and runs his hands through this, on the rise, through the covers
length at leg stump, flicked into the leg side
length ball just outside off, punched on the up to mid-on
falls short of mid-on. Short of a length outside off. Looks to pull off the front foot, it dips to mid-on's right
length at middle stump, defended off the back foot
length at leg stump, defended into the leg side
short ball in the corridor, ducks under it
short ball wide outside off, left alone
length ball wide outside off, left alone
short of a length at off stump, defended off the back foot
short of a length outside off, arches into the leg side and chops this handsomely to deep point's left. Looking good
short ball at off stump, ducks under it. Front-foot no-ball as well
short ball down leg side, left alone
length ball just outside off, pushed to point off the outside half
length ball just outside off, defended off the back foot. Inside half of the bat
keeps low. Length ball has likely hit a crack outside off. Looks to punch through the line but this skids under the bat
past the outside edge. Length ball outside off, draws him in on the front foot and jags it away
another one stays low. Cracks cracks cracks. Length ball just outside off, looks to punch through cover and this is almost ankle height as it rolls through to the keeper
length at off stump, defended off the back foot
length at off stump, defended down the pitch from deep in the crease
short of a length outside off, nicely behind the line to cut to point's right
falls short or deep backward point. Rabada spots it late. It's an upper cut. Good looking upper cut too, but ill-advised. Slices it up and Rabada takes it on the bounce
bouncer at an off stump line. Quickly crouches to get out of the way
short of a length just outside off, defended into the covers

taken at second slip. Was a matter of time before one went up instead of down. Length outside off. Gets forward to defend. Perhaps stretching out a little too far away from the body, but that's a marginal shout. It gets big on him and he fends to Elgar. Replays show he walked down at that too
length at middle stump, languidly pushed into the leg side off the front foot
length at off stump, blocked into the covers
short of third slip. Short of a length just outside off. Not enough room for the cut, which he has attempted. Jams his glove as it drops to De Bruyn's left at third slip
length ball just outside off, tapped into the covers off the back foot
top edge sails over the keeper. Faheem playing the shot that got him out in the first innings. Short and climbing at the helmet. Swipes and swivels. Safe this time
short and slanted across off stump. Uses the angle to get on top of the bounce and slice it wide of gully
short ball angled into the corridor. Looks to pull that. In woeful position. Beaten by pace as this skids hip height
short ball down leg side, ducks under it
short of a length and in at leg stump. Looks to flick, cops it on the thigh
short of a length just outside off. Hurriedly nudged into the covers off the back foot
short ball down leg side, can't get bat on the glance
length ball just outside off, pushes with hard hands on the front foot. Thick edge to gully
length ball just outside off, leans in and jabs this wide of cover
length ball shaping away wide outside off, left alone
length ball, slight shape away from off stump. Defended into the off side on the front foot. Hard hands again
short of a length at leg stump, whipped to deep square off the back foot
length outside off, blocked into the off side
short and jumping away outside off. Loses his shape as he flails at this and is beaten
short of a length on leg stump, on the back foot to stab this wide of mid-on
short ball down leg side, lets that slide
shot. Takes on the bouncer and unlike the first innings, he adds four to Olivier's runs column with the hook this time. Short, up the chest, and a nice swivel to place this where he wants

in front of square this time. They put in a square leg halfway in from the boundary, so he needed to go in front of the stumps this time. Keeps his eyes on this short ball and drags it through midwicket as it slants across him
bouncer at off stump. Gets too big for him to attempt the hook this time
short of a length at the pads, whipped to deep square
short of a length and in at off stump. Tapped to point off the back foot
length outside off, sliced to backward point on the rise
short of a length and in at leg stump, swivels and pulls to fine leg's right
length outside off, punched on the rise to mid-off
short ball up at the throat. Hooks uppishly, but safely in front of deep square
length ball outside off, driven on the rise into the covers
length outside off, punched to extra cover on the up

oh great catch! Markram at wide gully. He's not squatting like a normal cordon fielder does. On his toes and walking in, ever so slightly as the bowler runs in. Then he gets static and is ready to spring at it with a crouch as Faheem looks to cut a ball that is too close for the cut. It flies high to Markram's left but his initial momentum from the faux walk-in means he is in a good position to explode to his left. And he does it. And he gets two hands at it to grab on. Tumbles gracefully to his left to arrest the momentum too. Superb.
mighty full and fizzing away outside off at 144ks, squeezes under the bat and goes to the keeper
bouncer, slanting away outside off, 141ks, Amir sways his upper body out of the way
really full and speared outside off at 143ks, a crease-bound Amir drives weakly... and misses
good length and moving in at off, 141ks, Shadab presses forward and plays it back to Steyn
on a length and sharply angling into off, 140ks, Shadab ventures forward and across as he bunts the ball towards mid-on
back of a length and on off, Shadab gets right behind the line and blocks carefully
much fuller nibbling away outside off, 139ks, left alone
back of a length and holds its line outside off, Shadab gently runs it away towards point
on a length and on a fifth-sixth stump line outside off, no shot
short, wide outside off, Amir throws his bat at it and slashes it up and over gully. No protection at third man to cut that off

Grabbed by Markram at gully, but this is a much simpler catch. Back of a length and on a sixth-stump line, not as short as the previous delivery. Amir chases after it and slices an edge to Markram. SA two wickets away from 3-0
fuller and outside off, Hasan sits back, opens the face, and secures a single to the covers
back of a length and slanting into middle, Shadab shuffles across off stump and pats the ball to mid-on
Rabada bangs a bouncer on middle, 138ks, Shadab ducks under it safely
Shadab rides the bounce of this 140ks short ball outside off and drops it to gully
full and homing in at off stump, Steyn hits 145ks, Hasan covers up in defence
shorter and outside off, Hasan attempts a pull and ends up flat-batting it in the air past the outstretched right hand of Steyn in his followthrough
full and curves in on middle and leg, 145ks, Hasan presses forward and chips it in the air but wide of mid-on
Steyn hits 140ks, Hasan leans into this full one outside off and drives to left of Olivier at short cover
banged in short and outside off, 140ks, Hasan goes after it and splices it up and over point
wide of the crease, angling into the hips, glanced away to short leg's right
back of a length and angling into a smooth push through vacant mid-on
on the pads, Shadab can't get the flick away
Shadab gets on top of a short ball outside off and punches up to cover
full and angling into middle, defended back to the bowler
short and outside off, keeps low, draws the edge but does not carry to the keeper
pitched up and outside off, leans into a drive and places it to the left of Hamza at mid-off
short and just a shade outside off, Shadab gets right behind the line and blocks to cover
on a length and straightens outside off, Shadab dangles his bat out and edges it between slips and gully for four
back of a length and on off, Shadab gets back and punches to point
bouncer, angling in on middle, Hasan ducks under it
short and banged down leg as Hasan gets out of the way once again
Hasan looks away, ducks into a 142ks short ball, catches the glove and loops over gully

Rabada calls for the catch and takes it himself! 146ks short ball aimed at the chest, Hasan is hurried into a hook. He can only top-edge it in the air. The ball drops down into the lap of Rabada. He collects it near the midwicket region. SA one away from 3-0
yorker, tails in on off, 145ks, Abbas jams it out
Abbas looks away from a back of a length ball, he expects a proper bouncer. Rolls off the shoulder of the bat and sneaks away past the cordon
full on off, blocked to mid-off
shorter and outside off, stabbed to the covers
back of a length and ducks back in, inside-edged onto the pad

short and swerves away outside off, 140ks, Shadab swings his hands at a pull. Steyn thinks there was a noise. Not given by umpire Wilson. Elgar asks for a review. Nah, not bat involved. Steyn and de Kock exchange wry smiles. Steyn gesticulates: it's on you, de Kock
jabbed away to short cover, a direct hit could have had Abbas at the striker's end
lifter on middle, Abbas rocks his head out of the way
back of a length and outside off, 142ks, punched on the up to short cover
on a length and outside off, played to the covers
shorter and outside off, fenced to gully on the bounce
Shadab rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and secures a single to point
full and nips back in at 143ks, catches Abbas in the crease, umpire Ravi shoots down the lbw appeal. Heading down leg. SA have exhausted their reviews
back of a length and bends back in, inside-edged to fine leg
on a length and outside off, Shadab presses forward and dead-bats it away
kicks up from a length on off, off the shoulder of the bat and wanders away to third man
dug in short and outside off, 146ks, Shadab splices a pull over the top of mid-on
good length and angling in on middle, stoutly defended back to Steyn
shortish and outside off, crisply punched to cover

Shadab arches back, meets this 141ks short ball outside off, and ramps is smartly over the cordon for four. Pace can be your friend. Pace can also be your enemy. Nice, little innings from Shadab, this
on a length and snakes in, off the inside half and rolls away to the right of short leg
gets on top of a short ball outside off and punches away to deep point. Shadab hares back for the second
bouncer from wide of the crease, Shadab ducks under it
short and wide outside off, Shadab leaps and batters it up and over point. Scythed away with both feet in the air
Shadab aims to duck into a short ball angling in at off, then defends belatedly and keeps it out
full and holds its line outside off, left alone
lifter just a shade outside off, 142ks, Abbas ducks out of the way
short and on leg stump, Abbas ducks again. Steyn cranks it up to 145ks
pitched up and outside off, driven straight off mid-on off the front foot
on a length on off, 143ks, Shadab presses forward and blocks solidly
full and outside off, Shadab gets forward, opens the face, and deftly runs it away between gully and point
sloppy stuff from gully. Abbas rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and fends it to Markram, who misfields and lets Abbas off strike
short at the body, short-armed away to deep midwicket off the back foot
back of a length and shoved down the leg side, away from the reach of Abbas' flick
fuller and outside off, tickled to gully
kicks up from a back of a length outside off, fended off
full-toss dipping in to take the pad, not given by S Ravi. But this seems to be heading down leg and SA have exhausted their reviews
full on off, backs away outside leg and drills to deep cover does Shadab
dangled up on off, 77ks, very full, dead-batted away by Abbas
donkey drop, lands just a shade outside off, defended. 76ks

A mix-up between the wickets and that aptly sums up Pakistan's tour. SA sweep them 3-0! Tossed full around off, forced away towards mid-on, Abbas risks a single, he's eventually sent back by Shadab. Horrible running. Markram, I think, swoops down on the ball and throws it to de Kock, who finishes off the game
Sandeep starts off with a gem of a ball! Perfectly-pitched ball. Full, shaping to swing away, comes in, then again swings away past the hanging bat
very full and angling in, defended
good length and holds its line on off stump, Rohit negotiates it carefully

Deepak Hooda drops it! Sandeep hits a hard length on middle, cramps up Rohit for room. He goes for a pull, instead skies it in the air. Three men converge on the ball, neither call, and Hooda runs back from midwicket, stretches his hands only to shell it
good length and attacking the stumps, blocked
Lewis pats the ball to the left of the bowler, Sandeep swoops down on the ball but misses the direct hit. Lewis wanted a risky single but was sent back by his partner
shorter and just a shade outside off, Stanlake hits the bat hard, blocked to cover
banged in short and outside off, Rohit reads the length quickly. Skips back and nails a pull into the stands beyond long leg. Sails over the long boundary for a six - the first of the night
good length and just a shade outside off, tapped into the covers
full and outside off, patted into the covers
even fuller and outside off, Rohit frees his arms and laces a drive through the covers. The ball fizzes away to the boundary

Shakib dives forward from square leg and pouches a low catch to dismiss Rohit Sharma. Another failure for him as Mumbai Indians' opener. This was short, skiddy, and attacking the body, Rohit is cramped up. This isn't a full-blooded flick. He chips it in the air and watches Shakib take a sprawling catch
First runs in the IPL for Lewis. He launches it into the second tier beyond fine leg. This was a poor ball. Short and sliding outside leg, he picks it off his hips and swivel-pulls it away
back of a length and outside off, punched through the line, the ball bursts through the hands of the cover fielder
back of a length on middle and leg, Sandeep gets it to straighten, defended
back of a length on top of off, punched down to long-off for one
Kishan forays down the track, back of a length on middle, he swings so hard that he loses his shape and drags an inside edge past the leg stump and into the fine leg boundary
around the wicket, full, angling in and straightening to take the outside edge this time. It wanders away fine of short third man for four. Sandeep threatening both edges
back of a length and outside off, 145ks, the extra pace of Stanlake works to Lewis' advantage. He stands tall and unleashes a jabbing punch through extra cover. Fetch that
Stanlake responds with a fiery bouncer on leg stump, forcing the left-hander to duck under it
chest-high short ball on the leg stump, pings the glove of Lewis was looking to fend it off
back of a length and angling across off, Lewis aims for a big leg-side hoick and instead skies it over cover-point for a one-bounce four
short ball shoved down leg, Lewis sneaks inside the line and lets it go
length ball on middle stump, Lewis creates swinging room outside leg and smears it over extra cover. Hit flat and hard for a six
much fuller and sliding in on middle from around the wicket, catches Lewis on the crease. He quietly defends it to the off side
pushed through on middle, presses forward and drives to mid-off
fizzes through outside off, no turn, punched off the back foot to extra cover
flat dart, Kishan ventures a reverse-sweep and does not make contact. Off the thigh pad and rolls away between the keeper and slip. The tracker confirms it pitched outside leg

Sandeep at mid-off drops a relatively simple chance. Pops in and pops out. Rashid unfurls a wrong'un that slides away outside off. Kishan dares to step out and slog. He only top-edges it hiiiiigh into the night sky. It drops down and Sandeep drops it
back of a length on the hips, worked away to midwicket

Sunrisers have their man finally. Back of a length and angling away outside off, Kishan looks to slog it away against the angle and across the line. Another low-percentage shot. This time he skies it to deep third man, where Yusuf Pathan slides on his knees and completes a sharp, low catch despite being blinded by the floodlights
full and shaping away outside off, squirted to the leg side
overpitched and outside off - right in Lewis' swinging arc - he drills it away between the bowler and mid-off. Rasping drive

good length on middle, Lewis manufactures room and slices it in the air over mid-off. Williamson runs back from mid-off, dives, then swivels around swiftly to stop the ball from the reaching the boundary. Excellent work from Williamson

Kaul strikes twice in his first over. He hits the top of off stump and leaps for job. He brings out the knuckle ball, Lewis has no clue about this variation. He is early into his leg-side swing. Kaul cleans him up
flat, dart outside off, chopped away to the covers
very full on middle stump, pushed back to the bowler
full and skids in, dragged away to long-on
tossed up just a shade outside off, Krunal presses forward and runs it back to the bowler
full and outside off, Suryakumar reaches out for the ball and carves it over backward point
back of a length on middle, defended to cover
pitched up outside off, squeezed to mid-off
back of a length on off, hit down to long-on
off-stump yorker, jammed back to the bowler
darted down leg for a wide
tossed outside off, nurdled through the vacant spaces at midwicket
low full-toss, dips on middle, nudged again to midwicket
Shakib tosses it outside off, Krunal stretches out and drives it against the turn in the gap at the covers
pushed through on off stump, Krunal goes low, and reverse-paddles it away fine of short third man

Another soft, soft dismissal. Non-turner outside off, Shakib lobs it up in the air. Krunal expects it to turn but it doesn't. He closes the face early and chips a leading edge to Williamson at extra cover
back of a length on middle, punched down the ground
back of a length and outside off, Suryakumar sizes it up and swats it away to the midwicket boundary with great authority
wide of the crease, back of a length and outside off, steered down to third man
Pollard shimmies out, Stanlake digs it shorter and outside off, gets it to zip past the bat again
Pollard skips out, manufactures a full-toss, and flicks from off stump to deep midwicket
fired on off, run away to short third man
skidder on off stump, nearly 98ks, blocked to cover off the front foot
back of a length and breaks away just a shade outside off, Pollard hangs back and stabs it back to the bowler
very full on middle, forward and hit back to the bowler. Four dots in a row
tossed outside off, Pollard sees the flight, stays still, and lofts it cleanly over Rashid's head for a boundary
quicker googly, breaks back in to beat the inside edge and catch the pad but this is heading past the leg stump
back of a length on off, stabbed away to short midwicket
back of a length on off, punched back, Pollard's bat is in the way, deflected to short midwicket
hurled short on middle, gets big on Suryakumar as he hooks and misses
short, on top of off, punched back to Kaul
back of a length and on a fourth-stump line, Pollard chops his bat down and gets it away fine of short third man for a much-needed boundary
sharp wrong'un, starts outside off and breaks back in, cramps the batsman for room, hits the flap of the front pad. It might have bounced over the stumps
fast legbreak outside off, punched with the turn to cover
tossed up on middle stump, a bit too full for the sweep, tickled to short fine leg where the fielder fumbles
tossed-up wrong'un, swerves in from outside off, Pollard did not pick the variation. It was tantalisingly close to the off stump
shorter on middle, swatted to long-on off the back foot
back of a length on off, Pollard punches it straight back to Shakib
tossed up outside off, Pollard charges down the track. He isn't close enough to the pitch but still muscles it over the cover boundary
tossed outside off, driven through the covers
Pollard punches a six over Stanlake's head. Good length ball on off stump or just a shade outside off, Pollard takes a step back and lifts it imperiously with a high elbow
slower bouncer outside off, bends away, past Pollard's reach
back of a length and outside off, Pollard reaches out for a cut and scythes it away past the right of deep third man sliding in the deep
back of a length and outside off, Pollard can't connect with a little dab to third man

Pollard checks his punch but the ball has carried all the way to Dhawan at sweeper cover. 143.3ks short ball outside off, sticks in the pitch, Pollard yanks his bottom hand off the bat, the ball springs off the bat and into the hands of Dhawan. He slaps his thigh in celebration. What a bizarre dismissal
off-stump yorker, squeezed down to third man
tossed outside off, swept across the line to deep square leg
Suryakumar finally breaks free. Flighted on middle, he backs away outside leg, and launches it over extra cover
back of a length, slides in on middle, hammered to long-on
swept from the stumps to long leg this time
back of a length on middle, swung away to deep square leg
full and angling into a little chip to long-on
slower short ball outside off, flashed to backward point. Suryakumar chances a single but it sent back
back of a length and slanting in on middle, punched down to long-on
backs away and flat-bats a short ball to long-on
full-toss on middle, clipped through square leg
dug in short on middle, Suryakumar holds his shape and swats it away like a fly. Beats deep midwicket to his right
looks like a googly, bounces, Cutting sweeps.... and misses
slider just outside off, Cutting uses the pace of Rashid and scoops it over the head of the keeper

Rashid storms through the gate of Cutting with another ripping wrong'un. This is slower through the air, breaks back in from outside off, Cutting ventures down the track, swishes and does not make contact. Rashid rattles the stumps and claims his first wicket of the night
googly, finishes down leg, wide
pushed through quicker and slides in to hit the thigh
finishes with a legbreak on off, defended. Rashid walks away with outstanding figures of 4-0-13-1, including 18 dots
really full and outside off, toe-ended past the bowler to long-off
slower cutter outside off, barely 103ks, the batsman slogs early and only collects thin air
Sandeep puts Suryakumar out of his misery. He picks up his second wicket with the knuckle ball. Floated outside off, Suryakumar hits early and ends up dragging a catch to Hooda at long-on

big appeal for lbw from Sandeep. This looks plumb. Umpire Nandan, however, shoots down the appeal. SRH challenge the on-field not-out decision. Another knuckle ball, hits the back pad in front of middle as the batsman plays across the line early and misses the ball altogether. It would have crashed into middle stump. Umpire Nandan eventually reverses his decision
full and angling into a little chip to the leg side. Bumrah averts the hat-trick
full and outside off, Bumrah has a big whoooosh and misses. Kaul has overstepped? Tight call from umpire Llong
full and outside off, the free-hit it swiped off the inside half to fine leg
full and outside off, steered past backward point
banged in short on middle, spliced to long-on
knuckle ball outside off, tipped into the covers
very full on off - near yorker, inside-edged behind square on the leg side

Markande finishes Mumbai's innings with a scooped four. He shuffles across off even before Kaul delivers, the bowler pushes it outside off, Kaul holds his shape and ramps it away fine of short fine leg to end the innings on a high. Sandeep Sharma embraces his Punjab team-mate Markande
width outside off, Dhawan slaps this length ball through extra cover.
gets this to straighten from off stump, squirted behind point for a quick single
tucks this shortish delivery to short fine leg for a quick single
on a length and largely holds its line outside off, Saha stays beside the line and bunts the ball to cover
on a length and outside off, glided to third man
slower ball on middle and leg, Dhawan waits for the ball to arrive, then  tucks it away to square leg
on a length and just a shade outside off, Saha loosens his grip and glides a single to deep third man
full and straight, driven away to the left of midwicket, sublime timing from Dhawan as the ball skips away to the boundary
massive whippage of the wrists from Dhawan. Fullish and outside off, picks it up and sends the ball over midwicket
skidding into the pads, deflected away to the leg side

Cutting runs back from mid-on, drops the catch, and parries the ball away to the boundary. Sangwan hits a hard length on off, neither driveable nor pullable, the bat turns in Saha's hands as he skews it and gets away
back of a length on middle, defended to midwicket
banged in short on middle, rushes a hook, top-edged over the keeper for the third boundary of the over
short on middle, Saha looses his grip and fends it off
slower ball on off, guided to point
rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and secures a single to third man
overpitched and outside off, Saha clears his front leg and clouts it over the non-striker's head
shortish and outside off, helped down to third man
full and angling into the pads, picked up and fluently whipped to deep midwicket
tossed outside off, nudged to wide mid-on
straight ball on middle, defended back to Krunal

Dropped by Kishan behind the stumps. He can't cling onto the rebound either. Saha backs away for a cut, instead top-edges the turning ball. Kishan is undone by the bounce as the ball bobbles out. He dives forward but the ball evades his reach
full and straight, clipped through square leg
shorter and faster on middle, forced down to long-on for a single
overpitched and outside off, Dhawan meets the pitch and laces the ball through the covers
slower ball on off, tip and run to the off side
shortish and outside off, run down to third man
Dhawan steps out, slashes and misses outside off
picked off the pads square of short fine leg for four
back of a length and holds its line outside off, Dhawan chops an inside edge past the leg stump. The ball sneaks away to the fine leg boundary
slower through the air outside off, Saha stretches out and paddles it away behind square on the leg side
half-tracker outside off, Dhawan lays into it and cracks it through the covers. Sunrisers cruising
full on middle and spins in, driven to mid-on off the front foot
Dhawan steps out, has a big heave-ho, drags it behind square on the leg side

Saha steps out, Markande foxes him with a quicker googly, hits the thigh pad. Lbw appeal, but umpire Llong does not budge. Going down leg? Mumbai go for a review. Spins in, bounces to hit the front flap, the tracker returns three reds. Umpire Llong is bemused. He reverses his decision
back of a length on middle, swatted down to long-on
hip-high short ball outside off, Dhawn lines it up and smokes it in front of square on the leg side
short on off, chopped only as far as point
short and outside off, punched up to cover. A direct hit could have had Dhawan at the non-striker's end

good length and cutting away outside off, past the outside edge? Kishan goes up for an appeal. Mustafiz isn't convinced. Not given by the umpire. It prompts another review from Mumbai. Breaks away sharply outside off and bounces in the channel, Williamson attempts a late cut but the ball gets big on him. He feathers it behind. UltraEdge detects a tiny spike. No woody sound, just a little spike, and it's enough to overturn the not-out decision. Former Sunriser Mustafiz strikes
good length and spins in to catch the pad. Dhawan takes off for a leg bye and gets another via an overthrow
shorter and outside off, forced down to long-off
flighted and spins away outside off, guided to backward point

Burmrah snags the catch at the edge of the long leg boundary. Markande has opened the game up for Mumbai. Tossed up and bounces on middle, finds the top edge as Dhawan goes to sweep. Bumrah judges it well in the deep. Just like that Mumbai have taken three wickets in three overs
shorter and spins away outside off, Pandey rocks back and cracks it away to the point boundary
flighted outside off, driven to sweeper cover
full on middle, driven to long-off now
drifts in on middle, blocked back to the bowler
really full and outside off, hit to long-off to close out the over
full and spins away outside off, driven to wide long-off off the front foot

Pandey ventures down the track and skies it. Rohit runs across to his right from extra cover, this was Markande's catch but he leaves it to his captain. Rohit stretches across to his right and hangs onto it. For a moment, I thought this was going to fall between Rohit and Markande. It was poor shot from Pandey. He steps out, slogs against the turn and holes out
chopped from off stump to cover
googly, spins away and bounces outside off, carved to point
back of a length and outside off, sliced to third man
Shakib gets on top of a short ball outside off and cuts it away to the point boundary
back of a length and tucked away to fine leg
full-toss on the waist, worked away through square leg
fizzing cutter, swerves away outside off, past the outside edge. The keeper is beaten as well by the bounce or the lack of it. They sneak in a bye
tossed up on middle, presses forward and drives to midwicket
full on middle, tapped down to long-on
full and outside off, googly? sliced to backward point
down the track and driven down to long-on for a single

Markande has his fourth with his last ball of the night. Wrong'un, breaks away outside off, Shakib reads it off the pitch, and drags a thick inside edge back onto the stumps. What a spell from Markande. He ends with a potentially match-winning 4-0-23-4
back of a length and outside off, run down to deep third man
short and on top of off, punched back to the bowler
chest-high short ball on middle, Yusuf hooks it away past the left of fine leg for a one-bounce four
slower offcutter on off, defended back to the bowler
short and outside off, hangs back and hits it to long-on
back of a length on middle, sensibly knocked into the gap at midwicket
full and angling into a push to short midwicket
shortish and outside off, steered down to third man
back of a length and outside off, sliced away to third man
gets on top of a short ball outside off and crunches it through the line to sweeper cover. Sangwan slides to his left but fumbles. He slides back again and stops the ball from reaching the boundary
cutter outside off, runs past the outside edge
short and angling away outside off, guided with the angle to backward point
full, wide, slashed to sweeper cover
another slower cutter, dabbed to short third man
Yusuf reaches out for a cutter but misses it outside off. Beaten. Time out

picked off the hips to deep midwicket. Hooda and Yusuf scamper across for the second. The throw is to the keeper's end and Hooda dishes out a desperate full-length dive and just makes it. The dive saves Hooda
back of a length and outside off, sensibly dabbed down to short third man
rides the bounce of another shortish ball and steers to short third man
slower short ball on the leg stump, Hooda has a big slog at it and only toe-ends it onto the pitch. He, however, calls his partner through for a single
back of a length and outside off, he reaches out for a dab and misses
hip-high short ball on off stump, Pathan was waiting for the bad ball. He gets it now. Helped away past short fine leg for four. Sunrisers will breathe easy
back of a length and angling in towards off stump, dragged away towards wide long-on
wide yorker, squirted to deep third man
inswinging yorker on middle, jammed to the covers for one
Bumrah bounces out Pathan and gives Mumbai hope. Chest-high short ball on middle, rushes a pull, Pathan flaps it in the air. Pollard at short midwicket lumbers to his right and clings onto the ball

Two in two balls for Bumrah! He has Rashid nicking off now. Pitched up and outside off, Rashid stays leg-side of the ball and aims for an expansive dive. He does not get enough bat on it and only edges it behind to Kishan. Okay, I spoke too soon. Sunrisers still need 12 off 13 balls
very full and straight - near yorker - squeezed back. Two wickets and three runs off the over. Well done, Bumrah. Sunrisers need 12 off 12 balls
back of a length on off, backs away and stabs to cover. Hooda stutters and eventually takes the single
cutter, moving away outside off, Kaul pushes away from the body and watches the ball run past the outside edge
very full and angling across off, another big swing and a miss. Hooda walks up to Kaul and has a word with him

Mustafiz pockets a one-handed return catch. This was a Mustafiz special: cutter, skipping away outside off, Kaul chips a leading edge to the left of the bowler. Mustafiz stretches out his left hand and comes out with the ball. Mumbai edge ahead
yet another cutter, nipping away outside off, opens Sandeep up and goes past the outside edge

Mustafizur has his hands aloft in delight. Sandeep attempts to clear short fine leg. No dice. He shows his ace early and shuffles across off stump. Mustafiz chases him with a short ball that gets big on the batsman. He miscues a scoop to Krunal Pandya. Not sure if the batsmen crossed over
full-toss, angling away outside off, Hooda clears his front leg, then bends his knee, and sends it clattering over extra cover for a six. First six of the chase in the last over
Cutting loses his line and his head. Sprayed wide past the marker. Left alone
back of a length and angling away wide outside off from round the stumps, Hooda slashes with all his might, but loses his shape, and only collects fresh air
low full-toss outside off, bunted down to the right of long-off. Hooda looks for the second. But Pollard is too quick for him
slower ball floating into the pads, tickled away to the leg side. Stanlake and Hooda scamper across for the single. The fumble from Rohit helped their cause
Hooda shuffles across the off stump, banged in short and attacking the body, miscues a scoop in the air. Bumrah runs in from short fine leg but the ball lands in front of him. Scores are tied

Field up, what?Stanlake hits over the top and secures a thrilling win for Sunrisers. Pretty full on middle stump, yet another slower ball from Cutting, Stanlake does not get all of it but manages to swipe it over midwicket for a boundary. Hooda embraces Stanlake and the celebrations begin in the Sunrisers camp
length on middle, a gentle delivery but on target, movement back into Dimuth, who is struck on the thigh pad hanging back
length outside off, Dimuth gets on his toes and taps the ball down close to his feet
length outside off, Dimuth hangs back again, pats it away to the off side
length outside off again, a bit more width this time, Dimuth chases it with his hands a little, which might not be the best option but guides it safely to point on that occasion
full and swinging back in, slips down the leg side for Sri Lanka's first runs through extras
slightly fuller but short enough to allow Dimuth to camp on the backfoot, taps it to the off side
short on middle, a poor drag down delivery on a pitch that should have plenty on it, doesn't rise enough either, pulled away through square leg for four
better length but a hint of width on offer, punches it through the covers without trying to hit it too hard and the timing's good for three
fuller and swinging back in, Dimuth misses the flick but the deflection off the thigh pad allows a single as Shahzad isn't able to collect it cleanly
length on off, and that's swatted down the ground, beats mid-off to his left and races to the fence
length on middle, pushed to mid-on and they scamper through for a quick single
full outside off, Dimuth pushes with his hands and squirts it away past point and down to third-man for a couple
length on middle, hurries on with a bit of seam movement back, surprised by the pace he takes it on the body
shorter around middle again, doesn't rise much and he helps it along to fine-leg for one
length outside off, quick delivery, nearly 90mph, left alone by Dimuth
fuller around off, Dimuth unsure about coming forward and staying back but defends it pretty late
length around off, rocks back and defends towards point
short one on middle, quick delivery but he ducks under it
Length on off, jags back in sharply as Perera gets an inside edge for one towards square leg
misdirected down the leg side and the movement takes it further away from the diving keeper. wayward bowling by Afghanistan
length outside off, steered to third-man
full on middle and clipped past square leg, the bat turned in his hand but the timing was still good enough to take it all the way to the long square boundary
length outside off and cracked straight to point
length on middle, extra bounce for him, the bottom hand comes off Perera's bat as he defends it back to the bowler
fuller on off and he drags it across the line with those powerful forearms, clears square leg, who gave it a valiant chase but couldn't keep it in play with a dive
bouncer and it's too high even for the keeper, sails over him and into the boundary
slower ball on off, pushed to the off side and with the fielders hanging on their heels, they steal a quick single
full outside off, left alone
length and shaping back in but the problem is that it starts too straight and slips further down the leg side
length on off from around the wicket, draws him forward and leaves him audaciously late, superb delivery to finish off a poor over
length on middle, swept hard and aerially towards deep square leg, on the bounce to the fielder
full on off, pushed to long-on for one
slower on off, pushed to mid-off and they come through for a quick single
googly outside off, it's much slower and tossed up, pushed to cover
another googly on off, comes forward and defends
full and quicker on middle, flicked away along the ground through midwcket, all timing and that's another boundary
tossed up on middle, he comes down the wicket and almost turns it into a yorker
slower on off, swept along the ground to deep square leg
pulls his length back slightly, pushed to midwicket
tossed up on off, waits for it and defends with a straight bat
full and down the leg side, called wide
slower on off, waits for it and defends towards midwicket

length outside off, it's a flatter delivery, he comes down the wicket and picks it up wide of long-on, it made a cracking sound off the bat but only goes for four as it's the longest part of the ground
back to back fours and well anticipated by the batsman! H was waiting for Mujeeb to drop it short having advanced the previous ball, cracked past point
fuller and straighter, defended
length on off, backs away to cut but the width isn't there, chops it away towards point
tossed up on off, pushed to long-on for one
short and quick on middle, pulled away along the ground to deep square leg
length on off, pushed back to the bowler
slower on middle, pushed to long-on
full on middle, pushed to long-on for one
quicker one on middle, he hangs back and pushes it to mid-off, which makes the quick single riskier but he makes it in time
full on off, out comes the reverse sweep but can't beat short third-man
length outside off, cut away to cover-point
length on middle, pushed to long-on
length on middle, defended back
good length ball on the pads at 122 kph/76 mph, flicked through square leg.
good length ball again on the legs, slower pace at 102 kph/63 mph, nudged through midwicket as Gulbadin gives chase.
fullish length on middle stump angled across, driven straight to extra cover.
CLOSE! good length ball on middle, loose flick from captain toward his opposite number, Gulbadin lunged left in his follow-through but it's about two feet wide of his reach and goes to mid-on.
good length again on middle and off, flicked in the air toward Samiullah Shinwari at deep square leg on as a sub fielder.
short on off stump, pulled fiercely into the ground to Shinwari at deep square leg again.
slightly short on off, pulled to deep midwicket.
floaty ball lands full at 51 mph, dug out to midwicket.
comes back with a quicker arm ball into the legs again, misses a back foot flick, stifled lbw appeal as the ball dribbles to short third man.
full outside off, flicked across the line to midwicket where Gulbadin misfields to allow a run. He's apparently hurt his hand sliding and Shinwari returns once more as a sub.
full and very wide outside off, driven to Rahmat at long-off.
slower ball again, really really slow at 100 kph/62 mph, lands on a good length but on the legs, easily tucked behind square to the man at 45 for a safe run.
good length on the legs, flicked fine of deep backward square and they hustle a pair.
full on the legs again, Gulbadin struggling with his line as another run is picked off to deep backward square.
short and pitching outside leg stump, pulled to deep square leg.
good length ball on off, first one he's pitched to the right of leg stump line this over, checks a drive back just short of the bowler.
full outside off, pushed with soft hands toward Mujeeb at mid-off who is slow attacking the ball.

Nabi does him in the flight! Karunaratne came down the pitch to one at 82 kph/51 mph. It dipped on him more than he expected and was playing for a bit of turn trying to drive over mid-off but it was the arm ball and the bat turns in his hand not timing it at all. The ball flutters toward Najibullah at long-on. He comes in 7 yards from the rope and takes the catch crouching down at shin height.
good length ball, goes back to punch off the back foot to long-on.
comes down the pitch, Nabi drags the length back slightly on middle, checked into a defensive shot to point.
short of a length angled into the legs, punched off the back foot again to long-on.
floated full and very wide at 78 kph/48 mph, driven square to point.
full on fifth stump, driven to Mujeeb at mid-off, sliding stop but fumbles as they pick on him for another single.
full and angled into off stump, defended back to Gulbadin.
fullish length outside off, legcutter driven in the air off a thick edge well wide of slip to third man.
the slooooooooooowwer ball from Gulbadin again at 96 kph/60 mph, pitching short on the legs, flicked behind square.
full on off stump, overstep by Gulbadin by a good two inches. Remarkable for the pace he's bowling at. Free hit to come.

another slower ball, gone to the well one time too many at 62 mph, and way too short allowing Thirimanne to keep his hands back long enough to flat bat this past Gulbadin and the umpire Nigel Llong down the ground.
good length angled in on middle stump line, clipped off the back foot wide of mid-on.
full on the legs, clipped to Zazai at short fine leg, who fires wide of Shahzad for an overthrow. Mujeeb at cover sweeper dives to keep it to two overthrows instead of four.
good length ball on off, punched awkwardly short of mid-off.
good length ball on the legs, clipped straight to Zazai at 45.
flighted a touch more, googly landing on middle and defended with a full face back to Rashid.
very full on middle, punched down the pitch and cut off by long-off.
full on middle, clipped straight to midwicket.
full and angled across off stump, left alone.
fullish length on off, defended softly to backward point.

good length ball outside off, punched off the back foot behind point to third man. Zazai is fielding fine and has a long way to go. Kusal didn't want a second but Thirimanne called him through belatedly. Poor throw by Zazai, who has a very weak arm. Direct hit might have had Kusal in trouble and Gulbadin gestures his displeasure with the relay.
full on off, driven off a thick edge to Zazai at third man on the rope again. Nigel Llong signals a no ball once more for an overstep. Absurd from Gulbadin at his pace. Another free hit coming now.
wide yorker, too wide to be legal. Free hit still in play.
wide yorker lands wider outside off this time. More free runs and another free hit to come.
50 up for Kusal Perera! Gulbadin finally lands one within the legal space on a good length, hammered on the up over cover. Just 13 dots on the 42 balls faced thus far along with seven fours now.
short of a length on middle, cut to Zazai who fumbles at third man. He's a complete liability out there. It turns one into two.
short and wide, cracked wide of Mujeeb sweeping on the cover rope. Nigel Llong shouts out 'NO!' for the second time this over. Turning into a nightmare for Gulbadin. 10th ball of the frame coming up.
slower ball lands full outside off in the slot, hammered along the ground this time through the covers. Sri Lanka getting a big confidence booster in the first 90 minutes of play here.
full on off, defended on the front foot to extra cover.
flighted very full on off, pushed back to Rashid.
full on off, defended again into the ground.
good length on the legs, googly spinning to off and flicked across the line to square leg for a tight run.
good length ball on off, punched to long-off.
knee high full toss wide outside off, Thirimanne doesn't punish him as much as he could have, slaps it to long-off.
good length on the legs, clipped to long leg.
short of a length on off angled in, opens the face to run it to third man.
good length ball outside off, jags off the seam to beat a waft.
short of a length wide outside off again, guided with an open face to third man on the rope again.
full and wide, drives hard and a thick edge flies off two bounces to Nabi at the third man rope.
full and wide, sucker ball driven off a thick edge wide of slip to Nabi again on the third man rope.
full outside off, driven to the cover sweeper Dawlat and they hare a tight two picking on his arm.
flighted on a good length very wide of off stump, spins back just inside the guideline to avoid a wide after being left alone.
good length ball on sixth stump spinning in, defended on the front foot but hits the pads off an inside edge. Stifled lbw shout.
full and defended back to Rashid.
very full outside off, driven back to Rashid who dives to stop moving right in his follow-through.
full on the stumps, clipped through square leg.
length outside off, steered to third-man for one
length outside off, steered to third-man's left and that's good for two
short ball outside off, quite high, left alone but the umpire extends a bit of leniency
tossed up on off, defended to cover

through him off the inside edge! Really slowed it up, pulled the length back, and Thirimanne, as he often is, was casual in trying to turn it somewhere towards mid wicket and ended up dragging it back on to his stumps

second time lucky for Nabi, who's having a gem of a day! Beautiful loop, drawing the batsman forward, but as though held on a string it drops just short of where Mendis could have smothered it, goes on with the arm and takes the outside edge straight to slip this time. Excellent captaincy to have the slip in
length on outside off., Mathews goes right back and defends back

would you believe it, three in the over and Nabi is turning the match on its head! Another arm ball outside off, beautiful length as well creating the doubt in Mathews' mind as to come forward or go back, he does neither, hangs his bat out and the outside edge takes the Shahzad's gloves before being safely pouched by first slip
short ball, angled in, pulled away towards square leg and Perera is keen on the second, the fielder fumbles before sending in a weak return to the keeper
length on off, stays back and defends to the off side
fuller on off, defended
length, bit of drift back in for Nabi again, defended
length outside off, pushed to deep cover for one
full on off, bit of drift again, defended
pulls his length back just a little, still draws him forward, squeezed away to point
full on off, defended
tossed up on off, pushed to the off side, it's all a little frenetic at the moment, even the running between the wickets, Thisara really had to hurry there
short one, tries to pull it away but gets it high on the bat and can't beat mid-on
length around off and this is becoming routine now, cuts away after threatening to come in with the angle
length on off, defended back
slightly shorter on middle, helped along to deep square leg
length outside off, cut away to deep point
a rare poor ball from Nabi, short and slow outside off, cut away to deep cover's left for two
flatter one goes down the leg side this time
another flatter one, angled in, tickled to short fine off the pad

quicker on off, pushed to cover and do we have a run-out here? Afghanistan are confident. This was always on the cards with the amount of indecision that had crept in and the replays confirm, Thisara is short of his ground despite the dive
full on off, pushed to cover
tossed up outside off, comes forward and defends
length outside off, Kusal chops it away to deep point
length on off,  banged hard into the surface, defended
length on middle, defended back
short one on middle, goes for the pull but it hurries on to him
short one,  a quick one that takes off and clears the keeper
fuller on off, straightens off the seam as the batsman comes forward to defend, squirts it away to third-man
length outside off, and shapes away off the seam after drawing Perera into having a poke
full on off and finally some aggression against Nabi, lofted down the ground and clears the short straight boundary
full on middle, pushed back
quicker one, drifts in, defended back
tossed up on off, comes down the track and kicks it away
full outside off, comes forward and pushes it to deep cover for one
full on middle, pushed to midwicket
quicker and flatter on off, pushed to long-off off the backfoot
full on off, comes forward and defends
flatter one, angled in, defended off the backfoot
googly on off, stays back and defends
length outside off, chopped away to point
length and angling in, backs away and defends again
slows it up and pulls the length back, Perera backs away again but that kicked and turned off the surface
length outside off, cut away towards point for one
another arm ball, quicker also, stays back and defends
full outside off, strides forward to smother to cover.
good length googly spinning in from outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover.
good length ball outside off, slapped to backward point.
good length ball, defended on off stump to cover.
good length googly on off spinning to middle, defended awkwardly back to Rashid.
full on on off, defended on the front foot. Maiden from Rashid.
yorker, stabbed out with intent.
yorker length again on fourth stump, goes for a drive and drags an edge past leg stump. OOOHHHs from the crowd, which is heavily pro-Afghan despite the small numbers overall.

What are you DOING UDANA?! 19 overs left to bat and Udana lifts his head for a wild slog over the River Taff. Full and straight on the stumps from Dawlat and the zing bails go flying as middle stump is knocked back. Dawlat runs through wagging his index finger to the skies. SL team management might be doing more than that once Udana walks through the changing room door.
greeted with a bouncer. Lakmal handled it well ducking comfortably, Shahzad behind the stumps was toppled by it though, drawing a laugh from Dawlat.

EDGE! Doesn't carry. Short of a length on fourth stump, Dawlat cramps him as he tries to fend back, played it with soft hands though and it bounces four yards short of Shahzad. Got more of Lakmal's right/bowling hand than the shoulder of the bat and the physio is on the field now to give some numbing spray.
short again, guided off the back foot behind point to deep third man.
googly from Rashid pitches too short outside off, enough time for Lakmal to read it off the pitch and get onto the back foot to clip through square leg and get off strike.

MY GOODNESS! Goes for the reverse sweep and now goes to the pavilion! He tried to pick the line on about fourth stump with Rashid regularly bowling googlies, it's not the worst option as he'd be hitting with the spin. But the length is a touch too full for the shot. The result is he gloves it instead of getting any bat on it. Shahzad holds onto the deflection. Sri Lanka's set man is gone!
fullish length wide outside off, misses a flat footed poke.
full on the legs, smothered without footwork.

NEARLY ANOTHER RUNOUT! Full going down leg and it clips the pads down to fine leg. Malinga jogs the first. Lakmal wanted a second and Malinga was slow coming back. Dawlat chases it down from short fine leg and an off balance relay is rushed to Shahzad. Malinga was five yards short but Shahzad was pulled away from the stumps by Dawlat's hurried throw and his flick back to the stumps wasn't going to be in time as a result.
length outside off, pushed to deep cover
short outside off, pretty wide, Malinga was backing away, lets it through
length on middle, better line seeing as Malinga's backing away, which he was again, defends it back to the bowler
length on off and first display of aggression from Malinga, expected that length again, didn't back away as much and swatted it over mid-off
length outside off, poor line, just hangs his bat out and gets it away to deep cover for one
length on off, skids on to him as he stays back and pushes it to the off side
fuller but drifting in, defended towards midwicket
full outside off, comes forward and defends solidly to the off side
full on off and another solid defensive stroke, perhaps recognizing Rashid's threat
length on off, skids on but Malinga is up to the task, brings his bat down straight and on time to defend it to the off side
googly, much slower, outside off and shorter, Malinga waits for it and steers it to short third man
short and into the body, doesn't get high enough and he pounces on it, hits it hard into the ground and through midwicket for four crucial runs that he himself has to defend
length on middle, , behind it and defends
another short one on middle and Lakmal seems to have hurt the bowler's ego and he's now reaping reward, backs away and swats it to long-on on this occasion
better delivery, yorker on middle, not particularly fast so he's able to squeeze it out

another short one, slower ball this time, followed Lakmal as he backed away, gets an inside edge back on to his body and they come through for a quick single despite the direct hit a the non striker's end
finally gets one target! reminiscent of Malinga himself at his best, a slow looping yorker on middle, dipped appreciably and Malinga couldn't squeeze it out
length on middle, skids on, he tries to pull it away, a dangerous option, gets a bit of a thick inside edge towards square leg
full on off, comes forward and defends
length on middle, skids on, Pradeep looks to go across the line and misses but it's too high
full and sliding down the leg side
length on the pads, defended to midwicket
an absolute snorter to end the innings, much too good for the tailender! Legspinner on middle and off, completely squared him up and clipped off stump
outswinging yorker to start, blocked out by Shahzad.
fullish length ball swinging away, Shahzad pokes at it a fraction late outside off, beaten badly without much footwork.
yorker on the pads, flicked away by Zazai wide of long leg. Excellent effort by Nuwan Pradeep to turn a boundary into two.
yorker again, this one on middle stump, Zazai somehow stabs this out to backward square leg to get off strike.
full and swinging away from Shahzad on middle stump, he tries to flick this through midwicket. Way out in front, leading edge squirts through point.
HOW DID THIS MISS THE STUMPS!?! Very full almost yorker length ball on off stump, Zazai swings over the top of it playing across the line, it barely misses shaving off stump.
drops short and is hammered! After nearly bowling him the previous ball, Lakmal curiously decides to go short and Zazai spanks him over midwicket, hits the rope on the full.
fullish length ball swinging into leg stump line, Zazai clears the front leg and heaves this out to a deep midwicket now in place.
short of a length on fourth stump line, touch of swing again but not going to bother Shahzad on that length, gets behind the line and defends it off the back foot.
short of a length again, this time on a sixth stump line, Shahzad gets back and punches this off the back foot bisecting backward point and extra cover, teasing backward point's chase to the rope.
tighter this time on that same back of a length closer to fifth stump now, not as much room to free the arms and Shahzad defends on the back foot.
full on a fifth stump line angled in, Zazai blocks it with his arms, no footwork.
knee high full toss on a sixth stump line outside off, Zazai still with no footwork slaps at it and picks out backward point. Missed boundary there.
BLISTERING DRIVE! Overpitched on fourth stump by Malinga, no swing this time, a smidgen of footwork this time from Zazai and he smokes this to the left of extra cover.
attempted slower ball yorker, crosses Zazai at shin height on fifth stump, powers a flat drive but straight to mid-off. Second time this over Malinga gets away with a full toss for a dot ball.
very very full on off stump swinging in, Zazai swipes after clearing the front leg, creams it flat along the ground to mid-on.
slower ball on a good length on leg stump at 113 kph/70 mph, Zazai keeps the hands back and flicks gently through midwicket to keep strike.

full on middle and leg, Zazai continuing with the front leg clearance every single ball, this time it's in the slot for him to heave wide of mid-on. The tricolour black, red and green flags are waving furiously in Cardiff!
bouncer outside off, way too high for Zazai to have a chance to play, wide called on height.
another bouncer, this time angled in at shoulder height on the off stump line, Zazai is late hooking. This one is deemed legal though.
full and angled into leg stump, flicked through to deep midwicket.
good length ball angled past Shahzad's hips, misses a flick but it's a bonus run for Afghanistan.
peach! good length ball on fifth stump line jags back in, beats Shahzad hopping on the back foot between bat and pad.
good length ball swinging away on a sixth stump line, Shahzad comfortably shoulders arms.
good length ball, tighter this time on fifth stump but still not close enough to the stumps to draw Shahzad into a stroke as he shoulders arms again.

slower ball lands on a fullish length, Zazai was slightly fooled at 113 kph/70 mph with his front leg having gone a long way out to the leg side, but he was able to keep his hands back just enough to swat it over midwicket. Solid adjustment.

DROPPED! Shelled! Grassed! Kusal Mendis! Zazai was late trying to pull Malinga at 131 kph/81 mph, skier is in the air for a long time as Kusal Mendis sprints in from deep square leg. Got there in time to settle his body reaching forward at thigh height and it caroms off his hard palms. My goodness! It was 3/10 on the degree of difficulty scale. But he made a monumental mess of it.
good length ball on off, defended.

The captain shows how it's done in the field! Full length on leg stump at 84 mph, Shahzad flicked it ever so slightly uppishly and Karunaratne at short midwicket lunges forward and clasps it at ankle height. 8/10 degree of difficulty but he made it look easy. A dent in Afghanistan's rapid start.
good length ball on off stump, Rahmat goes onto the back foot to defend to extra cover.
full on middle, defended once more to cover.
nearly a return catch! Fullish length angling into off stump, awkward prod with no footwork, floats just short of Udana in his follow-through.
yorker on middle, dug out to deep midwicket.
fullish length on fifth stump line, Rahmat leans forward and drives between cover and extra cover, safely enough between the fielders to pinch a single.
ankle high full toss on fifth stump, driven back past Udana to mid-off.
slower ball on a good length angling into the legs, clipped to deep midwicket.
fullish length on middle at 81 mph, clipped wide of midwicket, Zazai wanted a run but Rahmat wasn't sold and turns back as Thirimanne swoops in front of the square leg umpire to cut it off.
slower wide yorker attempted, almost off the pitch outside off though. He'll have to redo it.
full on off stump at 86 mph, driven to mid-on.
good length ball slower delivery at 112 kph/69 mph, flicked behind square for a run.
good length ball angling away on sixth stump line, left alone comfortably.
bouncer, Rahmat rolls his wrists over a pull along the ground to long leg.
slower ball pitching outside leg stump at 69 mph, clipped through the leg side with ease.
fullish length ball pitching on off stump, defended off the back foot to extra cover.

yorker on middle stump, dug out and Udana tries to knock it down off a bounce moving left in his follow-through but also has to negotiate Rahmat at the non-striker's end and the ball squirts through to long-on for a run.
nearly drags on! Good length ball angled across off stump. Rahmat doesn't get his feet moving much with a forward prod. Gap between bat and pad and the inside edge ricochets into his feet.
good length ball on middle and off, this time Rahmat shuffles his feet across to get behind the line, defended firmly into the ground.
fullish length outside off on fourth stump line, driven softly to cover.

great bowling by Udana is rewarded! Udana kept on teasing Rahmat with that fourth/fifth stump line on a consistently good length. After nearly dragging on earlier in the over playing away from his body, Rahmat is sucked into another play well away from his body and this time it clips the outside edge. It carries to Mathews at thigh height, as he crouches slightly to cushion the take in the breadbasket. Sri Lanka starting to claw back!
fullish length outside off, drives with hard hands and a thick edge goes well wide of slip down to third man on the rope.
short of a length on fourth stump, goes back to knock this down behind point for a run to third man.

OH MY GOODNESS! 10 OUT OF 10 FROM THE FRENCH JUDGE FOR THISARA PERERA! Pradeep bounced Zazai, who hooked flat and hard toward long leg. Thisara had about 1.5 seconds to cover 15 yards haring to his left. The ball never got more than 10-15 yards above the ground but he judged it immaculately before diving forward to clasp on two inches above the turf. Spectacular, a momentum-shifting effort!
short of a length on the body, defended to square leg.
short of a length on fifth stump, defended to cover.
short of a length outside off, almost a wide, left alone.
short of a length angled into off stump, extra bounce extracted by Udana and Shahidi drops his hands late to avoid edging it.
good length ball on off, comes forward to defend, backward point misfields badly to allow a run.
fullish length ball on fifth stump, Nabi shuffles across to get behind the line and defend to cover.
fullish length ball on off stump, Nabi comes forward to defend, inside edge cannons off his inner thigh through his legs and they scamper an alert run to fine leg.
short of a length ball. Shahidi hops on his toes to defend.
length on off, defended
full on the pads, driven to mid-on
full on off, shuffles ever so slightly and defends to cover
full outside off, driven to cover's right without any timing
delivered from pretty wide, full on middle and he goes through the line, just an extension of a defensive stroke and into the boundary at long-on
length on middle, turns it around towards midwicket and they come through for a quick single
length on off, pushed to cover
length outside off, punched straight to point
length on off, defended to cover
length outside off, gets on his toes and punches it past point's right and down to third man for one

short one, angled across, Nabi tried to casually help it along with one leg in airborne, got a top edge that fell in no man's land. there was an appeal for run-out at the non striker's end but Hashmatullah made it comfortably
length on off, defended to cover
nearly drags it back on, saved by his own pad. Length ball angled across, he defended that with half a bat and nearly paid the price
short one, doesn't rise much but he ducks under it, nevertheless

edged and taken! Sri Lanka have roared back into the contest and they're bossing this game. Extra bounce there for Pradeep as Hashmatullah tried to drive it off the backfoot and only managed a nick to the keeper. The square cut may have been a better choice there but a good old fashioned leave would have been ideal.
full on off, driven to mid-off
length on off, gets an inside edge back onto the pad as he looks to defend
extra bounce again and beats the outside edge! Length outside off, a beautiful leg cutter that left him as he had a poke
length on middle, defended

that's through bat and pad and Nabi won't be the hero with the bat! One had snaked away from him couple of balls ago, this one was fuller, drew him forward and jagged back in off the seam to crash into off and middle
full on off, stays back and defends
full outside off, comes forward and caresses it through the covers for three
short ball on middle and leg, ducks under it
length on off, stays back and defends to point
length outside off, too much width, leans into it nicely and drives it crisply through the covers
length outside off, steered to third-man
short one, angled in, he ducks under it
length on off, punched to mid-on
length outside off, too much width, he just hung his bat out at it but the timing was surprisingly good, bisects point and cover and into the boundary
length on middle, adjusts his line, defended back to the bowler
full outside off, he throws his bat at it again, finds the gap through the covers again and that's another boundary
full on off, opens the face and defends to point
length on off, defended to cover
length on off, chopped away towards point
length on middle, defended back
short one, angled in from around the wicket, sways out of the way and the umpires deem it too high
length on middle, banged hard into the surface, stays back and defends to the off side
change of angle, over the wicket this time, length on middle, defended back to the bowler
full outside off, leans into it and gets a single down to deep cover
full outside off, it's overpitched but he's unable to capitalise, squeezes it awkwardly to cover
length outside off, the bowler goes up as he beats the bat, but nobody joined him
length outside off, slapped to cover
length outside off, seams away further, he throws his bat at it again, misses but so does the keeper, low to his left and they come through for a bye
full on middle, pushed to mid-on, they take off for a quick single and there's a direct hit at the non striker's end but he makes it comfortably
full outside off, drives on the up and sloppy fielding by Udana at cover allows a couple as it goes through him
short one, the batsman shows no interest as it's too high
another short one, too high again
length outside off, pushed to point
full on middle, and punched down the ground, bisects mid-on and mid-off and into the boundary
short one outside off, no pace on it, he shuffles across and hammers it in front of square, all along the ground for another four
length on middle from around the wicket, an angle he attempted during the IPL, defended back
short one down the leg side
another short one on middle, doesn't rise and Gulbadin does well to stay low with his hands as he help it along to deep square leg
slower ball on off, defended to point
slower one on the pads, tucked away towards square leg and they come through for two. Except, it will only be one as the umpire at the non striker has called it one-short
length on off, defended
full on off, driven back to the bowler
full outside off, drilled to mid-off for one
full outside off, pushed to cover
length outside off, steered to third man
full outside off, steered to third-man and we have a match on our hands regardless of what the whether is like going ahead. There could be some rain around, so we've made it just in the nick of time
fullish length on the stumps, Gulbadin chips uppishly but just short of mid-on.
short of a length on fourth stump and seaming in, Gulbadin goes back to defend, inside edge into the thigh.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended with little footwork to extra cover.
fullish length ball, driven firmly to mid-off.
short of a length on fifth stump, Gulbadin shuffles back to flick across wide of mid-on.
full and very wide, Najibullah drives off a thick edge over backward point, Pradeep covers 20 yards to his left at third man to slide and deny the boundary. Solid effort.
nearly drags on first ball! Identical ball that claimed Rahmat. Good length on a fifth stump line, Gulbadin drove away from his body, inside edge goes past the stumps to long leg.
fullish length on off stump, Gulbadin comes onto the front foot to defend back to Udana.
bouncer at 80 mph/130 kph, Gulbadin sways back to leave.
full on middle stump, swings across the line to flick behind square, long leg has a lot of ground to cover and it's a simple two.
good length ball angled across on fourth stump, defended on the back foot through mid-off.
full toss at thigh height, flicked off his legs through square leg and they pick up another pair.
short of a length pitching on leg stump angled across, goes to the back foot to defend back to Pradeep.
bouncer on the body, Najibullah gets in a slight tangle ducking out of the way but evades danger in the end.
good length ball on fifth stump, zero footwork from Najibullah as he cross bats it defensively back to Pradeep.
bouncer, down the leg side, umpire had the option to call a wide on height or the line down the leg side.
good length pitching outside leg angled into the stumps, Najibullah goes back and defends to short midwicket, Pradeep pounces in his follow-through.
bouncer for the third time in the over, called a wide on height.
short of a length on fourth stump, defended to backward point.
full on off, defended on the front foot.
good length on middle spinning into the pads, clipped off the back foot behind square.
full on fourth stump, driven back to de Silva.
full on the legs, clipped to short fine leg, Malinga. Panicky shouts in the middle. Najibullah with a big hesitation mid-pitch but his dive had him safe in the end.
full on off, driven to long-on.

the reverse! Flighted on a good length on middle angling into leg stump, not nearly to the pitch of the ball but he goes through with the premeditated shot anyway and hammers it behind point. Fabulous stroke.
full outside off, driven square to the point sweeper.
fullish length angled across fourth stump, flat-footed drive and a thick edge squirts to third man on the rope.
full length ball on fourth stump angled into off, driven firmly to mid-on.
bouncer, not only clears Gulbadin but Kusal behind the stumps leaps in vain and it's 5 bonus runs!
short of a length ball on the stumps, defended toward extra cover.

GONE! And goes for the review but this looked golden on the live shot! Full length ball pitching on off and angling into the pads. Najibullah was late with a flick across the line going a fraction onto the back foot. Ball-tracking stays on field with the ball shaving leg-stump on umpire's call!
fullish length outside off, driven crisply through cover.
full and angling down the pads, Rashid misses a flick, clips the pad on the way to the keeper.
good length ball on fourth stump, punched off the back foot just wide of extra cover, well-judged run to mid-off.
fifth stump ball on a good length, prodded with zero footwork to point.
touch wider on a good length on a sixth stump line, again Najibullah waves at it with his arms and knuckles it back down the pitch.
tighter on the stumps this time on a fourth stump line, defended with a slight front foot shuffle to point.
fourth stump line again on a good length to Najibullah, defends nervously to cover.

Castled! Pradeep did this to Scotland just a few weeks ago at the Grange and now he's bringing another match-winning spell to Cardiff! Good length ball jags back from outside off stump, Rashid was pinned on the crease not really coming forward or back. Tries to stab the bat down across the line belatedly and the ball brushes off his knee roll into the stumps.
very full and angled into the pads, big lbw shout denied. Didn't look close live. Angling down leg for sure.
short of a length ball, Dawlat pushes awkwardly at it and a leading edge loops well short of Pradeep.

three stooges act reprised at Cardiff! Full on middle stump, pushed down the pitch, Pradeep misfielded in his follow-through. The momentum carried to Malinga at mid-off who slid over the ball on the slick outfield. Then Mathews completes the hat-trick of misfields at the rope having got there in plenty of time but kicks the ball over the rope.
great comeback ball. On a good length on fourth stump, holds its line to beat the edge.
short of a length on fourth stump angled in, defended back down the pitch.
short of a length outside off, tapped behind point to put the tailender on strike.
good length on off, defended to cover.
bouncer, Dawlat moves across his stumps but is beaten hooking.
full on middle stump, goes to the back foot to push a single to midwicket.
short of a length ball on fourth stump, tapped gently behind point for a tight run.
bouncer outside off, ducked under by Dawlat.

full and wide outside off, driven square and flat in the air toward the point sweeper Thisara. He sprints in hard but this one wasn't going to carry and he does well to field on a short-hop. Najibullah has decided that Dawlat is struggling too much to run hard and so they turn down a clear single.
bouncer, Najibullah sways back.
good length ball on middle clipped through the leg side to the midwicket sweeper. Dawlat left to see off the final ball.
bouncer. Ducks under it easily.
